title: VR Supervisor (Austin)
description:
This position is internal to TWC VR employees only.

The mission of the Texas Workforce Commission (TWC) is to promote and support a workforce system that creates value and offers employers, individuals and communities the opportunity to achieve and sustain economic prosperity. To support our mission, we are seeking to fill a Vocational Rehabilitation (VR) Supervisor position to join the North Capital Area Management Unit 3-3. This position is located at 9001 N I-35, Austin, Texas.

TWC is not considering applications from individuals who require sponsorship for an employment visa, now or in the future, for this position. This includes, but is not limited to, individuals currently on H-1B, F-1 (OPT/CPT), or H-4 visas. You must be a Texas resident to work for the Texas Workforce Commission or willing to relocate to Texas.

The Vocational Rehabilitation (VR) Supervisor is selected by and accountable to the VR Manager. Performs complex (journey-level) managerial work administering the daily operations and activities of a business function, division, or department. Work involves establishing goals and objectives; ensuring compliance with guidelines, procedures, rules, and regulations; developing schedules, priorities, and standards for achieving established goals; coordinating and evaluating business functions and activities; developing and evaluating budget requests; and monitoring budget expenditures. Plans, assigns, and supervises the work of others. Works under general supervision, with moderate latitude for the use of initiative and independent judgment.

GENERAL DUTIES\:
- Provides managerial work overseeing the daily operations and activities related to VR work.
- Supervises VR Counselors (VRC) and Transition VRCs.
- Establishes goals and objectives for achieving division goals in VR.
- Conducts and oversees mentoring and training activities including employment readiness training activities, as well as monitoring these activities.
- Performs complex consultative services in the Texas Workforce Solutions (TWS)-VR customer services programs.
- Provides technical assistance to staff, other agencies, community programs and the general public regarding division programs.
- Oversees the day-to-day operations to include, but not limited to, caseload budget management; conducting reviews to determine compliance with laws, regulations, policies, and procedures; resolving customer complaints and legislative inquiries; assisting in quality assurance and implementing continuous improvement processes; performing and monitoring community outreach efforts (including business development); hiring employees using agency selection process; approving customer services policy exceptions (under delegated authority); and conducting analyses using TWS data systems for unit quality improvement efforts and reporting requirements.
- Leads the VRCs to achieve performance outcomes.
- Performs other duties as assigned.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS\:
- One year experience as a Vocational Rehabilitation Counselor (and)
- One year experience in management or leading a team (and)
- Master's degree in Rehabilitation Counseling or Rehabilitation Management from an accredited college or university plus one year experience\: 1) in interpreting and applying VR program policies and procedures, 2) planning, implementing, and monitoring customer services, 3) coaching, mentoring and providing technical assistance for staff development, and 4) developing and providing training activities (or)
- Master's degree from an accredited college or university plus three years’ progressive experience working in a vocational rehabilitation program. With three years’ experience in areas referenced above (or)
- Bachelor's degree in Rehabilitation Counseling or Rehabilitation Management from an accredited college or university plus three years progressive experience working in a vocational rehabilitation program. With three years’ experience in areas referenced above (or)
- Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university plus four years’ progressive experience working in a vocational rehabilitation program. With four years’ experience in areas referenced above.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS\:
- Graduation from an accredited four-year college or university plus four years of full-time experience in the development, implementation, or interpretation of policies and procedures in a public or private agency, one year of which must have been in an administrative management or supervisory capacity;
- Twelve semester hours of graduate study from an accredited college or university may be substituted for each year of the required qualifying experience up to two year;
- A doctorate degree from an accredited college or university may be substituted for three years of the required qualifying experience;
- One year of full-time qualifying experience may be substituted for each year (30 semester hours) of college.

This position involves up to 30% travel (method of transportation is the responsibility of employee) and the ability to lift/carry 10 pounds.

YOU GAIN\:
- A Family Friendly Certified Workplace.
- Competitive salary $5,916.66 - $8,886.16 per month, depending on qualifications
- Defined Retirement Benefit Plan
- Optional 401(k) and 457 accounts
- Medical Insurance
- Paid time off, including time for vacation, sick and family care leave
- Additional benefits for active employees can be found at https\://www.ers.texas.gov/Active-Employees/Health-Benefits.

VETERANS\:
Use your military skills to qualify for this position or other jobs! Go to www.texasskillstowork.com to translate your military work experience and training courses into civilian job terms, qualifications and skill sets. Also, you can compare this position to military occupations (MOS) at the Texas State Auditor's Office by pasting this link into your browser\: http\://www.hr.sao.texas.gov/Compensation/MilitaryCrosswalk/MOSC_ProgramManagement.pdf.

HOW TO APPLY\:
To be considered, please complete a State of Texas Application for Employment and apply online in Taleo. TWC is not considering applications from individuals who require sponsorship for an employment visa, now or in the future, for this position. This includes, but is not limited to, individuals currently on H-1B, F-1 (OPT/CPT), or H-4 visas. You must be a Texas resident to work for the Texas Workforce Commission or willing to relocate to Texas. A position utilizing this classification will be designated as security sensitive according to the Texas Labor Code, Section 301.042.

title: Inventory Specialist
description:
About Sightpath Medical

Sightpath Medical is a leading provider of mobile ophthalmic surgical services, offering innovative solutions and technologies to enhance patient care. Our mission is to improve vision and change lives by delivering exceptional service and support to healthcare providers and their patients.

INVENTORY SPECIALIST

We are seeking a detail-oriented and organized Part-Time Inventory Specialist to join our team. The Inventory Specialist will be responsible for managing and maintaining inventory levels, ensuring accurate record-keeping, and supporting the efficient operation of our services. This role is crucial in ensuring that our medical supplies and equipment are available when needed, contributing to the overall success of our healthcare services.

Key Responsibilities

  • Inventory Management:
    • Monitor and maintain inventory levels of medical supplies and equipment.
    • Conduct regular inventory counts and reconcile discrepancies.
    • Ensure inventory records are accurate and up-to-date in the inventory management system.
  • Stock Control:
    • Receive, inspect, and store incoming shipments of medical supplies and equipment.
    • Track inventory usage and forecast future inventory needs.
    • Coordinate with suppliers and vendors to ensure timely delivery of products.
  • Data Entry and Record Keeping:
    • Accurately enter inventory data into the inventory management system.
    • Maintain detailed records of inventory transactions and adjustments.
    • Prepare and generate inventory reports as needed.
  • Quality Assurance:
    • Ensure that all inventory items meet quality standards and regulatory requirements.
    • Report any damaged or defective items to the appropriate personnel.
  • Collaboration:
    • Work closely with procurement, clinical, and administrative teams to manage inventory needs.
    • Communicate effectively with team members regarding inventory status and issues.
  • Compliance:
    • Adhere to all company policies and procedures regarding inventory management.
    • Ensure compliance with safety and regulatory standards in handling medical supplies and equipment.

title: Principal Engineer, Actuation Systems Embedded Software
description:
Date Posted: 2026-08-18

Country:

United States of America

At Raytheon, the foundation of everything we do is rooted in our values and a higher calling – to help our nation and allies defend freedoms and deter aggression. We bring the strength of more than 100 years of experience and renowned engineering expertise to meet the needs of today’s mission and stay ahead of tomorrow’s threat. Our team solves tough, meaningful problems that create a safer, more secure world.

The PCAS department is seeking an embedded software/firmware engineer to support development of a range of high-performance actuation systems, such as aerodynamic steering, thrust vectoring, attitude and divert maneuvering, pointing, and stabilization of missile systems & subsystems.

This is an onsite role:

Tucson, AZ or Huntsville, AL or Portsmouth, RI

What You Will Do​

  • You will help specify, design, verify, and integrate motor control embedded firmware for current and future precision control actuation systems.

  • You will implement digital control algorithms in C/C++ in conjunction with the Controls and Algorithms team.

  • Day-to-day the candidate will be expected to apply sound engineering practices to address technical problems while collaborating with a team including electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, control systems engineering, test engineering, systems safety engineering, and others.

What You Will Learn

  • Hands-on opportunity with firmware integration and verification testing in a laboratory environment is plentiful, thus enabling firsthand knowledge of system function and performance.

  • The position will rely on fundamental understanding of C/C++, MATLAB/Simulink, and working with electrical and mechanical hardware.

Qualifications You Must Have

  • Requires a University Degree in Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics (STEM) and a minimum of 8 years of prior relevant experience or an advanced degree and a minimum of 5 years of prior relevant experience

  • Experience with systems engineering design and/or development or experience working in a disciplined, controlled manner, fully documenting work; extensively commenting code, test benches and test software.

  • Experience with C/C++ development on embedded hardware platforms or similar.

  • Experience with model development and/or data analysis in MATLAB/Simulink.

Qualifications We Value

  • Advanced degree in Aerospace Engineering, Control Systems Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Physics or Computer Science

  • Experience developing firmware or software for safety significant environments including requirements development and traceability, design decomposition and documentation, static code analysis, design to safety critical coding standards such as MISRA-C, test case development, code coverage including modified decision/code coverage (MC/DC), code coverage analysis and formal qualification testing.

  • A working understanding of configurable logic (FPGA firmware) and VHDL).

  • Experience implementing digital control algorithms in hardware including embedded microcontrollers, digital signal processors, FPGAs and a working understanding of serial communication interfaces, analog to digital converters, and PWM generators.

  • Experience working with and integrating hardware.

  • Knowledge of actuation communication busses; UART, SPI, and I2C protocols; electromechanical actuators (using gears, ballscrews, leadscrews etc); position sensors; electronic controllers and power amplifiers; test equipment

  • Basic understanding of modeling and controls of electric motors and solid background in PMSM motor fundamentals

  • Digital and analog signal electronics design, development and verification.

  • Use of software/firmware configuration management tools such as GIT, Subversion or similar tools

  • Ability to work hands-on in teams and to articulate, in both oral and written form, to technical, non-technical and management audiences

  • Motivation to continue developing and learning on-the-job skills

What We Offer

  • Our values drive our actions, behaviors, and performance with a vision for a safer, more connected world. At RTX we value: Safety, Trust, Respect, Accountability, Collaboration, and Innovation.

  • Relocation Eligibility

Learn More & Apply Now!

The City of Fort Worth is one of the fastest growing large cities in the U.S. Our employees serve the needs of over 1,000,000 residents, promoting our values of exceptional customer experience, mutual respect, embracing our diversity, continuous improvement, ethical behavior, and accountability. 🌆

Utility Crew Lead • Water Line Maintenance • Field Supervision • CDL Jobs

Ready to lead the crews who keep Fort Worth’s water flowing? Fort Worth Water is hiring Water Field Operations Crew Leaders to oversee teams responsible for the construction, maintenance, and repair of the city’s water distribution systems.

This role combines leadership with hands-on work in the field. You’ll supervise crews, manage complex repairs, and ensure water infrastructure projects are completed safely, efficiently, and to the highest standards. Whether it's isolating leaks, coordinating emergency response, or keeping teams on task, your leadership keeps critical services running across our growing city.

If you’re an experienced operator ready to lead from the front—and want to grow your career while building something that matters—this is your next step.

Minimum Required Qualifications:

  • High School Diploma or GED equivalent.
  • Possession of a TCEQ Water Distribution Class C license (or higher).
  • Texas Class A Commercial Driver’s License (CDL) with an acceptable driving record.
  • Minimum of four (4) years of hands-on experience in water and/or wastewater field operations
  • Ability to pass a physical examination, drug screen, and education and background verification

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with work order management software (e.g., GIS, Maximo, or similar)
  • Familiarity with large-scale utility operations and infrastructure systems
  • Minimum of one (1) year of supervisory or crew leadership experience

  • Lead Crews: Provide direction, oversight, and support to field crews performing construction, maintenance, and repair activities related to water distribution systems.
  • Ensure Safe and Efficient Operations: Maintain the safe, effective, and timely operation of essential water systems, ensuring compliance with regulatory standards and City policies
  • Oversee Installation and Maintenance: Supervise the installation, repair, and maintenance of key water and wastewater infrastructure such as mains, valves, manholes, hydrants, pumps, and taps
  • Monitor Work Quality: Ensure that work is performed to high standards, adhering to established policies and procedures
  • Perform Technical Tasks: Take on complex, hands-on tasks related to the technical aspects of water systems, offering expertise and guidance to the crew
  • Promote Safety and Training: Lead by example in ensuring a safe work environment and provide on-the-job training for team members to meet safety and operational standards
  • Report and Document Operations: Maintain detailed records, prepare operational reports, and ensure proper documentation for ongoing activities and project progress
  • Support Emergency Response: Be ready to respond to emergencies affecting water and wastewater systems, providing effective leadership during crises to minimize service disruption

title: Analytical and Quality Chemist
description:

title: Maintenance Tech II
description:
PrimeSites is seeking an experienced Maintenance Technician to join our growing team. This position is responsible for maintaining the physical condition, safety, and appearance of our apartment communities while delivering exceptional customer service to residents.


This is not an entry-level maintenance position. The Maintenance Technician II is expected to independently diagnose, troubleshoot, and complete a wide range of repairs while maintaining high standards of quality, safety, and resident service.


Key Responsibilities

  • Complete service requests and work orders in a timely, professional manner.
  • Prepare apartments for new residents, including all repairs, maintenance, and quality inspections necessary to meet company standards.
  • Diagnose and repair HVAC systems, appliances, plumbing fixtures, electrical components, and other building systems.
  • Perform preventative maintenance to minimize equipment failures and extend asset life.
  • Respond promptly to resident maintenance requests while providing excellent customer service.
  • Identify and report property deficiencies, safety hazards, and capital improvement needs.
  • Participate in an on-call rotation and respond to after-hours emergencies as required.
  • Maintain accurate records of completed work orders and maintenance activities.
  • Ensure company vehicles, tools, and equipment are maintained in a safe and organized condition.

  • Minimum of 3-5 years of maintenance experience in multifamily housing, residential, commercial, or related maintenance fields.

  • Working knowledge of plumbing, electrical, drywall, painting, carpentry, and general building maintenance.
  • Valid driver's license with a satisfactory driving record.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities.
  • Tech knowledge

title: Print Production Technician
description:
About Green Dot Labs

Green Dot Labs is a premium cannabis brand founded in Boulder, Colorado in 2014 by husband-and-wife team Dave and Alana Malone. Built on proprietary genetics, small-batch cultivation, and craft extraction across Flower, Live Resin, and Live Rosin, GDL has earned multiple #1 brand rankings from BDSA and Leafly and was named Flower Brand of the Year at the 2025 Emjays. With more than a decade of leadership in Colorado and an expansion into Arizona, GDL is known for its innovation, consistent quality, and deep consumer trust.

About the Role

The Green Dot Labs (GDL) Print Production Technician is primarily responsible for the processes and equipment needed to print custom labels as designed by the marketing department and regulation-required labels accurately and compliantly. This role works closely with the marketing, branding and production teams to provide all printed materials needed to accurately label all products by coordinating across departments. The Print Production Technician is responsible for all printing equipment, maintenance and managing label supply inventory.

Responsibilities

Printing
•Print all custom labels needed for production: product, compliance and regulatorylabels in advance for use in production
•Maintain needed par level of each standard label for just in time use
•Follow all department SOPs to create accurate labels, collaborate withstakeholders and meet compliance for each type of label
•Ensure accuracy of all labels including those with required regulatory information
•Set up and run print jobs to meet GDL standards with name and other updatesand gain approval prior to printing
•Review all labels and printed materials for quality and accuracy before they leave the printshop


Workflow and Needs Planning
•Maintain organization of multiple projects, prioritize workflow, adhere to timelines, and meet deadlines, while ensuring quality and consistency throughout the printing process
•Regularly review production queues to manage daily and weekly print needs and plan to have all labels ready for production ahead of need
•Monitor jobs in production queue and communicate with production, inventory and marketing to monitor needs, requirements and timing
•Coordinate printing jobs to utilize machines and materials efficiently while to ensure timely completion of project


Typesetting
•Collaborate with marketing and branding to ensure custom labels are printed to GDL standards for design and approval prior to printing
•Utilize proven skills of typesetting and color matching to uphold GDL brand
•Maintain templates and type set all updated info for each label, keep all labels up to date and with accurate naming convention, palate and strain information
•Coordinate with necessary teams to cross check accurate labeling information before printing


Inventory
•Manage inventory of printed labels in various stages of production and organization of print supplies
•Submit supply orders with appropriate lead time for each vendor to maintain appropriate quantity on hand of needed materials for label creation and departmental needs


Maintenance
•Proactively maintain all printing equipment with regular preventative maintenance and basic troubleshooting including but not limited to; changing of ink cartridges, simple repairs, and calibration
•Coordinate with vendors when needed for troubleshooting or outside repairs
•Maintain set up of equipment for maximum output and color functionality

Compliance
•Maintain detailed knowledge of all GDL policies, procedures, SOPs and quality standards pertaining to packaging, QC, order fulfillment and inventory
•Collaborate in the department record keeping related to training and safety
•Support teams in maintenance of accurate records of product inventory and logs per company policy and legal regulations
•Maintain confident comprehension and ensure compliance with Department of Health Services Adult-Use Marijuana Program regulations as they apply to cannabis production and delivery, including but not limited to:
oR9-18-308 – Administration
oR9-18-310 – Product Labeling and Packaging


Qualifications & Requirements
•College graduate preferred
•2+ years of working experience in print or design
•General knowledge of printing materials and laminates
•Familiarity with roll-fed printers and printing processes required
•Experience Afina (L801) and Afina Cutters (DLF220S and DLF140S) preferred
•Familiarity with Sato CL4NXPlus preferred
•Ability to troubleshoot and repair equipment
•Proficiency in Adobe Suite (InDesign and Illustrator)
•Understanding of basic design principles preferred
•Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite
•Familiarity with Dutchie a plus
•Must be able obtain and maintain all required cannabis industry credentials
•Must have reliable form of transportation

Work Environment & Physical Requirements
This role is primarily onsite in Boulder, CO and requires work within a fast-paced cannabis production and print environment. The position involves extended periods of standing and working at printing equipment and computer workstations, along with regular handling and organization of labels, print materials and supplies. The role requires the ability to safely operate and perform basic maintenance and troubleshooting on printing equipment, move materials and supplies as needed, and work around production equipment, inks and other printing materials. Personal protective equipment (PPE) must be worn as required, and all work must be performed in accordance with applicable safety procedures and operational standards.

Benefits & Total Rewards
We offer a comprehensive benefits package for full-time employees working at least 30 hours per week, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, an HSA option for eligible plans, company-paid basic life and AD&D insurance, an Employee Assistance Program, paid time off, and a 401(k) plan. Benefits for most employees become effective the first day of the month following 60 days of employment. Eligible employees may participate in the 401(k) plan after 90 days of employment, subject to plan terms and eligibility requirements.


EEO Statement
Green Dot Labs provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind, including based on any legally protected status.

title: Associate Director, Employee Relations
description:
At Rocketship Public Schools, we believe in the infinite possibility of human potential. We believe that every student deserves the right to dream, to discover, and to develop their unique potential and it is our responsibility and our privilege to unleash the potential inside every Rocketeer we serve. Our non-profit network of public elementary charter schools propels student achievement, develops exceptional educators, and partners with parents who enable high-quality public schools to thrive in their community. We are a collective of parents, teachers, leaders, and students working together to transform the future for underserved communities across our country. At Rocketship Public Schools, we are unleashing potential.

Position Summary
The Associate Director of Employee Relations serves as Rocketship Public Schools’ central subject-matter expert for complex, sensitive, and high-risk employee relations matters across our multi-state, non-union network. Working closely with Regional Talent Leads, the Chief Talent Officer, organizational leaders, and employment counsel, and reporting to the Director of Organizational Effectiveness, this role conducts fair and impartial investigations, develops well-supported findings and recommendations, and helps ensure employment decisions align with organizational policies, applicable employment laws, education requirements, student-safety obligations, and Rocketship’s commitment to safe and equitable workplaces. Managing employee relations (ER) for a large, multi-state, non-union charter school network requires balancing complex state labor laws with a deep mission-driven focus on student safety. In a non-union model, this role acts as the primary champion of organizational fairness, protecting school environments from legal risk while ensuring staff feel valued and supported. The Associate Director also oversees key HR compliance operations across the network, including annual mandatory training completion, personnel records governance, internal compliance audits, and coordination of external audit and authorizer reporting requests. In partnership with Legal, Governance & Compliance, and Talent teams, this role identifies compliance gaps and coordinates timely corrective action to support alignment with applicable federal and state requirements.

Multi-State Workplace Investigations

  • Lead neutral, timely, and comprehensive investigations into complex or high-risk matters, including allegations of discrimination, harassment, retaliation, serious misconduct, and significant policy violations
  • Produce thorough, objective, and well-documented investigation reports, findings, and recommendations.
  • Maintain complete and confidential investigative files that meet organizational, legal, and regulatory requirements.

Multi-Jurisdictional Regulatory Compliance

title: Senior CRM Technical Specialist
description:
Fanatics Commerce is the global leader in licensed sports merchandise, operating a vertically integrated platform that designs, manufactures, and delivers officially licensed apparel, jerseys, headwear, and collectibles for major leagues, teams, and events worldwide. With more than 900 e-commerce sites and a global omnichannel presence across digital, in-venue, and retail, Fanatics Commerce reaches fans in over 180 countries and powers official fan experiences for many of the world's most iconic sports properties.

At Fanatics, we bring our BOLD Leadership Principles to life every day - building championship teams, obsessing over fans, acting with entrepreneurial speed, and delivering with a determined and relentless mindset.

ROLE OVERVIEW
Fanatics Commerce operates one of the most expansive fan engagement platforms in sports, powering CRM across 100+ million fans and 900+ e-commerce properties for the NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, and hundreds of teams and colleges. The Senior CRM Developer works embedded within an agile, marketing-led CRM team, owning the end-to-end execution of triggered journeys, personalized content, and the data integrations that power them — built on Adobe Journey Optimizer and Adobe Experience Platform, connected to a custom in-house commerce platform. The Senior CRM Developer delivers business and fan impact through BOLD leadership and execution excellence, leveraging data, automation, and AI-enabled insights.

HOW WILL YOU DRIVE IMPACT
Success is measured by the ability to deliver results through BOLD capabilities and measurable outcomes.

Team & Leadership Impact (Build Championship Teams)

• Partner with marketers, analysts, and technical leads to challenge assumptions and align on the right solution design before building begins, ensuring cross-functional clarity and shared ownership of outcomes.

• Document journey logic, templates, and data configurations so teammates can extend and maintain your work, raising the capability of the broader CRM team.

• Manage work transparently in Jira and GitHub, modeling strong CI/CD and agile practices that establish a higher standard for the team.

Fan & Customer Impact (Obsessed with Fans)

• Build real-time and batch journeys triggered by fan behavior — including cart abandonment, browse retargeting, purchases, price changes, inventory signals, loyalty milestones, and live game outcomes — to reach fans with the right message at the right moment.

• Develop responsive, personalized email, SMS, and push templates and reusable components in HTML, CSS, and Handlebars, tailored by team, league, player, purchase history, and behavioral signals.

• Design and execute A/B and multivariate tests across content and journey logic to continuously improve fan engagement and conversion performance.

• Troubleshoot fan-facing delivery issues end to end — tracing a profile through a journey, reading event payloads, and diagnosing why a fan did or did not qualify — to resolve root causes quickly.

Innovation & Problem Solving (Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit)

• Extend XDM schemas, configure event and profile ingestion, and build audiences from upstream commerce and fan-engagement events, going well beyond out-of-the-box platform capabilities.

• Connect the marketing technology stack to surrounding systems via REST APIs, enabling data flows that standard connectors cannot support.

• Bring an architectural mindset to CRM development — evaluating trade-offs across journey design, data modeling, and integration patterns before committing to a build approach.

• Identify opportunities to apply emerging tools, AI capabilities, and platform features to improve journey sophistication, personalization depth, and operational efficiency.

Ownership & Execution (Determined & Relentless Mindset)

• Own journey, template, and fragment changes from requirements through production deployment, with no hand-off gaps between design, build, and release.

• Manage code in GitHub using CI/CD practices, maintaining quality and deployment rigor across every release.

• Translate business problems from marketers into complete technical solutions, operating with end-to-end accountability rather than waiting for tasks to be defined.

• Track, prioritize, and deliver work in Jira with consistency and transparency, meeting commitments in an agile, fast-moving environment.

AI & DIGITAL CAPABILITY
We are building a future-ready organization. This role is expected to:
• Apply AI and technology to improve efficiency, quality, and outcomes

• Use data and digital tools to inform decisions and enhance performance

• Demonstrate curiosity and adaptability in adopting new technologies and ways of working

• Contribute to a culture of innovation and continuous improvement

CAPABILITIES & EXPERIENCE YOU BRING
Required Qualifications:

• 5+ years designing and building personalized, real-time customer journeys on an enterprise marketing platform such as Adobe Journey Optimizer, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Braze, or Iterable — depth of journey design and behavior-driven architecture matters more than platform.

• Proven experience building behavior-driven programs — abandoned cart, browse retargeting, replenishment, and similar — not only scheduled batch sends to static lists.

• Experience with custom data models and integrations, including event ingestion, profile data management, and API connectivity beyond standard platform connectors.

• Strong HTML and CSS for responsive email development, plus proficiency in at least one templating language such as Handlebars, AMPscript, Liquid, or Jinja.

• Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot complex journey and data issues — tracing profiles, reading event payloads, and resolving root causes independently.

• Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to gather requirements from marketers and explain technical trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders.

• Experience managing code in GitHub with CI/CD practices and tracking work in an agile project management tool such as Jira.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Hands-on experience with Adobe Journey Optimizer and Adobe Experience Platform, including Real-Time CDP, XDM schemas, and segmentation.

• SQL proficiency for validating data and building or QA-ing audience definitions.

• Experience building SMS or push notification programs in addition to email.

• Platform certifications in AJO, RTCDP, SFMC, Braze, or a comparable enterprise marketing platform.

• Consumer-facing personalization experience in any industry demonstrating impact at scale.

WORK LOCATION

Hybrid: The primary place of performance of this role is the Company's office located in Redwood City, CA, subject to the Company's current hybrid work policy. This role currently requires in-office presence Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday.

The salary range represents base pay only and does not include short-term or long-term incentive compensation. When determining base pay as part of a final compensation package, we consider several factors such as location, experience, qualifications, and training. For information about our benefits, please visit

Salary Range
$115,000—$165,000 USD

At Fanatics, we operate with a BOLD mindset - We Build Championship Teams, we’re Obsessed with Fans, we embrace a Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit, and we approach every challenge with a Determined and Relentless Mindset. If you’re ready to contribute to a dynamic, fast-paced environment that thrives on collaboration and growth, we want you to be part of our team.

ABOUT US
Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting & Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally.

ABOUT THE TEAM
Fanatics Commerce is a leading designer, manufacturer, and seller of licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods. It operates a vertically-integrated platform of digital and physical capabilities for leading sports leagues, teams, colleges, and associations globally – as well as its flagship site, .

Fanatics Commerce has a broad range of online, sports venue, and vertical apparel partnerships worldwide, including comprehensive partnerships with leading leagues, teams, colleges, and sports organizations across the world—including the NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, MLS, Formula 1, and Australian Football League (AFL); the Dallas Cowboys, Golden State Warriors, Paris Saint-Germain, Chelsea FC, and Tokyo Giants; the University of Notre Dame, University of Alabama, and University of Texas; the International Olympic Committee (IOC), England Rugby, and the Union of European Football Associations (UEFA).

title: Staff Software Engineer - Linux Kernel
location: Denver, CO; New York City, NY; San Francisco, CA
description:
Fastly helps people stay better connected with the things they love. Fastly’s edge cloud platform enables customers to create great digital experiences quickly, securely, and reliably by processing, serving, and securing our customers’ applications as close to their end-users as possible — at the edge of the Internet. The platform is designed to take advantage of the modern internet, to be programmable, and to support agile software development. Fastly’s customers include many of the world’s most prominent companies, including GitHub, Yelp, Paramount, and JetBlue.

We're building a more trustworthy Internet. Come join us.

Posting Open Date: 10/07/2026

Anticipated Posting Close Date*: 11/6/26

*Job posting may close early due to the volume of applicants.

Staff Software Engineer, Linux Edge Kernel

Fastly's Kernel and Host Networking team builds and ships the Linux kernel that runs on every server in our global edge network, and every customer request passes through it. As a Staff engineer you own technical problems end to end: from a crash signature or a new NIC on the bench, through root cause and design, to a change that is upstreamed and safely running on thousands of servers. The work spans networking, XDP and eBPF, memory, performance and hardware enablement. It also spans layers. Our kernel is the datapath of a distributed system whose control planes are constantly pushing new state to the fleet, so staying correct under change is part of the job. Formal CS education is not required; demonstrable experience is what matters.

What You'll Do:

  • Set technical direction for kernel projects, own them end to end from problem statement to fleet rollout, and mentor engineers on the team
  • Take new servers, CPUs and NICs from first boot to full fleet: drivers, IRQ affinity, RSS and queue layout on high core count hosts
  • Improve datapath and transport performance with XDP, eBPF and protocol work based on IETF specifications
  • Debug problems that cross layers with application teams, such as MTU behavior, cgroup memory accounting and packet filtering
  • Develop and maintain kernel changes and Fastly kernel modules on our long term kernel line, and reduce our private delta by upstreaming
  • Make sure state pushed from control planes to eBPF and XDP programs is applied, verified and safe to roll back
  • Own kernel health in production: triage crashes, WARNs and regressions across the fleet, find the root cause and ship the fix
  • Own and improve the kernel release process and the signals behind it: CI, bake, canary, staged rollout and rollback across thousands of servers, plus crash metrics and drift detection that fire before customers notice
  • Join the on-call rotation, lead the kernel side of incidents and drive follow-up actions to closure

What We're Looking For:

  • 7+ years of related engineering experience, including substantial production C, with 3 of those years leading technical projects
  • Production Linux kernel development, including debugging use-after-free, refcount and leak bugs with KASAN, kdump, ftrace, perf or bpftrace
  • Working knowledge of the scheduler and memory management (EEVDF, memcg)
  • Experience managing a kernel patch stack and working with upstream communities
  • Solid understanding of the Linux network stack (TCP/IP, sk_buff lifecycle, qdiscs, NIC drivers) and XDP or eBPF, with deep expertise in at least one of these areas
  • Operational discipline: staged rollouts, canaries, kill switches, observability, postmortems and closing action items
  • Understanding of distributed systems: control plane and datapath consistency, partial failure and safe config rollout at fleet scale
  • Ability to design broadly scoped work and drive it across teams

We’ll be super impressed if you have experience in any of these:

  • Upstream kernel contributions or subsystem maintainership
  • Deep Knowledge of Transport protocols from IETF RFCs: QUIC, TCP, ECN and L4S, MASQUE
  • Hardware enablement on AMD EPYC or Intel platforms, and NIC drivers such as mlx5, ice or i40e
  • Load balancing or traffic steering systems
  • CDN or large edge network environments
  • Container networking: network namespaces, veth, cgroups, and eBPF-based CNI datapaths

Work Hours:

This position requires availability during core business hours and participation in an on-call rotation.

Work Location(s) & Travel Requirements:

This position is open to remote and hybrid work locations in the United States. Our US Fastly offices are located in:

  • New York, NY
  • San Francisco, CA
  • Denver, CO

This position may require travel as required by your role or requested by your manager.

SF / LA Fair Chance Ordinance Statement

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Salary:

The estimated salary range for this position in the US is $211,370 to $253,644.

Starting salary may vary based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as experience, skills, qualifications, and location.

This role may be eligible to participate in Fastly’s equity and discretionary bonus programs.

Benefits:

We care about you. Fastly works hard to create a positive environment for our employees, and we think your life outside of work is important too. We support our teams with great benefits that start on the first day of your employment with Fastly. Curious about our offerings?

We offer a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision insurance. Family planning, mental health support along with Employee Assistance Program, Insurance (Life, Disability, and Accident), a Flexible Vacation policy and up to 18 days of accrued paid sick leave are there to help support our employees. We also offer 401(k) (including company match) and an Employee Stock Purchase Program. For 2026, we offer 11 paid local holidays, 12 paid company wellness days.

Why Fastly?

  • We have a huge impact. Fastly is a small company with a big reach. Not only do our customers have a tremendous user base, but we also support a growing number of open source projects and initiatives. Outside of code, employees are encouraged to share causes close to their heart with others so we can help lend a supportive hand.

  • We value diversity. Growing and maintaining our inclusive and diverse team matters to us. We are committed to being a company where our employees feel comfortable bringing their authentic selves to work and have the ability to be successful -- every day.

  • We are passionate. Fastly is chock full of passionate people and we’re not ‘one size fits all’. Fastly employs authors, pilots, skiers, parents (of humans and animals), makeup geeks, coffee connoisseurs, and more. We love employees for who they are and what they are passionate about.

We’re always looking for humble, sharp, and creative folks to join the Fastly team. If you think you might be a fit please apply! A fully completed application and resume or CV are required when applying.

All job applications must be submitted through our official careers site at www.fastly.com/about/careers. We will never request sensitive information, such as your Social Security number, bank account or credit card information during the application process. title: Area Health Information Specialist I
location: Little Rock, North Little Rock, Conway, and Pine Bluff, AR
description:
Datavant is the data collaboration platform trusted for healthcare. Guided by our mission to make the world’s health data secure, accessible and actionable, we provide critical data solutions for organizations across the healthcare ecosystem - including providers, health plans, researchers, and life sciences companies. title: Sr. Information Systems Security Engineer (ISSE) II (6836) (Up to 25k Sign-on)
description:
We are seeking a Sr. Information Systems Security Engineer (ISSE) II to join our dynamic team and play a pivotal role in safeguarding our organization's digital assets and sensitive information. The ideal candidate is a dedicated professional with a strong background in cybersecurity, a deep understanding of current threats and vulnerabilities, and the ability to implement robust security measures.

We know that you can’t have great technology services without amazing people. At MetroStar, we are obsessed with our people and have led a two-decade legacy of building the best and brightest teams. Because we know our future relies on our deep understanding and relentless focus on our people, we live by our mission: A passion for our people. Value for our customers.

What you’ll do:

  • Serve as a security engineering SME for containerized environments, service mesh technologies, and microservices.
  • Design, implement, and manage security controls for containerized workload solutions, including image scanning, firewalls, intrusion detection/prevention systems, endpoint protection, encryption mechanisms, runtime protection, role-based access control (RBAC), and network segmentation to ensure the organization’s networks and systems remain secure.
  • Integrate security into CI/CD pipelines and DevSecOps workflows, ensuring compliance with RMF, NIST SP 800-53, ICD 503, and FedRAMP requirements.
  • Configure and optimize security monitoring and logging solutions and work with container security tools such as Prisma Cloud or similar.
  • Monitor network traffic, system logs, and security alerts to detect and respond to potential security incidents; analyze and investigate anomalies and security breaches and take appropriate actions to mitigate risks; and develop and implement incident response plans to address security breaches, incidents, and other security concerns.
  • Monitor and assess threat intelligence feeds, conduct threat analysis, and perform risk assessments to proactively identify emerging threats and vulnerabilities.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams—including platform engineers, ISSOs, developers, IT, software development, and compliance—to establish, embed, and enforce security policies, standards, and procedures throughout the system lifecycle, integrate security into all phases of the development lifecycle, and ensure a comprehensive approach to cybersecurity.
  • Conduct regular security assessments of container orchestration platforms, microservices, and APIs to identify vulnerabilities and weaknesses in systems, networks, and applications and recommend mitigations.
  • Maintain thorough and accurate documentation of security architecture processes, control implementation procedures, configurations, and continuous monitoring strategies, and prepare detailed reports on security findings, incidents, and actions taken.

What you’ll need to succeed:

  • Active TS/SCI with CI Poly security clearance.
  • CISSP or equivalent certification to support DoD 8140 requirements.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field.
  • 7+ years of experience as a cybersecurity engineer specializing in designing and building implementations of required security controls and implementing continuous monitoring and auditing of solutions for compliance with security controls, with strong experience in these areas (e.g., NIST SP 800-53, RMF, ICD 503, FISMA, FedRAMP).
  • Strong skills in specifying and implementing log collection into tools (Splunk) and querying and analyzing aggregated logs to identify security-relevant anomalies or risks.
  • Experience with security tools such as Fortify, Acunetix, and Prisma Cloud.
  • Proficiency in incident response, security incident handling, and forensic analysis techniques.
  • Experience performing periodic security checks to support continuous monitoring aligned with the NIST Risk Management Framework.
  • Strong understanding of network protocols, operating systems, and infrastructure components.
  • Experience implementing controls for cloud, container, and DevSecOps services and solutions within IL5 to IL6+ environments, and hands-on experience securing containerized/Kubernetes environments (OpenShift preferred).
  • Effective communication skills, with the ability to convey complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

SALARY RANGE: $190,000 - $250,000

The salary range for this position is determined based on qualifications, skills, and relevant experience. The final salary offered will be determined based on several factors including:

  • The candidate's professional background and relevant work experience
  • The specific responsibilities of the role and organizational needs
  • Internal equity and alignment with current team compensation
  • This role is also eligible for additional compensation, subject to the terms and policies of MetroStar, which may include:
    • Performance-based bonuses
    • Company-paid training and/or certifications
    • Referral bonuses

Application Deadline: Applications will be accepted on a rolling basis until the position is filled; candidates are encouraged to apply as early as possible for full consideration.

Additional Compensation: This role may also be eligible for bonuses and/or additional incentives based on individual and company performance.

title: Quality Technician
description:
Who We Are

Zenni pioneered the online eyewear industry in 2003 with a mission to make eyewear affordable and accessible for everyone. With complete prescription pairs starting under $10, Zenni offers adults and children the freedom to see clearly and express themselves through a wide selection of high-quality prescription glasses, sunglasses, protective eyewear, and non-prescription frames - curated with fashion, function, and style in mind.

Based in the San Francisco Bay Area, Zenni has redefined the traditional retail model, emerging as the premier destination for online eyewear in the United States while surpassing 70 million frames sold globally.

Zenni is proud to be the Official Eyewear of the San Francisco 49ers, Columbus Crew, Monster Jam, WWE, Team Liquid, and more. Zenni has collaborated with designers and tastemakers on exclusive collections, including Chase Stokes and George and Claire Kittle. For more information, visit zenni.com.

About the Role

We are looking for an Optical Quality Technician that will play a critical role in our manufacturing facility by testing, documenting, and routing non-conforming eyeglass lenses. Operating at the intersection of quality control and laboratory operations, the Quality Technician uses precision optical measuring instruments to test lenses, inspect rejected lenses, identify the exact root cause of failure, and accurately record defect metrics in our Laboratory Management System (LMS). Reporting to the Quality Supervisor, this work directly ensures fast turnaround times for customer remakes while providing actionable quality data to prevent repeat manufacturing errors.

Please note: as a condition of employment for this role, you will be required to undergo pre-employment drug testing in accordance with our company policies and applicable law.

Responsibilities:

Defect Analysis & Quality Inspection:

  • Perform Detailed Inspection: Inspect non-conforming single-vision, progressive, and specialty lenses using manual lensometers, digital lens analyzers, calipers, photometers, and high-intensity bench lighting.
  • Identify Root Causes: Determine precise failure points across manufacturing processes—including generator marks, wave/power errors, axis/prism errors, AR coating crazing, edger chips, or material defects.
  • Verify Specifications: Cross-reference physical lenses against ANSI/ISO standards and original prescription job tickets.

Electronic Documentation & LMS Data Entry

  • Log Defect Metrics: Promptly log non-conforming items into the Laboratory Management System (LMS) using standardized defect taxonomies and failure codes.
  • Initiate Remakes: Authorize and generate immediate digital remake tickets to minimize overall job turnaround delays.
  • Data Integrity: Ensure accurate attribution of defect origin (e.g., department, machine, shift, material, or operator) to maintain reliable quality reporting.

Departmental Operations & Process Improvement

  • Physical Tray Management: Maintain organized sorting bins for scrapped components and ensure proper hazardous/optical waste disposal protocols.
  • Feedback Loop: Partner with cross-functional department supervisors to flag real-time defect spikes or machine calibration failures.
  • Continuous Improvement: Participate in weekly quality reviews to analyze data and recommend process adjustments.

Qualifications:

  • Experience: Minimum of 1+ year in a manufacturing environment. Must be able to demonstrate critical thinking and reasoning skills, and work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Equipment Proficiency: Demonstrated ability to operate lensometers, thickness gauges, optical layout systems, and precision testing equipment.
  • Technical Aptitude: Experience working with optical Laboratory Management Systems and optical testing equipment.
  • Attention to Detail: Excellent visual acuity (with or without vision correction) and fine visual discrimination under varied lighting conditions.
  • Sound Judgment: Ability to ask thoughtful questions, respectfully challenge assumptions, and seek clarity when evaluating decisions or recommendations.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Prior experience in Quality Assurance
  • Basic proficiency in Microsoft Office (specifically, Microsoft Excel)
  • Strong understanding of lens optics, prescription variables (Sphere, Cylinder, Axis, Add Power, Prism), lens materials (CR-39, Polycarbonate, High-Index, Trivex), and coatings (AR, Photochromic, Hard Coat).

Perks & Benefits:

  • Annual Bonus Program
  • Employee Paid - Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental & Vision)
  • Retirement Plan (401K & matching)
  • Life Insurance (Basic, Voluntary & AD&D)
  • Paid Time Off (Vacation, Public Holidays)
  • Training & Development
  • Dental insurance
  • Employee assistance program
  • Flexible spending account
  • Health savings account
  • Vision insurance
  • Free Lunch Daily
  • Referral program

At Zenni Optical, people remain the heart of our mission, even as we embrace technology that moves us forward. While we recognize the immense promise of AI, we are equally mindful of its limitations and use these tools strictly to assist our Talent Acquisition team rather than replace human judgment. We utilize AI tools as a collaborative partner to create content–such as job descriptions, interview questions, and outreach messaging–and review resumes, but we maintain a firm commitment to human-led hiring where AI never makes a final decision. Every selection is determined by a member of our team to ensure every candidate is personally valued by a human rather than an algorithm.

title: Site Attendant - Day Shift
description:
“Every person deserves compassion, dignity, and the safety of a place to call home.”

Homelessness is the largest social and public health crisis in California. Illumination Health + Home is a growing non-profit organization dedicated towards disrupting the cycle of homelessness by providing targeted, interdisciplinary services in our recuperative care centers, emergency shelters, housing services and children's and family programs. IH+H currently has 13+ facilities with 22+ micro-communities scattered across Orange County, Los Angeles County and the Inland Empire.

Job Description

The Site Attendant plays a key role in maintaining a safe, clean, and supportive environment for clients. This position is responsible for enforcing facility rules, assisting with client needs, and ensuring the overall cleanliness and safety of the site. Duties include regular sanitation of high-touch areas, general cleaning of the facility, and following health and safety protocols. The Site Attendant also supports client intakes and discharges, performs routine room checks, and responds to immediate client or facility concerns. By maintaining high standards of cleanliness and care, the Site Attendant helps promote the health, safety, and well-being of all residents. This position operates in a high-level, fast-paced, and high-stress environment that requires the ability to manage multiple priorities, make critical decisions under pressure, and maintain professionalism at all times.

The starting pay rate for this position is $20.00-22.00 per hour. This position is also eligible for $1.00 swing shift differential and $2.00 graveyard shift differential. The schedule for this role is Friday - Tuesday or Tuesday - Saturday 7:00AM to 3:30PM. Workdays may vary.

Responsibilities

Client Care & Support

  • Assist with client intakes and outtakes by preparing client bed area and ensuring bedding and surrounding areas are clean and ready prior to client arrival. Enforce client site rules and policies during admission and discharge.
  • Conduct routine wellness checks and facility walk-throughs (minimum of every 2 hours) to monitor client safety, behavior, and overall welfare. Intervene using de-escalation and conflict resolution techniques as necessary.
  • Perform scheduled and unscheduled searches of client belongings to ensure compliance with site rules and to prevent prohibited items from entering the facility.
  • Pick up client medications from pharmacies and assist with client move-outs, including the packing of belongings and final room sanitation.
  • Perform any other duties assigned by leadership to support client care and facility operations.

Meal Preparation & Food Safety
  • Prepare and serve balanced meals to clients in accordance with food safety standards (e.g., proper food storage, temperature control, hand hygiene, and cross-contamination prevention).
  • Sanitize all kitchen surfaces and equipment before and after every meal service, including countertops, prep areas, cutting boards, and utensils.
  • Ensure dining areas are cleaned and disinfected after every meal, including tables, chairs, and serving stations.

Sanitation & Housekeeping
  • Maintain a sanitary environment using universal precautions, including proper PPE usage and the safe handling/disposal of bodily fluids. Follow biohazard protocols when cleaning up spills or contamination.
  • Perform routine janitorial duties daily, including:
    • Sweeping and mopping all floors (client rooms, hallways, kitchen).
    • Vacuuming carpeted areas.
    • Emptying trash bins and replacing liners.
    • Cleaning windows, walls, and vents weekly or as needed.
  • Conduct deep cleaning of client dorms/rooms weekly or upon discharge, including disinfecting mattresses, wiping down all surfaces, laundering linens, and checking for pests or damage.

Transportation & Vehicle Maintenance
  • Drive clients to and from scheduled appointments and program activities, ensuring timely and safe transport in compliance with organizational protocols.
  • Maintain daily transportation logs, noting mileage, trip purposes, and any issues during transit.
  • Inspect company vehicles before each use and report maintenance or safety concerns to the supervisor immediately.
  • Clean and sanitize high-touch areas in vehicles (steering wheel, seatbelts, door handles, gear shift, dashboard) before and after each use.

Expectations

  • We uphold the values of Community, Action, Respect, and Empowerment in all aspects of our work.

    • Community We lead with the vision of a strengthened and compassionate community for all. By embodying collective care, we serve as an example of what is possible when we come together.

    • Action Our “whatever it takes” mindset drives us forward. We take initiative, step in where others have stepped out, and create solutions when none exist.

    • Respect We deeply value the dignity and uniqueness of every individual we serve. We honor their stories, their journeys, and their right to be seen and heard.

    • Empowerment We heal—always. Our work enables clients to grow stronger in health, confidence, and belief in their potential as they move forward on their life journey.

  • Follow all safety and sanitation guidelines

  • Set and maintain healthy boundaries with clients and staff.

  • Be able to meet targets and work under pressure.

  • Communicate any concerns and feedback to the Site Manager with tact and professionalism.

  • Demonstrate the ability to maintain confidentiality of client information and work-related information/materials.

  • Must remain in full compliance with all applicable local, state, and federal wage and hour laws, California Fair Employment and Housing Act (FEHA), as well as other regulatory and compliance standards relevant to the organization's operations.



Minimum Qualifications/Preferred Experience:

Required
  • High School Diploma or GED equivalent.
  • Basic computer skills, including the ability to send and receive emails and summarize data in spreadsheets.
  • Valid CA Driver’s License, 5 years of clean DMV record, and eligibility for company vehicle insurance.
Preferred
  • Bilingual in English and Spanish.

title: Mobile Program Coordinator
description:
If you believe a girl's ZIP code should never limit what she gets to explore, and you love bringing bold ideas to life through hands-on learning, community partnership, and a little road-trip energy, this role is for you. As our Mobile Program Coordinator, you will build a new program from the ground up and bring memorable Girl Scout experiences to girls and communities across Oregon and Southwest Washington.


The Basics

  • Pay - Nonexempt/hourly, starting at $25.24 to $30.29 per hour, based on relevant education and experience. Plus $1.25 per hour for conversational-level or higher Spanish language skills. We set starting pay with a published formula and don't negotiate, so we calculate every offer the same way.
  • Benefits - We offer medical, dental, and vision coverage; health care and dependent care flexible spending accounts; life and AD&D insurance; up to 35 days of paid time off per year, based on years of service; paid holidays; and a 403(b) retirement plan with an employer contribution. For more details, visit www.girlscoutsosw.org/careers.
  • Hours - Full-time, 40 hours per week, with evenings, weekends, and overnight travel up to 70% of the time.
  • Location - This hybrid role travels up to 70% of the time throughout Oregon and Southwest Washington, including rural communities. Most administrative work is performed remotely and requires reliable internet service and a home workspace that meets organizational remote work standards. All staff participate in in-person meetings, events, work assignments, and retreats as business needs require. You must live in Oregon or Southwest Washington.


What You'll Do

This is a rare opportunity to create something new and then see it come alive in communities across our service area. As the Mobile Program Coordinator, you will listen to girls, families, schools, and community partners; turn what you learn into engaging programs; and prepare a mobile program vehicle that is ready to roll. You will lead the soft launch in summer 2027 and the full rollout in October 2027, then continue shaping the program through every visit, partnership, and participant response. You will have room to experiment, learn, and make thoughtful decisions, backed by colleagues across programs, technology, property, communications, retail, and fund development.


Responsibilities

  • Listen to girls, families, schools, and community organizations, then turn what you learn into a clear route map for where the mobile program goes and what it offers.
  • Create hands-on, age-appropriate experiences for girls in grades K-12, bringing STEM, life skills, outdoor learning, and entrepreneurship together in programming that works in both English and Spanish.
  • Transform a large non-commercial vehicle into an inviting, organized, and safe mobile learning space, and guide the program from a summer 2027 soft launch to a full October 2027 rollout.
  • Bring the experience to life from arrival through pack-up, delivering 18 visits in FY27 and at least 35 visits annually in FY28 and FY29; about 90% of sessions will be for youth and 10% for adult volunteers.
  • Build relationships that open doors for girls, working with schools, community organizations, peer Girl Scout councils, and colleagues to find host sites, introduce the program, and keep it relevant locally.
  • Keep the program moving smoothly across a large, varied service area by driving and parking the vehicle, transporting equipment, coordinating visits and registration, and keeping supplies ready for the next stop.
  • Use budgets, grant commitments, translation and interpretation services, and participant feedback to strengthen the program and show what it is accomplishing for girls and communities.
  • Work Conditions & Physical Requirements:
    • Indoor environment - 70%
    • Outdoor events - 50%
    • Travel to other locations - 70%
    • Use of computer, phone, and other office equipment - 100%
    • Standing - 40%
    • Walking, including on uneven ground - 40%
    • Sitting - 70%
    • Loading and unloading supplies - 20%
    • Lifting up to 40 pounds - 10%
    • Pushing and pulling up to 40 pounds - 10%
    • Reaching above and below shoulder level - 10%
    • Stooping, bending, and twisting - 10%
    • Driving - 50%


What You Bring

We are most interested in finding the best person for this job, who will be successful and satisfied in the role. If you believe you are that person, we encourage you to apply, even if you do not meet every qualification listed below.

  • At least seven years of combined relevant education and experience in youth program delivery, curriculum development, teaching, community programming, or a related area. For example, a bachelor's degree and five years of experience, or seven years of experience.
  • Experience creating and leading youth programs, with the judgment to adjust an activity when a group, age level, setting, or community calls for a different approach.
  • High proficiency in English and Spanish, including creating and leading programming in both languages and communicating with Spanish-speaking families.
  • A track record of building trust with schools, community organizations, families, and people whose experiences may differ from your own.
  • Warm, clear communication and facilitation skills that help youth, families, volunteers, colleagues, and partners know what to expect and feel welcome participating.
  • Strong project management skills, including keeping deadlines, budgets, supplies, travel details, and multiple partners moving toward a shared launch or event.
  • Comfort turning attendance, feedback, and other program data into useful decisions, compelling updates, and accurate grant reports.
  • Intermediate to advanced Microsoft 365 skills, including Outlook, Teams, Word, and Excel, plus comfort learning project management and customer relationship management platforms.
  • A valid driver's license in good standing and a driving record that meets our motor vehicle records standards, plus state-required minimum
    auto insurance if a personal vehicle is used.
  • Comfort driving and parking a large non-commercial vehicle, such as a cargo van, and traveling up to 70% of work time, including evenings, weekends, rural routes, and overnight trips during peak seasons.
  • Preferred:
    • Experience delivering mobile or community-based programs.
    • Experience measuring, tracking, and reporting outcomes for grant-funded programs.
    • Experience facilitating learning for adults.


About Girl Scouts of Oregon and Southwest Washington

Girl Scouts builds girls* of courage, confidence, and character, who make the world a better place. Girls in grades K–12 try new things, take on challenges, and discover what they're capable of. They explore STEM, camp under the stars, run their own cookie businesses, and lead projects that make their communities kinder. Along the way, they find friends who cheer them on and a place where they can truly be themselves.

Across Oregon and Southwest Washington, girls join the fun in troops, at camp, at local events, and on their own, guided by dedicated adult volunteers. Our staff make that possible. We support volunteers, create programs, run camps, and keep the council running so every girl has a place to belong.


Our culture and values guide how we work together to deliver on our mission:

  • Joy: We make space for joy every day and build a workplace where everyone is genuinely glad to be here.
  • Inclusion: We listen with curiosity, remove barriers to participation before being asked, and keep learning how to better serve every community.
  • Integrity: We follow through, treat everyone equitably, and speak up when something isn't right.
  • Agency: We trust each other with real responsibility and make sure every voice helps shape what happens next.
  • Mission-Driven: We connect our daily work to outcomes for girls and co-create solutions with the communities we serve.


We're building a workplace where everyone can contribute, grow, and belong, and everyone on our team helps create it through ongoing learning, reflection, and action.


*We use the word "girl" expansively and welcome all youth from kindergarten through 12th grade who see our girl-centered leadership experience as the right fit for them.


Equal Opportunity

Girl Scouts of Oregon and Southwest Washington is an equal opportunity employer. If you need an accommodation at any point in the hiring process, please contact HR@gsosw.org.


How to Apply

Submit your application via our Careers site. You don't need to include graduation dates or pay history.

description:

At CesiumAstro, we are developers and pioneers of out-of-the-box communication systems for satellites, UAVs, launch vehicles, and other space and airborne platforms. We take pride in our dynamic and cross-functional work environment, which allows us to learn, develop, and engage across our organization. The Skylark product line is focused on the rapid design, build, and test of cutting-edge active phased array antennas (AESA) for terrestrial and airborne applications. Current programs span high-power, large-scale ground terminals for missile defense to commercial airline and helicopter connectivity solutions.

We are looking to add a Senior Program Scheduler to our team. In this role you will lead program scheduling activities by developing, maintaining, and analyzing integrated master schedules for complex programs. This role contributes to successful program execution by evaluating schedule performance, resolving complex scheduling challenges, and providing schedule analysis that supports program objectives and customer requirements.

Working cross-functionally with program management, engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, finance, and production, this role supports schedule planning, schedule maintenance, performance reporting, and program execution.

JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Develop integrated master schedules, schedule baselines, and planning methodologies supporting complex programs and customer requirements.
  • Evaluate program scope, work breakdown structures, resource requirements, milestones, and dependencies while developing executable program schedules.
  • Conduct schedule planning meetings, baseline reviews, and schedule updates throughout the program lifecycle.
  • Lead integrated schedule management by coordinating schedule activities, dependencies, milestones, and progress updates across multiple functional organizations.
  • Evaluate schedule performance, critical path activities, schedule variances, forecasting, and schedule risks while resolving complex scheduling challenges.
  • Validate schedule integrity through schedule health assessments, baseline control, forecasting activities, and schedule recovery planning.
  • Lead coordination with program management, engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, finance, contracts, and production to support program scheduling activities.
  • Develop schedule reports, milestone charts, executive dashboards, schedule metrics, and performance analyses supporting program reviews and business decisions.
  • Coordinate program reviews, schedule assessments, customer meetings, and cross-functional planning activities by providing schedule recommendations and execution guidance.
  • Manage scheduling documentation, schedule baselines, change records, forecasting data, and scheduling files supporting current and future programs.
  • Evaluate scheduling processes, scheduling standards, customer requirements, and program performance while identifying opportunities to improve execution.
  • Develop improvements that enhance schedule accuracy, forecasting effectiveness, reporting efficiency, cross-functional coordination, and overall scheduling performance.

JOB REQUIREMENTS AND MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree in project management, business administration, operations management, finance, or a related field with 5–8 years of related experience, Master's degree with 3–6 years of related experience in program scheduling, project controls, project management, operations, or a related discipline.
  • Advanced knowledge of program scheduling, integrated master scheduling, and project planning principles.
  • Experience developing integrated master schedules, schedule baselines, forecasting models, and schedule performance analyses for complex programs.
  • Strong understanding of critical path methodology, schedule risk analysis, earned value concepts, resource planning, and project lifecycle management.
  • Experience evaluating schedule performance, identifying schedule risks, and developing recovery strategies that support program objectives.
  • Experience leading cross-functional scheduling activities while balancing program priorities, customer milestones, and organizational objectives.
  • Demonstrates sound judgment when leading scheduling activities, resolving complex scheduling challenges, and supporting strategic program decisions.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite including Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Teams.
  • Scheduling and project management tools, e.g. Microsoft Project, Primavera P6, Open Plan, or equivalent applications.
  • Data analysis and collaboration tools, e.g. Power BI, SharePoint, Jira, or equivalent applications.
CesiumAstro considers several factors when extending an offer, including but not limited to, the role and associated responsibilities, a candidate’s work experience, education/training, and key skills. Full-time employment offers include company stock options and a generous benefits package including health, dental, vision, HSA, FSA, life, disability and retirement plans.
