Our commitment to innovation, creativity, and philanthropy drives us to explore new frontiers, create unforgettable experiences, and build a legacy that inspires future generations.

About the Role

As the Director, Branded Content & Partnerships – Financial Services at MrBeast, you will lead post-sale operations for high-profile integrations with key financial services partners. Operating at the core of Client Leadership, Creative, Production, Post-Production, and Sales Marketing Operations, you transform innovative partnership concepts into seamless, high-impact production plans aligned with client goals.

You will champion the execution lifecycle from contract signing to comprehensive wrap reporting. As the primary client-facing leader across production timelines, on-set executions, edit workflows, and multi-stakeholder approvals (Marketing, Legal, Compliance, and Product Marketing), you will orchestrate real-time creative solutions while safeguarding project vision and client trust. Additionally, you will integrate robust measurement frameworks upfront and leverage performance analytics to continuously sharpen future renewal strategies.

Based in the Greenville, NC area, where you’ll work in-office five days per week, with flexibility for weekend and irregular hours when required by production. You’ll maintain close, daily collaboration with Studio, Creative Development, Post, Legal, Sales, Sales Marketing Operations, and executive client teams to deliver exceptional results in a fast-paced setting.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead sold partnerships seamlessly from initial production briefing through final delivery and insightful reporting.
  • Spearhead integration schedules in close coordination with Studio, Post, and Creative Development. Serve as the main client liaison.
  • Host and guide client teams during production shoots, delivering an exceptional on-set experience and clear alignment at every step.
  • Coordinate with the client’s product and growth marketing teams on app onboarding and card activation efforts connected to content launches.
  • Manage on-set compliance for financial disclosures, rates, terms, and banking disclaimers, and build required reviews of visual and verbal elements by the client’s Legal and Compliance teams into the production workflow.
  • Oversee the on-set handling of cash, card, and prize elements in coordination with client compliance teams, ensuring physical cards, payment props, and demo environments are set-ready.
  • Streamline client review and approval workflows across brand Marketing, Legal, Compliance, and Product Marketing divisions.
  • Drive creative agility and adaptive problem-solving on set and in post-production to ensure deliverables hit the highest creative bar.
  • Develop high-level performance wrap reports that distill key analytics into strategic recommendations for upcoming renewals.
  • Partner with Sales Marketing Operations to embed key performance metrics into activation plans prior to production.

What We’re Looking For

  • 15+ years of leadership experience including branded content activation, integrated production, and/or executive-producer-level content project management.
  • Direct experience running enterprise-scale branded integrations for a Fortune 100 marketer at a major network, streaming platform, brand, or agency.
  • Product marketing or licensed merchandise experience is a strong differentiator given the role’s co-branded product component.
  • Experience in a regulated industry, particularly financial services or banking, is strongly preferred.
  • Working knowledge of financial marketing regulations and comfort partnering with client legal and compliance teams.
  • Native production literacy. You have worked on sets and understand how call sheets are built and how post-production workflows and tight editing schedules run.
  • Expertise in managing complex enterprise client relationships.
  • Exceptional organizational leadership and project management rigor across all phases of execution.
  • Strategic partnership mindset, with equal confidence leading executive strategy meetings and hands-on production environments.
  • Valid U.S. driver’s license.

Fixed annual salary of $178,000 - $223,000 plus an annual bonus, an employee equity plan grant, and comprehensive benefits.

Equity grants are issued in good faith, subject to company policies, board approval, and individual eligibility.

Benefits

The Perks, Why Work On the MrBeast Team

We are redefining what entertainment and storytelling look like at global scale. Every piece of content we publish reaches millions and influences culture in real time. This is your opportunity to lead the team that decides how those moments come to life across every screen.

title: Principal Software Platform Engineer | AI Infrastructure & MLOps
description:
Job Description

A high-growth technology company is seeking a Lead Software Platform Engineer to own the architecture, scalability, and operational excellence of a next-generation AI and machine learning platform. This is a rare opportunity to shape the foundation that enables complex AI workloads to run securely, reliably, and at scale in highly regulated environments.


This role sits at the intersection of distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, AI/ML operations, and software platform engineering. You will serve as a technical leader responsible for defining how AI models, large language models, and intelligent agents are deployed, governed, monitored, and operated in production.


The platform you help build will be a customer-facing product rather than an internal tool. Your work will directly influence how sophisticated organizations apply AI to mission-critical workflows, requiring a balance of innovation, reliability, security, and cost efficiency.


The Opportunity

As a senior technical leader, you will own the strategy and architecture for AI infrastructure that supports production-grade machine learning and generative AI systems. You will collaborate closely with software engineers, data engineers, AI practitioners, and platform teams to design systems that are scalable, observable, secure, and maintainable.


This position is ideal for someone who enjoys solving large-scale technical challenges and has experience building platforms that support external users, stringent compliance requirements, and demanding service-level expectations.


You will have significant influence over technical direction, platform standards, architectural decisions, and engineering best practices while helping mentor and elevate other engineers across the organization.


What You'll Be Responsible For

  • Owning the architecture and technical roadmap for a cloud-native AI and machine learning platform.
  • Designing and scaling infrastructure that supports model deployment, model lifecycle management, prompt management, and multi-model serving.
  • Building reliable systems for both real-time and batch inference workloads.
  • Developing frameworks for running and operating LLM-based applications, retrieval systems, and intelligent agent architectures in production.
  • Establishing platform-wide standards for security, governance, tenant isolation, and data protection.
  • Creating robust evaluation frameworks that measure model quality, detect regressions, and support safe releases.
  • Defining observability practices including monitoring, alerting, logging, tracing, and performance management.
  • Driving reproducibility, lineage, auditability, and compliance requirements across AI workflows.
  • Contributing to infrastructure automation and deployment processes using modern cloud engineering practices.
  • Leading technical design reviews and acting as a trusted advisor on architecture, scalability, reliability, and platform strategy.
  • Evaluating emerging AI technologies, frameworks, and tooling while making informed build-versus-buy decision.
  • Supporting operational excellence through incident response, production readiness reviews, and continuous improvement initiatives.


What We're Looking For

You are an experienced platform engineer or technical architect who has spent your career designing and operating large-scale cloud systems. You understand what it takes to move AI and machine learning workloads from experimentation into production environments where reliability, cost control, security, and performance matter.


We're particularly interested in engineers who have built customer-facing AI infrastructure rather than internal-only tools.


Key Requirements

  • 10+ years of software engineering and cloud infrastructure experience.
  • Proven success designing and scaling distributed, cloud-native systems in production.
  • Experience serving as a technical lead, architect, or principal-level engineer responsible for major architectural decisions.
  • Deep hands-on experience building and operating AI/ML infrastructure at scale.
  • Strong knowledge of modern LLM architectures and production deployment patterns, including retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), prompt lifecycle management, embeddings, and tool integration.
  • Advanced coding skills in Python and TypeScript, with a strong focus on backend services and API development.
  • Experience with model lifecycle management, deployment workflows, and model-serving infrastructure.
  • Strong understanding of software quality, automated testing, release management, and CI/CD practices.
  • Familiarity with cloud-native technologies including AWS, containers, and infrastructure-as-code tooling.
  • Experience designing secure multi-tenant systems and handling sensitive or regulated data.
  • Expertise in monitoring, observability, reliability engineering, and service-level management.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence technical direction across multiple teams.


Highly Desirable Experience

  • Production experience with agentic AI systems and orchestration frameworks.
  • Knowledge of advanced model serving, latency optimization, and cost management techniques.
  • Experience supporting multimodal AI workloads involving images or other complex data types.
  • Exposure to model optimization techniques such as fine-tuning, distillation, or performance tuning.
  • Background operating AI systems within regulated industries where auditability and compliance are critical.
  • Experience working in data-intensive, scientific, healthcare, pharmaceutical, or similarly complex environments.


Why This Role Stands Out

This is a high-impact leadership position where you'll help define the future architecture of a rapidly evolving AI platform. You'll work on meaningful technical challenges involving scalability, reliability, security, governance, and production AI operations while partnering with a team that views engineering excellence as a strategic advantage.


If you're excited by the challenge of building the platforms that power next-generation AI applications and enjoy solving difficult infrastructure problems at scale, we'd love to hear from you.


Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States. Sponsorship is not available for this position.

title: Senior Program Manager, Customer Success
description:
Who are we and why should you join us?

ConcertAI is building the future of precision medicine. We use advanced artificial intelligence and real-world data to transform how healthcare and life sciences generate evidence, make decisions, and improve patient outcomes—starting in oncology and rapidly expanding across therapeutic areas. Our teams partner with the world’s leading pharmaceutical companies, providers, and research organizations to solve some of healthcare’s most complex challenges.

At the core of our innovation is Cara, our next-generation AI platform that unlocks powerful insights from complex clinical, imaging, and molecular data. Combined with our Precision Suite—which unifies real-world data, advanced analytics, and scalable evidence generation—these solutions are transforming how clinical development, regulatory, and commercialization decisions are made.

ConcertAI brings together a portfolio of purpose-built solutions, including TeraRecon, an industry leader in advanced imaging and AI-driven visualization, and CancerLinQ, the ASCO-originated oncology platform advancing care quality and large-scale discovery.

Joining ConcertAI means working alongside bold thinkers, builders, and healthcare experts on innovative, high-impact products that directly improve patient lives. You’ll be part of a fast-growing, mission-driven organization at the forefront of AI-enabled healthcare, with meaningful opportunities for growth and leadership.

Your Opportunity

As a Senior Program Manager in the Customer Success department of the Clinical Solutions business unit, you will oversee entire programs of customer engagements and serve as central source of customer information. You will report to the Executive Director, Customer Success and collaborate in a cross-functional environment with representatives from Business Development, Data Products, and Client Services. This is a client-facing role where you will ensure program delivery meets customer needs, increases satisfaction, drives adoption, and strengthens long-term relationships. Your responsibilities will focus on deriving maximum value for customers from all contracted products and services. This role will contribute to corporate goals that progress the company’s portfolio of products and operational efficiency.

How You'll Make an Impact

  • Act as a central hub of customer information and disseminate insights to Business Development, Customer Success, Operations, and Client Service delivery teams.
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders to create comprehensive program plans including tasks, timelines, milestones, team assignments, and deliverable responsibilities.
  • Serve as a point of contact for program-level customer engagements, including developing agendas, preparing meeting content, leading discussions, synthesizing minutes, and coordinating action items.
  • Advocate for the customer with internal teams by collecting and analyzing customer feedback, understanding requirements, conducting gaps assessments, synthesizing findings, and driving internal change.
  • Manage interdependencies across unique client engagements, facilitate collaboration to optimize outcomes, and advise on prioritization as needed.
  • Develop expertise and consult on end-to-end workflows, key stakeholders, best practices, and common pitfalls related to client solutions.
  • Monitor KPIs related to program progress, customer engagement, and overall satisfaction; build dashboards and provide regular status updates to strategic and operational leads.
  • Identify risk and issues across the client program, define and lead mitigation tactics, implement issue resolutions, and perform escalations as needed.

What You'll Bring

  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant field or equivalent combination of education and professional experience.
  • PMP (Project Management Professional) or similar certifications preferred.
  • Minimum of seven years of experience in program management, client management, project management, or a related role.
  • Proven track record of managing multi-faceted client engagements and delivering successful outcomes.
  • Strong project management skills with the ability to handle multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills for managing internal and external stakeholders.
  • Analytical skills to interpret data and make informed decisions.
  • Proficiency in project management tools and software (e.g., Smartsheet, Jira, OpenAir).
  • Customer-focused mindset with a commitment to enhancing client satisfaction.
  • Ability to work effectively in a cross-functional team environment.
  • Strong problem-solving abilities and attention to detail.
  • Adaptability to changing priorities and a fast-paced work environment.
  • Understanding of data management, scientific methods, and/or prior collaborations on projects using large healthcare datasets such as claims, electronic medical records, or patient-reported outcomes preferred.
  • Experience within the oncology space related to one or more specific solid tumor types or hematological malignancies preferred.

More of description here

Salary Range
$89,000—$134,000 USD

Learn More About ConcertAI

Our team at ConcertAI is dedicated to transforming healthcare decision-making through the application of RWE and AI to improve patient outcomes. We work in a fast-paced, dynamic, high-performing culture where diversity, collaboration, and innovation are valued. Join us on our quest to create a world free of disease. Learn more about ConcertAI at www.concertai.com , or follow us on LinkedIn. Serving 1,300 clinical sites globally, TeraRecon - a ConcertAI company - is a Best in KLAS solution provider for AI-empowered radiology, oncology, cardiology, neurology, and vascular surgery. In the future, the combination with ConcertAI could bring a single, advanced AI-augmented diagnosis and interpretation capability from clinical trials to patient care.

Job Summary\:

The Department of Neurosurgery is seeking a Research Collaborator to assist Dr. Kevin Lillehei, with the collating and analysis of the clinical data accumulated within the multi-disciplinary Pituitary Program, over the last several decades. This position will require the individual to review clinical data, perform analysis, and independently review its importance with regard to clinical impact. Functions will include assistance, and often the lead, in manuscript preparation and submission.

Key Responsibilities\:

· Collaborate with and support clinical and research personnel, and other stakeholders, within the Pituitary Program.

· Perform scientifically rigorous data management and bioinformatic analyses

· Develop and disseminate a variety of tools designed to access relevant clinical and sample data

· Creatively and effectively integrate data from multiple sources to accelerate discoveries

· Independently and creatively identify bioinformatic and data management solutions

· provide the biostatistical/data science expertise and leadership in study design, study oversight, data management, data analysis and manuscript preparation to assist all levels of biomedical investigators and clinicians on new research activities across a wide range of disciplines

· Serve as a resource to PIs and other stakeholders

· Act as a Subject Matter Expert and authority in the area(s) of Neurosciences

· New grant application data analysis for clinical trial design and power calculations

· Additional grant and publication assistance as needed

Work Location\:

Remote – this role is eligible to work remotely, but the employee must be in the United States.

Why Join Us\:

The Department of Neurosurgery at the University of Colorado continues to expand. We currently have ~ 40 MD faculty, > 30 Advance Practice Providers, and various Research faculty. Our Department spans CU Anschutz, Children’s Hospital of Colorado, the Denver VA, Longs Peak Hospital, and Highlands Ranch Hospital, and consists of both general and specialized surgeons with expertise in Neuro-Spine, Endovascular Neurosurgery, Skull-Based/Tumor, Functional and Stereotactic, Neuro ICU and Neuropsychology. We offer a leading ACGME approved residency program in Neurosurgery that alternates between 2 and 3 resident opportunities each year. One-year fellowships are offered in all our specialties for advanced training. We are a top 20 Neurosurgery department in NIH funding. The Department of Neurosurgery believes in investing in our faculty, staff and trainees and provides opportunities for their growth and wellness.

title: Director of Manufacturing Engineering, Imaging
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE JOB

As the Director of Manufacturing Engineering, your role encompasses the strategic oversight and tactical management of manufacturing engineering and systems to support both the development of new products and the scaling of high-volume production in Waltham, MA. You are charged with ensuring rigorous manufacturing processes are in place, resulting in the consistent delivery of superior quality products to our customers. Your leadership will also guarantee the fulfillment of manufacturing’s capacity commitments while driving advancements in digital tools and methodologies to improve design, analysis, and execution. This role demands an innovative and adaptable approach to solving complex manufacturing challenges in a highly dynamic environment.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Build & Lead the Manufacturing Engineering Team: Recruit, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of manufacturing engineers and technical staff. Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement across the organization.
  • Drive Manufacturing Strategy & Technology: Develop and implement a long-term manufacturing engineering strategy aligned with Anduril Imaging's growth objectives. Drive adoption of automation, advanced manufacturing technologies, and digital manufacturing tools to enhance efficiency and scalability across development and high-volume production.
  • Lead New Product Introduction (NPI): Partner with R&D and product development teams to ensure seamless transition of new products from design to production. Champion Design for Manufacturability (DfM) and Design for Assembly (DfA) principles early in the development cycle to de-risk production scaling.
  • Scale Production Capability: Evaluate, plan, and prioritize supply chain, production, and test optimizations to ensure the value stream can reliably meet production output goals. Develop business cases for vertical integration or supplier diversification where strategic partnerships will accelerate scalability.
  • Drive Continuous Improvement & Complexity Reduction: Lead initiatives to improve yield, reduce cycle time, and lower cost across the manufacturing value chain. Drive commonality optimization, component and supplier rationalization, and process standardization to simplify production at scale.
  • Resource & Budget Management: Manage budgets, staffing, and capital equipment planning for the manufacturing engineering organization. Forecast headcount and operational needs to support rapid scaling, including classified production environments.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related technical field; Master's degree or MBA preferred.
  • 12+ years of progressive experience in manufacturing engineering and operations, with at least 5 years in a leadership role managing manufacturing engineering teams.
  • Demonstrated experience owning manufacturing value chains for complex electro-mechanical or imaging hardware — defense, aerospace, or adjacent industries strongly preferred.
  • Strong background in make-vs-buy analysis, contract manufacturer management, and supplier development for precision hardware.
  • Experience managing NPI and scaling production in high-growth environments with condensed timelines.
  • Familiarity with optical system integration and test, precision assembly, or imaging hardware manufacturing.
  • Knowledge of automation, advanced manufacturing technologies, and digital manufacturing tools.
  • Familiarity with quality systems (ISO 9001/AS9100) and PLM, MES, and ERP systems.
  • Hands-on experience physically manufacturing hardware (assembly, soldering, machining, fabrication, etc.).
  • Excellent leadership, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance.
US Salary Range
$220,000—$292,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

  • No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

  • Please always verify communications:
    • Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.
    • Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

  • Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

  • What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

title: Research Assistant I, Children's Research Institute
description:
WHY UT SOUTHWESTERN?
With over 75 years of excellence in Dallas-Fort Worth, Texas, UT Southwestern is committed to excellence, innovation, teamwork, and compassion. title: Data Engineer, MS stack
description:
Haluatko hyödyntää ja kehittää osaamistasi Microsoftin data- ja analytiikkaratkaisuissa?

Mikäli vastasit KYLLÄ ja KYLLÄ, jatka lukemista, sillä etsimme kokenutta Data Engineeriä vakituiseen työsuhteeseen!

Tehtävästä

Meillä (Senior) Data Engineer työskentelee modernien data-alustojen parissa aina datan lähteistä analytiikan mahdollistamiseen saakka. Työsi painottuu erityisesti tietovarastointiin, dataintegraatioihin sekä skaalautuvien data-alustojen suunnitteluun, rakentamiseen ja ylläpitoon Microsoft Fabricin ja muiden modernien datateknologioiden avulla.

Työtehtäviisi kuuluu datan kerääminen ja integrointi eri lähteistä, tietovarastojen sekä dataputkien suunnittelu, toteutus ja ylläpito sekä datan laadun, eheyden ja tietoturvan varmistaminen. Rakennat ratkaisuja, joiden avulla asiakkaamme voivat hyödyntää dataa tehokkaasti raportoinnissa, analytiikassa ja yhä useammin myös tekoälyratkaisuissa.

Meillä konsultit työskentelevät hybridisti tai virtuaalisesti toimivissa asiakaskohtaisissa projektitiimeissä. Tämän lisäksi sinulla on oma pysyvämpi "kotitiimi", jossa tuki ja sparraus ovat aina lähellä.

Työn keskeiset vastuualueet

  • asiakkaiden liiketoiminta- ja datatarpeiden ymmärtäminen ja kääntäminen käytännön teknisiksi ratkaisuiksi,

  • tietovarastojen, dataputkien ja integraatioiden suunnittelu, toteutus ja ylläpito,

  • datan laadun, luotettavuuden, tietoturvan ja hallittavuuden varmistaminen,

  • asiakkaiden sparraaminen data-alustojen ja datanhallinnan parhaissa käytännöissä,

  • oman osaamisen jatkuva kehittäminen niin data-alustojen, analytiikan kuin AI-avusteisten työskentelytapojen osalta.

Toivomme sinulta kiinnostusta hyödyntää tekoälyä omassa työssäsi. Sinun ei tarvitse olla AI-asiantuntija, mutta ymmärrät, miten AI-avusteiset työkalut voivat tehostaa kehitystyötä, datan käsittelyä ja ongelmanratkaisua sekä ymmärrät laadukkaan ja tietoturvallisen datan merkityksen analytiikka- ja AI-ratkaisujen perustana.

Tehtävässä menestyminen edellyttää:

usean vuoden kokemusta IT-konsultoinnista ja asiakkaiden liiketoimintahaasteiden ratkaisemisesta datan avulla

osaamista tiedonmallinnuksesta ja moderneista tietovarastointiratkaisuista (esim. Data Vault, Data Lakehouse)

vahvaa kokemusta dataintegraatioista, dataputkista ja moderneista datateknologioista (esim. SQL, Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory, DBT, Snowflake tai vastaavat)

kykyä ottaa vastuuta omasta työstä, suunnitella tekemistäsi itsenäisesti ja arvioida työmäärää realistisesti

ymmärrystä modernien AI-työkalujen hyödyntämisestä kehitystyössä sekä siitä, millainen dataperusta mahdollistaa luotettavat analytiikka- ja AI-ratkaisut

sujuvaa suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa

Henkilönä meillä menestyy utelias, analyyttinen ja oma-aloitteinen ongelmanratkaisija, joka haluaa jatkuvasti kehittää osaamistaan. Sinulla on konsultatiivinen työote ja kyky rakentaa luottamusta erilaisten asiakkaiden kanssa. Osaat sisäistää asiakkaan tarpeita, haastaa ratkaisuja tarvittaessa ja löytää toimivia sekä pitkäjänteisiä tapoja kehittää asiakkaan datakyvykkyyksiä.

Eduksi katsomme

Microsoft-sertifikaatit (esim. DP-700 tai DP-750) sekä Databricks ja Snowflake -sertifioinnit

osaamisen tietovarastojen suorituskyvyn optimoinnista

ymmärryksen dataratkaisujen rakentamisesta generatiivisen AI:n, Copilot-ratkaisujen tai muiden AI-käyttötapausten tarpeisiin

ymmärryksen AI-, ML- tai AutoML-ratkaisujen toteuttamisesta Microsoft Fabric-, Databricks- tai Azure-ympäristöissä

ruotsin, norjan tai tanskan kielen osaamisen

Moninaisten vastuiden lisäksi tarjoamme sinulle:

  • työyhteisön, jossa sinulla on mahdollisuus kehittyä yhdessä mahtavien asiakkaidemme ja osaavien kollegoiden kanssa

  • mahdollisuuden Microsoft-teknologioiden koulutukseen ja sertifiointeihin

  • mielenkiintoisia ja haastavia projekteja Microsoftin uusimmilla teknologioilla ja vaihtelevilla projektihallintamenetelmillä

  • joustavat työaikajärjestelyt sekä monipuoliset, työnantajan tukemat harrastusmahdollisuudet ja yhteiset tapahtumat

  • mukavia työtovereita ja vauhdikkaan ilmapiirin, jossa työtä tehdään tiiviisti yhdessä pilke silmäkulmassa, rautaisella ammattitaidolla

Kiinnostuitko?

Lisätietoja tehtävästä ja rekrytointiprosessista antaa Talent Acquisition Lead Tomi Mänttäri tiistaisin klo 14–16 ja keskiviikkoisin klo 8–10, puh. 040 865 9599.

Innofactorilla on Pohjoismaiden laajin Microsoft-ekosysteemin ratkaisutarjonta ja johtava osaaminen. Innofactorilla työskentelee noin 550 innostunutta ja motivoitunutta huippuasiantuntijaa Suomessa, Ruotsissa, Tanskassa ja Norjassa. www.innofactor.fi

title: Measurement Technician
description:
The Measurement Technician will perform field measurement work for oil and gas customers, with an emphasis on accuracy, safety, reliability, and complete documentation.

Requirements

• 1–3 years of oil and gas measurement or related technical experience preferred

• Working knowledge of gas and/or liquid flow measurement and meter calibration

• Strong mechanical and troubleshooting skills

• Valid driver's license with an acceptable driving record

• Dependable, detail-oriented, and safety focused

• Ability to work independently in a field environment

Job responsibilities

• Verify and calibrate gas and liquid flow meters

• Verify and calibrate pressure and temperature transmitters and liquid level instrumentation

• Inspect and verify measurement data at custody transfer points

• Perform meter tube inspections and air leak inspections

• Troubleshoot measurement discrepancies and equipment issues

• Complete and maintain customer- and BLM-required calibration records and field reports

• Work closely with Production and I&E personnel to identify and resolve measurement issues

Knowledge, skills & responsibilities

• Familiarity with oil and gas production facilities

• Strong documentation and recordkeeping habits

title: Senior QA Engineer
description:
Company Overview:

Global Technology Services is a rapidly expanding organization situated in Medellín, Colombia. We pride ourselves on possessing one of the most influential networks within software development and IT services for the entertainment, financial, and logistics sectors. Our corporate projections offer a multitude of opportunities for professionals to elevate their careers and experience substantial growth. Joining our team means engaging with expansive engineering teams across Latin America, Philippines and the United States, contributing to cutting-edge developments in multiple industries.

Position Title: QA Engineer Automation

Category: Quality Assurance & Testing

Seniority: Senior



Location: LATAM

What you will be doing:

We are seeking a Quality Automation Engineer (QE) – Microsoft Fabric to ensure the accuracy, completeness, reliability, and overall quality of enterprise data pipelines and data products built on Microsoft Fabric.

The Quality Engineer will be responsible for designing and executing comprehensive testing strategies across data ingestion, transformation, aggregation, and end-to-end data pipelines. This role will validate KQL and SQL-based transformations, business logic, data reconciliation, and data quality across a Medallion Architecture (Bronze, Silver, and Gold).

The ideal candidate combines strong data engineering and testing skills with a modern AI-enabled quality engineering mindset, using AI-assisted tools to accelerate test development, defect analysis, root-cause investigation, and technical documentation.

Required Skills & Experience

  • Senior-level experience in Quality Engineering, Data QA, Data Engineering QA, or a closely related discipline. testing data pipelines, ETL/ELT processes, and data transformations.

  • Mid-to-senior level SQL proficiency, including the ability to write complex queries for:

    • Data validation

    • Reconciliation

    • Aggregation verification

    • Duplicate detection

    • Completeness checks

    • Transformation validation

    • Root-cause investigation

  • Demonstrated experience designing and executing data-focused test strategies rather than solely application/UI testing.

  • Experience with test automation frameworks, automated data validation, or QA automation.

  • Experience working with cloud-based data platforms and data-processing services.

  • Experience using an AI coding/development assistant such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Kiro, Amazon Q Developer, or a comparable tool for debugging, test development, code analysis, or technical documentation.

  • Should have experience with the individual Azure-native services that make up the Fabric capabilities (i.e. Azure Data Factory, Azure Notebook, Databricks, etc.).

  • Familiarity with Medallion Architecture (Bronze, Silver, Gold).

  • Optional Experience testing pipelines implemented with KQL.

Soft Skills

  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.

  • Ability to work independently and within a team environment.

  • Strong communication skills with the ability to articulate, diagram and document complex engineering concepts.

Why you will love GTS:

  • Join a powerful tech workforce and help us change the world through technology

  • Professional development opportunities with international customers

  • Collaborative work environment

  • Career path and mentorship programs that will lead to new levels.

Join GTS and contribute to shaping the data landscape within a dynamic and growing organization. Your skills will be honed, and your contributions will play a vital role in our continued success. GTS is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Residential Construction Risk Management Field Inspector
description:
PEG, LLC is in its twenty-eighth year being a diverse energy efficiency, engineering, environmental and management consulting firm operating principally in the Eastern and Central United States.

PEG, LLC is proud to partner with many of the nation’s leading homebuilders in delivering construction compliance services. Our mission is to deliver innovative, data-driven solutions that support high-performance buildings, sustainable development, and client success across residential and commercial sectors. We strive to continually improve building energy efficiency and therefore, the quality of homes and life in the communities that we service.

PEG, LLC offers a comprehensive, total rewards package that includes competitive compensation and a flexible benefits package that reflects our commitment to creating a diverse and supportive workplace.


Please visit our website at to learn more about PEG!


Competitive Compensation Package with Full Benefits Includes:

  • Company-issued Gas Card, Toll Pass, & Vehicle Maintenance Allowance (in addition to salary)
  • Company-issued Uniforms, iPhone/iPad, Field Equipment/Tools including Personal Protective Equipment (PPE)
  • Flexible Work Schedule – Year Round Employment – No Weekends – Monday to Friday Only!
  • Visit a construction site and see the job in action during the interview process!
  • Paid On The Job Training – Paid Professional Development through Learning/Certification Opportunities
  • Pay increases available for approved job-related certifications
  • 20 Annual Paid Days Off (12 Days of Personal Time Off, Birthday PTO, 7 Company Paid Holidays)
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan with up to a 4% company match vested immediately
  • Company Sponsored Medical Insurance that includes a contribution of up to 50% off the monthly premium
  • Dental & Vision Insurance, Short-Term & Long-Term Disability, Accident & Pet Insurance, Basic Life & Supplemental Life Coverage

THE ROLE

PEG, LLC is seeking a detail-oriented construction professional to oversee the inspection and execution of the company’s Risk Management Program across residential, multi-family residential, and light commercial developments. This role is essential to protecting construction quality, reducing risk exposure, and strengthening client confidence throughout the building process.

Through paid hands-on training, the selected candidate will monitor projects from foundation through final turnover, ensuring compliance with program standards, manufacturer specifications, and applicable codes. By conducting plan reviews, coordinating critical stage inspections, maintaining accurate documentation, and proactively addressing field issues, this position directly reduces rework, improves efficiency, and safeguards project margins.

Serving as a key liaison between PEG, clients, and contractors, this individual will drive accountability, resolve field challenges, and promote adherence to established standards. The role requires strong communication, organization, and technical construction knowledge to ensure consistent execution and continuous improvement across assigned sites.

This position delivers measurable impact by elevating build quality, minimizing construction risk, and enhancing client satisfaction across diverse project types.

Job Location:

The geographical area assigned to this position includes a 200-mile radius with Trenton, NJ at its center.

Essential Areas of Responsibility:

Start Process

  • Monitor construction activity to ensure structures are inspected within the established parameters of the Risk Management Program
  • Monitor Risk Management Program to ensure accuracy and completion of information is collected for each inspection type.
  • Attend new client and community orientation and kickoff meetings
  • Complete a comprehensive plan review of all products being inspected and retain product information for Client/Management Company
  • Review product specifications to ensure applications meet the manufacturers' specifications.


Inspections

  • Constantly monitor the client’s daily construction schedule to be on site for program inspections. Items for inspection include Footings, Concrete Slabs/Wall/Foundation, Framing/Sheathing, Exterior Envelope/House Wrap, Sound Testing/Sound Channel, and Final Turnover for each site.
  • Assigned inspections will fluctuate will client construction schedules.
  • Continually evaluate the effectiveness of the Risk Management Program and make recommendations for improvements
  • Coordinate with client contractors as needed to complete Risk Management Program
  • Maintain construction documents and schedules on SharePoint
  • Support the Field Operations Department with daily pre-drywall and final inspections, as needed


Site Management

  • Ensure adherence to PEG/Client safety program
  • Oversee the startup of all assigned new sites
  • Ensure daily inspections and field reports are conducted in each assigned site
  • Must become completely familiar with assigned site blueprints and specifications
  • Responsible for coordinating the completion of each structure within the Risk Management Program with client(s)


Contractors

  • Ensure we are maintaining a mutually beneficial relationship between contractors and clients
  • Ensure contractors/clients adherence to established Risk Management Program
  • Solicit feedback and provide support to client for handling contractor conflicts make final decisions regarding resolution of issues


Client Satisfaction

  • Resolve any client conflicts during the Risk Management Program process
  • Follow up with client(s) after inspection to ensure they understand report(s) and answer any questions
  • Ensure clients receive proper training for the Risk Management Program
  • Review client’s feedback with respect to the Risk Management Program and implement any changes or improvements where necessary


Miscellaneous Responsibilities

  • Stay current on all codes and code changes and communicate information to management as necessary
  • Determine ways to execute all functions of the Risk Management Program more efficiently to improve overall margins and client satisfaction for the company
  • Ensure all Risk Management files are maintained for each assigned site and, upon closing, ensure the company policy for storage is followed
  • Must have a good working knowledge of the company and the ability to communicate this information to clients and assigned personnel
  • Communicate, immediately, any major client issues to management.
  • Perform other duties as assigned by the Company.


Education and/or Experience:

  • 3 - 7 years of Residential Construction Experience, including the entire building process from concrete to turnover to builder.
  • Must be willing to obtain additional certifications/licenses as required (i.e. ACI Concrete Field Testing Technician – Grade 1)
  • OSHA 10-Hour and/or 30-Hour Certification is not required but is a plus


Physical Demands:

  • Must be able to work outside during summer high temperatures
  • Ability to work in attics, basements, and crawl spaces
  • Ability to climb, balance, kneel, crawl, and lift
  • Ability to work on ladders (up to 30’) and hand/power tools
  • Ability to frequently lift and move 50 pounds unassisted


Additional Requirements:

  • Must be personable, well-groomed, articulate, and able to convey technical information in plain language
  • Must be organized, self-motivated, and enthusiastic
  • Must be willing to obtain additional certifications/licenses as require
  • Valid driver’s license in good standing with insurable driving record
  • Must have reliable transportation (Gas/Vehicle Allowance included)
  • Must be able to drive for long periods to and from job site locations


PEG, LLC is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer.


PEG, LLC uses E-Verify to confirm the identity and employment eligibility of all new hires.

title: Retail Specialist- Part-time
description:
About REP:

REP designs world-class, innovative gym equipment that is sold around the world, and we are now expanding into apparel, supplements, athletes, and events. REP was established in 2012 by two brothers who shared a deep passion for fitness. From our humble beginnings of selling bumper plates out of a small garage, REP has experienced remarkable growth, now occupying over 300,000+ square feet of office and distribution space in the USA and internationally. With a dedicated team of over 200+ fitness enthusiasts, our vision is to be the #1 Strength Brand in the World. Our commitment to innovation, customer service, and value sets us apart.

We believe in building a culture centered around fitness, so we specialize in outfitting home gyms, commercial gyms, and strength and conditioning facilities. Our dedication to excellence has been recognized many times – as one of Inc. 5000’s fastest-growing private companies; as Newsweek’s Reader’s Choice Best Exercise Equipment Brand; and as the most popular brand in the home gym market (with cost in mind) by Garage Gym Experiment. From Men’s Health to Self.com, Garage Gym Reviews, and Men’s Journal, REP’s products are consistently named the best in their class. We also boast impressive partnerships, such as providing F45’s functional racks worldwide. Our team works out together, and we regularly invite fitness superstars to join us. We organize fun challenges to test our limits – and the limits of our equipment.

At REP, we continue to grow and bring new opportunities for those who want to be a part of a winning team. We firmly believe that being surrounded by like-minded individuals fuels creative energy and fosters a fun and collaborative work environment.

This role is based in Lafayette, CO at our brand-new, state-of-the-art showroom — and yes, the views of the Rocky Mountains are just as epic as they sound. Nestled in one of Colorado's most charming towns, just minutes from REP headquarters, this is a workplace that actually inspires.

Fuel your best work with a fully stocked kitchen loaded with healthy snacks, energy drinks, and protein — because we believe great people deserve great fuel. This is an in-person role, five days a week, and honestly? With a team this passionate and an environment this dialed-in, you'll want to be here.

Our Core Values:

Think Like a Customer – We empathize with our customers; understand the "why" behind every decision we make.

Progress not Perfection – We don’t let perfect get in the way of good; we are better today than we were yesterday.

Positive Attitude – Be a glass half-full kind of person and remember to have fun.

Teamwork without Ego – We put the team above ourselves; we only win together.

Take Initiative – We drive momentum; if there is an opportunity to make us better, we want to hear it.

About This Role:

Are you passionate about fitness and love connecting with people? As a part-time Retail Sales Specialist at REP Fitness, you'll be at the heart of our Denver Showroom experience, helping customers find the equipment that fuels their goals during our busiest days of the week.

The expected hours for this role will be Saturday 10:00 AM – 6:00 PM and Sunday 12:00 PM – 5:00 PM.

You'll collaborate with a driven team of retail and commercial specialists, supported by the Showroom Manager, while building real relationships with customers through in-person, phone, and email interactions. From guiding a first-time buyer to closing a major sale, every conversation is an opportunity to make an impact.

Essential Functions: Include the following. Other duties may be assigned.

  • Provide world-class service to our in-store customers.
  • Assist customers with selection of gym equipment by maintaining thorough knowledge of all products.
  • Assist in loading the order after being selected by stockroom staff.
  • Maintain a clean showroom to provide customers with an optimal shopping experience.
  • Process sales orders, returns and exchanges.
  • Respond promptly to customer inquiries and issues via email or phone when not assisting an in-store customer.
  • Record details of actions taken with customers in CRM.
  • Participate in ongoing product training to remain up to date with REPs newest products

What You Will Bring:

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • Ability to read and interpret documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, and procedure manuals.
  • Ability to write routine reports and correspondence.
  • Ability to speak effectively before groups of customers or employees of an organization.
  • Ability to solve practical problems and deal with a variety of concrete variables in situations where only limited standardization exists.
  • Ability to interpret a variety of instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram, or schedule form.
  • Be able to do simple technical troubleshooting for computers, phones, and other personal devices
  • Ability to calculate figures and amounts such as discounts, interest, commissions, proportions, percentages, area, circumference, and volume.
  • Ability to apply concepts of basic algebra and geometry.
  • Have a basic understanding of Microsoft Office programs such as Excel, Word, PowerPoint, or equivalent programs.
  • Be able to quickly learn how to navigate and use complex warehouse management systems and customer relation management systems.

Education and/or Experience:

title: Biorepository Technician II
description:
Position Summary:

The Biorepository Technician II will perform with a high degree of accuracy and quality a variety of laboratory-related activities including cryopreservation of biological samples that arrive daily in the repository. This position requires skills in data reconciliation and using the reporting features of the BSI.

Essential functions of the job include but are not limited to:

Data Reconciliation:

  • Investigate and resolve data discrepancies in conjunction with project collaborators
  • Prepare and analyze reports from the BSI to identify possible errors in data
  • Verify discrepancies noted by Lab Assistants during withdrawal or inventory procedures
  • Complete Investigation tasks in specimen requisitions

Monitoring of freezers:

  • Respond to freezer alarms in accordance with standard operating procedures
  • Monitor freezers, refrigerator and room temperatures as assigned by Manager

Receive biological samples:

  • Unpack specimens and record all pertinent information in Incoming Shipment Batch and incoming folder
  • Create a folder to house all associated paperwork
  • Store at appropriate temperature following guidelines set by procedures
  • Distribute confirmation of shipment receipt form if required by project

Receive supplies into inventory:

  • Verify shipment contents against packing list
  • Quarantine Raw Materials for release by QA department

Inventory of Frozen Biological Samples:

  • Utilize Quality Control Vials to estimate volume of frozen samples
  • Check information on sample vial against information provided by the study site
  • Scan samples into data management system, BSI
  • Correct paperwork where necessary and inform supervisor/manager of any discrepancies by generating a discrepancy report
  • Assist in the inventory of returned specimens
  • Aliquot frozen specimens utilizing aseptic technique

Retrieve Frozen Samples from Inventory and Ship:

  • Pull samples according to requisition, SOP, and instructions
  • Perform quality control verification of outgoing samples
  • Update Outgoing Batch Record
  • Contact receiving labs prior to shipment to confirm shipping address and ensure contact will be available to receive specimens
  • Ship samples (dangerous and non-dangerous goods) by Commercial or local courier
  • Complete all paperwork (link-up forms, aliquot forms, return forms or BSI data collection sheets and any other forms which may be necessary)

Miscellaneous:

  • Perform annual competency assessments for Repository staff
  • Label vials and shipping boxes
  • Perform dry shipper QC
  • Coordinate and execute the quarterly temporary freezer inventory
  • Coordinate Repository Equipment preventative maintenance
  • Keep current on IATA Shipping Regulations and maintain certification and standards
  • Carry out other duties/projects as assigned

Qualifications:

Minimum Required:

  • High School Diploma or equivalent combination of education and experience
  • 2 years’ of general working experience

Other Required:

  • Must possess basic laboratory skills
  • Experience in written and verbal communications and a strong documentation background in a laboratory setting with respect to regulatory requirements (cGMP, cGLP or ISO) and Standard Operating Procedures
  • Current knowledge of IATA Shipping Regulations and maintenance of certification and standards
  • Requires good attention to detail, excellent documentation skills and must work well in a group environment
  • Familiarity with excel and basic functions with the program
  • Must be a flexible agile team player who can change activities and directions quickly and respond to a variety of assignment and changing business needs
  • Ability to lift and carry between 31-50 lbs.; Ability to lift up to 50 lbs. overhead with assistance; frequently required to sit, stand and walk for prolonged periods; occasionally required to squat, bend, stoop, push, kneel, reach and perform tasks with repetitive motion; Will be exposed to a cold freezer environment (Freezer temperatures range between -20ºC -196ºC)
  • Must be able to read, write, speak fluently and comprehend the English language

Preferred:

  • 1 year of relevant lab experience
  • Trained in aseptic technique

The rise of heavy-lift launch vehicles is shifting the industry from an era of mass constraint to one of mass abundance, and we believe this new era demands a fundamentally different class of spacecraft. Engineered to survive the harshest radiation environments and to fully capitalize on today's and tomorrow's massive rockets, K2 satellites deliver unmatched capability at constellation scale and across multiple orbits.

With multiple launches in 2027 and plans to scale to 100 satellites a year, we're Building Bigger — helping develop the solar system and build toward a Kardashev Type II (K2) civilization. If you are a motivated individual who thrives in a fast-paced environment and you're excited about contributing to the success of a high-growth Series D-funded company, we'd love for you to apply.

The Role

We're looking for a stellar Platform Engineering Intern to join our team for a 3-month internship. You'll join the team responsible for the overall development and integration of K2's satellite bus, gaining exposure to how we drive bus-level design integration and technical readiness from concept through launch. You'll work alongside the engineers who own vehicle design, program schedule, and cross-functional coordination, supporting the day-to-day work that keeps a satellite platform program moving. This role offers broad exposure to how a satellite platform comes together end-to-end, the opportunity to contribute directly to active engineering efforts, and the chance to own impactful pieces of work in K2's highly collaborative environment.

Responsibilities

  • Support bus-level design integration efforts, helping track vehicle design status and technical readiness across subsystems
  • Assist in developing and maintaining engineering schedules, milestones, and requirements documentation for the satellite platform
  • Support cross-functional coordination with engineering teams to help assess vehicle readiness, track technical changes, and flag risks
  • Help support internal design reviews, ensuring documentation aligns with requirements
  • Contribute to process and analysis framework improvements that support the team's growth
  • Get hands-on exposure to how a satellite platform program is run end-to-end, from design through flight readiness

Qualifications

  • Must be currently enrolled in a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in mechanical, electrical, aerospace, or other relevant engineering discipline
  • 6+ months experience of technical engineering skills outside of the university setting classroom (eg: laboratory, research, extracurricular project teams, volunteering, personal projects or prior internship/work experience)

Additional Requirements

  • Available for a minimum 12-week internship in person at our HQ in Torrance

Nice to Have

  • Prior leadership experience for projects or teams
  • Ability to work well in an integrated collaborative team environment, including frequent interactions with technicians, engineers, and managers
  • Experience testing and troubleshooting spacecraft and their related components and systems, including subsystem checkouts and system acceptance testing
  • Experience or exposure in a test or automation role

Compensation

  • Hourly pay range for this non-exempt role is $30 - $40 per hour
  • Hourly rate will be based on several factors including, but not limited to: knowledge and skills, education, and experience level
  • Housing and travel stipend may also be available

If you don’t meet 100% of the preferred skills and experience, we encourage you to still apply! Building a spacecraft unlike any other requires a team unlike any other and non-traditional career twists and turns are encouraged!

If you need a reasonable accommodation as part of your application for employment or interviews with us, please let us know.

Export Compliance

As defined in the ITAR, “U.S. Persons” include U.S. citizens, lawful permanent residents (i.e., Green Card holders), and certain protected individuals (e.g., refugees/asylees, American Samoans). Please consult with a knowledgeable advisor if you are unsure whether you are a “U.S. Person.”

The person hired for this role will have access to information and items controlled by U.S. export control regulations, including the export control regulations outlined in the International Traffic in Arms Regulation (ITAR). The person hired for this role must therefore either be a “U.S. person” as defined by 22 C.F.R. § 120.15 or otherwise eligible for a federally issued export control license.

Equal Opportunity

K2 Space is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with K2 Space is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.

title: Instructional Professor (open rank) in Data Science
description:
Data Science Institute

Description

Position Description

The Data Science Institute invites applications for the position of Instructional Professor (open rank) in the area of Data Science. The selected candidate will be appointed as Assistant Instructional Professor, Associate Instructional Professor, or Instructional Professor, depending on qualifications. Appointments will be made in the Data Science Institute.

The appointment will be for a term of up to five years, renewable. This is a career-track position with potential progression, competitive salary, and benefits. This position is expected to begin on or around September 1, 2027. The terms and conditions of employment for this position are covered by a collective bargaining agreement between the Service Employees International Union (SEIU) and the University.

In addition to teaching (an average teaching load is 2 courses per quarter in the fall, winter, and spring quarters), the candidate will also be expected to keep regular office hours, contribute to non-classroom instructional or service duties and ongoing professional development.

This position is benefits-eligible. The University of Chicago offers a wide range of benefits programs and resources for eligible employees, including health, retirement, and paid time off. Information about the benefit offerings can be found in the Benefits Guidebook ().

The University of Chicago is implementing an ambitious plan for research and education in Data Science and AI, including new undergraduate and graduate academic programs and new cross-disciplinary research programs. The Data Science Institute () is a collaboration among the Department of Computer Science (), the Department of Statistics (), and other units on campus. Topics of interest include safe and trustworthy AI, foundations and applications of artificial intelligence, world models, large language models, scientific AI, data ethics and privacy, data visualization, societal impacts of data and AI, data engineering, and scalable data and AI systems. The Data Science Institute focuses on fundamental advances at the intersection of data science, artificial intelligence, statistics, and computing in the context of real-world and domain-specific problems. The Committee on Data Science (codas.uchicago.edu) is the home of data science education programs. The larger data science community at the University of Chicago includes the Committee on Computational and Applied Mathematics (), the Toyota Technological Institute at Chicago (TTIC), the Polsky Center for Entrepreneurship and Innovation, Fermilab, and Argonne National Laboratory.

Qualifications

Required:

  • By the time of appointment, a PhD in statistics, computer science, or some field of mathematics or science where data science concepts play an important role.
  • At least one year of university-level teaching experience, either as an instructor of record or as a teaching assistant.

Preferred:

  • Training, credentials, or experience in teaching undergraduate and graduate courses in data science or machine learning.

Application Instructions

Applications must be submitted online through the University of Chicago’s Academic Jobs website: .

Review of applications will begin on December 1, 2026 and will continue until all positions are filled.

The following materials are required:

  • cover letter;
  • curriculum vitae, including teaching experience and publications;
  • syllabi of courses previously taught and/or designed by the candidate or sample syllabi of proposed courses
  • teaching statement, which should include information about the candidate’s teaching and mentoring activities, teaching philosophy and goals; must include a list of courses the candidate is qualified to teach;
  • three confidential letters of recommendation requested via Interfolio.
  • Additional evidence of pedagogical accomplishment and promise, such as, but not limited to: a teaching portfolio, recent course evaluations, third-party observations of the applicant’s teaching, or other relevant assessments.

Salary Range:

Assistant Instructional Professor: $94,000 - $119,000; Associate Instructional Professor: $102,000 - $129,000; Full Instructional Professor: $110,000 - $140,000. This base pay range is for a nine-month academic appointment. Individuals may be eligible for additional summer work for additional pay.

Equal Employment Opportunity Statement

The University of Chicago is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, national or ethnic origin, shared ancestry, age, status as an individual with a disability, military or veteran status, genetic information, or other protected classes under the law. For additional information please see the University's Notice of Nondiscrimination ().

Job seekers in need of a reasonable accommodation to complete the application process should call 773-834-3988 or email equalopportunity@uchicago.edu with their request.

title: Mission Operations Product Manager, Group 5 Mission Autonomy
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Develop Mission Autonomy products that support the operation of Group 5 autonomous air vehicles
  • Drive product development for the entire lifecycle from initial requirements development to fielding
  • Define product roadmaps and timelines, guide cross-functional product decisions, and manage engineering risk
  • Working closely with engineering leads and business development, evaluate trades to enable exploration of early designs
  • Develop autonomy behavior and supporting product requirements. Collaborate with engineering teams to implement requirements
  • Work collaboratively with cross-functional teams, including software engineers, hardware engineers, test engineers, and program managers, to define test requirements and ensure alignment between system capabilities and mission objectives in complex operational scenarios
  • Plan, execute, and analyze mission autonomy tests in simulated environments that replicate real-world scenarios to validate system performance and identify areas for improvement, iterating rapidly to refine autonomy behaviors and supporting products
  • Support business development teams by being the product voice at the table with customers through customer briefings/demonstrations/exercises
  • Support business development in creating and maintain updated presentation templates of product capabilities that can be used as an 80% solution for customer briefs

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Operational experience as a Pilot or CSO/NFO of USAF, USN, USMC 4th or 5th generation fighter/bomber aircraft or RPAs
  • Self-starter with high ownership, mission-oriented mentality. Desire to see the product meet the need of the end customer
  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret test data, diagnose system behaviors, and recommend actionable improvements
  • Organized and detail-oriented, with strong verbal & written communication skills
  • Proven track record of working collaboratively with multidisciplinary teams to achieve project milestones and deliverables
  • Experience in leading system design and development from initial concept through delivery to customers
  • Ability to leverage operational experience and technical knowledge to make educated decisions and leverage engineering trades in the absence of clear customer requirements
  • Willingness to work flexible hours. Up to 25% travel as required for customer engagements and product development activities
  • Active U.S. Top Secret security clearance and experience with Special Access Programs

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • 5th generation aircraft pilot experience preferred
  • Weapons school instructor, weapons school graduate, test pilot school graduate, Developmental or Operational Test experience
  • Bachelor’s degree in STEM, or equivalent experience in a relevant field
  • Direct experience in the development, testing, and deployment of mission autonomy systems in a defense or aerospace context
  • Familiarity with agile software development practices
  • Knowledge of current industry and military standards related to unmanned aerial systems and their operation within national airspace
  • Familiarity with the principles of mission autonomy, unmanned systems, and the integration of multiple assets into cohesive operational frameworks
US Salary Range
$166,000—$220,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

  • No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

  • Please always verify communications:
    • Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.
    • Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

  • Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

  • What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit .

title: Transformer Assembly - Magnetics
description:
Magna-Power Electronics (MPE), a Flemington, New Jersey based electronics manufacturer, we believe that world-class engineering starts with a great team. We’re incredibly proud of the culture we’ve built, one that truly supports our people and has earned us award-winning workplace recognitions.


Now, as we continue to grow, we’re looking for a Transformer Assembler to join our family. At MPE your expertise won't just sit on a shelf; it will power the future. You’ll be diving into exciting, globally impactful projects, shaping everything from electric vehicle powertrains and next-generation semiconductor fabrication to particle accelerators, cutting-edge energy research, and national defense. If you're looking for a place where your work matters and your team has your back, you've found it.


Summary

The Transformer Assembler will perform a combination of winding and assembling of various magnetic components according to company specifications. The assembler will use hand and power tools, read electrical diagrams, and follow samples to complete various assembly duties or winding magnetic components. Given the complex nature of the products, there will be significant hands-on training and interaction with various Magna-Power teams.


Position Responsibilities

  • Assembling and laminating main magnetic components according to required specifications
  • Using hand tools to twist, bend, trim, strip, and crimp wire leads of transformers to required lengths
  • Soldering wire leads of transformers/inductors using hand soldering iron or solder pot
  • Varnishing and baking transformers in the oven according to department procedures
  • Gluing and clamping various chopper chokes
  • Reading blue prints and schematics
  • Assembling various inductors according to required specifications
  • Winding coils (with or without machinery assistance) as specified by data sheets and electrical diagrams
  • Operating core machine for manufacturing steel cores in assembly of the transformers


Education & Experience Requirements

  • High school diploma or GED (Required); 4 year degree or combination of experience and degree (Preferred)
  • Minimum 1-year related experience (Required)
  • Good mechanical aptitude using hand and power tools
  • Ability to read a tape measure and perform basic math
  • Knowledge in performing crimping, soldering, and assembly (Preferred)
  • Knowledge and understanding of BOMs, assembly drawings and other related manufacturing documents
    (Preferred)


Perks & Benefits

In addition to your competitive compensation, Magna-Power provides a comprehensive total rewards package designed to help you thrive:

  • Health & Wellness: Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage.
  • Financial Future: 401(k) plan with a competitive company match, plus Life/Supplemental insurance, Critical Illness & Accident plans, and FSA options.
  • Work-Life Balance: Generous accrued paid time off to unplug and recharge, and a steady work schedule (Monday-Friday).
  • Continuous Learning: Tuition reimbursement programs, certifications, conferences and additional learning opportunities to fuel your ongoing professional development and technical mastery.


An Inclusive Place to Build Your Career

We don't just build world-class products; we build exceptional careers. If you are driven to learn and innovate, you will find unlimited growth potential here.

Innovation demands diverse perspectives and minds. Magna-Power Electronics is a proud equal opportunity employer committed to an inclusive, welcoming workplace.
