title: Analyst, Family & Child Health
description:
Summary: The Analyst, Family and Child Health provides direct support to projects related to child, adolescent, and school health. This position provides technical assistance to multi-sector jurisdictional teams on evidence-based and -informed practices. The analyst supports the Leadership Exchange for Adolescent Health Promotion Plus (LEAHP+) Community of Practice and other projects on issues relating to child and adolescent health and cross-cutting projects (e.g. pediatric primary care, child nutrition, access to care, etc.).

Project Summary:

Leadership Exchange for Adolescent Health Promotion Plus (LEAHP+) Community of Practice (funded through CDC’s Division of Adolescent and School Health):

The purpose of the LEAHP+ Community of Practice is to support local and state education agencies and health departments to work together to improve health education, connection from schools to services, and safe and supportive school environments. This project aligns CDC’s What Works in Schools (WWIS) model into state-level action plans, with the goal of utilizing evidence-based practices in schools to improve adolescent health. ASTHO offers ongoing technical assistance and facilitates peer-sharing opportunities, creating a Community of Practice of state and territorial teams to encourage collaboration, learning, and enhance outcomes.

Location: Remote

Anticipated salary: $67,800 Extended experience: up to $76,000 if experience exceeds expectations

Principal Functions:

  • Supports the Director, Family and Child Health in ensuring a coordinated presence and follow up on federally funded projects
  • Assists in the development of ASTHO products such as reports, issue briefs, blogs, podcasts, newsletters, PowerPoint presentations, and webinars
  • Assists in the design and development of virtual and in-person convenings
  • Conducts, analyzes, and summarizes web-based research and original data collection with states and territories
  • Collaborates across ASTHO on cross-cutting issues related to maternal and child health
  • Responds to requests for assistance and information from members, affiliates, and national organizations
  • Participates in the evaluation of project activities and outcomes and other quality improvement initiatives sponsored by the organization
  • Establishes and manages strategic relationships with national partners
  • Assists in the development of project proposals and concept papers
  • Represents ASTHO on national advisory committees and at meetings and conferences as requested
  • Identifies opportunities for collaboration both internally across ASTHO teams, and externally by representing ASTHO at national/federal meetings, workgroups, and committees

Qualifications:

  • MPH or related degree preferred
  • Minimum 2 years of prior related experience
  • Knowledge of state or state and local public health, maternal and child health (specifically child and adolescent health) desirable
  • Strong written and oral communication skills
  • Strong interpersonal skills necessary to work effectively with a variety of colleagues, funders and state and federal officials
  • Ability to work independently and in a team environment, manage multiple projects and complete assigned tasks in a timely manner
  • Ability to communicate tactfully and diplomatically with public and internal contacts
  • Knowledge of public health systems change at local, state, or federal levels desirable
  • Ability to develop project outcome measures, track progress and evaluate outcomes
  • Ability to effectively translate and disseminate information to various groups and audiences
  • Ability to work with large networks and to represent ASTHO at meetings and conferences on public health-related issues
  • Ability and willingness to travel

Benefits:

  • Vacation leave, Sick leave, Personal days
  • 12 Holidays (with some floating options for personalization)
  • Medical, Dental, and Vision
  • Retirement Plans – 403B and Roth 403B, eligible employees can receive a company contribution up to 11.75%
  • Electronic communication stipend
  • Life and AD&D Insurance
  • Short and Long-term disability insurance
  • Additional Benefits include: Employee Assistance Program (EAP), Pet Insurance, Legal Resources, Health & Wellness reimbursement, Flexible Spending accounts, Tuition Reimbursement, and Professional Development Assistance

About Us: ASTHO is the national nonprofit organization representing the public health agencies of the United States, the U.S. territories and Freely Associated States, and the District of Columbia, as well as the more than 100,000 public health professionals these agencies employ. ASTHO members, the chief health officials of these jurisdictions, are dedicated to formulating and influencing sound public health policy and to ensuring excellence in public health practice. ASTHO is headquartered in Arlington, Virginia, and was incorporated on March 23, 1942, with the goal of helping health officials navigate a rapidly changing public health landscape and remains a strong voice in governmental public health.

This position is contingent upon the availability of grant, contract, or organizational funding. Funding levels and organizational needs may impact the duration or continuation of employment.

title: Staff Software Engineer
description:
Beacon Biosignals is transforming precision medicine for the brain, from clinical development to clinical care. For Life Sciences partners, we offer the leading at-home EEG platform for clinical development of novel therapeutics for neurological, psychiatric, and sleep disorders. Our Diagnostics business is building the most comprehensive at-home platform for precision diagnostics, combining EEG and cardiopulmonary signals to deliver reimbursable assessments for sleep and central nervous system disorders. Together, we're changing the way patients are diagnosed and treated for any disorder that affects brain physiology.

Beacon Biosignals is seeking a Staff Software Engineer to join our Datastore team. The Datastore sits at the heart of Beacon's platform. It defines our foundational data model and serves as the centralized repository and API for brain data collected from clinical studies, supporting the analytical tools, services, and applications used by our scientists, clinicians, and partners.

This role emphasizes the design and scaling of backend systems for data infrastructure: PostgreSQL data models, Kafka-driven event pipelines, and the GraphQL API that makes scientific and clinical data usable - distinct from frontend development or end-user product surfaces. At this level you will lead the design of complex systems within the Datastore rather than individual components, own the pipelines that deliver dataset snapshots into our warehouse, and collaborate across platform, application and scientific teams to implement APIs that unlock new workflows in Beacon's expanding portfolio of clinical studies and digital health products.

You should have experience writing complex SQL queries by hand, and should be prepared to reason about schema design, indexes, and query behavior as a matter of course.

Two properties of our system that shape our work may influence your application. Our GraphQL API is generated from the PostgreSQL schema using PostGraphile, so a schema decision is an API decision. Secondly, row-level security is in force on effectively every table, because clinical data from different studies and partners shares one schema, with some rows shared for access by multiple internal teams. RLS predicates get injected into your queries, which makes reasoning about query plans genuinely harder here than it is in most places. If that sounds interesting rather than tedious, you'll enjoy this team.

We are hiring two engineers into this role, with two different centers of gravity. One will focus on the breadth of the Datastore: the event pipelines, the GraphQL API, core data models, and third-party integrations. The other will focus on depth in PostgreSQL (data modeling, performance tuning, operations) and supporting all engineers in developing schemas and the access controls that protect clinical data. The core requirements are the same. Tell us which one you are most drawn to in your application.

This role is 100% remote from anywhere in the U.S. Beacon's robust asynchronous work practices ensure a first-class remote work experience, but we also have in-person office hubs in Boston, New York City, and Paris.

What success looks like

  • You lead design and architecture for complex projects and systems within the Datastore, weighing implementation trade-offs with engineering principles and backing your decisions with data rather than preference
  • You partner with product managers, scientific and clinical stakeholders, and other development and support teams to translate their requirements into new integrations, services, and solutions for scaling Beacon's data platform - contributing to broader product and technical decisions, not simply implementing them
  • You debug and profile ambiguous problems that cross system boundaries, including codebases beyond the Datastore's purview, and you leave what you touch better than you found it — structure, test coverage, tooling
  • Peers look to your work as an example: you implement features with attention to detail, demonstrating product awareness and high standards for data integrity, design soundness, and maintainability across the lifespan of the system
  • You draft RFCs to lead complex feature discovery and technical design phases, soliciting and incorporating input, and helping your team align on a set of decisions to guide development
  • You plan your own work and contribute to planning the team's, making reasoned trade-offs between speed, generalizability, and technical debt, and accounting for the needs of multiple stakeholder teams
  • You teach and mentor other engineers regularly, give feedback that people act on, and are sought out for it. You may act as tech lead on a project or as the coordination point for engineering practice within the team
  • You leverage feedback from internal stakeholders and external partners to improve operational robustness and ease of use of the Datastore and its services via new documentation, tools, and dashboards

What you will bring

  • 7+ years of backend development experience, including at least 3 years focused on data platforms and backend infrastructure for data-centric applications: transactional systems, event pipelines, and the APIs that serve them
  • Highly proficient in at least one technical area relevant to this work: data modeling, distributed systems, API design, or database engineering, with the depth that others on a team come to you for
  • Strong proficiency in SQL, with production experience working with PostgreSQL as an application database; you write and tune queries fluently and are comfortable reasoning about schema design, indexes, and query plans
  • Hands-on experience with data streaming and event processing, using Kafka (our event bus) or an equivalent such as RabbitMQ, Pulsar, or a cloud-based equivalent like Amazon Kinesis
  • Proficiency in Julia or Python; Julia is a core Datastore language, and experience with Julia is a strong plus, but not required — we welcome candidates eager to learn it!
  • Experience deploying and operating services in containerized environments, with familiarity in Kubernetes and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform and/or Helm
  • A track record of mentoring engineers and improving how a team works - practices, tooling, test coverage, or documentation that outlasted your involvement
  • A collaborative mindset: you enjoy working across disciplines and believe people achieve more together than alone
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, especially in asynchronous and remote-friendly environments
  • A self-directed approach, with a track record of thriving in hybrid or fully remote teams
  • Experience with, or interest in, using LLM-assisted or agentic coding tools in a production setting, with good judgment about what guardrails are needed

For the Datastore Systems role:

  • You can lead design across the breadth of the platform.
  • GraphQL and TypeScript/JavaScript (Node.js) - GraphQL is the Datastore's primary interface, and this profile owns significant parts of it
  • Designing event-driven pipelines end to end: producers, consumers, replay, idempotency, and what happens when a consumer falls behind
  • Leading the design of complex systems rather than individual components, across the API, the pipelines, and the services that depend on them

For the PostgreSQL & Data Modeling role:

  • You can be the person the rest of the team comes to about the database.
  • Deep PostgreSQL: you reason fluently about the query planner, index selection, and EXPLAIN (ANALYZE), and why a query that should be fast isn't
  • Data modeling: you design the schema itself: entities, relationships, and the constraints that make invalid states impossible. Including how to model time, since clinical results get re-scored and corrected and we need to answer "what did this look like when the report was signed?"
  • Schema evolution under load: zero-downtime migrations, dual-write transitions, lock avoidance, backfill and verification. Our schema has hundreds of migrations behind it and will have hundreds more
  • Operating PostgreSQL in production, not only designing for it: upgrades, replication, backup and restore, connection pooling, bloat and vacuum behaviour, extensions
  • Making others good at it: you teach, review, and document, because a schema only stays coherent if the team understands it

We don't expect every candidate to check every box. If you bring strong fundamentals, care about data infrastructure for health, and are excited to learn, we’d love to hear from you!

The US-based salary range for this role is $170,000 – $190,000. Salary ranges are determined using current market compensation data for this role and adjusted based on experience, skills, and location. The base salary is one component of the total compensation package, which includes equity, PTO and other benefits.

At Beacon, we've found that cultural and scientific impact is driven most by those that lead by example. As such, we're always seeking new contributors whose work demonstrates an avid curiosity, a bias towards simplicity, an eye for composability, a self-service mindset, and - most of all - a deep empathy towards colleagues, stakeholders, users, and patients. We believe a diverse team builds more robust systems and achieves higher impact.

title: Visual Comms Resident
description:
Job Title: Visual Comms Resident

Group/Team: Design + Marketing

Reports to:

Design Mentorship: MAS Design Team / designated Design Lead

Marketing Mentorship: Marketing Associate

Location: Remote

Employment Type: Part-time, 20-week contract, hourly

Time Period: Jan. 25–Jun. 11, 2027

WHO WE ARE

We're all creatives here, even if your title doesn't say so.

MAS is an award-winning experiential agency driven by people who care deeply about the work and the impact it creates. We design immersive environments, live moments, and digitally integrated experiences that challenge brands to move beyond the expected.

At MAS we don't settle for anything less than more. We'd rather hear the idea that scares us than the one that plays it safe, so bring your boldest self, we’re built for it. We're not for everyone. But we're everything for our people.

MAS is a member of the Opus Group, a collective of agencies including Verve and Opus Agency who together create experiences that create action for the world's most influential brands. That gives us shared services across IT, HR, Finance, and Legal, and a network of teams we lean on for best practices and global resources.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

The MAS Residency program is a 20-week tasting of our MAS special sauce — who we are, what we do, and how we do it. It's a deep dive into the experiential marketing industry, where fresh minds can immerse themselves in our world (and our clients’). During this time, residents will have the opportunity to hone and grow their skills, while also uncovering new interests and opportunities along the way. Ultimately this is a unique chance to collaborate closely with leading experts in the field, forge invaluable professional connections, actively contribute to the agency’s perspective, and depart with substantial portfolio work.

We’re not looking for coffee runners, we’re looking for cultural collaborators! Recent grads, grad students, or anyone in the event marketing industry can apply - we're looking for standout candidates ready to go above and beyond what is asked for. We want relentless learners, envelope-pushers, and creatives who are immune to ordinary thinking. You’re not just here to sit in and watch how the magic happens; you’re here to roll up your sleeves and help shape the future for the world’s most influential brands.

Now you might be thinking, this all sounds great, but what does Visual Design look like at MAS? Good question! This role is the ultimate hybrid for a visual storyteller who understands how to make a brand pop online and in real life.

We’re looking for a visual thinker grounded in graphic design, with an appetite for storytelling and a curiosity for how ideas can grow across marketing, culture, and experiences. You’ll work across Design and Marketing, creating social and internal marketing materials while developing your broader design practice through active client and experiential projects. Along the way, you’ll gain exposure to presentation storytelling, visual systems, environmental graphics, production, and the creative workflows behind live experiences.

You’re not expected to know all of this walking in. We’re looking for curiosity, an emerging point of view, and a willingness to learn through making, feedback, repetition, and close looking.

Feeling it? Awesome, we’d love to have you!

YOU SHOULD HAVE

  • A strong foundation in graphic design, including typography, composition, hierarchy, and visual storytelling, with curiosity about visual systems and how design translates across digital, print, and experiential applications.

  • Working proficiency with Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign), with an appetite to deepen your technical craft. Premiere Pro or After Effects is a plus.

  • Curiosity or experience beyond the traditional design toolkit, whether that’s Figma, TouchDesigner, AI-assisted creative tools like Flora, generative workflows, or systems-based design. We’re interested in how you explore new ways of making, not just which tools you already know.

  • Google Workspace (including Slides, Sheets, Docs, and Drive) knowledge and an interest in building clear, compelling presentation decks.

  • Required: A design portfolio that proves your talent for visual storytelling and graphic design, whether self-taught, freelance, or built through traditional experience.

  • An understanding of organic and paid social media analytics: how to interpret and create a strategy.

  • A drive to soak up industry knowledge, ask questions, and be proactive in every task you take on.

  • Interest in researching brand marketing, competitor strategy, and industry trends.

  • Experience writing and designing social-first copy, optimized for LinkedIn and Instagram. Bonus if you have SEO and keyword experience.

  • Interest in learning how Marketing, PR, and New Business work together to tell the story of MAS and its work.

  • Clear and confident written and verbal skills, across drafting emails, participating in video calls, messaging the team, and more.

  • Solid time-management and basic project-management abilities to help keep fast-moving projects on track.

  • Comfort with shifting priorities, evolving briefs, and learning how to make clear design decisions within real-world timelines.

  • Interest in understanding how social performance and audience behavior can inform creative decisions.

  • Note: you will need access to a personal laptop for the duration of the 20-week program.

ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Participate in a collaborative resident initiative that creates meaningful value for MAS while bringing the cohort’s unique perspective to the agency.

  • Partner with Marketing to concept and design content across social, email, case studies, internal communications, and other channels that showcase MAS’s creative capabilities, work, and perspective.

  • Work alongside the Design team on active client projects, contributing to concept development, presentation design, visual systems, experiential graphics, environmental applications, mock-ups, and production-ready assets.

  • Participate in regular Design critiques, mentorship, and skill-building, learning to articulate creative decisions, receive feedback, and develop work through iteration.

  • Gain exposure to different stages of an experiential project, from early creative development and client presentations through production and execution.

  • Collaborate on the development and execution of integrated marketing campaigns, ensuring all visual assets and messaging perfectly align with the MAS brand voice.

  • Compile project assets, performance data, and client narratives to write and design beautiful, comprehensive case studies for the website and New Business team.

  • Partner with the New Business team to design targeted marketing materials and customize pitch decks that support prospect outreach and RFPs.

  • Assist in social media content scheduling and review performance analytics to understand which designs and copy formats drive the most engagement.

  • Keep the team inspired by sharing interesting brand activations, emerging platforms, or experiential trends.

  • Act as an engaged team member who contributes to MAS’s culture, perspective, and growth.

  • Note: you will need access to a personal laptop for the duration of the 20-week program.

WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT IN RETURN

  • Dedicated mentorship across both Design and Marketing, with regular opportunities for feedback and development.

  • Hands-on experience across internal marketing and active client work, with exposure to how experiential projects move from concept through execution.

  • A structured Design curriculum focused on technical craft, typography, production, visual systems, design judgment, and confidence within a professional creative team.

  • Temporary position with potential for contract extension or conversion

  • A collaborative, inclusive, and enthusiastic team

HOW WE’LL TAKE CARE OF YOU

Our job titles may span more than one career level. The starting pay for this role is $22.00 per hour. Our pay ranges are based on third-party national average market compensation analysis. The actual pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs, and market demands. The pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future.

CREATIVE SUBMISSION

*SUBMIT A CREATIVE PRESENTATION ABOUT YOURSELF*

We want to get to know you! In place of a coverletter, this creative presentation is an opportunity to share how you work, projects you’re proud of, what you’re passionate about, and why MAS. Choose 1 of the MAS values, (outlined below), and share an experience that shaped you. Don’t be shy; use this presentation as an opportunity to highlight your unique personality and perspective. TL;DR BE YOU. We’re here for it.


MAS Values:

  • KEEP GOOD COMPANY - It’s about showing up in all the right ways — the friend, the devil’s advocate, the hype squad — and keeping it a damn good time through it all.

  • HAVE SOME GUTS - This is about being bold with purpose — pushing the envelope to inspire new ideas, surprise our audiences, and go beyond the expected.

  • HOLD NOTHING BACK - It’s about never settling for anything less than more — or whatever you define as the best. Day to day, it’s showing up with fiery passion, big dreams (because why the hell not), and the determination to take your shot and challenge what’s comfortable.

  • GET EMOTIONAL - This is about being madly devoted to giving a shit — they seriously can’t help the fact that they’re so passionate.

  • STAY HUNGRY - This is about always exploring, tinkering, expanding skill sets, soaking up inspiration, and asking those what if questions.

Submissions should be submitted as a PDF, but can consist of:

  • An Image/collage or mood board

  • A Word Doc (1 page max)

  • A Deck (5 slides max)

  • A Video or Audio recording (1 minute max - embedded link)

Opportunity to Present:

There will be an opportunity to present for no more than 5 minutes during the 2nd round interviews.

SUBMISSION PROCESS

  1. Create your Presentation

  2. Submit your Resume, Presentation, and other relevant Candidate Info via this Job Posting


APPLICATION DEADLINE

Applications and presentations will be accepted till filled.

NOT SURE IF YOU SHOULD APPLY?

Studies show that those identifying as under-represented individuals might have talked themselves out of applying at this point. Don’t worry about checking every single box. At MAS, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic team – so if you’re excited about this role, but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every single qualification in this job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may just be the right candidate for this role or we may have other roles that better align with your skillset.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:

Individuals will be required to sit for the majority of the day and may be required to stand as needed. title: Robotics Systems Engineer I, Robotics Delivery & Packaging Innovations (RDPI) Technology Deployment
description:
Join Amazon's Robotics Delivery & Packaging Innovations (RDPI) Technology Deployment team within Amazon Robotics (AR) organization to deploy innovative industrial robotics across North America's fulfillment network. In RDPI, we have the unique role and privilege of deploying leading edge industrial robotics and customer fulfillment technologies across the North America Stores operations. We raise the bar on the speed, quality and cost of deploying industrial technologies at scale across North America, functioning as the field team who plan, execute and launch the technologies that our internal design and product strategy partners in RDPI develop.

As a Systems Engineer in RDPI, you will be overseeing large scale project planning, installation, and launch of industrial automation technologies across Amazons growing Stores network. This field engineering position demands strong technical skills for deploying robotic equipment, including mechanical and electrical systems, network configurations, and software coordination. The ideal candidate has experience with complex electro-mechanical and network systems, large scale installations, and system troubleshooting. You will work with cross-functional partners across the Amazon Fulfillment Technology & Robotics engineering, safety, product strategy, software, supply chain, third-party installers, contracted deployment engineers, construction teams, and internal operations customer teams, functioning as the lead on-site project manager to provide technical oversight on installation Amazon-designed automation equipment. This Systems Engineer position is an individual contributor role, influencing and leading stakeholders from planning through go-live of each project. Project durations vary from a few days to several months each. This is a travel-based role and you will be expected to travel to meet the requirements of your projects across North America, upwards of 75% or more.

**Relocation to Amazon Corporate offices in Seattle, Boston, or Austin will be required for the role.

Key job responsibilities
As a Systems Engineer I, you will work with a team of 1-5 engineers and collaborate with an on-site project manager to provide technical oversight on the installation of both third party and Amazon designed robotics equipment that may be in various phases of the product life cycle. These deployments require extensive collaboration with various stakeholders, including third-party installers, contracted engineers, construction, hardware, software, IT, and other partner teams. Strong communication skills are essential for interacting with both internal and external partners and customers. As an Amazonian, you must demonstrate independent initiative to identify and solve problems in real time during deployments. A strong technical understanding, love for field work, and a keen interest in diving deep into the understanding of Amazon’s robotics systems are key attributes for this role.

- You will support and guide installation of robotics, packaging and sortation technologies at Amazon fulfillment centers
- You will develop detailed knowledge of the operation of robotic systems and guide installation, commissioning, and troubleshooting of these systems both on site and remotely
- You will manage technical ambiguity around integration of work cells in fulfillment centers
- You will collaborate with hardware engineering, technical program managers, product managers, and internal customers including site maintenance and operations teams
- You will travel to project sites and collaborate both virtually and in person to ensure all business stakeholders are aligned on program status
- You will manage day to day project scheduling and budget management
- You will work on continuous improvement activities to improve the projects in your space
- You will generate and implement continuous improvement ideas around work-scopes
- You will lead teams of other engineers on projects
- You will travel to both live warehouses and new construction sites, the scopes may vary significantly in length and include heavy travel
- You will travel to project sites across North America, upwards of 75% or more

A day in the life
In this role you will be focused on execution of end-to-end deployment and manage technical ambiguity around integration of workcells in fulfillment centers. On a daily basis you will collaborate with hardware engineering, technical program managers, product managers, construction teams, and internal customers including site maintenance and operations teams, to ensure a safe, on time, high quality product is delivered to the internal customer. You will travel to your project sites, collaborate both virtually and in person, to ensure all business stakeholders are aligned on program status. You will manage the day-to-day project execution, and work on continuous improvement activities to improve deployment execution first pass yield. You will work with senior engineers and your manager to develop technical depth and begin building strategic thinking skills for future growth.

Amazon offers a full range of benefits that support you and eligible family members, including domestic partners and their children. Benefits can vary by location, the number of regularly scheduled hours you work, length of employment, and job status such as seasonal or temporary employment. The benefits that generally apply to regular, full-time employees include:

1. Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage
2. Maternity and Parental Leave Options
3. Paid Time Off (PTO)
4. 401(k) Plan

If you are not sure that every qualification on the list above describes you exactly, we'd still love to hear from you! At Amazon, we value people with unique backgrounds, experiences, and skillsets. If you’re passionate about this role and want to make an impact on a global scale, please apply!

About the team
Are you inspired by invention? Is problem solving through teamwork in your DNA? Do you like the idea of seeing how your work impacts the bigger picture? Answer yes to any of these and you’ll fit right in here at Robotics Delivery & Packaging Innovation (RDPI) within Amazon Robotics (AR). We are a smart, collaborative team of enthusiastic doers that work passionately to apply innovative advances in robotics and software to solve real-world challenges that will transform our customers’ experiences in ways we can’t even image yet. We invent new improvements every day. We are RDPI and we will give you the tools and support you need to invent with us in ways that are rewarding, fulfilling and fun

RDPI Tech Deployment are missioned with enabling the delivery of large scale automation technologies designed and manufactured by Amazon. The team is multi-disciplinary, and consists of Field Deployment Engineers, Controls Engineering, Design for Deployment, Product Single Threaded Leaders, and a Program Management Office team, who collaborate on enabling the delivery of new technologies and packaging solutions that delight our customers, and improve the safety, quality and costs within the Amazon fulfillment processes. The team is geographically located across four North America hub locations. The work we deliver directly impact high priority goals set each year to our most senior leadership at Amazon.

  • Work cross-functionally with Design and UXR to develop intuitive ad experiences that drive clarity, performance, and long-term trust.
  • Champion ads quality and integrity, ensuring we scale monetization responsibly while maintaining an excellent consumer experience.

  • 8+ years of Product Management experience delivering highly successful, user-facing products at scale.

  • Strong analytical capabilities, including experiment design, metrics definition, and proficiency with data tools.
  • Deep customer obsession and demonstrated ability to simplify complex problems into elegant, intuitive experiences.
  • Proven success scaling products and owning business outcomes in high-growth environments.
  • Experience leading cross-functional teams across multiple geographies.

  • A “Driver” mindset—biased toward action, comfortable with ambiguity, and excellent at clarifying complexity.

  • Ability to independently pull, analyze, and synthesize data to tell compelling stories and drive decision-making.

title: Regional Structural Engineering Discipline Leader
location: Orlando, Florida, United States; West Palm Beach, Florida, United States
description:

As a Regional Structural Engineering Leader, you will be responsible for leading design of structural systems for buildings across a variety of sectors including Higher Education, Cultural & Performing Arts, Healthcare, K-12, Justice/Civic, and Science & Technology. You will lead structural engineering teams to produce high-quality construction documents using Revit and manage project schedules to meet deliverable requirements. As part of the integrated design team, you will collaborate closely with architects, engineers, and other disciplines to develop highly integrated building designs.   • Develop designs from concept through completion of construction, including engineering design calculations, detailed engineering reports and narratives, and coordination of structural design including the design of concrete, masonry, steel, wood materials; gravity and lateral systems.
  • Perform quality control of the electrical engineering plans and specifications.
  • Direct or coordinate activities of personnel, vendors, and consultants.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Civil/Structural/Architectural Engineering

title: Lane Closure Technician (LCT)
description:
Are you a hardworking and growth oriented individual looking to make a career switch?


The Universal Group, recognized as one of Canada's Best Managed companies in 2026, has an exciting opportunity in our Traffic Control team. As a Lane Closure Technician (LCT), you play an essential role in supporting the safety of your fellow roadworkers, crews and members of public on the road. You will be responsible for the safe and efficient set up, maintenance, and removal of traffic control measures in various work zones across the lower mainland. You will work with contractors involved in heavy underground, light utility, electrical, paving, road building, and special events. You role will be instrumental in ensuring safety and regulatory compliance while minimizing traffic disruptions, upholding standards, and providing a secure work environment for our teams and community.


What you will be responsible for:

Traffic Control

  • Lead Traffic Control persons, providing direction and guidance to set up and tear down signs, work zone delineations, and ensure safe traffic control.
  • Set up traffic control zones.
  • Give clear and precise traffic control directions and signals for motorists' understanding.
  • Monitor the traffic and work zone and modify when scope of work changes.

Safety and Compliance

  • Effectively conduct traffic control at worksites within the scope of training to protect workers, the public, and our employees.
  • Comply with all Acts, Regulations, Guidelines, Policies, and Procedures for health and safety.
  • Participate in accident/incident investigations as required and complete necessary forms and reports for due diligence and compliance.

Special Events and Meetings

  • Conduct traffic control at Special Events when required, following the direction of the company's Special Events coordinator.
  • Attend health and safety tool-box/tailgate meetings to discuss work related matters.
  • Hazards must be addressed in a Field Level Risk Assessment (FLRA) and must be complete prior to work commencing.

Reporting and Communication

  • Report directly to the contractor's site supervisor, taking their direction for traffic control setup and safety if no Lane Closure Technician or Traffic Control Supervisor from the company is on-site.
  • Report health and safety matters, non-compliance issues, or conflicts with any company employee to the company's Area Manager or Health and Safety Officer.

Safety Gear and Equipment

  • Always wear all personal protective equipment (PPE) as required by WorkSafeBC regulations or site safety rules, policies, or procedures.
  • Use proper protocol when using two-way radios and refrain from the use of profane or vulgar language.

Certification and Training

  • Ensures the BC Traffic Control Person (TCP) certificate is maintained to be current and valid at all times.


What you get from us:

  • Signing bonus of $1000 for experienced LCTs (terms and conditions apply).
  • A new company pickup truck and gas card!
  • A highly experienced and knowledgeable Health & Safety department dedicated to your safety on site.
  • Excellent total compensation package and vacation pay paid out on every cheque.
  • Exclusive Corporate Discounts (TELUS, HelloFresh, etc.).
  • Company Events and RRSP
  • Medical, Vision Care, Dental Care, and Life Insurance benefits coverage after probationary period
  • Opportunities for growth into higher level positions, including field, operations and health and safety positions.


What we need from you:

  • Minimum 6 months of BC LCT experience.
  • Current TCP certification recognized by WorkSafeBC or equivalent provincial regulator.
  • Drivers License with a clean driving record.
  • Possession of and ability to use a smartphone with a data plan.
  • Good knowledge and understanding of the WorkSafeBC Regulations for Traffic Control, Part 18.
  • Knowledge and understanding of the WCB Act, sections 115-117, General Duties.
  • Knowledge and understanding of the Traffic Management Plans and Traffic Management Manual for Work on Roadways as developed by the Ministry of Transportation and Infrastructure.
  • Knowledge of the requirements of the British Columbia Motor Vehicle Act and other regulations related to traffic control.
  • Ensures accountability - holding self and others accountable to meet commitments.
  • Collaborates - Builds partnerships and works collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.
  • Manages conflict - Handling conflict situations effectively.
  • Directs Work - Provides directions, delegates, and removes obstacles to get work done.
  • Situational adaptability - adapting approach and demeanor in real time to match the shifting demands of different situations.
  • Plans and aligns - plans and prioritizes work to meet commitments aligned with organizational goals.


Where/When you will be working:

  • Dispatchable region across the lower mainland.
  • Available 5 weekdays (Mon-Fri).
  • Occasional weekend work available.
  • Working outdoors in all elements and weather.


The recruitment process for this role typically lasts 1 week and includes a phone screen, behavioral assessment and an in-person interview.


Why Universal Group?


The Universal Group is driven by our purpose to provide Peace of Mind to both our clients and team members. Our people embrace our core values of being ‘Passionate, Authentic, and Driven’ in everything we do and in every decision we make every day. They are the fabric of who we are and, without question, the reason for our success and continued growth.


The safety of our team members and the public drives us daily.


The Universal Group is an industry leader in traffic control services, traffic management planning, traffic equipment supply, landscaping, temporary labour and occupational health and safety training. We are a one-stop shop, as our full suite of services ensures that we can manage projects from conception to completion.


For more information about the company, please visit our Indeed Profile!

Apply today; we can’t wait to hear from you. Come grow with us!


SIGNING BONUS


We offer a signing bonus for all experienced LCT's!

title: Chief Engineer, Electronic Warfare Payload
description:
CHAOS Industries is redefining modern defense with a multi-product portfolio that gives the ultimate advantage—domain dominance. The company's products are powered by Coherent Distributed Networks (CDN™), empowering warfighters, commercial air operators, and border protection teams to act faster, adapt rapidly, and stay ahead of evolving threats.

CHAOS Industries was founded in 2022 and has raised a total of $1 billion in funding from leading investors, including 8VC, Accel, and Valor Equity Partners. The company is headquartered in Los Angeles, with offices in Washington, D.C., San Francisco, San Diego, and London. For more information, please visit .

Role Overview:

CHAOS is seeking a Chief Engineer to own the technical direction of our electronic warfare (EW) payload, from concept and architecture through qualification, platform integration, field test, and production transition. You will lead a multidisciplinary team and be the senior technical authority across RF hardware, digital signal processing, firmware and software, and systems integration. This is a build-and-field environment where you will be accountable for getting real hardware operating in realistic conditions.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as the senior technical authority for EW payload architecture, requirements, and design decisions
  • Lead system-level trade studies, technical risk management, and design reviews (SRR, PDR, CDR, TRR)
  • Direct integration of antenna, RF front-end, digital processing, power, thermal, and mechanical subsystems into host platforms
  • Own system verification and validation, including test planning, anechoic chamber and range testing, and field test readiness
  • Provide technical leadership across RF, hardware, firmware, software, and systems teams, and mentor senior engineers
  • Partner with program management, manufacturing, and customers to translate mission needs into executable technical plans
  • Drive configuration control and the transition from prototype to production and fielding, including software and waveform updates

Minimum Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Aerospace, Mechanical, Systems, or Electrical Engineering, or a related field
  • 15+ years of experience developing EW, radar, or RF sensing and signal processing systems, including technical leadership of a program or major subsystem
  • Detailed understanding of EMSO, adversary system operation, EM countermeasure and CCM techniques and their implementation
  • Hands on experience with EW technique verification, validation, field and operational testing
  • Demonstrated experience taking a high TRL RF system through full lifecycle development, including field or flight test
  • Strong command of RF systems engineering, digital signal processing, and DoD standards for safety, environments, and test
  • Current or recent DoD SECRET clearance

Preferred Requirements:

  • Master's degree or higher
  • Current or recent DoD TOP SECRET security clearance; eligibility for SAP and/or SCI indoc.
  • Prior role as Chief Engineer, Lead Systems Engineer, or Technical Director on a fielded EW or radar program
  • Experience with SDR, FPGA-based signal processing, and RF/digital co-design
  • Experience with airborne small form-factor EW subsystem development for tactical aircraft and/or missile application
  • Experience with a prime integrator or in a fast-moving defense startup

Why CHAOS?

  • Health Benefits: Medical, dental, and vision benefits 100% paid for by the company
  • Additional benefits: 401k (+ 50% company match up to 6% of pay), FSA, HSA, life insurance, and more
  • Our Perks: Free daily lunch while you're working onsite, fully-stocked kitchen, unlimited PTO, casual dress code
  • Compensation Components: Competitive base salaries, generous pre-IPO stock option grants, relocation assistance, and (coming soon!) annual bonuses
  • Team Growth: 500+ employees and counting across 5 global offices
Salary Range: $220,000 - $300,000

The stated compensation range reflects only the targeted base compensation range and excludes additional earnings such as bonus, equity, and benefits. If your compensation requirements fall outside of the range, we still encourage you to apply. The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations.

WHO WE ARE

We're all creatives here, even if your title doesn't say so.

MAS is an award-winning experiential agency driven by people who care deeply about the work and the impact it creates. We design immersive environments, live moments, and digitally integrated experiences that challenge brands to move beyond the expected.

At MAS we don't settle for anything less than more.

That gives us shared services across IT, HR, Finance, and Legal, and a network of teams we lean on for best practices and global resources.

It's a deep dive into the experiential marketing industry, where fresh minds can immerse themselves in our world (and our clients’). During this time, residents will have the opportunity to hone and grow their skills, while also uncovering new interests and opportunities along the way. Ultimately this is a unique chance to collaborate closely with leading experts in the field, forge invaluable professional connections, actively contribute to the agency’s perspective, and depart with substantial portfolio work.

We’re not looking for coffee runners, we’re looking for cultural collaborators! We're looking for standout candidates ready to go above and beyond what is asked for. We want relentless learners, envelope-pushers, and creatives who are immune to ordinary thinking. You’re not just here to sit in and watch how the magic happens; you’re here to roll up your sleeves and help shape the future for the world’s most influential brands.

This role will require an exceptional communicator, a desire to create a budding network and passion to meet new and interesting brands. This role will be a part of the Accounts team, where we will provide many learning opportunities and the potential of working on real projects alongside the Account Managers and Directors.

Feeling it? Awesome, we’d love to have you!

YOU SHOULD HAVE

  • Working knowledge of Google Workspace (including Slides, Sheets, Docs, and Drive).

  • A natural ability to connect with others and build relationships, a foundational skill for client services.

  • A drive to soak up industry knowledge, ask questions, and be proactive in every task you take on.

  • A genuine interest in researching major brands, cultural trends, and industry news.

  • Comfort learning and navigating new digital tools and platforms.

  • Clear and confident written and verbal skills, across drafting emails, participating in video calls, messaging the team, and more.

  • Solid time-management and basic project-management abilities to help keep fast-moving projects on track.

  • A collaborative attitude amid shifting timelines and priorities.

  • A desire to learn the ins and outs of how agencies manage client expectations and pitch new business.

  • Note: you will need access to a personal laptop for the duration of the 20-week program.

ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Participate in a special capstone project with fellow residents that will result in a one-of-a-kind portfolio piece and an opportunity to present your work to the broader agency.

  • Work closely with your Accounts mentor to tackle project tasks and learn the lifecycle of a campaign from pitch to execution.

  • Assist the team with data gathering, research, and analysis to help inform team decisions.

  • Keep the team inspired by sharing interesting brand activations, emerging platforms, or experiential trends you spot in the wild.

  • Act as an engaged team member who contributes to the culture, perspective, and overall growth of MAS.

WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT IN RETURN

  • Temporary contract position with potential for extension or conversion.

  • A collaborative, inclusive, and enthusiastic team

HOW WE’LL TAKE CARE OF YOU

Our job titles may span more than one career level. The starting pay for this role is $22.00 per hour. Our pay ranges are based on third-party national average market compensation analysis. The actual pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs, and market demands. The pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future.

SUBMISSION PROCESS

  • Submit your resume and Candidate Info via this job posting.

CREATIVE SUBMISSION

*SUBMIT A CREATIVE PRESENTATION ABOUT YOURSELF*

We want to get to know you! In place of a cover letter, this creative presentation is an opportunity to share how you work, projects you’re proud of, what you’re passionate about, and why MAS. Choose 1 of the MAS values, (outlined below), and share an experience that shaped you. Don’t be shy; use this presentation as an opportunity to highlight your unique personality and perspective. TL;DR BE YOU. We’re here for it.


MAS Values:

  • KEEP GOOD COMPANY - It’s about showing up in all the right ways — the friend, the devil’s advocate, the hype squad — and keeping it a damn good time through it all.

  • HAVE SOME GUTS - This is about being bold with purpose — pushing the envelope to inspire new ideas, surprise our audiences, and go beyond the expected.

  • HOLD NOTHING BACK - It’s about never settling for anything less than more — or whatever you define as the best. Day to day, it’s showing up with fiery passion, big dreams (because why the hell not), and the determination to take your shot and challenge what’s comfortable.

title: Security Architect - AD/Entra ID (Remote in the US)
description:
GuidePoint Security provides trusted cybersecurity expertise, solutions and services that help organizations make better decisions and minimize risk. By taking a three-tiered, holistic approach for evaluating security posture and ecosystems, GuidePoint enables some of the nation’s top organizations, such as Fortune 500 companies and U.S. government agencies, to identify threats, optimize resources and integrate best-fit solutions that mitigate risk.

General Description

We are seeking a highly experienced Security Architect (AD/Entra ID) to join our dynamic team and lead our identity and access management initiatives. The Security Architect will be responsible for the scope, assessment, design, testing, and technical documentation for the implementation, support, and security of identity solutions. The Security Architect will possess and maintain expertise in Microsoft Azure AAD (Entra) and Active Directory platforms utilizing the knowledge to address business requirements.

About the Active Directory/Entra ID Practice

Our team focuses on Securing Microsoft Identities, which includes both on-prem Active Directory and Entra ID. We partner with other Identity teams, threat assessment teams, and Cloud Security teams to cover IGA, PAM, IAM, AM, pen testing, and all areas within Microsoft on-prem AD and Entra ID.

  • Active Directory and Entra ID Security Assessments and Remediations

Roles and Responsibilities:

  • Lead the evaluation, design, and development of Active Directory & Azure Active Directory technical requirements, solutions, and implementation roadmap to ensure functional, reliable, secure, and cost-effective technology environment.

  • Provide to global project and operational teams technical advice, guidance, expertise, and risk analysis on your area of expertise.

  • Participate in or lead complex or high severity troubleshooting and incident/problem resolutions with other infrastructure teams.
  • Evaluate and ensure the resolution of technically complex security issues, internal control issues, critical incidents and/or crisis resolution management, escalating as necessary.
  • Implement and enforce Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) and security best practices across user accounts and devices.
  • Develop and manage integrations using the Microsoft Graph API for automation and custom applications, enabling advanced capabilities across Microsoft 365 services.
  • Create custom scripts to automate administrative tasks and data retrieval from the Graph API, enhancing operational efficiency.
  • Write and maintain Advanced PowerShell scripts to automate user and resource provisioning, reporting, and service configurations across Entra ID and Active Directory.
  • Implement and maintain security best practices.

Required Experience and Education:

  • 10+ years of relevant working experience in IT Security and IT Architecture
  • 7+ years of experience with Active Directory architecture and infrastructure, with an in-depth understanding of Active Directory Replication, DNS, Site Links, Site Topology, Group Policy, Global Catalogs, and other core infrastructure components.
  • 3+ years of experience with Azure Active Directory architecture and design
  • 5+ years of experience with Identity and Access Management (IAM) processes and technologies
  • Proven expertise in designing and implementing IAM solutions in complex environments.
  • Expertise in managing Azure AD/Entra, including Conditional Access, MFA, security best practices, hybrid environments, GPO's, On-Premises Active Directory Migrations and Azure AD Connect.
  • Experience with Microsoft Graph API for data retrieval and automation across Azure AAD.
  • In-depth knowledge of identity governance, authentication, authorization, and federation. Including MFA, SSO and PAM
  • Understanding of federation technologies (WS-Fed, OAuth, SAML, etc.)
  • Enterprise/Domain Admin and/or Azure Global Admin responsibilities
  • Proven knowledge in managing Active Directory 2016/2019/2022 infrastructure for the Enterprise.
  • Strong experience in PowerShell and Microsoft Graph API is required.
  • Knowledgeable of Microsoft Security Stack: Defender for Office 365, Defender for Identity, Defender for Cloud Apps, Entra ID, Microsoft Purview Information Protection, Data Loss Prevention and Compliance Center Experience including – Litigation Hold, Retention, and eDiscovery.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with stakeholders at all levels.
  • Embraces emerging technologies, including AI tools, to work smarter, solve problems, and drive better business outcomes.
  • Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CISM, or Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator Associate are considered an asset.

Travel Requirements:

Physical Requirements:

  • Sedentary work
  • Substantial movement of the wrists, hands, and/or fingers for a minimum of 8 hours a day

title: Research Specialist
description:
Harbor is seeking a Research Specialist to join its Library and Research Department. This is a full-time, fully remote position open to candidates based anywhere in the United States. The Research Specialist will be responsible for delivering high-quality legal research and retrieval services in support of Harbor’s law firm clients. This role requires strong proficiency in electronic research platforms and internal tools to ensure accurate and timely results.

This position has a particular emphasis on intellectual property (IP) research, supporting attorneys and legal teams on matters involving patents, trademarks, copyrights, and related areas. The ideal candidate will bring demonstrated experience in IP research and familiarity with a range of specialized tools, including Darts-IP, LexisNexis TotalPatent One, Derwent Innovation, USPTO databases, Saegis, and other IP resources. Knowledge of global IP filings, prosecution histories, and litigation analytics is highly desirable.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Conduct in-depth legal, business, and other research and reference work, utilizing both legal and non-legal information resources.
  • Perform effective reference interviews and synthesize findings into clear, concise, and actionable reports.
  • Evaluate diverse information sources for currency, reliability, relevance, and cost-effectiveness; select the most appropriate tools and databases to meet research needs.
  • Maintain expertise across a broad range of legal, business, legislative, analytics, and docket resources, including but not limited to: Lexis, Westlaw, Bloomberg Law, PACER, WK VitalLaw, and Lex Machina.
  • Utilize request tracking software to manage, process, and document research tasks efficiently and accurately.
  • Stay abreast of developments in the legal research field through continued professional development, including active participation in library associations and related activities.

Qualifications:

  • MLS (Master of Library Science) or equivalent experience in legal research within a law firm, academic law library, special library, or research center. J.D. Preferred
  • 5-7 years of professional research experience in a private law firm, academic law library, special library, or research-focused organization.
  • Strong working knowledge of legal and business information sources, including online database searching, legal research techniques, and business intelligence gathering.
  • Demonstrated experience using Lexis, Westlaw, and other core legal research platforms.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Outlook, Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple deadlines while maintaining responsiveness and attention to detail.
  • Excellent client service orientation combined with strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Highly organized with effective time management skills.
  • Ability to work both independently and collaboratively within a service-oriented team environment.

Harbor is the preeminent provider of expert services across strategy, legal technology, operations, and intelligence. Our globally integrated team of 900+ strategists, technologists, and specialists navigate alongside our clients – leading law firms, corporations, and their law departments – to provide essential resources and invaluable insights. title: Transportation Team Lead
description:
Do you enjoy contributing to a team where Participant safety, care, and satisfaction come first?

Do you enjoy keeping workflows, schedules, and systems organized and running smoothly?

If so, you may be the perfect fit for our One Senior Care family of businesses including LIFE-NWPA, Mountain View PACE, and Buckeye PACE.

Job Summary:

As a Transportation Team Lead, you’ll guide a team of schedulers and driver/PCAs while supporting the daily flow of transportation services.

This role is ideal for someone who is versatile, even-tempered, and comfortable moving between coaching, coordinating, problem-solving, and hands-on support. You’ll help keep operations smooth, maintain strong communication with staff, and work closely with the multidisciplinary team to support participant care.

Schedule:

First shift, full-time hours. Specific work hours will be established in consultation with your supervisor.

Benefits:

  • 9 Paid Holidays
  • PTO starting at 3 weeks + 1 day per year (accrued from date of hire for full-time employees)
  • Medical, Dental, & Vision
  • Free Life and AD&D Insurance Plan
  • Health Savings and Flexible Spending Accounts
  • Short Term Disability Insurance
  • Group Voluntary Term Life Insurance for Employee, Spouses, and Dependents
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Tuition Reimbursement and Paid Training Opportunities
  • Retirement Plan with company annual match
  • Mileage Reimbursement at annual IRS rate as applicable

Duties and Responsibilities:

Center Operational Leadership

· Lead the daily transportation huddle covering staffing, vehicle status, weather, route risk, critical appointments, high-risk riders, and unresolved issues.

· Confirm route manifests, driver assignments, backup coverage, and vehicle readiness before service begins.

· Direct same-day response to delays, call-offs, no-shows, route disruptions, and participant service recovery.

· Ensure timely communication with participants, caregivers, Center Leadership, Clinical Operations, and external appointment functions.

· Maintain visible operational leadership rather than functioning primarily as the dispatcher or scheduler.

2. Scheduler Partnership and Dispatch Oversight

· Partner with the assigned scheduler to convert center schedules, external appointments, mobility needs, and service priorities into accurate daily transportation plans.

· Provide supervisory direction, escalation support, and decision-making while preserving the scheduler’s responsibility for route building, real-time adjustments, communication, and documentation.

· Review upcoming demand, capacity, special transportation needs, vendor requirements, and unresolved scheduling risks.

· Ensure standardized participant flags and ride requirements are accurately communicated, including mobility equipment, escort, oxygen, cognitive, behavioral, and infection-control needs.

· Escalate recurring scheduling, technology, capacity, or communication barriers with a clear recommendation.

3. People Supervision and Workforce Accountability

· Interview, onboard, schedule, coach, observe, evaluate, recognize, and hold accountable assigned transportation employees in partnership with Human Resources and transportation leadership.

· Manage attendance, conduct, performance, overtime, training completion, and coverage plans within delegated authority.

· Maintain an identified backup for daily leadership and support succession development for scheduler and frontline roles.

· Build a respectful, safety-first culture focused on participant dignity, teamwork, reliability, and early escalation.

4. Safety, Compliance, and Fleet Readiness

· Verify required vehicle inspections, securement practices, driver qualifications, competencies, and documentation.

· Immediately remove unsafe vehicles, equipment, or practices from service and escalate according to policy.

· Ensure incidents, near misses, injuries, complaints, and defects are reported promptly and corrective actions are completed.

· Coordinate preventive maintenance, vehicle defects, downtime, road calls, and documentation with centralized Fleet and transportation leadership.

· Support audits, field observations, ride-alongs, retraining, and readiness reviews.

5. Performance, Clinical Integration, and Service Recovery

· Monitor on-time performance, missed rides, critical appointment reliability, ride-time exceptions, complaints, vacancies, overtime, vehicle availability, and corrective-action closure.

· Use trend review and root-cause analysis to identify center-level improvement priorities and implement time-bound action plans.

· Partner with the IDT, Center Leadership, Clinical Operations, and external appointment teams to protect access to required care.

· Lead local recovery when service is disrupted and elevate issues that exceed center authority or capacity.

6. State Framework Contribution and Peer Leadership

· Provide practical center-level input into state transportation SOPs, escalation pathways, dashboard definitions, staffing approaches, training tools, and readiness standards.

· Participate in state operating reviews and present concise updates on results, risk, root cause, corrective action, and decisions needed.

· Serve as a resource to other center supervisors through peer coaching, orientation support, problem-solving, and sharing effective practices, without assuming their formal supervisory authority unless specifically delegated.

· Accept delegated cross-center assignments such as launch readiness, temporary stabilization support, workflow pilots, audits, or contingency planning.

· Help identify systemic themes across centers and recommend state-level solutions while maintaining accountability for the assigned center.

· Other duties as assigned.

Leadership Responsibilities:

· Owns center outcomes and escalates early when safety, participant access, staffing, fleet, or service performance is at risk.

· Balances hands-on operational awareness with protected time for coaching, performance management, analysis, and improvement.

· Influences peers through credibility, consistency, data, and collaboration rather than title alone.

· Demonstrates the ability to think beyond one center and distinguish local issues from state-wide patterns.

· Communicates clearly with frontline staff, peer leaders, Clinical Operations, and executive transportation leadership.

Supervisory Responsibilities:

  • 8+ direct reports depending on census.

Everyone’s journey is unique. Even if you haven’t done it all, your dedication to learning and helping others is what counts. With our training, mentorship, and career development programs, we’ll help you grow and succeed.

What Makes You a Great Fit:

  • Versatile, patient, and able to adjust easily to shifting needs.
  • Calm under pressure while still keeping tasks moving forward.
  • Skilled at building relationships and supporting team dynamics.
  • Comfortable mediating differences and helping others stay aligned.
  • Clear, steady communicator who listens well and supports others.
  • Organized, reliable, and detail-focused.
  • Committed to participant safety and a positive team environment.

Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree.
  • One year of experience working with the frail or elderly population.
  • Five or more years of experience in supervision, scheduling, logistics, Tripmaster, GPS software, Pacelogic, and Prime Suite.
  • Intermediate to advanced experience with Microsoft Office.
  • CPR and First Aid Certification (or willingness to obtain after hire — we’ll provide the training!)
  • Must be at least 18 years of age

Requirements:

  • Requires valid State driver’s license with a clean driving record.

  • Successful completion of background check, physical, drug screening, TB Screening

Physical Requirements:

  • Works in well-lighted and ventilated office and therapy areas.
  • Sits, stands, bends, lifts, and moves intermittently during the workday.
  • Must be able to assist with participant evacuations.
  • May experience frequent interruptions and shifting priorities.

Join Us!

At One Senior Care, you’ll be part of a compassionate team that makes a tangible difference in seniors’ lives — working together to keep participants safe, healthy, connected, and at home.

One Senior Care is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment is contingent upon successful completion of required background checks, health and safety screenings, and any clearances required for healthcare programs.

title: Bilingual IT Service Desk Agent
description:
The IT Service Desk Agent is responsible for providing exceptional technical support to end-users, ensuring prompt resolution of IT-related issues, and maintaining the overall health of IT systems. The role involves collaborating with cross-functional teams, diagnosing technical problems, and offering hands-on and remote support to ensure optimal functionality for end-users.
Key Responsibilities:
  • Ticket Management: Continuously monitor and create service desk tickets from incoming phone calls, emails, and voicemails, ensuring all issues are logged, tracked, and resolved in a timely manner.
  • Issue Documentation: Use Jira Help Desk software to log, document, and manage all service requests and incidents, ensuring accurate record-keeping and reporting.
  • Troubleshooting and Escalation: Follow predefined scripts and troubleshooting protocols to resolve issues and escalate complex incidents to IT Level 2 or Level 3 support teams when necessary.
  • End-User Support: Provide effective, one-on-one support to end-users, both over the phone and in person, ensuring clear communication and customer satisfaction.
  • System Monitoring: Regularly monitor IT systems and network performance, identifying potential issues before they impact end-users.
  • Hardware Support: Perform routine maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair on desktop and laptop hardware. This includes diagnosing and replacing faulty components.
  • Software Installation and Updates: Assist with the installation, configuration, and updating of software applications, ensuring all systems are up to date and secure.
  • Team Collaboration: Actively participate in team meetings, providing feedback on recurring issues and assisting with the development of process improvements.
  • Documentation and Knowledge Base Management: Contribute to creating and updating internal knowledge base articles and documentation for both users and support staff.
  • Customer Service: Demonstrate a strong focus on customer service by responding to user inquiries promptly, clearly, and professionally, while ensuring a positive user experience.
  • Onboarding/Offboarding Support: Assist with IT-related onboarding and offboarding processes for new and departing employees, including system access, software provisioning, and hardware setup or return.
  • Remote and On-Site Support: Provide both remote and on-site technical support, demonstrating flexibility to meet the diverse needs of the organization.
  • Continuous Learning: Stay updated on the latest technology trends, best practices, and security protocols to provide top-notch support and contribute to the overall success of the IT department.
Qualifications & Skills:
  • Technical Knowledge: Strong understanding of desktop operating systems (Windows), including troubleshooting and support for both hardware and software issues.
  • Web & Application Proficiency: Familiarity with common browsers (e.g., Internet Explorer, Firefox, Chrome), email clients (e.g., Outlook), and essential applications, including security tools and anti-virus programs.
  • Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to effectively articulate technical information to non-technical users.
  • Problem-Solving: Strong analytical and diagnostic skills with the ability to think critically and resolve issues efficiently.
  • Customer Service Focus: A commitment to providing exceptional customer service, ensuring user satisfaction, and demonstrating patience and professionalism in all interactions.
  • Teamwork: Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment, sharing knowledge and assisting colleagues as needed.
  • Attendance & Reliability: A reliable track record of high attendance (98% or more) and adherence to shift schedules.
  • Flexibility: Willingness to travel within the city and work on weekends or after hours when required to support business needs.
  • Disciplinary Record: Must have a clean disciplinary record with no written warnings.
  • Experience (Optional):
    • Previous experience in a help desk or IT support role, with a demonstrated ability to resolve technical issues efficiently.
    • Experience with Jira Help Desk software or other ticketing systems.
What we offer:
· SEASONAL agreement for peak season. (6 months)
· Full-time $17,000 MXN monthly gross salary + Termination bonus.
· Law benefits since day one.
· Onsite.
· Full equipment provided.
· 100% paid training.
· Schedule window (8 am - 8 pm).
· 10-hour shift (8 am - 6 pm / 9 am - 7 pm/10 am - 8 pm).
· 1 hour Lunch - 2 breaks of 15 minutes each.
· Two days off (Fri-Sat).
· Total Pass.
· Only for CDMX and Edo. de Mex.

title: Software Engineer II, Annapurna Labs ML Acceleration System Software
description:
Annapurna Labs designs silicon and software that accelerates innovation. Customers choose us to create cloud solutions that solve challenges that were unimaginable a short time ago-even yesterday. Our custom chips, accelerators, and software stacks enable us to take on technical challenges that have never been seen before, and deliver results that help our customers change the world.

The Machine Learning Server Software Team is looking for candidates interested in writing data-driven software for our Machine Learning servers.
We build production software to initialize and monitor the most advanced machine learning acceleration servers in the world.

We touch technologies including accelerator chip initialization, setting up clocks and voltages, to systems level device drivers for I2C infrastructure pervasive in the server and everything in between. Our team does not work on machine learning algorithms, but rather on the physical systems (hardware) which execute and accelerate those machine learning algorithms. Data paths, PCIe, SPI, I2C, accelerator inner-workings are our bread and butter. Come join our team.

Key job responsibilities
- Member of a team responsible for the software associated with server components and integration in to EC2.
- Working with the MLA Hardware, Test and Manufacturing teams to create a coordinated software package to enable both qualification as well as rapid deployment of software.
- Developing software (C, C++, Python, Lua) which can be maintained, improved upon, documented, tested, and reused.

A day in the life
The MLA Systems Software team was formed to focus on server software primarily for initialization, monitoring, debug, testing, qualification, and manufacturing. At a high-level our goal is to find ways to help the organization scale though the use of software and automation.

About the team
Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we're building an environment that celebrates knowledge-sharing and mentorship. Our senior members enjoy one-on-one mentoring and thorough, but kind, code reviews. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects that help our team members develop your engineering expertise so you feel empowered to take on more complex tasks in the future.

Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying.

About AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating - that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve in the cloud.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
BASIC QUALIFICATIONS - 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
