title: Project Manager - WATER
description:
Position Summary:

Plan, coordinate, and successfully deliver specialty water and mechanical construction projects, including work at data centers, water treatment plants, wastewater treatment facilities, pumping stations, reclaimed water systems, industrial water treatment facilities, and hydronic systems. Ensure project goals are achieved safely, on schedule, within budget, and in compliance with quality and regulatory requirements. Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, engineers, subcontractors, and project teams. Manage budgeting, scheduling, contracts, buyout, documentation, meetings, billings, change conditions, labor productivity, cost control, and project closeout.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Manage and supervise day-to-day operations of project staff and field teams on assigned projects, accounts, and service work.
  • Manage assigned specialty water, wastewater, treatment plant, and hydronic system projects from preconstruction through closeout.
  • Review and thoroughly understand project scope, contract requirements, deliverables, and timelines.
  • Ensure customer contract agreements are secured, reviewed, processed, and executed.
  • Participate in Sales-to-Operations and preconstruction turnover meetings for assigned projects to confirm scope, budget, schedule, procurement needs, and project risks.
  • Develop, review, finalize, and distribute project budgets. Establish and maintain project schedules, procurement plans, and risk mitigation strategies.
  • Monitor and update project schedules throughout execution.
  • Coordinate procurement of materials and equipment with the purchasing agent, including buyout planning to meet or improve established schedule dates and budgeted costs.
  • Oversee construction activities involving hydronic and process mechanical systems, treatment equipment, process piping, pipelines, pump stations, instrumentation and controls, SCADA, and chemical feed and dosing systems.
  • Ensure project work complies with contract documents, project specifications, applicable permitting and regulatory requirements, safety standards, and quality control procedures. Ensure required permits and licenses are obtained and posted.
  • Initiate, review, and oversee project administration and documentation to protect the interests of RK Water and its client. Ensure required submittals are reviewed, processed, approved, and tracked in maintained submittal logs.
  • Negotiate, prepare, process, and execute subcontract agreements. Manage contract administration, subcontractor coordination, and owner communications.
  • Price, negotiate, and process change conditions and change orders. Document changes to project scope, cost, and schedule while supporting claims avoidance.
  • Ensure projects are appropriately staffed with field forces, including review, updating, and approval of labor resource loading. Monitor labor productivity and analyze performance.
  • Oversee the use of tools and rental equipment on assigned projects. Ensure equipment that is no longer required or being used is returned promptly.
  • Manage the overall financial performance of assigned projects through ongoing cost control, forecasting, and financial performance monitoring, including earned-value reporting as applicable.
  • Develop, submit, and obtain approval of the billing schedule of values.
  • Prepare and submit accurate monthly contract valuations on time.
  • Maintain an overbilled cash position, proactively request retention releases and payments, and collect progress billings and retention receivables on or before their due dates.
  • Review, approve, and process subcontractor and supplier invoices.
  • Facilitate regular project meetings with relevant stakeholders.
  • Communicate project status, risks, cost and schedule impacts, and mitigation plans to project stakeholders.
  • Support commissioning, startup, operator training, system testing, and successful turnover of completed systems and facilities to owners and end users.
  • Develop and maintain strong customer relationships while identifying opportunities for additional work and long-term partnerships.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Accountability:

  • Comply with all company policies and procedures.
  • Prompt, punctual, and regular attendance during core business hours, in an office environment, currently located in the 80 E 62nd Ave area of Denver, including a reliable means of transport to and from work. Ability to occasionally travel between corporate offices and jobsites within the Denver Metro Area, during work hours.
  • All employees are accountable for safety and health and are empowered to stop work if an unsafe condition is present. Employees should immediately notify their supervisor so that the hazard may be corrected.

Physical Requirements:

  • While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to: stand, sit, talk, hear, and use hands and fingers to operate a computer, telephone, and a variety of office equipment.
  • Occasionally may need to reach, stoop, or kneel.
  • Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision requirements due to computer work.

Qualifications:

Career Level: Project Manager 1

  • 5–6 years of relevant project or construction experience; a degree in a related field or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Strong technical knowledge of process mechanical piping systems, building on the knowledge of an Assistant Project Manager.
  • Good knowledge of project budgeting, scheduling, procurement, cost control, forecasting, and labor productivity.
  • Knowledge of contract administration, change orders, submittals, progress billing, and project closeout; proficiency with project management and scheduling software.

title: Senior Platform Engineer (IT Services)
location: Boston, MA, United States; Chicago, IL, United States; New York, NY, United States; Oakland, CA, United States; Washington, DC, United States
description:
About Charles River Associates

For over 50 years, Charles River Associates has been a premier consulting firm that offers employees a place to learn from a diverse group of consultants, industry experts, and academics. At CRA you will be exposed to leading minds who use economic, financial, and business analysis to solve complex world problems for an impressive roster of clients, including major law firms, Fortune 100 companies, and government agencies. Through a collegial environment, formal and informal training opportunities, and a broad array of professional development resources, your experience at CRA will open doors for you throughout your career.

Position Overview

The Information Technology (ITS) department at Charles River Associates is currently a team of more than 40 professionals dedicated to enhancing, maintaining, and developing the firm's technology infrastructure and security based in offices around the globe. The team is comprised of four functions: Service Delivery & Telecom, Enterprise Application Solutions, Infrastructure, Networking and Cloud Solutions, Information Security. Primarily a Microsoft house, CRA is looking to maximize the performance of our on-premise systems and hybrid infrastructure, meaning experience with cloud technologies is essential for this role.

The Senior Platform Engineer is responsible for designing, building, and continuously improving the firm's hybrid infrastructure platforms spanning on-premises datacenters and public cloud environments. This role focuses on platform engineering practices, automation, infrastructure-as-code, and operational excellence to deliver scalable, secure, and self-service infrastructure services.

The engineer will partner closely with cloud, networking, security, automation, and application teams to create reusable platform capabilities, automate infrastructure lifecycle management, and enable modernization initiatives across the enterprise. This position plays a key role in advancing CRA's hybrid cloud strategy through platform standardization, governance, observability, cost optimization, and automation-first operational practices. Primary responsibilities include:

Platform Engineering & Service Enablement

  • Design, build, and maintain hybrid infrastructure platforms supporting public cloud and on-premises environments.
  • Develop reusable platform services that enable self-service provisioning and standardized infrastructure deployment.
  • Establish platform standards, golden images, reference architectures, and engineering guardrails.
  • Contribute to enterprise platform roadmaps and modernization initiatives.

Infrastructure Automation & IaC

  • Develop and maintain Infrastructure-as-Code solutions using Terraform, Terraform Cloud, Bicep, Ansible, and automation frameworks.
  • Build automation workflows for provisioning, compliance validation, lifecycle management, patching, backup, and disaster recovery.
  • Develop reusable infrastructure modules and automation pipelines following DevOps and Platform Engineering principles.

Cloud-enabled Operations & Support:

  • Engineer and optimize hybrid cloud environments across VMware Cloud Foundation, Azure, AWS, and future cloud platforms.
  • Support a “Cloud Landing Zone” architecture pattern.
  • Assist with workload discovery and migration readiness activities, then execute migration tasks (e.g., provisioning, cutovers, validation) for workloads moving to multi-cloud strategy.
  • Infrastructure optimization and improve day-day management of on-premises compute, storage, and virtualization platforms (VMware vSphere) that would introduce efficiencies thru automated workflows.
  • Experience managing a Cloud-enabled Identity and Directory Services implementing and maintaining Active Directory/Azure AD integration (Entra), RBAC/ABAC, policy-based access control, service principals, and secrets management across cloud environments.
  • Support a hybrid network connectivity by implementing, validating, and troubleshooting connectivity between on-prem and cloud environments (e.g. SDWAN, ExpressRoute, Direct Connect, Private Gateways) in partnership with Network Reliability team, InfoSec, including segmentation, routing, firewall rules, load balancing, and latency/bandwidth requirements for target workloads.
  • Familiarity with cloud governance & FinOps enablement by implementation of governance controls (guardrails, tagging, policy enforcement), cost management (FinOps) reporting, and securing a hybrid environment.

Desired Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree (Master’s preferred) in a relevant technology-related discipline;
  • Azure/AWS Solutions Architect or cloud related certifications preferred, HashiCorp Terraform Associate or Advanced certifications desirable;
  • 8+ years supporting enterprise-scale infrastructure and multi-cloud hyperscalers (eg. Azure, AWS, GCP);
  • 5+ years working with Terraform and advanced understanding of Infrastructure-as-Code methodologies;
  • Deep experience designing, building, and operating CI/CD pipelines and GitOps workflows using GitHub Actions, Jenkins, and enterprise source control platforms to enable automated, secure, and scalable infrastructure and application delivery;
  • Experience building automation using ansible, bash, powershell, python scripting, and Rest APIs;
  • Experience with cloud governance, policy management, and FinOps practices.
  • Understanding of cloud networking, DNS, cloud-enabled identity services, security controls, and hybrid connectivity;
  • Hands-on experience with Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Application Insights, Grafana, Datadog, Splunk, or similar observability platforms;
  • Familiarity with Internal Developer Platforms (IDP).

Preferred

  • Experience with VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF), vSphere, and hybrid cloud architectures;
  • Hands-on experience with Kubernetes, AKS, EKS, or OpenShift;
  • Experience with Databricks infrastructure, AI platform hosting, or enterprise data platforms;
  • Experience integrating AIOps, observability, or monitoring platforms.

Career Growth and Benefits

  • CRA’s robust skills development programs, including both formal and informal programs, encourage you to thrive as an individual and team member. Beginning with research and analysis skill building, training continues with technical training, presentation skills, internal seminars, and career mentoring and performance coaching from an assigned senior colleague. Additional leadership and collaboration opportunities exist through internal firm development activities.
  • We offer a comprehensive total rewards program including a superior benefits package, wellness programming to support physical, mental, emotional and financial well-being, and in-house immigration support for foreign nationals and international business travelers.

Work Location Flexibility

CRA creates a work environment that enables our colleagues to benefit from being together in the office to best deliver on our promise of career growth, mentorship and inclusivity. At the same time, we recognize that individuals realize a range of benefits when working from home periodically. We currently expect that individuals spend at least 3 to 4 days a week working in the office (which may include traveling to another CRA office or to client meetings), with specific days determined in coordination with your practice or team.

Our Commitment to Equal Employment Opportunity

Charles River Associates is an equal opportunity employer (EOE). All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.

title: Consultant - Data Engineering
description:
About Alpha FMC

Alpha Financial Markets Consulting (Alpha) is a leading global consultancy to the financial services industry. Founded in 2003, we have worked for over 20 years to bring together specialist, sector-focused strategy, management consulting and technology expertise to support the entire client transformation lifecycle. Having partnered with more than 1,200 clients worldwide across the asset and wealth management, alternatives and insurance industries, Alpha is truly a trusted advisor for complex change programmes. We now have over 1,180 consultants working with clients across North America, the UK, Europe, Middle East and APAC. In 2024, in recognition of our successful track record and strong growth prospects, Alpha was acquired by Bridgepoint, one of the world's leading quoted private asset growth investors. Our people are at the heart of everything we do. We are delighted that many of our team have built long and fulfilling careers with us, many staying over a decade. We believe this is because Alpha offers a genuinely rewarding place to work: a meritocratic environment where your career can flourish, and a welcoming culture where you can be yourself, connect with others and thrive. As we look to the future, we’re excited to be looking for new Alpha colleagues - individuals who are collaborative, innovative and ambitious. We hope you will join us and help shape the next chapter of our growth journey.
Why join Alpha?
  • Established yet entrepreneurial – with over 20 years of success and a proven record on the London Stock Exchange, Alpha offers the stability of an established consultancy with the energy of a fast-growth business.
  • Backed by Bridgepoint – as part of one of the world’s leading growth investors, Alpha benefits from strategic investment that fuels innovation, expansion and new offerings – creating even more opportunity for our people.
  • Exposure to senior leadership – whether you are in an internal or a client facing role, you will have the opportunity to work with and learn from the best of the best – high performers at the top of their game.
  • Learning and growth opportunities – we run tailored training to help you be successful, provide you excellent mentorship, and offer up to 5 days paid training time per year. Perhaps the best training though is the experience on the job – as everyone at Alpha has high responsibility and autonomy, you can develop your skillsets quickly.
  • Performance-driven culture with real impact – advancement at Alpha is based on impact and capability, not tenure or quotas. You’ll have autonomy and see the tangible difference your ideas and decisions make.

Position Overview:

We have a fast-growing team of dedicated consultants with deep experience from working both within the industry and consulting. title: Staff Software Engineer - Core Identity
description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

Staff Software Engineer, Device Identity (Java)

Device Identity and Access Organization

The Device Identity and Access organization is at the forefront of Okta’s Zero Trust vision. As a foundational pillar within Okta Research and Development (ORD), our mission is to transform the device itself into a secure, trusted, and effortless identity factor. We are the teams responsible for ensuring users can seamlessly interact with their work from any endpoint, anywhere in the world.

We engineer the end-to-end device experience—from our flagship FastPass, Okta Device Access (ODA), and Device Assurance. Our teams own the continuous authentication pipeline, device lifecycle management, and the sophisticated cloud services that analyze real-time trust and assurance signals to make frictionless, passwordless access a reality across Windows, macOS, iOS, Linux and Android.

Our organization is comprised of engineers who thrive at the intersection of deep client-side platform engineering and massive-scale distributed systems. The work we do secures millions of enterprise endpoints globally, prevents modern identity attacks, and fundamentally changes how people work by making world-class security completely invisible to the end user.

Explore our culture and technical innovations on the Okta Engineering Blog.

The Staff Software Engineer Opportunity

We seek a dynamic and influential Staff Software Engineer to join our Device Identity engineering team. The ideal candidate will leverage their deep Java experience to architect, build, and scale the critical server-side software and services at the heart of our security and identity platform. This is a high-visibility, hands-on opportunity to design solutions for current and emerging industry challenges.

You will not only demonstrate an aptitude for software engineering excellence but also act as a player-coach, mentoring other engineers and elevating the team's capabilities. You will join an engineering team that shares a passion for elegant solutions and believes in designing for scale, rigorous code reviews, automated testing, and an iterative process to build high-quality enterprise software.

What you’ll be doing

  • Drive cross-functional collaboration with Product, Design, and QA to ensure the seamless delivery of our most critical engineering initiatives.
  • Lead the design and implementation of new features and services within our core Java platform, taking ownership from conception to deployment.
  • Define and champion engineering best practices, and make critical contributions to technical designs, proposals, and long-term architectural decisions.
  • Mentor and coach other engineers through code reviews, technical guidance, and by setting a high bar for quality and security.
  • Develop high-quality, maintainable software with comprehensive test coverage and drive improvements to our testing and CI/CD strategies.
  • Create and maintain high-quality technical documentation and foster a culture of knowledge sharing within the team and the broader organization.
  • Champion the adoption of AI-native engineering practices within our Product Development Lifecycle (PDLC), utilizing AI coding assistants to accelerate delivery while ensuring rigorous security and code quality standards.

What you’ll bring to the role

  • 7+ years of software development experience, with a proven track record of designing and building scalable, high-performance server-side features using Java and Spring.
  • Deep expertise with high-performance Postgres or MySQL environments, including schema design and query optimization.
  • Extensive experience designing, building, and securing RESTful APIs for large-scale systems.
  • Expert knowledge of server-side technologies, including caching, asynchronous processing, and multi-threading.
  • A deep understanding of design patterns, scalability patterns, security engineering, and object-oriented principles.
  • Experience in fast-paced agile environments, with a strong understanding of CI/CD and automated testing.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to diverse audiences and influence technical direction.
  • Proficiency in leveraging AI coding assistants (e.g., GitHub Copilot) to accelerate the development lifecycle, with a focus on maintaining high standards for code quality and security.

Nice-to-haves

  • Understanding of Identity and Access Management protocols and technologies (FIDO, U2F, WebAuthn, SSO, SAML, OAuth, Federation, etc.)
  • Knowledge of cybersecurity principles, secure coding practices, and certifications like CISSP or Security+.
  • Experience with UI technologies such as ReactJS
  • Exposure to gRPC API development
  • Exposure to microservice architecture

Education:

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience.

title: Sr. Product Designer
description:
About us

Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that. About the Role

We are seeking a Senior Product Designer who can elevate HighLevel's product experiences through exceptional craft, product judgment and strong execution. You have spent 5+ years designing complex digital products and are ready to own meaningful work from early ambiguity through shipped outcomes.

As a senior individual contributor, you will partner closely with product managers, engineers, researchers, data partners and other designers on cross-functional teams that own and improve key product experiences across the HighLevel platform. You will connect customer needs, business goals and technical constraints to clear, useful and highly polished product design.

We expect candidates at this level to demonstrate exceptional visual and interaction design judgment, practical systems thinking and the ability to carry work from discovery through delivery. You should care deeply about the standards that make product experiences feel refined, trustworthy and coherent.

Experience designing B2B SaaS, platform, CRM, workflow-heavy or SMB software experiences is highly valuable. Experience using AI-powered tools for exploration, prototyping, critique, synthesis or workflow acceleration is expected. Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.

What You'll Do

  • Own meaningful product areas from discovery through delivery, translating customer needs, business goals and technical constraints into clear experience direction
  • Partner with product managers, engineers, researchers, data partners and designers to define, test and ship polished product experiences at scale
  • Use qualitative and quantitative insight to make design decisions and improve outcomes

  • Support junior designers and partner teams with practical design guidance
  • Collaborate effectively across US and India time zones in a 100% remote environment

What We Are Looking For

  • 5+ years of relevant product design experience, ideally in B2B SaaS, platform, CRM, workflow-heavy or similarly complex digital product environments
  • An exceptionally strong portfolio that demonstrates product judgment, systems thinking, customer empathy, high-quality execution and measurable product impact
  • Proven experience across the design lifecycle, including research, information architecture, interaction design, visual design, prototyping, content design and usability testing
  • Exceptional visual and interaction design craft, with deep care for hierarchy, layout, typography, grids, spacing, motion, usability, accessibility and product quality
  • Working knowledge of design systems, accessibility standards, reusable patterns and scalable product experience decisions

  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills and the ability to work fluently with product managers, engineers, researchers, data partners and other designers
  • Clear communication skills, with the ability to explain design decisions, incorporate feedback and persuade through rationale, evidence and craft
  • Understanding of front-end implementation constraints and the ability to bridge practical gaps between design and code
  • Curiosity about users, data, systems, new tools, emerging technologies and better ways for teams to work

How You Work

  • You hold yourself to an unusually high bar for craft, visual sophistication and product quality
  • You move comfortably from customer insight and product strategy to detailed design execution
  • You balance speed, detail, scalability and quality without losing sight of the customer

title: Software Engineer, Numerical Computing
location: Washington, District of Columbia, United States
description:
CHAOS Industries is redefining modern defense with a multi-product portfolio that gives the ultimate advantage—domain dominance. The company's products are powered by Coherent Distributed Networks (CDN™), empowering warfighters, commercial air operators, and border protection teams to act faster, adapt rapidly, and stay ahead of evolving threats.

CHAOS Industries was founded in 2022 and has raised a total of $1 billion in funding from leading investors, including 8VC, Accel, and Valor Equity Partners. The company is headquartered in Los Angeles, with offices in Washington, D.C., San Francisco, San Diego, and London. For more information, please visit .

Role Overview:

We are seeking a software engineer who is fluent in numerical computing to build the software foundation of our electromagnetic warfare product line. Our Spectrum Sensing team is transforming CHAOS radar systems into distributed sensing systems that detect, classify, and geolocate RF emissions — and the algorithms that do it only matter if they run correctly, quickly, and reliably in production.

This is a software engineering role first. You will own how our numerical and signal processing code is architected, integrated, tested, and accelerated. You do not need a background in RF or radar; you do need to be the person on the team who knows why a Python implementation is slow, what to do about it, and how to build a codebase that other engineers can safely extend. You will work alongside signal processing and RF engineers who supply the algorithms, and you will be the reason those algorithms become dependable software.

Responsibilities:

As a key contributor to the Spectrum Sensing team, you will shape the software architecture and engineering practices behind our sensing stack. The day-to-day will be diverse, engaging, and intellectually stimulating, with direct impact on pushing the boundaries of sensing technology and application. Key responsibilities include:

  • Design, develop, and maintain production-quality numerical software in Python, with an emphasis on clear interfaces, composability, and long-term maintainability
  • Integrate third-party software and hardware into the CHAOS platform via APIs, and own the abstractions that keep those integrations from leaking into the rest of the codebase
  • Profile and accelerate signal processing implementations — through vectorization, array-programming frameworks, JIT compilation, GPU offload, or bindings to compiled code — and quantify the improvement
  • Define and drive test and CI hygiene for numerical code: numerical regression tests, tolerance and reproducibility strategy, property-based and reference-implementation testing, and automation that catches breakage before a field demonstration does
  • Partner with signal processing engineers to turn algorithms from papers, prototypes, and MATLAB into software that ships
  • Contribute to overall software architecture decisions for the sensing product line, including how components compose across the platform
  • This role will require periodic travel, up to 30%

Minimum Requirements:

  • B.S. degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Physics, or a related field
  • 5+ years of professional software development experience
  • Demonstrated proficiency in Python for numerical computing, including writing, maintaining, testing, and debugging production-quality codebases — not analysis scripts or notebooks alone
  • Strong command of array-based numerical computing (NumPy, SciPy, or equivalent), including an understanding of where and why Python performance breaks down
  • Demonstrated experience making numerical code fast through at least one of: array/tensor DSLs and JIT compilation (JAX, Numba, PyTorch, Triton, Halide, or similar), GPU-accelerated computing (CUDA or equivalent), or bindings between Python and compiled languages (pybind11, nanobind, Cython, or similar)
  • Demonstrated experience contributing to a large, multi-team codebase — working within existing architecture, navigating unfamiliar code, and shipping changes that other teams depend on
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals: version control workflow, code review, automated testing, and CI
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to clearly document technical details and present findings
  • Must be able to work on-site 4 days per week in Washington, D.C.
  • U.S. citizen
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. security clearance

Preferred Requirements

  • M.S. degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or a related field
  • Meaningful open-source contributions to numerical, scientific computing, or signal processing software (we will read your commit history, not just your repository list)
  • Exposure to digital signal processing — filtering, FFT-based processing, detection and estimation, or beamforming — whether from coursework, research, or industry
  • Experience with software-defined radios (SDRs) or associated signal processing toolkits (e.g., GNU Radio)
  • Experience with real-time, streaming, or throughput-constrained data processing systems
  • Experience designing APIs or libraries consumed by other engineering teams
  • Familiarity with MATLAB, sufficient to read and port existing algorithm prototypes
  • Current U.S. security clearance
  • Experience with agile development tools like JIRA and Confluence
  • Experience in DoD, military, or other Government environment in a fast-paced, dynamic environment

hy CHAOS?

  • Health Benefits: Medical, dental, and vision benefits 100% paid for by the company
  • Additional benefits: 401k (+ 50% company match up to 6% of pay), FSA, HSA, life insurance, and more
  • Our Perks: Free daily lunch while you're working onsite, fully-stocked kitchen, unlimited PTO, casual dress code
  • Compensation Components: Competitive base salaries, generous pre-IPO stock option grants, relocation assistance, and (coming soon!) annual bonuses
  • Team Growth: 500+ employees and counting across 5 global offices

Technical Ownership & System Reliability

  • Cross-functional collaboration

This position operates within active semiconductor manufacturing, utility, mechanical, wastewater treatment, and production support environments. Personal protective equipment (PPE) is required. title: Appleton - Lawn Care Technician / Specialist
description:
Naturescape of Appleton, WI is seeking to hire a Lawn Care Specialist to provide our customers with outstanding services for their residential and commercial properties. Are you looking for a career in lawn and landscape care with a stable, family-owned business? Would you like to be a valued and respected member of a close-knit team? If so, look no further!

PAY & COMPENSATION

  • Starting Wage: $20/hr
  • Expected Average: $20/hr - $27/hr
  • Top Earners: Make an extra $15,000+ per year in performance bonuses alone!
  • Weekly Bonus Potential: Most specialists earn a bonus every single week

In addition, overtime opportunities are frequently available. We offer you either (or both!) of these opportunities because Naturescape believes in rewarding you for your successes and in giving you the opportunity to significantly improve your compensation through your efforts.

BENEFITS AT A GLANCE:

  • 401K with unheard of - 200% company match up to 6%, vested immediately
  • Keep your insurance all winter: Naturescape pays 100% of insurance benefits during any winter unemployment!
  • Become a manager in as little as one year, especially for those willing to relocate
  • Up to 3 weeks of PTO plus holidays starting in year one
  • Paid training; no lawn or landscape care experience required!
  • Generous benefits: health, dental, vision, and supplemental insurance; HRA and HSA; and employee discounts
  • Snow removal and other winter work opportunities are available to most specialists
  • Typical annual raises
  • Military friendly, willing to work with current drill schedules
  • Full-time, part-time, and seasonal employees; flexible schedule
  • Independent work in the great outdoors

A DAY IN THE LIFE OF A LAWN CARE SPECIALIST

Your primary responsibility is to be the face of our company in the field. You aren't just performing manual labor; you are managing a route and transforming landscapes across our service area. You will typically work 10-hour days, 4 days per week (with variations due to weather and customer needs). While most of the world is stuck behind a desk, your "office" changes daily. You'll navigate to residential and commercial properties, where you'll complete precision lawn care, lawn aeration, mowing, tree/shrub care and pruning, and mosquito control. You take pride in the "before and after," knowing that your work on a lawn and landscape directly enhances a customer's home and their pride in their property.

You are more than a technician; you are a consultant and a problem-solver. Because you work in a high-visibility role, you are the first person a customer sees when they have a question about their landscape. You use our provided training to assess lawn health and landscape needs, building a level of rapport that makes our customers feel like they have a "pro in the family." Whether you're explaining the benefits of aeration or discussing tree care, your ability to communicate clearly and kindly ensures our clients are happy, informed, and confident in the services you provide.

Adaptability is the heartbeat of this role. You are a specialist who moves with the seasons, ensuring our customers' properties are cared for year-round. When winter hits, you pivot to snow removal, ensuring our customers stay safe and mobile. This is a licensed specialist position, meaning you get to do the high-impact work of beautifying properties with the immediate need for state pesticide certifications.

Your most important responsibility is your own development. We don't expect you to walk in the door knowing the difference between species of turfgrass or the nuances of aeration timing-we expect you to be hungry to learn. You are part of a team that values "learning by doing." Whether you have previous experience as a general laborer, construction worker, landscaper, groundskeeper, or lawn mower, you bring a "can-do" attitude and a willingness to be coached. You are excited to grow your skills alongside a company that is excited to invest in your future.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Valid driver's license and good driving record
  • Ability to lift 50 lbs
  • Motivated with a desire to learn

Not sure if you're qualified? Relax! No lawn care or landscape experience is required, and we provide paid training! Are you passionate about working outdoors and helping people? If so, you could be perfect for this lawn and landscape position!

ABOUT NATURESCAPE

Naturescape is a family-owned company that is 100% committed to making our customers happy with our lawn and landscape care. Since our humble beginnings in Appleton, WI in 1986, we have been committed to providing the highest quality service, guaranteeing satisfaction, and offering very affordable prices. Because of these continued commitments, we have grown and now have 38 locations around the Midwest and South.

We know that we owe this success to our outstanding team. We care about employee satisfaction and want you to love your job. Here at Naturescape, we have a team culture where management is always willing to train and take the time to help you succeed.

For the benefit of our employees, customers, and anyone who interacts with Naturescape, we are proud to be a drug-free workplace and provide safe and healthy working conditions at all of our branches.

HERE'S WHAT OUR EMPLOYEES LOVE ABOUT WORKING AT NATURESCAPE

"Management is team-oriented and genuinely interested in employees, team environment is positively reinforced and overall a great place to be."

"Everyone has made an effort in training me. People actually care about me and my family, along with things we are involved in."

"The incentive system is very motivating and makes the job more fun."

"Naturescape is an awesome company to work for . . . very generous and have always been very caring and understanding. I am happy to have chosen Naturescape for my career."

ARE YOU READY TO JOIN OUR TEAM?

Our application takes just 3 minutes and is mobile-friendly. No resume? No problem. Apply today and grow with us!

Come Grow With Us!

title: Senior Engineer - Water R
description:
Senior Engineer - Water Resources


Water Resources - Roseville, California


Position Summary

The Senior Engineer for Water Resources plays a central role in advancing sustainable water solutions for the communities BENEN serves. In this highly visible position, you will work in close partnership with the Water Resources Vice President to guide the team while managing the planning, design, and delivery of water supply, wastewater, and related infrastructure projects for public agencies and utility clients.

You will leverage water and wastewater engineering expertise to lead multidisciplinary teams from early planning and analysis through final design, permitting, and implementation. Your work will protect technical quality, regulatory compliance, constructability, and the long-term value of the systems BENEN delivers.

As a Senior Engineer, you will oversee core project deliverables, including analyses, models, reports, plans, specifications, and cost estimates. You will also help shape workload, project economics, staff development, delivery standards, and client continuity across the Water Resources practice while remaining close to the technical work.

Leadership Impact

This role combines senior technical authority, influence over the Water Resources team, and direct partnership with firm leadership. You can remain close to complex engineering work while shaping delivery standards, developing people, strengthening client continuity, and building the practice for the long term.


Essential Responsibilities

Internal Focus

  • Provide technical leadership, planning direction, and rigorous QA/QC oversight for complex water and wastewater projects.
  • Serve in responsible charge and guide the preparation and review of technical analyses, models, reports, plans, specifications, and cost estimates.
  • Ensure project work complies with applicable federal, state, local, and client standards, codes, and regulatory requirements.
  • Partner with the Water Resources Vice President to strengthen technical standards, delivery practices, resource priorities, and practice continuity.

Project and Staff Focus

  • Lead multiple complex projects and guide project managers and delivery teams through scope, schedule, budget, risk, documentation, quality, and client commitments.
  • Oversee an annual portfolio of multiple projects, balancing complexity, risk, concurrent assignments, financial performance, and leadership scope.
  • Assign and coordinate staff and subconsultants, balance workload, monitor project financial performance, and intervene early when delivery is at risk.
  • Manage and develop staff, including retention, career goals, timely performance feedback, and succession readiness.
  • Encourage responsible learning from mistakes, reinforce clear team norms, and celebrate milestones.

External and Client Focus

  • Serve as a senior point of contact for clients, providing clear communication, sound technical judgment, and reliable follow-through.
  • Lead client and project meetings, facilitate progress discussions, and guide issue resolution to keep commitments on track.
  • Collaborate with public agencies, utility partners, and regulatory bodies to support compliant and coordinated project delivery.
  • Anticipate client concerns, communicate risk early, and develop practical solutions that protect trust and project outcomes.
  • Help sustain client relationships across projects and teams through responsiveness, continuity, and consistent delivery.

Business Development Focus

  • Prepare and contribute to proposals, including technical approach, scope definition, staffing, schedules, and fee development.
  • Identify opportunities within existing client accounts and partner with leadership on strategic pursuits and client continuity.
  • Represent BENEN at selected client meetings, industry events, conferences, and professional organizations to support strategic growth.

Minimum Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in civil or environmental engineering from an accredited institution.
  • Active California Professional Engineer (P.E.) license.
  • 14 or more years of engineering design experience, including at least 3 years of progressively responsible project or team leadership.
  • Substantive experience in municipal water, wastewater, and related water infrastructure planning, design, permitting, and project delivery.
  • Demonstrated experience leading multidisciplinary technical teams and serving in responsible charge.
  • Proven responsibility for project financials, technical quality, client communication, resource coordination, and multiple concurrent assignments.
  • Familiarity with HEC-RAS, AutoCAD Civil 3D, and water or sewer modeling software.
  • Strong communication, leadership, organization, judgment, and relationship-building skills.


Compensation

Salary aligned with senior technical and team leadership responsibilities: $140,000 - $190,000.

BENEN also offers a comprehensive benefits package that includes flexible work schedules, telework capabilities, health and wellness benefits, retirement and profit-sharing contributions, paid time off and holidays, professional development support, and performance-based incentives consistent with company policy.


Equal Employment Opportunity. BENEN is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, ancestry, national origin, religious creed, sex, pregnancy, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, reproductive health decision-making, veteran or military status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Director of Finance (Insurance)
description:
The role

We are a growing program insurance business and we are hiring the person who will own how we account for it and report on it.

The Director of Finance reports to the CFO and works alongside a Controller as an equal peer. The Controller runs day-to-day financial operations and the flow of funds; this role owns what the numbers mean, how they are reported, and the controls around them. Until the team is larger, the two review each other’s work.

This is a build, not a maintain. You will do most of it yourself in year one and hire behind you as the work allows.

What you will own
  • Financial reporting. All internal and external reporting — the monthly package, the KPI pack, board and investor materials, annual US GAAP statements with footnotes, and what lenders, reinsurers and carrier partners require under their agreements.
  • Close. The close calendar, the standard each task has to meet, and sign-off. The Controller executes it; you manage the consolidation process, approve the result and report from it.
  • Process and controls. Document every finance process and build the control matrix over it. Own segregation of duties and authorization limits, and design manual reconciliation out where the architecture allows.
  • Technical accounting. Research US GAAP questions and write position memos. Own the judgment areas — commission revenue including contingent and variable consideration, ceded reinsurance, premium receivable and payable presentation, gross versus net, collateral and restricted cash. Maintain the accounting policy manual and advise on new programs and contracts before they are signed.
  • Audit and tax. Both external relationships — the audit timetable and the PBC list, and the tax firm on filings, the provision, state registrations and the indirect obligations the business carries.
  • FP&A. The operating model, the annual budget, a rolling forecast re-cut as actuals land, and monthly variance analysis. Cash forecasting and runway, including the working-capital swings that settlement cycles and collateral create.
  • Treasury. The banking structure, borrowing and the investment of surplus cash.
  • Interim HR. The HR function until the company is large enough to staff it — the employee lifecycle, benefits and the annual renewal, the handbook and policy.
You will hire and develop the team as the work justifies it.

What we are looking for

Required Qualifications
  • CPA.
  • 8+ years in accounting and finance, including public accounting. Audit experience in an insurance practice is the strongest preparation.
  • Insurance accounting — MGA, program, fronting or carrier. Comfortable with ceded reinsurance, commission structures including contingent arrangements, premium receivable and payable, and collateral.
  • Ownership of a full close, not participation in one.
  • Technical research you can point to: standards applied, memos written, positions defended to an auditor.
  • Budgeting, forecasting and modeling built from drivers, in Excel at a level you can be tested on.
  • Writing. A material part of this job is explaining a number or a position in plain English to people who are not accountants.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Statutory accounting or insurance regulatory reporting.
  • An ERP or accounting-system implementation you helped select and run.
  • Working with outsourced accounting providers and holding them to a standard.
  • A first close calendar, a first audit, or a first finance hire built somewhere before.
How you work

You write things down. You chase a difference until you find it rather than plugging it. You say when a number is an estimate and when it is not. You are willing to tell the CFO something is wrong, including when you built it.

Equal employment opportunity

We are an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, marital status, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law. title: EDAT- Senior Palantir Foundry Engineer — Fort Bragg, NC
description:
Barbaricum is a rapidly growing government contractor providing leading-edge support to federal customers, with a particular focus on Defense and National Security mission sets. We leverage more than 17 years of support to stakeholders across the federal government, with established and growing capabilities across Intelligence, Analytics, Engineering, Mission Support, and Communications disciplines. Founded in 2008, our mission is to transform the way our customers approach constantly changing and complex problem sets by bringing to bear the latest in technology and the highest caliber of talent.

Headquartered in Washington, DC's historic Dupont Circle neighborhood, Barbaricum also has a corporate presence in Tampa, FL, Bedford, IN, and Dayton, OH, with team members across the United States and around the world. As a leader in our space, we partner with firms in the private sector, academic institutions, and industry associations with a goal of continually building our expertise and capabilities for the benefit of our employees and the customers we support. Through all of this, we have built a vibrant corporate culture diverse in expertise and perspectives with a focus on collaboration and innovation. Our teams are at the frontier of the Nation's most complex and rewarding challenges. Join our team.

Barbaricum is seeking a Senior Palantir Foundry Engineer to support the U.S. Army Special Operations Command (USASOC) Chief Data and Analytics Office (CDAO). This position provides hands-on technical leadership in designing, developing, integrating, and optimizing data solutions within the Palantir Foundry platform, translating complex operational requirements into scalable data products, pipelines, and analytical capabilities.

This is a senior-level Palantir Foundry engineering role — not a general data engineering role with limited Foundry exposure. The successful candidate will independently design and implement Foundry data products, develop pipelines and Ontology models, integrate mission data sources, troubleshoot complex platform issues, and work directly with USASOC CDAO stakeholders to deliver operational capabilities. They will collaborate with data engineers, software engineers, data scientists, analysts, mission owners, and government stakeholders to deliver secure, reliable, and mission-focused data solutions.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines, datasets, and data products within the Palantir Foundry platform.
  • Develop and optimize Foundry pipelines using Python, SQL, PySpark, and Foundry-native technologies.
  • Build and maintain Foundry data transformations, workflows, datasets, and analytical applications supporting USASOC mission requirements.
  • Develop and manage Ontology models that represent operational entities, relationships, actions, and mission data.
  • Integrate data from disparate enterprise, operational, and mission systems into Foundry.
  • Design data ingestion, transformation, validation, and quality processes to ensure reliable and trusted data products.
  • Work with data scientists, analysts, and mission users to operationalize analytical models and workflows within Foundry.
  • Develop reusable data products and services that support CDAO analytics and decision-making capabilities.
  • Troubleshoot pipeline failures, data quality issues, performance problems, and integration challenges.
  • Optimize Foundry pipelines and data products for scalability, reliability, performance, and maintainability.
  • Support the development and deployment of Foundry applications and workflows that provide actionable insights to mission stakeholders.
  • Apply data governance, access controls, security requirements, and data management practices within the platform.
  • Collaborate with cybersecurity and systems engineering teams to ensure data solutions operate within applicable security and authorization requirements.
  • Participate in technical design reviews and translate mission requirements into technical implementation plans.
  • Document data architectures, pipeline designs, integrations, dependencies, and operational procedures.
  • Mentor junior engineers and provide technical guidance on Foundry development, data engineering, and platform best practices.
  • Support continuous improvement of CDAO’s data engineering architecture, development standards, and engineering practices.
  • Participate in Agile development activities, including sprint planning, stand-ups, demonstrations, retrospectives, and backlog refinement.
  • Coordinate directly with government technical leads and mission stakeholders to identify requirements, resolve technical issues, and prioritize development efforts.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Active Top Secret/SCI (TS/SCI) security clearance, or the ability to obtain and maintain TS/SCI per contract requirements.
  • Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, Mathematics, or a related technical field.
  • 5+ years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, data platform engineering, or a related technical discipline, including demonstrated hands-on development within Palantir Foundry.
  • Experience designing and implementing production-grade data pipelines and data products.
  • Experience integrating data from multiple structured and unstructured sources.
  • Experience working with relational and non-relational data technologies.
  • Experience supporting data engineering solutions in DoD, federal, or other mission-critical environments.
  • Experience working in Agile software development environments.
  • Experience collaborating directly with technical and non-technical stakeholders to translate mission requirements into technical solutions.
  • Strong communicator able to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and government stakeholders, translate ambiguous operational requirements into practical solutions, and serve as a mentor and technical leader who raises engineering standards across the team.

REQUIRED TECHNICAL SKILLS

  • Palantir Foundry
  • Foundry Ontology
  • Foundry Pipeline Builder
  • Foundry Workshop and/or Slate
  • Python
  • SQL
  • PySpark
  • Data transformation and pipeline development
  • Data modeling
  • ETL/ELT development
  • API and system integration
  • Data quality and validation
  • Git / version control
  • CI/CD concepts and practices
  • Cloud-based data platforms
  • REST APIs
  • Data governance and access controls
  • Troubleshooting and performance optimization

CERTIFICATIONS (DOD 8140)

Must hold a current DoD 8140-compliant certification appropriate for this position. Approved examples include:

  • CSC
  • CSSLP
  • GCSA
  • GSEC

DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Direct experience supporting USASOC, USSOCOM, or another Special Operations Forces organization.
  • Previous experience supporting a Chief Data and Analytics Office (CDAO) or comparable enterprise data organization.
  • Experience developing Foundry solutions for DoD mission, intelligence, operations, logistics, or command-and-control use cases.
  • Experience working with Foundry in classified or air-gapped environments.
  • Experience with Foundry Ontology development and operationalization.
  • Experience building Foundry applications using Workshop, Slate, or similar Foundry application-development capabilities.
  • Experience integrating Foundry with enterprise APIs, databases, message queues, cloud services, and external applications.
  • Experience with data governance, metadata management, data lineage, and data quality frameworks.
  • Experience deploying machine learning or advanced analytics capabilities into operational data workflows.
  • Experience with AWS, Azure, or other cloud environments.
  • Familiarity with DoD data standards, enterprise data architectures, and cybersecurity requirements.
  • Experience working in TS/SCI or other classified environments.
  • Experience supporting systems subject to RMF/ATO requirements.
  • Palantir Foundry certification or demonstrated equivalent platform expertise.

EEO Commitment

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, race, ethnicity, age, national origin, citizenship, religion, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, pregnancy, family structure, marital status, ancestry, domestic partner status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran or military status, or any other basis prohibited by law.

title: Youth Development & Wellness Lead
description:
Start Date: November 2, 2026
Schedule: Monday-Friday, 8:00am-4:00pm
Job Type: Full-Time Salary, Exempt
Location: Roberto Clemente Campus, Bronx, NY

Organization Overview
Replications, Inc. is a leading nonprofit organization dedicated to replicating and implementing high-impact educational models that foster student success and community engagement. Our vision is that every child in every community has access to a dynamic and joyful public school that empowers them to thrive. We partner with schools to provide comprehensive support services to drive student academic achievement and social-emotional development. To learn more about Replications, visit


Why Join Replications, Inc.?
This is your chance to contribute directly to an organization committed to transforming public education and empowering communities.

Position Overview
The Youth Development and Wellness Lead (YDWL) works collaboratively with school and Replications teams to advance school improvement under the Community School Model. The YDWL is responsible for developing, facilitating, and monitoring interventions that support students’ social-emotional and behavioral development by applying tiered supports and facilitating developmentally appropriate student wellness strategies. Through a student-centered and relationship-based approach, the YDWL promotes a positive school climate where students are valued, heard, and supported, and where their voices and experiences inform the development of a caring school community.

The YDWL supports school improvement efforts by strengthening strategies that promote student attendance, engagement, and positive school experiences. In collaboration with school and Replications teams, the YDWL fosters high-performing teams by strengthening communication, coordination, and shared approaches to supporting students and advancing schoolwide goals.

The YDWL will report directly to the Community School Director.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide developmentally appropriate social, emotional, and behavioral support to students through individual check-ins and other targeted supports.
  • Facilitate youth groups focused on positive development, self-awareness, social-emotional skills, peer relationships, and problem-solving.
  • Build supportive relationships with students that promote student voice, engagement, self-advocacy, and connection to the school community.
  • Gather information about student and family strengths, needs, barriers, and existing supports to inform appropriate interventions, resources, and referrals.
  • Document interventions, progress, and follow-up in accordance with Replications’ expectations and procedures.
  • Recognize when student needs require additional support and coordinate appropriate consultation, referrals, and follow-up with school-based and community resources.
  • Apply cultural humility and a human rights framework when developing and implementing student supports, recognizing the influence of students’ identities, experiences, culture, and broader social conditions on their well-being and school experience.
  • Identify students who are chronically absent or at risk of chronic absenteeism and develop targeted, student-centered strategies to improve attendance and engagement.
  • Collaborate with school teams to develop and implement universal attendance strategies, including incentives and engagement initiatives, that promote consistent attendance and address barriers to school participation.
  • Use relevant student attendance, behavioral, and school climate data to inform intervention planning and assess progress toward identified goals.
  • Support teams in using shared problem-solving, communication, and data-informed practices to address student and schoolwide needs.
  • Incorporate student voice and feedback into school climate, wellness, SEL, and other schoolwide initiatives.


Qualifications

  • Experience working with youth experiencing behavioral, social-emotional, or other barriers to school engagement, and their families.
  • Experience organizing and facilitating youth support groups.
  • Strong relationship-building and interpersonal communication skills, with the ability to foster trust with students, families, and colleagues.
  • Strong proactive communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to engage and motivate students using developmentally appropriate and strength-based approaches.
  • Ability to work collaboratively as part of a school-based team and contribute to shared goals.
  • Ability to use student and school-based information and data to inform decisions.
  • Familiarity with restorative practices and principles.
  • Ability to work independently and take initiative over assigned tasks.
  • Bilingual speakers are preferred

Approach to Work

  • Passion for working with students in under-resourced schools
  • Exceptional level of patience and focus to overcome challenges, and achieve results
  • A passion for mission-driven school culture

Requirements

  • DOE Fingerprinted
  • Bachelor’s degree in social work, MSW preferred

Pay and Benefits

  • $68,000-$75,000
  • Pre-tax commuter benefits
  • 3% 401k employer match
  • $3,000 tuition reimbursement
  • Sick and Safe Leave
  • FSA account option
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance
  • School holidays

title: Import Specialist, Customs Brokerage
description:
Mallory Alexander International Logistics, a global third-party logistics (3PL) provider, is seeking a Logistics Professional to join our growing team.

The Import Specialist, Customs is primarily responsible for preparing, reviewing, and submitting customs entries to U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP) while coordinating the import clearance process to ensure shipments are cleared accurately, compliantly, and in a timely manner. This position works closely with customers, CBP, steamship lines, freight forwarders, CFS facilities, trucking companies, and internal teams to facilitate the efficient movement and delivery of imported shipments.

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Prepare and submit customs entries for imported shipments to U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP) in a timely and accurate manner.
  • Review commercial invoices, packing lists, bills of lading, and other supporting documentation to ensure completeness, accuracy, and compliance with U.S. Customs requirements.
  • Determine and/or verify Harmonized Tariff Schedule (HTS) classifications and applicable duty rates.
  • Identify products subject to OGA/PGA requirements and ensure appropriate data and documentation are included with entries.
  • Research and resolve customs entry discrepancies, documentation issues, holds, exams, and other clearance-related exceptions.
  • Monitor entry status and follow up with CBP and other government agencies as necessary to facilitate timely clearance.
  • Communicate with customers regarding customs entry requirements, clearance status, OGA/PGA requirements, customs holds, and shipment irregularities.
  • Maintain daily tracking reports for open, pending, and released shipments.
  • Track and trace imported shipments and coordinate with steamship lines, freight forwarders, and CFS facilities regarding cargo availability, arrival, and release status.
  • Issue delivery orders and arrange shipment pickup and delivery with trucking companies following customs release.
  • Maintain accurate and complete shipment and customs documentation in CargoWise One.
  • Handle related accounting processes, including preparation of invoices and review/approval of freight bills.
  • Provide timely updates to customers and internal teams regarding shipment and customs clearance status.
  • Perform additional duties as assigned.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, International Business, or a related field preferred.
  • 5 years of experience in customs brokerage, import operations, or international logistics.
  • Strong working knowledge of U.S. Customs regulations, import procedures, and Harmonized Tariff Schedule (HTS) classification.
  • Proficiency in CargoWise One preferred.
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Word and Excel.
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy when preparing customs entries.
  • Excellent time management and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple entries and deadlines.
  • Ability to research, identify, and resolve customs and documentation issues in a timely manner.
  • Strong customer service and problem-solving skills.

Why Mallory Alexander?

Mallory Alexander International Logistics is a leading full-service logistics provider established in 1925. With more than 10 facilities in the U.S. and 3 in Asia, Mallory Alexander supports manufacturers, retailers and other suppliers in the storage and shipment of their valuable cargo, and we do it with confidence–on time, with care, everywhere. We proudly offer competitive compensation, robust benefits and a family environment, an environment where our dedicated employees are able make an impact on our customers' experience.

title: Internal Only: Director of Programs and Engineering
description:
Director of Programs and Engineering - X-Bow Solid Rocket Motor Division

Company Overview

X-Bow Launch Systems, Inc. (pronounced "Crossbow") is a U.S. defense technology and rocket propulsion company that has developed an innovative, low-cost method to manufacture solid rocket motors. Our propulsion technology, space launch capabilities, and modular boost platforms make us unique and highly desirable aerospace supplier to the defense and national security industries.

Position Summary

X-Bow is seeking an exceptional Director of Programs and Engineering to join our Defense Systems Sector. Reporting directly to the VP of Solid Rocket Motor Programs and Production, this senior leadership position will provide strategic direction and operational oversight for both program management and engineering functions. This role requires a dynamic leader capable of bridging technical excellence with program execution, managing multiple rocket motor development and production programs from initial customer interaction through final delivery while simultaneously leading engineering teams to deliver innovative solutions on accelerated timelines.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership

  • Provide strategic direction and leadership for integrated program management and engineering operations across the Defense Systems Sector
  • Support the VP of Solid Rocket Motor Programs and Production in developing and executing organizational strategy
  • Drive alignment between engineering capabilities and program requirements to ensure successful delivery
  • Foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement across programs and engineering teams

Program Management Leadership

  • Direct and oversee multiple rocket motor development and production programs simultaneously
  • Develop comprehensive program portfolios that outline goals, timelines, resources, and budget requirements across all programs
  • Ensure programs are delivered on time, within scope, and within budget while maintaining technical excellence
  • Serve as senior escalation point for program challenges and strategic customer engagements
  • Lead proposal development efforts and strategic customer interactions

Engineering Leadership

  • Provide technical leadership and direction for SRM Engineering and SRM Mechanical Engineering teams
  • Ensure engineering deliverables meet rigorous design, analysis, testing, and validation requirements for solid rocket motors
  • Drive technical innovation in solid rocket motor design, development, and manufacturing processes
  • Balance engineering resources across multiple programs to optimize technical outcomes and schedule performance
  • Establish and maintain engineering standards, processes, and best practices

Cross-Functional Team Leadership

  • Lead and coordinate cross-functional teams across Solid Large Motor Programs, Small Motor Programs, SRM Engineering, SRM Mechanical Engineering, Business Management, and Production
  • Manage and develop program managers and engineering leaders within the organization
  • Collaborate effectively with Program Scheduling, Production Scheduling, Logistics, EHS, and Quality Management functions
  • Build and maintain high-performing teams capable of executing on compressed timelines

Stakeholder Communication and Engagement

  • Serve as a senior point of contact for critical program stakeholders, including executives, government representatives, and external partners
  • Communicate program and engineering status, challenges, and outcomes to the VP and senior leadership
  • Maintain transparency and collaboration across all organizational interfaces
  • Represent X-Bow at customer meetings, technical reviews, and industry forums

Risk Management and Problem Solving

  • Identify, analyze, and mitigate strategic and technical risks across the program portfolio
  • Resolve complex technical and programmatic issues, applying advanced problem-solving skills
  • Proactively address challenges related to requirements, technical development, and manufacturing
  • Implement risk mitigation strategies that protect program objectives and organizational interests

Quality Assurance and Compliance

  • Ensure all program and engineering activities comply with organizational standards, industry regulations, and government requirements
  • Implement quality assurance processes to maintain the highest standards in program deliverables
  • Oversee rigorous design, analysis, testing, and validation of solid rocket motors
  • Work closely with Quality Management and EHS teams to ensure compliance and safety across all operations

Resource Management and Business Operations

  • Manage departmental budgets and resources effectively to meet organizational objectives
  • Optimize resource allocation across programs and engineering functions
  • Support business development activities and strategic growth initiatives
  • Drive operational efficiency and cost-effectiveness while maintaining technical excellence

Continuous Improvement

  • Evaluate program and engineering performance and identify areas for improvement
  • Implement best practices and lessons learned into future programs and engineering processes
  • Champion organizational learning and knowledge management initiatives
  • Contribute to the advancement of X-Bow's innovative manufacturing methodologies

Required Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering (Aerospace, Mechanical, or related field) required
  • Master's degree in Engineering, Business Administration, or related field strongly preferred

Experience

  • Minimum of 10-12 years of progressive experience in the aerospace or defense industry
  • Minimum of 5-7 years in leadership roles managing programs and/or engineering teams
  • Extensive experience in program or project management, with demonstrated success managing complex, multi-million dollar programs
  • Strong technical expertise in solid rocket motor design, development, and manufacturing highly desired
  • Proven experience in proposal development and management in the aerospace/defense sector
  • Experience managing cross-functional teams and multiple concurrent programs
  • Track record of successful customer engagement and relationship management with government and commercial clients

Skills and Competencies

  • Exceptional leadership and people management skills with ability to inspire and develop high-performing teams
  • Deep understanding of project management principles, methodologies, and tools (Agile, Waterfall, Earned Value Management)
  • Strong technical acumen with ability to make sound engineering and programmatic decisions
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills
  • Strategic thinking with ability to balance long-term vision with near-term execution
  • Proven ability to work independently and make decisions with minimal oversight in fast-paced environments
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver results under compressed timelines
  • Experience with government contracting, ITAR compliance, and defense industry regulations

Location Requirements

This position may be based in the vicinity of existing X-Bow offices, including:

  • Luling, TX
  • Salt Lake City, UT
  • Huntsville, AL
  • Others

ITAR Requirements

To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR), you must be a U.S. citizen, a lawful permanent resident of the U.S., a protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.

What We Offer

  • Senior leadership opportunity in a cutting-edge rocket propulsion technology company
  • Direct impact on national defense and security initiatives
  • Fast-paced, innovative environment with significant growth potential
  • Collaborative culture with opportunity to shape organizational direction
  • Competitive compensation and benefits package
  • Opportunity to work with world-class engineering and program management teams
