title: Grounds Maintenance Tech I
description:
About the Role

Join our team! The City of Kentwood is seeking a Grounds Maintenance Technician I to support our Public Works Department. In this role, you’ll help maintain and enhance the City’s parks, trails, landscaped areas, and public spaces. From mowing and landscaping to irrigation and facility upkeep, your work will directly contribute to keeping our community beautiful, safe, and enjoyable for residents and visitors.

Our ideal candidate is dependable, hardworking, and enjoys working outdoors. You’re comfortable operating equipment, performing physical tasks, and working both independently and as part of a team.

About the Department of Public Works

The Department of Public Works keeps the City of Kentwood beautiful and functional with a team of nearly 40 full- and part-time employees. The department has five divisions that work together to maintain the City’s infrastructure, which includes more than 150 miles of pipes underground and more than 155 miles of streets above ground, as well as the City parks and grounds, buildings and fleet of vehicles. DPW takes care of everything from snow plowing and street cleaning to parks maintenance and police cruisers. The five divisions are building maintenance, fleet services, grounds maintenance, streets maintenance and utilities (water and wastewater) services.

What You’ll Do

  • Maintain parks, trails, landscaped areas, and cemetery grounds
  • Mow, trim, edge, fertilize, water, and maintain lawns and athletic fields
  • Plant, prune, mulch, and care for trees, shrubs, and plants
  • Assist with forestry operations including tree planting, trimming, and removal
  • Install, maintain, and repair irrigation systems
  • Inspect and maintain park facilities, paths, and public spaces for safety and cleanliness
  • Prepare and maintain ball fields and recreational areas for public use
  • Perform basic maintenance and repairs on park facilities and equipment
  • Assist with light carpentry, plumbing, painting, and concrete work
  • Operate trucks, trailers, tractors, and landscaping equipment
  • Perform snow removal and salt application during winter months
  • Respond to public questions and concerns in a courteous and professional manner
  • Follow safe work practices and help maintain a safe work environment
  • Maintain basic records of work performed and assist other Public Works divisions as needed

Minimum Qualifications

  • High school diploma or GED
  • One year of grounds maintenance or related experience, or equivalent combination of training and experience
  • Valid Michigan CDL Class A with Tanker (“N”) endorsement within six months of hire
  • Basic knowledge of landscaping, irrigation, and grounds maintenance practices
  • Ability to safely operate landscaping tools, equipment, and light construction vehicles
  • Ability to perform physical labor in outdoor environments and varying weather conditions
  • Basic math and recordkeeping skills
  • Ability to read and interpret manuals, drawings, and specifications
  • Strong work ethic with the ability to work independently and as part of a team
  • Good communication and customer service skills

Please view the full job description and requirements for more details.

Pay and Benefits

Hourly pay range: $22.40-28.62, dependent on qualifications and experience

The City of Kentwood offers a competitive compensation package and excellent benefits, including:

  • 10% employer retirement contribution
  • 11 paid holidays, three personal days, and 12 sick days annually
  • Up to four weeks of vacation annually
  • Fully paid parental leave (4–6 weeks depending on eligibility)
  • Medical insurance with 2% employee premium share
  • Free dental and vision insurance
  • Health Savings Account with employer contributions of $825–$1,650 annually
  • Employer-paid life insurance and long-term disability
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Employer-paid training and professional development
  • Discounts on city recreation programs

Why work for the City of Kentwood

A community of more than 54,000 residents and growing, Kentwood is a safe, prosperous, and welcoming city with vibrant neighborhoods and thriving businesses that make it a great place to live and work. The City offers access to a variety of amenities including shopping, dining, entertainment, and outdoor recreation throughout West Michigan.

With a mission of providing high-quality services to foster a thriving community for all, Kentwood promotes a culture of teamwork, customer service, and continuous improvement.

The City of Kentwood is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Apply today to join our dedicated Public Works team!

Are you ready to explore the world of aerospace and defense? Do you want to learn from and collaborate with some of the greatest minds in the industry? What You Will Do

Raytheon brings the strength of more than 100 years of experience and renowned engineering expertise to meet the needs of today’s mission and stay ahead of tomorrow’s threat. We deliver solutions that help our nation and allies defend freedoms and deter aggression, creating a safer, more secure world. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense.


Join the Software Engineering Directorate’s Effectors Center team at Raytheon, where you will develop precision software applications that power the next generation of defense capabilities. In this role, you will design, code, integrate, and test critical real-time embedded software and firmware on missiles, launchers, radars, and naval fire control systems. Working as part of a fast-paced agile team at the leading edge of technology, you will gain hands-on exposure across the full software development lifecycle—advancing real-time systems design, digital signal processing, machine learning, and DevOps methodologies while helping defend our nation and allies.


This position is an onsite role located in Tucson, AZ.


  • Assist in the derivation of software requirements, architecture design, implementation, and verification of real-time embedded software and application tools.
  • Design, code, test, and integrate high-reliability software solutions utilizing C, C++, and object-oriented programming methodologies.

  • Familiarity with modern software development workflows, version control (such as Git), and Agile methodologies.

Principal Program Manager

Who We Are

Boston-based company Piaggio Fast Forward Inc. (PFF) was founded in 2015 by the Piaggio Group (the Italian manufacturer that created the iconic Vespa scooter). We are on a mission to build technology products that move the way that people move. To bring products to market today, PFF is solving the problem of robotic interaction with people in dynamically changing environments. We’re innovators, neighbors, and creators with a passion for local living and pushing the limits on urban transportation. We support a sustainable mobility ecology with healthy lifestyles and social connectivity available to all, regardless of age or abilities.

The Role

We're looking for a Program Manager to own execution across our core robot product line including the full stack of hardware, software, AI models, cloud services, apps, and the quality control that gates every release. You'll report directly to the CEO and work as an individual contributor with company-wide execution authority. You won't manage people directly, but you will own the oversight of progress across every team that builds and ships these robots.

You'll work in close partnership with the Product Manager, who sets the goals and priorities for what gets built and why. Your job is to turn those priorities into a real program: sequencing the work, tracking progress, surfacing risk, and driving alignment across a wide set of disciplines so that the right things ship, on time, at the quality bar our robots require given how closely they operate with people.

What You'll Do

Own program execution for our core cargo-robot technology stack. Take ownership of the execution of products and features across the full range of our ground-movement, cargo-carrying robots (25–800 lb payload class) including the human-proximity behaviors, autonomy, and fleet self-management that make them safe and simple to deploy without environmental changes or integration work.

Translate product priorities into a driven, tracked program. Work closely with the Head of Product to understand goals and priorities, then own the planning, sequencing, tracking, and cross-team coordination required to execute against them; serving as the clear, trusted handoff point between "what we're building and why" and "how and when it gets done."

Track and drive progress across:

  • Design team including industrial design, HRI, UI/UX for apps and web, and cloud tools, ensuring design work stays aligned with program timelines and cross-team dependencies.
  • Smart Behaviors team including data science, behavior specifications, and AI model development that give our robots the ability to operate alongside people.
  • Engineering team, our largest including teams of engineers in Mechanical, Electrical, Software, Sensor Fusion, Localization, Navigation, Physical AI, Quality, Cloud, and Devops, coordinating across these disciplines to keep interdependent hardware/software work moving together.
  • Operations team including supply chain, manufacturing, and logistics, ensuring program plans account for real-world lead times, sourcing constraints, and production readiness.
  • Quality team including SQA, Sales Engineering, and Customer Support ensuring time for testing by this team before products or features ship.
  • Work closely with our Compliance and Certification Manager to ensure certification requirements are built into the program plan.
  • Manage risk and dependencies across a matrixed program. Without formal authority over any of the teams above, build the relationships, visibility, and judgment needed to identify risks early, resolve cross-team conflicts, and keep a highly interdependent hardware-plus-software-plus-AI program on track.
  • Maintain a clear, thin handoff with the Head of Product. Respect the boundary between setting goals and executing against them. You drive the "how" and "when," and you keep the Head of Product's priorities intact rather than re-litigating them, while giving clear, honest visibility into progress, tradeoffs, and risk.

What You'll Bring

  • Significant experience as a technical program manager (or equivalent) on complex products that combine hardware, embedded/cloud software, and AI/ML. Ownership experience where you were responsible for two or more programs for either robotics, autonomous systems, or another physical-plus-software product category strongly preferred.
  • A track record of driving execution across highly matrixed, multi-disciplinary teams (design, data science/AI, mechanical/electrical/software engineering, operations) without direct authority over any of them.
  • Comfort owning release quality gates for a physical product, with an understanding of why the bar is higher when a robot shares space with people.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills as this role sits close to the CEO and must give clear, credible visibility into program status, risk, and tradeoffs.
  • Demonstrated ability to partner with a product owner (Product Manager, Head of Product, or similar) without blurring the line between setting priorities and executing against them.
  • Experience managing programs that include a hardware certification path is a strong plus.
  • Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, or a related technical field; advanced degree a plus.

We like you just the way you are.
Diversity fuels our innovation. Inclusion, belonging, equity, and neurodiversity drives our best-in-class culture. We strive to create workplaces where everyone feels empowered to share ideas, grow at their own pace, and work together towards a shared vision while holding each other to a higher standard. For us, DEI&B is the only way forward.

title: Employment Counsel
description:
The Basics:

Tanium is seeking a highly motivated, proactive attorney to join its legal team as Employment Counsel. The right person for this position must be a team player who is comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment, has a pragmatic approach to problem solving, and is passionate about employment law and its practical application in a complex, global technology business. This person will serve as a trusted advisor to our People team and business stakeholders, helping Tanium attract, develop, and retain top talent while managing legal risk.

What you’ll do:

  • Provide strategic advice and counsel to the People team and business stakeholders on a broad range of U.S. employment issues, including recruiting and hiring, onboarding, performance management, disciplinary actions, leaves of absence, accommodations, wage and hour compliance, compensation and benefits, pay transparency, contingent workers, employee classification, reorganizations, redundancies, non-competition and non-solicitation, and separations and terminations
  • Oversee internal workplace investigations, including matters involving harassment, discrimination, retaliation, whistleblower complaints, and policy violations
  • Investigate and respond to claims, demand letters, administrative complaints, audits, and other employment-related inquiries
  • Manage pre-litigation and litigation matters with the assistance of outside counsel as needed
  • Draft, review, and negotiate employment-related documents and templates, including offer letters, employment agreements, contingent worker agreements, separation and severance agreements, and release agreements
  • Develop, review, and update employment policies, standards, and HR guidelines to ensure compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws
  • Support Tanium’s federal contractor compliance obligations, including OFCCP compliance evaluations and AAP preparation and maintenance under VEVRAA and Section 503
  • Advise on legal issues arising from the use of AI tools in recruiting and employment practices
  • Design and deliver employment related training to the People team, employees and managers
  • Monitor federal, state, and local employment law developments and proactively communicate changes and their business implications to the People team, leadership, and relevant stakeholders

We’re looking for someone with:

  • At least 5 years of relevant employment law experience at a law firm and/or in-house legal department
  • JD from an accredited institution
  • Active and in good standing in at least one U.S. state bar
  • Strong working knowledge of U.S. federal and state employment laws, including FLSA, ADA, FMLA, Title VII, and state equivalents
  • Experience conducting or managing workplace investigations
  • Familiarity with federal contractor compliance obligations, including OFCCP audits, AAP preparation, and VEVRAA and Section 503 requirements

About Tanium

Tanium is the Autonomous IT company. As Al accelerates both innovation and risk, Tanium Atlas, the company's autonomous operating system, puts the full depth of the Tanium Autonomous IT Platform behind every IT and security operator - human and agentic. Tanium provides the real-time intelligence, agentic decision-making, and autonomous execution operators needed to detect, decide, and remediate at machine speed across their endpoint estate.

The company is recognized as a Leader in the inaugural 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Endpoint Management Tools, as a Leader in the IDC MarketScape: Worldwide Client Endpoint Management Software for Windows Device Management 2025-2026 Vendor Assessment, and as a Leader in The Forrester Wave™. Endpoint Management Platforms, Q2 2026.

To learn how Tanium delivers Autonomous IT for unstoppable business, visit and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

On a mission. Together.

At Tanium, we are stewards of a culture that emphasizes the importance of collaboration, respect, and diversity. In our pursuit of revolutionizing the way some of the largest enterprises and governments in the world solve their most difficult IT challenges, we are strengthened by our unique perspectives and by our collective actions.

As a global organization with stakeholders around the world, it’s imperative that the diversity of our customers and communities is reflected internally in our team members. We strive to create a diverse and inclusive environment where everyone feels they have opportunities to succeed and grow because we know that only together can we do great things.

Our commitment to excellence and innovation has earned us a place on the Forbes Cloud 100 list for ten consecutive years, and we continue to be recognized worldwide as a great place to work.

Each of our team members has 5 days set aside as volunteer time off (VTO) to contribute to the communities they live in and give back to the causes they care about most.

What you’ll get

The annual base salary range for this full-time position is $191,000 to $293,000. This range is an estimate for what Tanium will pay a new hire. The actual annual base salary offered may be adjusted based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to, location, education, skills, training, and experience.

In addition to an annual base salary, team members will receive equity awards and a generous benefits package consisting of medical, dental and vision plan, family planning benefits, health savings account, flexible spending account, transportation savings account, 401(k) retirement savings plan with company match, life, accident and disability coverage, business travel accident insurance, employee assistance programs, disability insurance, and other well-being benefits.

Tanium is an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, protected Veteran status, or other legally protected categories. If you require a reasonable accommodation in searching for a job opening, completing an application, interviewing, or completing any pre-employment testing or requirements, please contact accommodations@tanium.com. For more information refer to the “Know Your Rights” poster which is available here - .

title: Flight Software Platform Engineer
description:
York is seeking a Junior / Early Career Flight Software Platform Engineer to support the Flight Software Engineering team.
This role is intended for an engineer early in their career who is interested in embedded Linux, spacecraft systems, mission-critical software, and hands-on platform development. The Platform Team owns the operating system foundation used to deliver embedded flight software for space applications.
The ideal candidate is curious, technically motivated, and excited to learn Linux platform development, embedded software practices, hardware/software integration, and flight software delivery in a fast-moving aerospace environment.
This is a hands-on engineering role with mentorship from senior engineers and technical leads. Over time, this engineer will grow ownership in embedded Linux platform components, integration workflows, test automation, and software release support.

Responsibilities:

Participate in an agile scrum team focused on supporting the embedded Linux platform used to deliver flight software for space applications.
Support development and maintenance of the embedded Linux platform, including:
Linux kernel configuration and debugging
Bootloader and BSP support
Root filesystem updates
Core system services and systemd configuration
Device driver integration and troubleshooting
Platform scripts, tools, and configuration files
Embedded Linux interfaces and processes
Collaborate with team members, management, systems engineers, hardware teams, application teams, and mission operations to support project execution.
Assist with understanding and expanding requirements based on high-level specifications, system needs, and mission use cases.
Contribute to platform stability, security, and maintainability by:
Investigating bugs and integration issues
Supporting software updates and release activities
Helping maintain reproducible builds
Documenting changes, assumptions, and troubleshooting steps
Identifying risks and raising issues early
Communicating challenges, failures, and successes clearly
Participate in technical design reviews and code reviews to improve quality and maintainability of deliverables.
Support implementation of software architectures and designs that meet requirements.
Develop code following project coding guidelines, process requirements, and review expectations.
Assist with unit, integration, software-in-the-loop, and hardware-in-the-loop testing, including:
Developing and executing unit tests
Verifying requirements and interface behavior
Supporting code coverage activities
Helping analyze test results
Supporting SITL and HITL integration and testing
Capturing test results and release artifacts
Work with other subsystems to support proper integration of platform software into the broader flight software design.
Participate in implementation approach discussions by helping evaluate cost, complexity, schedule, and technical risk.
Support continuous improvement of team practices, including:
Improving documentation and knowledge sharing
Automating repetitive development or test tasks
Contributing to CI/CD improvements
Participating in retrospectives and post-release reviews
Helping improve release confidence and integration quality
Grow technical ownership over time in areas such as:
Yocto-based build systems
Linux kernel customization
Device trees and low-level hardware interfaces
Embedded networking concepts
Platform test automation
Flight software deployment and update flows
Software-in-the-loop and hardware-in-the-loop environments

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience
0–3 years of experience in software development, embedded systems, Linux, or related areas
Basic programming experience in one or more of:

C , C++ , Python, Bash / shell scripting
Familiarity with Linux development environments
Interest in embedded Linux, spacecraft systems, or mission-critical software
Familiarity with basic software development practices, including Git, code reviews, debugging, and documentation

Ability to troubleshoot technical issues with support from senior engineers
Willingness to learn complex systems and ask good questions
Ability to communicate technical challenges, risks, and progress clearly
Strong teamwork and collaboration skills
Ability to work in a cross-functional engineering environment
Love Space!
Willingness to work full-time in our Greenwood Village, CO office

Preferred Qualifications

Internship, academic, hobbyist, or project experience with Linux or embedded systems
Exposure to Linux internals, bootloaders, kernels, device trees, or root filesystems
Exposure to Yocto, Buildroot, or other embedded Linux build systems
Exposure to cross-compilation and low-level system interaction
Familiarity with device drivers or hardware/software interfaces
Familiarity with networking concepts and protocols
Experience with GitLab, CI/CD, issue tracking tools, or automated test pipelines
Experience with hardware bring-up, lab equipment, or debugging on target hardware
Familiarity with unit testing, integration testing, SITL, or HITL testing
Interest in aerospace, spacecraft operations, or operational software systems
Hobbyist project experience using Linux, embedded boards, robotics, radios, or home lab environments
Ability to obtain or maintain a US Secret Clearance

title: Child Life Specialist
description:
Position Summary

The Child Life Specialist is responsible for helping pediatric patients and families (to include siblings) understand and manage challenging life events and stressful healthcare experiences related to the child’s life-limiting, life-threatening condition. By providing developmental, educational, and therapeutic interventions for children and their families, the Child Life Specialist helps reduce the stress and anxiety that many children experience as a result of their medical care with resultant impact on the child’s family. Requires occasional evening and weekend work.

Essential Functions

Provides therapeutic play activities which facilitate expression of feelings, coping skills and patients’ understanding of medical procedures/diagnoses.
Collaborates with the interdisciplinary team to screen for patients most appropriate for therapeutic play interventions.
Initiates and provides individualized and developmentally appropriate therapeutic play activities.
Develops individual plans of care based on assessment of the child’s need, development, temperament, coping style, medical plan, and available support.
Provides patients and families opportunities for medical play, memory making, distraction, activity modification, coping, and other child life-associated activities, to support the child and family and, as appropriate, normalize the situation.
Provides appropriate pre-operative and peri-procedural teaching to reduce patient and family anxiety.
Provides memory making and anticipatory grief/bereavement support to the child’s family through the course of the child’s sickness and progressive decline in status.
Collaborates with pediatric social worker on patient/family psychosocial needs.
Maintains ongoing inter-team communication related to patient/sibling responses to child life interventions and observations.
Provides child-life focused education to parents/caregivers on topics to include child development, behavioral management, memory making, and coping strategies.
Helps parents to understand their child's response to treatment and assist siblings to better understand their brother's or sister's illness/condition.
Provides child life interventions to siblings addressing issues regarding illness, disease, or injury, treatment and prognosis appropriate to their developmental and coping levels.
Utilizes and educates the child/parent on appropriate procedural support, medical play, and distraction techniques to increase knowledge and awareness of medical procedures and reduce patient anxiety during stressful situations.
Educates patients, families and staff on child-life appropriate non-pharmacological pain/anxiety management techniques.
Demonstrates professionalism by developing, facilitating, and/or accomplishing skills and programs that reflect the state of art of child life.
Contributes to the collaborative plan of care for patients through participation in weekly interdisciplinary team meetings.
Participates in professional groups and advisory boards related to pediatric hospice and palliative care.
Participates in planning and implementation of remembrance events, program support groups.
Participates in education to program staff and community on child-life related topics.
Maintains professional certification.
Demonstrates tact, sensitivity, professional attitudes and judgment relating to patients, families and colleagues.
Other duties as assigned.

Knowledge and Critical Skills

Knowledge of:

Principles and practices of child development, therapeutic recreation.
Dynamics of family relationships and family systems

Skilled at:

Effective communication and listening skills
Ability to work within framework of interdisciplinary team

Experience

Must have child development/child life or therapeutic recreation experience

License / Certification

Must be certified as a Child Life Specialist by the Child Life Certifying Commission under the Child Life Council
Must possess current CPR certification

Education

Bachelor’s degree in Child Development or Therapeutic Recreation

Other Requirements

Requires occasional evening and weekend work.

The knowledge, skills and abilities listed above are typically acquired through the levels of education and experience listed. However, any equivalent combination of education and/or experience, which provide an applicant with the listed knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform the essential duties and responsibilities of the job, is acceptable.

This description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed by employees assigned to this role. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, qualifications, or working conditions required of employees in this position. The organization reserves the right to modify or amend the duties of the position or to require that additional tasks be performed as organizational needs change. This description does not constitute a contract of employment, and employment with the organization is at-will, meaning either the employee or the organization may terminate the relationship at any time, with or without cause or notice.

title: Associate Director/Director, Clinical Pharmacology
description:
Company Overview:

Beam Therapeutics is a biotechnology company committed to establishing the leading, fully integrated platform for precision genetic medicines. To achieve this vision, Beam has assembled a platform with integrated gene editing, delivery and internal manufacturing capabilities. Beam’s suite of gene editing technologies is anchored by base editing, a proprietary technology that is designed to enable precise, predictable and efficient single base changes, at targeted genomic sequences, without making double-stranded breaks in the DNA. This has the potential to enable a wide range of therapeutic editing strategies that Beam is using to advance a diversified portfolio of base editing programs. Beam is a values-driven organization committed to its people, cutting-edge science, and a vision of providing life-long cures to patients suffering from serious diseases.

​Position Overview: ​

The Associate Director/Director in Clinical Pharmacology position will support a rapidly expanding clinical portfolio of promising gene/base editing therapeutics. The candidate in this position should have strong scientific and technical skills, be well versed in PK and PD with a strong ability to critically evaluate and interpret data, conduct rapid exploratory analysis, quantitative systems pharmacology (QSP) and PKPD modeling. In this role, the candidate is expected to have strong data analyses, modeling, and critical thinking ability with good oral and written communication skills. The role could be tailored to focus solely on pharmacometrics or could be a hybrid Clinical Pharmacology/Pharmacometrics role based on the candidate’s experience and career aspirations. As a member of the clinical pharmacology department, this person is expected to operationalize model-based drug development, by integrating modeling results into clinical study design, regulatory documents, and internal decision-making. ​

Responsibilities:

  • ​Provide critical input in build-out of the Clinical Pharmacology function, including hiring of personnel and deployment of modeling infrastructure.
  • ​Operationalize model-based drug development, including new methodology approaches as described in regulatory guidelines.
  • Serve as key functional expert to lead, direct, and coordinate the activities of their assigned modeling projects.
  • ​Conduct PK and PK/PD analyses and modeling using nonclinical and clinical data.
  • ​Contribute to protocol and study report writings.
  • ​Present key pharmacometrics analyses results to internal and external stakeholders.
  • ​Facilitate model-based drug development across to support BEAM’s clinical programs.
  • ​Develop and write pharmacometrics analysis plans, execute and author reports on results of analyses.
  • ​Define and drive pharmacometrics contributions to regulatory/submission strategy and related documents.
  • ​Provide strategic expertise and leadership for development programs based on relevant technical and disease area knowledge.
  • ​In collaboration with cross functional partners, provide support for the quantitative evaluation of competing trial/analysis strategies.
  • May manage portfolios at disease area/therapeutic area/indication level to support integration of pharmacometrics and relevant knowledge in the planning and execution of programs and strategies.
  • ​Preparation of abstracts and manuscripts for publications.

Qualifications:

  • ​​Ph.D. in Pharmacokinetics, Pharmacology, Pharmacology, Pharmaceutics or other relevant field with 3 to 10 years of experience in pharmaceutical industry, or M.D or Pharm.D. with equivalent experience.
  • ​Expert knowledge and evidence of hands-on experience in the application of pharmacometrics methods to drug development.
  • Expertise in quantitative systems pharmacology (QSP).
  • ​Expertise in pharmacokinetics, PKPD principles, ADME concepts, and clinical pharmacology.
  • Expertise in Phoenix WinNonLin, NONMEM and R, or other pharmacokinetic, modeling and data visualization software.
  • ​Strong communication skills (verbal and written) and presentation skills are required. Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to function in a highly matrixed team environment are essential.
  • ​Experience and willingness to mentor and develop others.
  • ​Expertise in translational modeling in in-vivo and ex-vivo gene editing therapeutics.
  • Curiosity and enthusiasm to adopt to new modeling and data analyst approaches that facilitate new data or scientific insights. ​

The salary range below reflects the full-time base salary range we expect to pay for this role at the time of posting. Base pay will be determined based on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant experience, education, scope of job, internal comparisons, and market data.

Beam Pay Range
$185,000—$260,000 USD

title: Sr. Business Intelligence Engineer, Deal Tooling and I
description:

title: Site Attendant - Swing Shift
description:
“Every person deserves compassion, dignity, and the safety of a place to call home.”

Homelessness is the largest social and public health crisis in California. Illumination Health + Home is a growing non-profit organization dedicated towards disrupting the cycle of homelessness by providing targeted, interdisciplinary services in our recuperative care centers, emergency shelters, housing services and children's and family programs. IH+H currently has 13+ facilities with 22+ micro-communities scattered across Orange County, Los Angeles County and the Inland Empire.

Job Description

The Site Attendant plays a key role in maintaining a safe, clean, and supportive environment for clients. This position is responsible for enforcing facility rules, assisting with client needs, and ensuring the overall cleanliness and safety of the site. Duties include regular sanitation of high-touch areas, general cleaning of the facility, and following health and safety protocols. The Site Attendant also supports client intakes and discharges, performs routine room checks, and responds to immediate client or facility concerns. By maintaining high standards of cleanliness and care, the Site Attendant helps promote the health, safety, and well-being of all residents. This position operates in a high-level, fast-paced, and high-stress environment that requires the ability to manage multiple priorities, make critical decisions under pressure, and maintain professionalism at all times.

The starting pay rate for this position is $20.00-22.00 per hour. This position is also eligible for $1.00 swing shift differential and $2.00 graveyard shift differential. The schedule for this role is Wednesday - Sunday, 3:00PM to 11:30PM. Workdays may vary.

Responsibilities

Client Care & Support

  • Assist with client intakes and outtakes by preparing client bed area and ensuring bedding and surrounding areas are clean and ready prior to client arrival. Enforce client site rules and policies during admission and discharge.
  • Conduct routine wellness checks and facility walk-throughs (minimum of every 2 hours) to monitor client safety, behavior, and overall welfare. Intervene using de-escalation and conflict resolution techniques as necessary.
  • Perform scheduled and unscheduled searches of client belongings to ensure compliance with site rules and to prevent prohibited items from entering the facility.
  • Pick up client medications from pharmacies and assist with client move-outs, including the packing of belongings and final room sanitation.
  • Perform any other duties assigned by leadership to support client care and facility operations.

Meal Preparation & Food Safety
  • Prepare and serve balanced meals to clients in accordance with food safety standards (e.g., proper food storage, temperature control, hand hygiene, and cross-contamination prevention).
  • Sanitize all kitchen surfaces and equipment before and after every meal service, including countertops, prep areas, cutting boards, and utensils.
  • Ensure dining areas are cleaned and disinfected after every meal, including tables, chairs, and serving stations.

Sanitation & Housekeeping
  • Maintain a sanitary environment using universal precautions, including proper PPE usage and the safe handling/disposal of bodily fluids. Follow biohazard protocols when cleaning up spills or contamination.
  • Perform routine janitorial duties daily, including:
    • Sweeping and mopping all floors (client rooms, hallways, kitchen).
    • Vacuuming carpeted areas.
    • Emptying trash bins and replacing liners.
    • Cleaning windows, walls, and vents weekly or as needed.
  • Conduct deep cleaning of client dorms/rooms weekly or upon discharge, including disinfecting mattresses, wiping down all surfaces, laundering linens, and checking for pests or damage.

Transportation & Vehicle Maintenance
  • Drive clients to and from scheduled appointments and program activities, ensuring timely and safe transport in compliance with organizational protocols.
  • Maintain daily transportation logs, noting mileage, trip purposes, and any issues during transit.
  • Inspect company vehicles before each use and report maintenance or safety concerns to the supervisor immediately.
  • Clean and sanitize high-touch areas in vehicles (steering wheel, seatbelts, door handles, gear shift, dashboard) before and after each use.

Expectations

  • We uphold the values of Community, Action, Respect, and Empowerment in all aspects of our work.

    • Community We lead with the vision of a strengthened and compassionate community for all. By embodying collective care, we serve as an example of what is possible when we come together.

    • Action Our “whatever it takes” mindset drives us forward. We take initiative, step in where others have stepped out, and create solutions when none exist.

    • Respect We deeply value the dignity and uniqueness of every individual we serve. We honor their stories, their journeys, and their right to be seen and heard.

    • Empowerment We heal—always. Our work enables clients to grow stronger in health, confidence, and belief in their potential as they move forward on their life journey.

  • Follow all safety and sanitation guidelines

  • Set and maintain healthy boundaries with clients and staff.

  • Be able to meet targets and work under pressure.

  • Communicate any concerns and feedback to the Site Manager with tact and professionalism.

  • Demonstrate the ability to maintain confidentiality of client information and work-related information/materials.

  • Must remain in full compliance with all applicable local, state, and federal wage and hour laws, California Fair Employment and Housing Act (FEHA), as well as other regulatory and compliance standards relevant to the organization's operations.



Minimum Qualifications/Preferred Experience:

Required
  • High School Diploma or GED equivalent.
  • Basic computer skills, including the ability to send and receive emails and summarize data in spreadsheets.
  • Valid CA Driver’s License, 5 years of clean DMV record, and eligibility for company vehicle insurance.
Preferred
  • Bilingual in English and Spanish.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office

Benefits

  • Medical Insurance funded by Illumination Health + Home (Kaiser and Blue Shield), depending on the plan
  • Dental and Vision Insurance
  • Life, AD&D and LTD Insurance funded 100% by Illumination Health + Home
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Professional Development Reimbursement
  • 401K with Company Matching
  • 10 days vacation PTO/year
  • 6 days of sick pay/year
  • Potential eligibility for the Public Service Loan Forgiveness Program (PSFL) for federally qualified loans

description:

title: Construction Project Manager Assistant/Contract Admin (C)
description:
TST TACTICAL DEFENSE SOLUTIONS, INC.
DBA TIDEWATER DEVELOPMENT SERVICES CORPORATION (TDSC)


Our search is currently limited to qualified candidates living within the Hampton Roads commuting area.



SUMMARY:

The Construction Project Manager Assistant/Contract Administrator supports the successful execution of construction projects from award through closeout. This role is responsible for coordinating project setup, managing owner and subcontractor contract administration, tracking financial and project documentation, and supporting the Project Management team with day-to-day operational and administrative functions. The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, comfortable managing multiple projects at once, and experienced in construction contracts, billing, and project documentation within a general contracting environment.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS / MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Sets up new projects upon award, including issuing job numbers, setting up projects in the construction management and accounting systems, and establishing project folders in accordance with federal and company document control requirements.
  • Performs all duties of Owner contract administration, including contracts, correspondence, formal submissions, pay applications, and accounts receivable. Must be familiar with AIA-style billing and government pay application processes.
  • Performs all duties of subcontract and vendor administration, including subcontract and PO issuance, change orders, correspondence, documentation collection and tracking, compliance tracking, and accounts payable processing.
  • Assists with Owner and Subcontractor change orders, RFIs, RFPs, and submittal administration and tracking in accordance with contract and agency requirements (e.g., USACE, NAVFAC, VA, state or local agencies).
  • Reviews, organizes, maintains, and assists with interpretation of contract requirements, specifications, and project documents, including FAR/DFARS and agency-specific requirements as applicable.
  • Coordinates internal approvals for contracts, subcontracts, change orders, and related agreements with appropriate management staff.
  • Prepares and maintains the master submittal register and submittal log, and assists with review, processing, and submission of project submittals through required government systems (e.g., RMS/QCS, eCMS, or similar).
  • Ensures timely processing of technical reports, closeout documents, and project deliverables, and coordinates with Project Managers to ensure contract compliance and schedule requirements are met.
  • Prepares, maintains, and reviews required management, compliance, and project reports, as required by the contract and agency.
  • Attends project meetings, records and distributes meeting minutes, and tracks action items and required follow-ups.
  • Collects, reviews, tracks, and manages certified payrolls, and submits required labor compliance and reporting documentation to Owners and agencies.
  • Works closely and effectively with Site Superintendents, Project Managers, Program Managers, Executive Management, Finance, and internal and external stakeholders to support successful project execution.
  • Maintains current knowledge of relevant federal, state, and local contracting procedures, compliance requirements, and industry best practices.
  • Performs administrative and document control duties including scanning, filing, correspondence tracking, and maintaining organized project records in accordance with audit and compliance standards.
  • Enters and maintains data in the accounting system, and assists with tracking, reconciling, and analyzing project financial information and transactions.
  • Maintains accurate financial records, including accounts receivable, accounts payable, retention tracking, and change order logs.
  • Manages multiple projects and priorities simultaneously in a deadline-driven, compliance-focused environment.

  • Must reside within commuting distance of our main office in Virginia Beach, VA.

  • 3–5 years of experience in the construction industry, preferably with a general contractor.

Spending time coding hands-on while also designing systems and architecture.

Raise Quality Practices: Partner with product and engineering teams to influence and uplift their quality practices. Promote best practices through writing high quality documents, recording videos or delivering technical sessions.

Estimating, Scoping, and Planning: Own the estimation, scoping, and planning of projects, defining the team's strategy and roadmap. Work closely with peers, leadership, and engineering teams to deliver impactful workstreams.

Solve Complex Technical Challenges: Address and resolve complex technical problems, promoting best practices to ensure engineering and operational excellence. Simplify architecture, manage technical debt, and enforce best practices in security and testing.

Mentoring and Coaching: Actively mentor and coach engineers, sharing knowledge and driving team topics. Promote a culture of support and collaboration to increase team productivity and growth.

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Build strong relationships with cross-functional teams, including product management and leadership, to drive the success of engineering initiatives. Participate in interviewing and hiring to contribute to the growth and success of the team.

Operational Leadership: Ensure operational excellence across the product lifecycle, driving incident management and continuous improvement. Enhance monitoring, observability, and team productivity.

Technical Expertise: Proficiency in Typescript with experience in writing high quality tests in Playwright (other frontend testing libraries are also valued). Experience of building testing infrastructure or frameworks and a record of improving developer experience through pipeline redesigns and declarative CI/CD approaches would be highly desired.
Operational Excellence: Skilled in implementing various testing strategies, including the testing pyramid, and demonstrated experience in maintaining high availability requirements and performance. Ensuring technical strategies are effectively translated into reality. Demonstrated experience in managing operational quality and incident response, with a focus on continuous improvement.
Leadership and Mentorship: Proven ability to mentor and coach engineers, amplifying their technical abilities and enabling the team to succeed. Strong written and spoken communication skills are essential.

Personio is an equal opportunities employer, committed to building an integrative culture where everyone feels welcomed and supported. We embrace uniqueness and understand that our diverse, values-driven culture makes us stronger. We are proud to have an inclusive workplace environment that will foster your development no matter your gender, civil status, family status, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, education level, or race.

The Portsmouth Sheriff’s Office seeks Virginia DCJS-Certified Law Enforcement officers to serve primarily as School Resource Officers (SRO).


Mandatory: Basic Law Enforcement certification and at least 3 years as a Certified Deputy


The School Resource Officer (SRO) position is responsible for the prevention, detection, investigation, and prosecution of criminal violations that happen on Portsmouth Public City Schools property or events.   • Is advised of all situations where other units within the law enforcement agency have provided services to the school.
  • Provides information to the appropriate investigative units of crimes or leads that come to the attention of the officer.
    Is kept advised of all investigations by other units that involve students from his/her assigned school.

  • Adhere to the guidelines of the MOU with Portsmouth Public Schools.

Certified as a School Resource Officer

The ideal candidate is compassionate, organized, and responsive, with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment. Join a mission-driven team dedicated to strengthening families and communities while making a meaningful impact every day.

title: Leave Specialist (HR)
description:
POSITION SUMMARY

We are looking for an HR Representative to join our team at Jireh Semiconductor in Hillsboro, OR. The HR Representative reports to and supports the Director of Human Resources with projects related to the HR functions of the organization. This position will focus on leave administration, workers' compensation, and benefits. This position is Monday-Friday, 9:30 am - 6:30 pm. This is a fully onsite position and as a 24/7 manufacturing facility, we are looking for a candidate who will be flexible to provide infrequent morning/evening and weekend coverage.

PRIMARY DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Advise employees and managers on leave policies, processes and laws; serve as primary point of contact for all leave types and applicable time off, disability benefits, Workers' Compensation, and benefit billing
  • Maintain tracking of leave status', as well as workers' compensation and accommodations
  • Maintain communication with employees on leave to facilitate smooth and timely return-to-work; relay communications between employees and managers during leave
  • Navigate difficult conversations, mental health situations, and in-crisis employee situations and provide resources
  • Administer the return-to-work process for employees, including coordinating ADA accommodations as needed
  • Advise on time off entries for all leave types; monitor time off entries during leaves to ensure accurate payroll
  • Prepare weekly/monthly/quarterly reports regarding leave usage
  • Prepare and distribute benefits and leave related communications, notices and reminders
  • Assist employees with benefits related questions and benefits enrollments
  • Maintain HR related systems and audit data for accuracy
  • May perform functions as part of new hire orientations and/or the termination process
  • Serve as a back-up for employee relations issues including employee complaints, investigations, corrective actions, etc.
  • May support an identified area and become main contact for employee/supervisory questions and employee relations activities
  • Provide backup coverage for other HR team members on weekends and evenings (up to 8 pm) as needed to cover vacations and other absence
  • Other HR related functions and duties as assigned

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE & EDUCATION

  • Bachelor's Degree in Human Resource Management or a related field highly preferred
  • 3-5 years of experience working directly in a Human Resources Department, with significant exposure to leave administration
  • 2 years of Paid Leave Oregon administration experience highly preferred
  • Equivalent combination of education and experience

OTHER QUALIFICATIONS

  • Benefits administration, workers' compensation, timecard processing, employee relations, and new hire orientation experience strongly preferred
  • Compensation experience a plus
  • Payroll & manufacturing experience a plus
  • Must have flexible availability to cover as early as 6 am and as late as 8 pm, as well as weekends, infrequently to cover for other teammates
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook required)
  • Experience with ADP Workforce Now preferred
  • Demonstrated ability to maintain confidentiality
  • High level attention to detail
  • Strong multitasking and prioritization abilities
  • Proactive and efficient work ethic
  • Customer focused / approachable / personable
  • Excellent communication skills (oral and written)
  • Demonstrated understanding of state, and federal employment laws

*Pay range listed in this job posting is an estimate only, and is not necessarily reflective of actual compensation that may be earned, nor a promise of pay for any specific employee future or past. Offers made are always dependent upon actual experience, education and other factors. Depending upon experience, candidates may receive an offer for a position level lower or higher than that listed, i.e. application to a Staff level position does not guarantee an offer of Staff title.

COMPANY INFORMATION: Alpha and Omega Semiconductor (AOS) is committed to excellence in design, manufacturing, and responsiveness to our customers through the continued development of new technologies, products and innovative solutions. We bring to the market devices designed to benefit our customers by meeting their product specific needs. Our mission is to bring value to our customers, shareholders and employees.

AOS differentiates itself by integrating its Discrete and IC semiconductor process technology, product design, and advanced packaging know-how to develop high performance power management solutions. AOS's portfolio of products targets high-volume applications, including but not limited to portable computers, flat panel TVs, LED lighting, smart phones, battery packs, consumer and industrial motor controls and power supplies for TVs, computers, servers and telecommunications equipment.

Jireh Semiconductor, Inc., a wholly owned subsidiary of Alpha and Omega Semiconductor Ltd., is the in-house wafer fab for AOS and is located in Hillsboro, Oregon.

title: Technical Records Assembly Specialist II
description:
Summary
The Technical Records Assembly Specialist II is responsible for continuous analysis and management of aircraft engine, APU, and landing gear assembly back to birth records to ensure compliance with 14 CFR 121.380. They identify, reconcile, and manage discrepancies with external repair vendors, OEM, and prior operators. The Specialist II coordinates with Powerplant Engineering, Fleet Planning, Materials, Component Repairs, Planning, Fleet Assets and other internal departments regarding scheduled and unscheduled assembly removals and installations. The Technical Records Assembly Specialist II reports to the Senior Manager of Aircraft Records.
Visa Sponsorship Available: No
Minimum Requirements
A combination of Education and Experience will be considered. Must be authorized to work in the US as defined by the Immigration Act of 1986. Must pass a Criminal Background Check.
Education: High School Diploma/GED
Years of Experience: Minimum three (3) years of experience as an Allegiant Records Technician, and/or experience at another part 91, 121, 135 operator, 145 repair station working on 91/121/135 aircraft, or DOD transport aircraft records department. A combination of listed experience is acceptable.
• Knowledge of and ability to understand and research FAA Airworthiness Directives (AD’s), IPC’s, Service Bulletins, etc that pertain to aircraft, engines, landing gear, and APU’s.
• Proficient in understanding of Federal Aviation Regulations (FAR’s) related to Aircraft Recordkeeping and retention requirements and Air Transportation Association (ATA) Coding.
• proficient in understanding required documentation to establish life limited component back to birth traceability.
• Understanding of required certification documentation for new, overhauled, and repaired components from suppliers and maintenance providers in multiple countries.
• Good written and oral communication skills, project management skills.
• Ability to interpret and understand technical documents such as CFM Chapter 5, ALS Appendix 7, IPC, Engineering Documents, Airworthiness Directives, Service Bulletins, and previous operator versions of documents.
• Proficient in ERP tracking software such as AIS, TRAX eMRO, AMOS.
• Proficient in Adobe Acrobat and Microsoft Office Products.

• Strong critical thinking and analytical skills.

• Ability to work well with others and communicate effectively with internal and external customers at all levels.

Job Duties

• Responsible for review of all life limited component potential purchases to ensure back to birth traceability and component build specifications requirements.
• Prepare, review, and present life limited status reports of removed assemblies for certification.
• Provide daily support to Component Repairs, Engineering, Heavy Maintenance, Regulatory Compliance for records requests received via JIRA.

title: Director of Data Engineering
description:
Job Description

At 2K, we create some of the most iconic and culture-shaping video games in entertainment, including NBA® 2K, one of the top-selling franchises in the world, and legendary titles like BioShock®, Borderlands®, Mafia, Sid Meier’s Civilization®, and XCOM®, as well as fan favorites WWE® 2K, TopSpin®, and PGA TOUR® 2K. We build unforgettable experiences by pushing the boundaries of creativity, authenticity and innovation across every genre.

Our portfolio is brought to life by some of the most influential game development studios in the world. Visual Concepts, Firaxis Games, Hangar 13, Cat Daddy Games, 31st Union, Cloud Chamber, Gearbox, HB Studios, and 2K SportsLab create world-class experiences across platforms.

But what truly powers 2K is our people.

We believe the best ideas come from teams that feel empowered, supported, and inspired. As an equal opportunity employer, we are committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive workplace where people are encouraged to come as they are and do their best work.

What We Need

The Director of Data Engineering is a technical and strategic powerhouse responsible for architecting the data foundations that power 2K’s global ecosystem. This role oversees the engineering strategy, telemetry standards, and infrastructure framework that transforms raw player interactions into high-fidelity, actionable intelligence.

You will lead the evolution of our data platform, moving beyond traditional ETL toward a proactive, AI-integrated environment. As a natural "bridge builder," you will partner deeply with Studio leads and cross-functional executives to expand the remit of data engineering. Crucially, you will act as a steward of our resources, applying FinOps principles to ensure our infrastructure is high-performing, cost-efficient, and that every technical investment delivers clear business value—ensuring the “juice is always worth the squeeze.”

What You’ll Do

  • Lead a forward-looking data engineering vision that scales across Sports, Core, and R&D, prioritizing high-scale telemetry and proactive data modeling.
  • Transition 2K’s infrastructure toward AI-augmented data processing, leveraging tools like Snowflake Cortex or Databricks Genie to automate and optimize the data lifecycle.
  • Own the cloud infrastructure budget, implementing rigorous FinOps practices to monitor, manage, and optimize data processing costs.
  • Evaluate technical debt versus innovation, ensuring all platform scaling is economically sustainable and tied to measurable ROI.

Own the End-to-End Telemetry Lifecycle

  • Drive the strategy for telemetry design and implementation, ensuring an intimate connection between game-client events and downstream analytical value.
  • Establish rigorous telemetry standards that ensure high-signal, low-latency data capture across all titles and platforms.

Build the Platform for ML Ops & Proactive Modeling

  • Design and scale a dedicated ML Ops framework that allows Data Scientists to deploy, monitor, and iterate on AI models with industry-leading efficiency.
  • Champion the use of proactive modeling to predict player needs and business trends before they occur.

Expand Impact Through Strategic Partnerships

  • Act as a key relationship builder, creating strong alliances with Studio Engineering, DevOps, and Commercial leadership to align data roadmaps with product goals.
  • Navigate complex partner dynamics with diplomacy, building trust and expanding the Data Engineering team's influence across the broader organization.
  • Partner tightly with the Director of Product of 2K Data to define and deliver upon a modern and comprehensive data strategy.

Build, Lead & Develop a High-Performing Engineering Team

  • Hire, mentor, and grow a world-class team of data engineers, telemetry specialists, and ML platform engineers.
  • Foster a culture of technical rigor, financial accountability, and "bridge-building" collaboration.
  • Foster an internal culture of innovation and fearless technical thought leadership throughout the data teams

What Will Make You A Great Fit

  • Extensive experience in Data Engineering or Software Engineering, with a heavy emphasis on high-scale distributed systems and telemetry.
  • Proven Success leading or managing engineering teams in complex, multi-title environments with proven track record of promoting engineers in both title and breadth of technical expertise
  • Intimate knowledge of Telemetry: You understand the nuances of event-driven architecture and how to design schemas that capture the “heartbeat” of a product.
  • Experience in Streaming Telemetry and Feature Pipelines Solid understanding and experience in delivering large-scale, global data streaming services with scalable and sustainable architecture to support real-time machine learning operations and features
  • FinOps Mentality: Proven ability to manage large-scale cloud budgets, optimizing for both performance and cost-efficiency.
  • Master Relationship Builder: You have a track record of turning “difficult” technical partners into advocates and successfully expanding your team's strategic remit.
  • Growth Mindset: Indexes toward learning through challenges and didactic learning patterns to bring about change at the individual and organizational levels.
  • Experience in Matrix-driven and Product-led Environments: Able to successfully operate and thrive in matrixed environments led by product strategies and roadmaps.
  • A Track Record of Operational Excellence: You have demonstrated experience upleveling global data operations and a deep understanding of SRE or DevOps principles. You don't just maintain systems; you build the guardrails, automation, and infrastructure needed to scale them reliably.

Bonus Points

  • Full-Lifecycle Data Science & ML Enablement: Comprehensive experience across the data science lifecycle, from exploratory data analysis and feature engineering to model deployment and monitoring.
  • Software Engineering Background: Strong experience in full-stack development or systems architecture.
  • Game Engine Expertise: Hands-on experience with Unreal Engine, Unity, or proprietary game engines, specifically regarding how they emit data.
  • AI Fluency: Experience with Snowflake Cortex, Databricks Genie, Langchain, Rust or similar AI-integrated data platforms.
  • Passion for games and a player-focused mindset.

As an equal opportunity employer, we are committed to ensuring that qualified individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform their essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us if you need reasonable accommodation.

title: Identity and Access Management Consultant
description:
Strata Information Group (SIG) is a trusted leader in higher‑education technology consulting, supporting colleges and universities with ERP/SIS modernization, digital transformation, CRM, cybersecurity, and strategic advisory services. As a long‑standing and deeply embedded partner within the higher‑education sector, SIG brings together technical depth, operational insight, and a culture rooted in integrity, collaboration, and exceptional client service. Our heritage is built on hands‑on expertise, genuine relationships, and a commitment to delivering value with humility and excellence—values that continue to define us as we scale.

Help colleges and universities build secure, scalable identity and access management solutions.
Strata Information Group (SIG) is seeking an experienced Identity and Access Management Consultant to partner with higher education institutions as they strengthen access, authentication, and identity management across their technology environments. You will assess existing IAM infrastructure, understand each client’s business and compliance needs, and guide practical solutions from discovery and design through implementation and ongoing support.
This remote role is a strong fit for an IAM professional who brings deep technical expertise, thoughtful problem-solving, and a collaborative, client-focused approach. If you value meaningful partnerships and want your work to improve technology experiences for students, faculty, and staff, we invite you to learn more.

Key Responsibilities:

  • For each project, understand the client's business processes, security policies, and compliance requirements to be able to design IAM solutions that meet the client's objectives.
  • Develop and implement IAM architecture that includes access control, authentication, identity management, and ensure solutions are scalable, secure, and meet the client's requirements.
  • Maintain technical currency for the latest IAM tools and solutions, assess their suitability for the client's requirements, and recommend solutions that meet their needs.
  • Conduct IAM assessments of the client's existing IAM infrastructure, identify risks and vulnerabilities, and recommend remediation strategies to address these issues.
  • Work with clients to develop IAM policies and procedures that comply with regulatory requirements and align with their business objectives.
  • Provide technical guidance and support to clients throughout the IAM solution lifecycle, including requirements gathering, design, implementation, and post-implementation support.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Previous experience working in or with higher education institutions is preferred.
  • 5+ years of experience in Identity and Access Management consulting.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field (related industry experience will be considered in place of a degree).
  • Experience developing and implementing IAM architectures, including access control, authentication, and identity management.
  • Knowledge of IAM technologies and solutions, including Active Directory, LDAP, SSO, and multi-factor authentication, including their strengths and weaknesses.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team, managing multiple clients and projects at one time.
  • SAML and CAS expertise to configure services, manage and troubleshoot IdP (user store, claim configuration), and manage certificates.
  • Knowledge and experience working with IdP solutions such as Ellucian Ethos Identity, WSO2 Identity Server, Shibboleth Identity Provider, Apereo CAS, QuickLaunch, PortalGuard, Entra ID, ADFS, and Okta.
  • Experience with the LDAP protocol and working with a directory server (such as Active Directory, OpenDJ/Open LDAP, etc) to configure, deploy, and manage the environment.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with Ellucian Products & Single-Sign-On Configuration.
  • Experience with Ellucian User Provisioning (EUP).
  • Significant experience working with IAM tools including InCommon Trusted Access Platform, Shibboleth, Grouper, Midpoint, Comanage, Microsoft Identity Manager, and Entra ID.
  • Technical skills working with Java and Java Server Pages.
  • Knowledge and experience working a variety of multi-factor authentication (MFA) products to design, test and deploy solutions depending upon clients requirements.
  • Knowledge of the SPML framework will be helpful in this position.
  • Experience working with RESTFUL APIs will be helpful.
  • CIAM, CISSP or CISM certifications are important.

Compensation & Benefits:

Starting salary range for this position is $110,000 - $130,000 depending on individual skills and experience.

  • Remote (with possible travel for onsite client engagements)
  • Flexible hours
  • Annual bonus
  • Medical, vision and dental

  • PTO, Sick and holiday pay
  • Life insurance
  • Retirement 401(k) 5% employer contributions
  • Professional Development opportunities
  • Monthly Connectivity stipend

title: Youth Development Counselor- Taylor Ray
description:

What You Bring

Day Camp roles will include outdoor activities such as hiking, swimming, and extended periods of standing or walking.

Day Camp Program: Monday–Friday, 6:30 am–6:30 pm with multiple shift options (aligned with ISD breaks). Occasional Saturdays.

When you join the YMCA, you join a mission-driven community that invests in your growth. title: Principal PMT, NTN Core, Amazon Leo
description:
Amazon Leo is building the world's most advanced Low Earth orbit (LEO) satellite constellation to deliver fast, reliable internet connectivity to unserved and underserved communities around the globe. As part of this mission, we are seeking a Principal Product Manager – Technical (PMT) to define product requirements, lead feature alignment, and drive roadmap planning for the NTN Core Network globally. You will work closely with engineering teams across satellite RAN, Core, and Devices, with focus on the NTN core.

This role requires deep technical mastery of 3GPP protocols, NAS signaling, extensive experience deploying 4G/5G Packet Cores across multiple vendors, product lifecycle software release management, and the ability to translate customer experiences and user stories into detailed product requirements. The Principal Product Manager - Technical (PMT) will be at the forefront of defining NTN Core Network requirements and building 0-to-1 satellite systems for consumer, business, and government customers globally.

Export Control Requirement:
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities
• Drive NTN Core Network feature alignment to ensure interoperability across Amazon Leo RAN, Core, Transport, and cloud infrastructure, delivering seamless connectivity and roaming services between satellite and terrestrial networks.
• Own the NTN Core Network product roadmap and service delivery plan, ensuring delivery across multiple workstreams with high standards and operational excellence.
• Work closely with Amazon Leo engineering teams, Payload Integration Test (PIT) and telco MNO/Device/Chipset partners to define, build, deploy and test 3GPP-compliant protocol layers, network functions, and service-based architecture, ensuring deterministic behavior, low latency, and high reliability for satellite-based connectivity and TN-NTN mobility. Lead by example with systems thinking to solve problems.
• Stay current with 3GPP releases, industry trends, and evolving NTN deployment models to guide long-term product strategy aligned to Amazon Leo’s roadmap.
• Write and present technical documents (6-pagers, PR/FAQs, BRDs, PRDs) to senior leadership.
• Collaborate cross-functionally with engineering hardware, software, systems, operations, and program management teams across Amazon Leo.
• Be structured and flexible at the same time to learn as the business evolves.
• Provide visibility and communicate extremely well, with responsibility to provide updates to VPs, author operation plans, business review documents, and communicate to the broader Amazon Leo team.
• Be a seasoned product leader with a demonstrated history of leading product strategy, technology solutions, data analytics, and customer experience.
• Thrive on ambiguity and have a track record of delivering large-scale technology products and/or led large operational or technical teams.
• Lead large, global, and complex technology initiatives in a large business unit, working cross-functionally with several business and technical teams.
• The ability to think and move quickly and is inspired to build mechanisms to simplify and continuously innovate.
• Demonstrated analytical and quantitative skills; ability to use hard data and metrics to back up assumptions and develop business cases.

A day in the life
Here at Amazon, we embrace our differences. We are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We have innovative benefit offerings, and host annual and ongoing learning experiences. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious and earn trust.

Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better-rounded professional and enable them to take on more complex tasks in the future.

About the team
You will be joining a team that is focused on defining and driving the product requirements for the Amazon Leo Direct-to-Device (DTD) satellite system.

title: Engineer or Mathematician - Cost Estimating Analyst (Entry Level)
description:
Position Summary:

Vali Incorporated seeks a highly qualified candidate to support the Missile Defense Agency (MDA) as an Entry level Cost Estimating Analyst. This position will perform Cost Estimating Analysis supporting the development, fielding, and integration of the Terminal High Altitude Area Defense (THAAD) program element of the Missile Defense Agency's (MDA) Missile Defense System (MDS). Cost Estimating support includes development and maintenance of Life Cycle Cost Estimates and models for Defense Acquisition programs, analysis and reporting of cost data, and conducting excursions.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Under supervision, develop, present, and defend mathematical cost estimates, cost estimating relationships, and cost models.
  • Under supervision, develop cost estimating relationships using applied mathematics, probability, statistics, regression analysis, linear algebra, learning curves, and data collection.
  • Under supervision, use Data Analytics to obtain and analyze essential cost data from contractors' DD Form 1921s and Cost Performance Reports/Integrated Program Management Reports (CPR/IPMR) for the purpose of establishing a credible cost database.
  • Participate in Business Case Analysis (BCA), Analysis of Alternatives (AOA), and risk analysis to develop multiple outputs using input variables by conducting what-if drills, sensitivity analysis, monte-carlo simulations, and other cost-related studies.
  • Review Cost Analysis Requirements Documents (CARDS).
  • Under supervision, collect and manage cost data, technical baseline data, and cost research/analysis.

Education and Experience Requirements:

  • Education: Bachelor's Degree in Mathematics, Engineering, Operations Research, Economics, Statistics, Business Analytics, or related field.
  • Experience: No prior experience required, but must have a math-based bachelor's degree.
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills.
  • Exceptionally strong analytical skills and be detail oriented.
  • Must possess or be eligible to obtain and maintain a DoD Secret clearance.

Desired Experience Requirements:

  • Must be a self-starter.
  • Strong knowledge of MS Office with a focus on Excel.
  • Membership and certification in International Cost Estimating and Analysis Association (ICEAA).
