title: Senior Conversion Design Analyst (f/m/d)
description:
Your mission

We're looking for a Senior Conversion Design Analyst who is genuinely both things: a designer who digs into data, and an analyst who designs. You decide with evidence. You will frame real user problems based on qualitative and quantitative data, design a part of our product, form a view about what should change, build the experiment that tests it, and analyze the results yourself.

You will sit inside the product delivery team that focuses on user growth, working closely with the person accountable for that part of the business and with the engineers building it. And you will not be doing it alone: You join a group of Conversion Design Analysts across the company who work the same way and hold each other's standards.

English is our working language. German matters here too: You will be designing flows that German-speaking users read.

Concretely, you will:

  • Design experiences grounded in real user needs and real neighbourhood life. Your job is to design flows and screens that are highly usable and intuitive and that earn their place by adding measurable value, not just because we can build them.
  • Frame the real problem before solving it. Dig into quantitative and qualitative data until you find the actual question underneath the ask. Then make it explainable and actionable. A well-framed problem is half the battle
  • Design, run the experiment, read it honestly and decide what comes next. Define a testable change, get it instrumented properly, and analyse the outcome. Then use what you learned to frame the next question. That includes reporting the tests that did not work, and designing the next step.
  • Talk to neighbours. Experiments tell you what happened, not what people needed. You will spend real time with the people who use this, because you cannot A/B test your way to understanding somebody.
  • Direct AI, and spend your judgment where it counts. AI produces a lot of our first-pass design. You will brief it, push back on it, and hold the quality bar, so your own hours go to the thinking a model cannot do.
  • Argue for cutting things. Adding is easy. You will help decide what earns its place and what should be removed, and be willing to make the case for less.

Your profile

  • You practice product design and analytics. You might come from an analyst background and bring a love of design and design thinking, or vice versa.
  • You have run experiments end to end and know how to move from one to the next. Setting up the hypothesis, designing strong variants using our design system, choosing the right metrics to track, analyzing the results and then making a clear call on how to continue: ship it, kill it, or iterate.
  • You have technical know-how and experience in setting up and evaluating experiments in an A/B testing tool, constructing the needed dashboards for the problem space you are working on.
  • With sufficient data literacy, you get your own numbers through SQL query. You work with raw data to dig up insights and spot opportunities, without waiting for someone else to pull it for you.
  • You have statistical literacy. You don’t need to be able to run R, but you understand what Bayesian vs. frequentist is about and why you do a power analysis before launching an experiment.
  • You care about craft and are attentive to details. You can tell the difference between good enough and actually good and you design experiences people do not have to think about.
  • You present your work clearly, defend your decisions when challenged, and are comfortable in front of a crowd.
  • You are fluent with AI tools. This role allows you to have more control and impact through both design and analysis, but to do this well you'll need to leverage (and at times extend) our AI enablement stack
  • Excellent English skills for working in our international team.

To apply, include a cover letter explaining why this role and why now and if your background doesn't tick every box, tell us how you'd bridge the gap. Alongside it, share a portfolio that shows your work through its impact, at least one project walked through end to end: the hypothesis, what you designed, the result, and what you took from it. Show us how you used data to move your thinking forward, and where experimentation shaped what you built. If you can't share a portfolio due to an NDA or the nature of your work, a detailed cover letter walking through a project in the same way is fine.

Nice to have

  • Experience with a marketplace, community, classifieds, or other network product.
  • Strong German, or the confidence to design in it with support.
  • Experience building or maintaining parts of a design system.
  • Comfortable writing SQL without AI assistance.
  • You have basic dbt knowledge.

What we offer

  • Hybrid work model combining office and remote days
  • A meaningful job – we're creating a great product with real added value for the community
  • Work in a cheerful and experienced team that exchanges ideas and learns from each other
  • Insights into the entire work process of our social startup and the foundation
  • Responsibility and great opportunities to actively contribute
  • Your SpenditCard – you'll receive an additional income of 35 Euros per month, which you can use for things of your choice
  • 30 days of vacation per year – we also offer the possibility of workation models and a sabbatical
  • A workplace in Berlin-Kreuzberg and regular events like yoga or Lunch & Learn sessions.

If we’ve captured your interest, apply now and let us know why you’re the perfect fit for the job!

title: Spacecraft Fluids & Pumps Engineering Technician
description:
K2 is building the largest and highest-power satellites ever flown, unlocking performance levels previously out of reach across every orbit. Backed by over $1 billion in total funding from leading investors including Altimeter Capital, ICONIQ, Kleiner Perkins, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Redpoint Ventures, and T. Rowe Price — and with over $1 billion in signed contracts across commercial and US government customers, we're mass-producing the highest-power satellite platforms ever built for missions from LEO to deep space.

The rise of heavy-lift launch vehicles is shifting the industry from an era of mass constraint to one of mass abundance, and we believe this new era demands a fundamentally different class of spacecraft. Engineered to survive the harshest radiation environments and to fully capitalize on today's and tomorrow's massive rockets, K2 satellites deliver unmatched capability at constellation scale and across multiple orbits.

With multiple launches in 2027 and plans to scale to 100 satellites a year, we're Building Bigger — helping develop the solar system and build toward a Kardashev Type II (K2) civilization. If you are a motivated individual who thrives in a fast-paced environment and you're excited about contributing to the success of a high-growth Series D-funded company, we'd love for you to apply.

The Role

As a Spacecraft Fluids & Pumps Engineering Technician, you will build and test the turbopumps and pumped fluid loop hardware that cool our high-power satellites, from development units through production. The ideal candidate is a highly hands-on technician comfortable working across mechanical, fluid, and electromechanical systems in a fast-paced environment.

Responsibilities

  • Assemble precision turbopumps and fluid loop mechanisms (rotating assemblies, bearings, seals, valves, accumulators) hardware to engineering drawings, BOMs, and work instructions
  • Build, operate, and maintain development flow loops and test stands, including plumbing, instrumentation, and dataacquisition
  • Install and check out pressure transducers, temperature sensors, and flow meters
  • Fabricate, bend, fit, and install precision tubing and fluid lines; perform orbital welding and fitting operations to required standards
  • Execute hydraulic performance, leak, flow, and proof pressure tests
  • Perform fluid loop cleaning, flushing, vacuum evacuation, and working fluid fill/charge per released procedures
  • Install pump motors, motorized/solenoid valves, and sensors, including harness routing, connector mating, and termination
  • Collaborate closely with manufacturing, test, quality, and design engineering to resolve hardware issues in real time
  • Follow detailed work instructions and manufacturing procedures, performing all work in the MES (scanning, material consumption, and as-built traceability)
  • Practice 5S principles of organizing and sustaining an efficient and presentable workspace
  • Provide consistent process improvement feedback to engineering and production leadership
  • Support vehicle integration operations and other related departments as needed

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of hands-on aerospace or high-reliability assembly and test experience with fluid or rotating hardware (propulsion, thermal control, pumps/compressors, hydraulics, or similar)
  • Experience with proof pressure, leak and flow testing
  • Hands-on experience with tube fabrication, bending, and fittings (swagelok/compression, AN, VCR, flare, or similar)
  • Familiarity with MES/MRP software
  • Familiar with calibrated tools including multimeters, megohmmeters, power suppliers, torque wrenches, safety cable guns, and crimpers
  • Demonstrated high level of ownership and problem-solving abilities
  • Experience working with FOD, ESD sensitive hardware and clean room requirements

Nice to Have

  • Direct experience with aerospace thermal control/fluid loop or propulsion systems
  • Ability to read mechanical and engineering drawings and interpret tolerances (including GD&T)
  • Experience working with engineering teams in development and production environments
  • Strong communication skills with ability to communicate hardware and systems problems, and provide feedback on improving tooling processes and part design
  • Ability to obtain or current hold top secret/SCI security clearance

Additional Requirements

  • Must be able to perform repetitive tasks such as bending or twisting, grasping, standing, lifting, pulling, pushing, stooping, stretching, carrying, and use hands to operate tools or machine controls
  • Must be able to lift and carry parts or equipment up to 50 lbs. unassisted
  • Must be able to stand for extended periods of time
  • Must be able to work extended hours and/or weekends as needed

Compensation and Benefits:

  • Hourly pay range for this non-exempt role is $35 - $45 + equity in the company
  • Compensation will be based on several factors including, but not limited to: knowledge and skills, education, and experience level
  • Comprehensive benefits package including paid time off, medical/dental/vision coverage, life insurance, paid parental leave, and many other perks

If you don’t meet 100% of the preferred skills and experience, we encourage you to still apply! Building a spacecraft unlike any other requires a team unlike any other and non-traditional career twists and turns are encouraged!

If you need a reasonable accommodation as part of your application for employment or interviews with us, please let us know.

Export Compliance

As defined in the ITAR, “U.S. Persons” include U.S. citizens, lawful permanent residents (i.e., Green Card holders), and certain protected individuals (e.g., refugees/asylees, American Samoans). Please consult with a knowledgeable advisor if you are unsure whether you are a “U.S. Person.”

The person hired for this role will have access to information and items controlled by U.S. export control regulations, including the export control regulations outlined in the International Traffic in Arms Regulation (ITAR). The person hired for this role must therefore either be a “U.S. person” as defined by 22 C.F.R. § 120.15 or otherwise eligible for a federally issued export control license.

Equal Opportunity

K2 Space is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with K2 Space is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.

title: Design Verification Engineer - technical lead, Annapurna Labs

This role requires developing and implementing verification environments using state-of-the-art simulation methodology. - Drive unified verification plans across multiple environments, tools and methodologies

- Own the technical direction and drive resolution of complex verification challenges at sub-system and chip-level, providing hands-on technical guidance and effective solutions
- Guide and mentor team members on best practices, methodology improvements, and technical problem-solving

The ideal candidate should have proven experience leading verification efforts at block, sub-system or chip level, with hands-on experience verifying at multiple levels of logic from IP blocks to SoCs to full system testing. Experience using multiple verification platforms including formal verification, emulation, and test-generation tools is highly desired.


About the team
Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, we embrace our differences. We are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We have ten employee-led affinity groups, reaching 40,000 employees in over 190 chapters globally. We have innovative benefit offerings, and host annual and ongoing learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences. Our team puts a high value on work-life balance. It isn’t about how many hours you spend at home or at work; it’s about the flow you establish that brings energy to both parts of your life. We believe striking the right balance between your personal and professional life is critical to life-long happiness and fulfillment. We offer flexibility in working hours and encourage you to find your own balance between your work and personal lives.

Mentorship & Career Growth
Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better-rounded professional and enable them to take on more complex tasks in the future.

title: Executive Director, Global Commercial Proleukin
description:
About Iovance Biotherapeutics, Inc.

Iovance Biotherapeutics, Inc. is the global leader in innovating, developing, and delivering tumor infiltrating lymphocyte (TIL) cell therapies for patients with solid tumors. Amtagvi® (lifileucel) is the first FDA-approved, one-time treatment for previously treated advanced melanoma, now approved in three global markets and available at more than 95 authorized treatment centers. The Iovance TIL platform spans registrational trials and next-generation programs in additional solid tumors, including gene-edited and IL-12 tethered TIL therapies, next-generation IL-2, and precision immuno-oncology approaches. As the first and only company to take TIL therapy from concept to a broadly accessible commercial treatment, Iovance operates as an end-to-end cell therapy company, anchored by fully owned, centralized U.S.-based manufacturing that is scaled to serve thousands of cancer patients worldwide each year. For more information, please visit .

Amtagvi® and its accompanying design marks, Proleukin®, Iovance®, and IovanceCares™ are trademarks and registered trademarks of Iovance Biotherapeutics, Inc. or its subsidiaries. All other trademarks and registered trademarks are the property of their respective owners.

Overview

The Executive Director, Global Commercial Proleukin leads the global Proleukin business and sets its long-range strategy and operating priorities for the United States and international markets, including licensed and unlicensed countries. The role is accountable for business performance and coordinates commercial plans with Clinical, Regulatory, Manufacturing, Medical Affairs, Market Access, Sales, Legal, Finance, Supply Chain, and regional teams to support growth, customer needs, reliable supply, and compliance.

The Executive Director advises senior leaders on business results, major risks, spending priorities, and growth opportunities and represents Proleukin in leadership reviews and decision-making forums. The role requires sound judgment in a highly regulated environment, strong scientific knowledge, and a clear understanding of the market for oncology therapies, including hospital-administered products. The Executive Director also determines staffing needs, develops leaders, supports succession planning, and sets clear expectations for team performance and collaboration.

Essential Functions and Responsibilities

  • Set and communicate the global commercial strategy, priorities, and performance measures for Proleukin

  • Follow Iovance Biotherapeutics’ values, policies, procedures, ethics standards, and compliance requirements

Travel

  • May require up to 40% travel based on business need

Key Qualifications

  • Ability to set direction, weigh tradeoffs, and make decisions that support long-term business goals
  • Clear, credible communication with senior leaders and external audiences
  • Sound judgment in complex, uncertain, and highly regulated situations
  • Experience managing profit and loss, budgets, forecasts, investments, and business risks
  • Ability to lead change, build effective teams, develop employees, and plan for future leadership needs
  • Experience leading work across countries, regions, and functions, including teams outside the role’s direct reporting line
  • Ability to use scientific, market, customer, operating, and financial information to make clear decisions and plans
  • Strong negotiation, partnership, communication, and relationship-management skills

Required Education, Skills, and Knowledge

  • Fifteen or more years of increasing commercial leadership responsibility in the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry, including experience with complex businesses, global or multi-market plans, financial results, and cross-functional teams
  • Experience leading a business unit, established brand, global portfolio, or similarly complex commercial operation with direct financial responsibility

description:
Loading Dockmaster

Location: Miami Worldcenter – Miami, FL

Position Overview

Miami Worldcenter is seeking a dependable, organized, and proactive Loading Dockmaster to oversee the daily operations of the property's loading dock and service areas.

The Loading Dockmaster will be responsible for coordinating deliveries, vendor access, tenant move-ins and move-outs, and overall loading dock traffic while maintaining a safe, organized, and professional environment.

This position serves as a key point of contact between property management, tenants, vendors, delivery personnel, security, and building operations. The ideal candidate is highly organized, comfortable enforcing property procedures, and capable of managing multiple deliveries and operational requests in a busy mixed-use environment.

  • Verify that deliveries, move-ins, move-outs, and vendor activities have received proper authorization before access is granted.
  • Maintain an accurate daily log of deliveries, vendors, vehicles, and loading dock activity.
  • Direct trucks and delivery vehicles to appropriate loading and unloading areas.
  • Monitor loading dock capacity and prevent congestion, unauthorized parking, or extended vehicle staging.
  • Ensure loading dock doors, gates, corridors, and service areas remain secure and properly maintained.
  • Enforce established loading dock hours, access procedures, and property rules.
  • Confirm vendors and contractors meet property access requirements prior to beginning work.
  • Work closely with Security and Property Operations to address unauthorized access or operational concerns.
  • Maintain clear fire lanes, emergency access areas, service corridors, and loading zones.
  • Conduct routine inspections of the loading dock and immediately report damage, safety hazards, maintenance issues, or unusual activity.
  • Help prevent damage to loading dock doors, walls, elevators, gates, and other property equipment.
  • Maintain a clean, safe, and professional loading dock environment.
  • Communicate professionally with tenants, vendors, contractors, delivery drivers, and property management.
  • Assist the Property Operations team with additional operational responsibilities as needed.

Qualifications

  • Previous experience in loading dock operations, logistics, property operations, facilities, security, warehouse operations, or a related field preferred.
  • Strong organizational and scheduling skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple deliveries and requests simultaneously.
  • Strong communication and customer service skills.
  • Comfortable enforcing property policies and procedures consistently.
  • Ability to remain professional and solution-oriented in a fast-paced environment.
  • Basic computer, email, and recordkeeping skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and situational awareness.
  • Ability to work independently while maintaining regular communication with management.
  • Bilingual English/Spanish is a must

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to stand and walk for extended periods.
  • Ability to work indoors and outdoors in South Florida weather conditions.
  • Ability to safely navigate active loading and service areas.
  • Ability to occasionally lift or move items weighing up to 30 lbs.

What We're Looking For

We are looking for someone who takes ownership of their area and understands that the loading dock is a critical part of property operations. The successful candidate will be reliable, punctual, organized, safety-conscious, professional, and confident when communicating and enforcing procedures.

This is a hands-on position that requires strong judgment, attention to detail, and the ability to maintain an efficient loading dock operation while providing a high level of service to our tenants and vendors.

title: Materials Engineer
description:
Supercut Engineering Limited based in Auckland is a well-equipped steel structural facility offering a range of structural engineering services all around New Zealand. We are looking for one qualified materials engineer to join our awesome team.

You will be expected to work at the company’s premises in Onehunga, Auckland。 This role guarantees a minimum of 40 hours per week, typically from Monday to Friday. You may also be required to work on Saturdays, with total working hours of up to 60 hours per week. Please note this is a permanent full-time role and the hourly pay rate would be $35.00 - $42.00 based on the candidates' experience and skills.

Job Description for This Position

  • Review technical drawings, project specifications, environmental exposure conditions and product data to assess material suitability, substrate preparation requirements and compatibility between different coating systems.

  • Coordinate and technically supervise abrasive blasting and surface preparation, including surface cleanliness, surface profile, contamination control and confirmation of substrate condition before coating.

  • Evaluate and recommend suitable anti-corrosion and fire-protective coating systems based on protective performance, material compatibility, application conditions, product availability and cost.

  • Liaise with coating manufacturers and suppliers to clarify technical requirements relating to product selection, compatibility, thinning, application, curing and alternative products, and raise technical queries where necessary.

  • Plan and evaluate controlled process trials covering coating mixing, permitted thinning, application parameters, film thickness and curing conditions, and implement validated process improvements.

  • Prepare and maintain standard operating procedures, work instructions and quality-control documents for surface preparation, coating application and quality assurance.

  • Prepare inspection and test plans and conduct or coordinate inspections of environmental conditions, surface preparation, wet film thickness, dry film thickness and material traceability.

  • Investigate coating failures and non-conformances by reviewing inspection and failure data, conducting structured root-cause analysis, including the 8D method where appropriate, and recommending corrective actions.

  • Calculate coating requirements and analyse material consumption, utilisation rates, wastage, rework and related costs to support production planning and process improvement.

  • Prepare technical reports and coordinate with workshop personnel, project teams, clients, suppliers and inspectors to resolve coating-related technical issues and support the safe use of coatings and solvents.

Key Requirements for Successful Applicants

  • A relevant bachelor’s degree or above in engineering, OR at least three years of relevant work experience to substitute for a formal qualification.

  • Punctual and reliable with a positive can-do attitude will be key in this role.

  • A positive and willing attitude to learn and progress.

  • Able to work with deadlines and schedules, and available to work weekends if required.

Note: We take the health and safety of our team members very seriously. The candidates must pass pre-employment medical and drug tests and have strictly no convictions.

If you are interested in this role and this is the exciting career you are looking for, please click on “Apply” to send through your CV and cover letter.

Applications close on 21 Oct 2026.

Applicants for this position should have NZ residency or a valid NZ work visa.

title: Public Affairs, Impact & Urbanism Fellowship (Spring 2027)
location: New York, N.Y. or Washington, D.C.
description:
ABOUT ORCHESTRA

Orchestra is a strategic communications and marketing company built for today’s complex and fragmented world. From decoding audiences to designing bold strategies, Orchestra integrates people, platforms, and stories that stick to help clients build lasting influence. The company offers programs that span from the highest level strategic business counsel through to tactical execution. Orchestra brings together 700+ people with experience across consumer and lifestyle, technology, nonprofit and philanthropy, real estate, sports, travel, hospitality, and more. Made up of leading firms BerlinRosen, Civitas Public Affairs Group, Derris, Glen Echo Group, Inkhouse, M18, Message Lab, Onward, and Small Girls PR, Orchestra also launched Brightmode, a talent acquisition firm for communications professionals, and Versus Media Group, a strategy-first political media team. Learn more at .

People of all backgrounds and abilities are strongly encouraged to apply. Orchestra is committed to building and maintaining a diverse staff, and recognizes that its continued success depends on hiring and retaining high-quality creative professionals with a variety of backgrounds and experiences. Opportunities for advancement exist, and we are committed to helping all staff develop and grow.

ABOUT THIS ROLE

Orchestra is seeking highly motivated individuals to join our Spring 2027 Fellowship Program. This is a hands-on opportunity for college graduates that provides meaningful experience across strategic communications, public affairs, media engagement, brand storytelling, and business operations.

Fellows are embedded within a specific practice area and contribute to active client work and business initiatives while gaining exposure to how integrated communications strategies are developed and executed.

Duration: January 13, 2027 - July 2, 2027
Location: Hybrid based in New York, NY or Washington, DC. Minimum 3 days per week in-office
Compensation: $24/hour

This program offers the potential for permanent, full-time employment. While full-time opportunities may become available, they are not guaranteed and are contingent upon individual performance and the company's hiring needs at the time.

COMMUNICATIONS TRACKS

Applicants should apply to and will be considered for one primary practice area based on their background, interests, and prior experience. Candidates should select the area that best aligns with their experience and career interests.

Important Eligibility Requirement

To be considered, applicants must have already graduated (or be graduating before the start date) and have prior internship or relevant work experience in their selected practice area.

PRACTICE AREAS

Integrated Marketing

Supports integrated communications campaigns that blend media relations, social media, content, influencer engagement, events, and brand storytelling across multiple industries and client types.

Public Affairs, Impact & Urbanism

Provides strategic communications, public affairs, and research support across government relations, public policy, real estate development, housing, economic development, and community engagement. Partners with foundations, nonprofit organizations, advocacy groups, and mission-driven brands to build awareness, drive engagement, and advance social impact initiatives.

Hospitality & Lifestyle

Supports clients across arts and culture, travel, tourism, hospitality, food and beverage, architecture, design, and lifestyle brands.

Consumer & Sports

Strategic narrative development for lifestyle, fashion, beauty, wellness brands, and advisory and communications support for teams, leagues, brands, and investors at the intersection of sports, media, and culture.

Technology

Works with startups, technology companies, investors, and innovators to build visibility, shape narratives, and support business growth.

Corporate (Business Development, Operations, Marketing, HR & Finance)

Supports the internal operations and growth of Orchestra, including business development, marketing, human resources, talent, finance, and other corporate functions.

THIS OPPORTUNITY: PUBLIC AFFAIRS, IMPACT & URBANISM

This fellowship program is part of Orchestra's Public Affairs, Impact & Urbanism practice areas.

WHAT YOU'LL DO
As a Fellow, you will:

  • Conduct research and monitor industry, market, and media trends
  • Draft content, reports, presentations, and communications materials
  • Support client and internal projects from planning through execution
  • Participate in meetings, brainstorming sessions, client calls, and events
  • Collaborate across teams on integrated initiatives
  • Gain exposure to strategic communications, public affairs, and agency operations in a fast-paced environment

QUALIFICATIONS:
Candidates should possess:

  • A bachelor's degree (or will graduate before the start date)
  • Prior internship or relevant work experience in their selected practice area
  • Strong writing, research, analytical, and communication skills
  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Proficiency with Google Workspace and Microsoft Office
  • Digital fluency and eagerness to learn new platforms
  • A strong interest in communications, marketing, public affairs, business, or related fields

HOW TO APPLY:
To be considered, applicants must submit:

Resume (1-2 pages)

  • Highlight relevant professional, academic, internship, volunteer, or extracurricular experience.

Application Form

  • As part of the application, candidates will be asked to select one practice area of interest and complete a brief essay (500 words or less) describing how their experiences have prepared them for success in that area and why they are interested in pursuing a career in the field.

Application Deadline

  • Sunday, November 1, 2026. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis beginning before the deadline, so we encourage candidates to apply early.

Due to application volume, we are unable to respond to all submissions. We will reach out directly to candidates selected for interviews. We kindly ask that you do not call, email, or contact us to confirm receipt of your application or inquire about your status.

title: Senior Design Strategist
description:
Who We Are: LINK is a fast-growing Woman Owned Small Business (WOSB) that leverages human-centered design to support strategy, innovation, communication, change, and branding within the federal government and adjacent industry partners. At LINK, we partner with engineers, futurists, and thought leaders to untangle complexity, discover opportunity, and communicate clearly with visual stories.

Let us be your partners in change.

Location: We are actively hiring in the San Diego area.

About the Opportunity

LINK is actively seeking a Senior Design Strategist to join our dynamic team, where we leverage strong partnerships and a robust portfolio of clients across diverse industries. You will be responsible for leading and executing innovative design strategies, collaborating with both internal teams and executive-level clients, and driving impactful visual storytelling to meet client objectives.

This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced professional to bring a combination of creative and strategic expertise to elevate LINK’s business growth and deliver high-quality, human-centered design solutions. You will work closely with clients to understand their challenges, develop compelling narratives, and implement design strategies that align with their mission, goals, and brand identity. Ideal candidates will have a proven track record of designing impactful visual experiences, utilizing data-driven insights, and collaborating cross-functionally to deliver exceptional client results.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Design, Communication, Sociology, Psychology, Human-Centered Design, or a related field.
  • 10+ years of experience in design strategy, service design, user experience, research, consulting, communications, or a related field.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a security clearance.
  • Strong expertise in human-centered design, design thinking, systems thinking, facilitation, and strategic storytelling.
  • Well-versed in a variety of design strategy disciplines and able to select the appropriate approach for a given challenge.
  • Experience designing and facilitating workshops, stakeholder engagements, and collaborative working sessions that drive alignment and informed decision-making.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead complex research efforts and translate findings into actionable insights, strategic recommendations, and organizational outcomes.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with clients and cross-functional teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to navigate ambiguity and guide stakeholders through complex challenges and decision-making processes.
  • Demonstrated ability to balance multiple priorities and deadlines while maintaining high standards of quality and client service.
  • Capable of mentoring and coaching others.
  • Approaches work with optimism, openness to new ideas, and a collaborative mindset.
  • Portfolio that demonstrates both design execution and strategic decision-making

Responsibilities

Client Partnership & Design Strategy Leadership

  • Serves as a trusted advisor to clients by framing complex challenges, identifying opportunities, and applying human-centered design approaches to inform strategic decision-making.
  • Partners directly with client stakeholders to understand organizational priorities, user needs, operational constraints, and desired outcomes.
  • Leads the development of design strategy approaches that align stakeholder needs, business objectives, and mission requirements.
  • Guides cross-functional teams through ambiguity, helping stakeholders build alignment and make informed decisions.
  • Identifies opportunities to create tangible business value and support long-term client success.

Research, Insight Development & Systems Thinking

  • Leads mixed-method research efforts, including stakeholder interviews, contextual inquiry, observations, journey mapping, ecosystem analysis, and systems mapping activities.
  • Synthesizes qualitative and quantitative findings into actionable insights, opportunity areas, strategic recommendations, and design directions.
  • Applies systems thinking to identify patterns, dependencies, root causes, and opportunities across complex organizational environments.
  • Translates technical, operational, and policy-focused challenges into human-centered insights and strategic considerations.
  • Guides research activities that inform organizational transformation, service design, experience design, and strategic planning efforts.

Strategic Visualization & Storytelling

  • Develops compelling visual frameworks, journey maps, service blueprints, ecosystem maps, decision-support tools, and strategic narratives that communicate complex information clearly.
  • Shapes storytelling approaches that help stakeholders understand challenges, opportunities, tradeoffs, and future-state possibilities.
  • Collaborates with information designers and strategists to develop executive-level deliverables that support alignment and decision-making.
  • Establishes quality standards for design strategy deliverables and provides guidance that improves consistency across engagements.
  • Ensures visual outputs effectively communicate research findings, strategic recommendations, and organizational priorities.

Workshop Facilitation & Stakeholder Alignment

  • Designs and facilitates workshops, design sprints, stakeholder engagements, and co-creation activities that advance strategic objectives and drive organizational alignment.
  • Develops facilitation approaches, agendas, exercises, and collaborative experiences that enable productive dialogue and structured problem-solving.
  • Synthesizes workshop outputs into actionable findings, recommendations, and implementation considerations.
  • Helps stakeholders navigate competing priorities, organizational complexity, and change initiatives through structured facilitation and engagement.
  • Guides teams in applying human-centered design methods throughout project lifecycles.

Team Development & Leadership

  • Mentors teammates through coaching, knowledge sharing, and constructive feedback.
  • Models LINK values and contributes to a collaborative, inclusive, and high-performing team culture.
  • Shares tools, methods, frameworks, and lessons learned that improve the quality and consistency of work across engagements.
  • Supports development of emerging practitioners by providing guidance on research, facilitation, synthesis, and visual storytelling approaches.
  • Contributes to the continued evolution of LINK’s design strategy practice through innovation, experimentation, and continuous learning.

Work Schedule

  • On-site with the client 2-3 days per week.
  • Full time, 40 hours per week
  • Some travel required to attend relevant events and conferences, and participate in LINK team events

Salary: LINK is committed to offering competitive compensation. While the salary range for this position is $112,000 - $151,000, your final offer may be adjusted based on factors such as experience and location.

Benefits:

  • $100 monthly internet/cell phone stipend
  • $150 monthly commuter stipend for eligible participants
  • LINK sponsored healthcare benefits including medical, dental, vision
  • Company-paid Short Term Disability Insurance
  • 401K with employer contribution of up to 4%
  • 11 Federal Holidays per year
  • 15 days of Paid Time Off (PTO) per year
  • Paid Holiday Time Off (Christmas Eve through the New Year)
  • Annual bonus plan participation
  • Annual profit sharing participation
  • $2,000 Learning and Development program reimbursement
  • Technology package that includes a LINK-owned MacBook Pro, monitor, mouse and keyboard

LINK is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by applicable state, local, and federal law.

If you are unable to complete this application due to a disability, contact Human Resources to ask for an accommodation or an alternative application process.

title: Interactive Resident
description:
Job Title: Interactive Resident

Group/Team: Technical Department

Reports to: Interactive Mentor

Location: Remote

Employment Type: Part-time, 20-week contract, hourly

Time Period: Jan. 25–Jun. 11, 2027

WHO WE ARE

We're all creatives here, even if your title doesn't say so.

MAS is an award-winning experiential agency driven by people who care deeply about the work and the impact it creates. We design immersive environments, live moments, and digitally integrated experiences that challenge brands to move beyond the expected.

At MAS we don't settle for anything less than more.

We'd rather hear the idea that scares us than the one that plays it safe, so bring your boldest self, we’re built for it. We're not for everyone. But we're everything for our people.

MAS is a member of the Opus Group, a collective of agencies including Verve and Opus Agency who together create experiences that create action for the world's most influential brands. That gives us shared services across IT, HR, Finance, and Legal, and a network of teams we lean on for best practices and global resources.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

The MAS Residency program is a 20-week tasting of our MAS special sauce — who we are, what we do, and how we do it. It's a deep dive into the experiential marketing industry, where fresh minds can immerse themselves in our world (and our clients’). During this time, residents will have the opportunity to hone and grow their skills, while also uncovering new interests and opportunities along the way. Ultimately this is a unique chance to collaborate closely with leading experts in the field, forge invaluable professional connections, actively contribute to the agency’s perspective, and depart with substantial portfolio work.

We’re not looking for coffee runners, we’re looking for cultural collaborators! Recent grads, grad students, or anyone in the event marketing industry can apply - we're looking for standout candidates ready to go above and beyond what is asked for. We want relentless learners, envelope-pushers, and creatives who are immune to ordinary thinking. You’re not just here to sit in and watch how the magic happens; you’re here to roll up your sleeves and help shape the future for the world’s most influential brands.

Now you might be thinking, this all sounds great, but what does Interactive look like at MAS? Good question! We use emerging technologies to help bring physical and digital experiences to life. We’re looking for a curious, collaborative thinker eager to explore how technology can support creative ideas and audience experiences. As an Interactive Resident, you will work alongside creative and technical teams to research new tools, ideate technology-enabled concepts, and contribute to prototypes and proofs of concept.

Feeling it? Awesome, we’d love to have you!

YOU SHOULD HAVE

  • Hands-on experience with at least one real-time or interactive tool: TouchDesigner, Unity, Unreal, p5.js, three.js, or similar.

  • The ability to explain a technical idea in plain language to producers, designers, and clients.

  • A working understanding of how hardware talks to software: sensors, cameras, OSC/MIDI, Arduino, or similar.

  • Comfort working with agentic AI.

  • Interest in assisting with crafting user journeys and ensuring that UX/UI considerations align with overall project goals.

  • Working knowledge of Google Workspace (including Slides, Sheets, Docs, and Drive).

  • Note: you will need access to a personal laptop for the duration of the 20-week program.

Bonus points if you have:

  • Live event, installation, or exhibition experience, especially troubleshooting something on show day.

  • 3D or motion tools (Blender, After Effects, Cinema 4D).

  • Web builds such as landing pages, registration flows, or simple apps.

ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Build quick prototypes and proofs of concept using TouchDesigner, Figma, Unity, or web technologies, then test and iterate on them with the team.

  • Support live client projects through asset prep, testing, and on-site setup and troubleshooting on show days.

  • Write clear setup and handoff documentation so a build can be redeployed or handed off to a partner.

  • Contribute concepts and visuals to RFPs and creative decks.

  • Support the team in preparing presentations, documentation, and reports for client engagements.

  • Help gather and organize data surrounding user journeys and project performance to inform future strategies.

  • Participate in a special capstone project with fellow residents that will result in a one-of-a-kind portfolio piece.

  • Learn to translate technical ideas into accessible, engaging language for both clients and internal stakeholders.

  • Provide insights into user behavior and cultural trends to help guide project direction.

  • Work alongside creative and technical teams to support the development of concepts and solutions that integrate innovative technologies and participate in the quality assurance of those ideas. .

  • Contribute to research and documentation of emerging technologies and trends that align with client objectives and creative strategies.

WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT IN RETURN

  • Temporary position with potential for contract extension or conversion

  • A collaborative, inclusive, and enthusiastic team

HOW WE’LL TAKE CARE OF YOU

Our job titles may span more than one career level. The starting pay for this role is $22.00 per hour. Our pay ranges are based on third-party national average market compensation analysis. The actual pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs, and market demands. The pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future.

CREATIVE SUBMISSION

*SUBMIT A CREATIVE PRESENTATION ABOUT YOURSELF*

We want to get to know you! In place of a cover letter, this creative presentation is an opportunity to share how you work, projects you’re proud of, what you’re passionate about, and why MAS. Choose 1 of the MAS values (outlined below) and share an experience that shaped you. Don’t be shy; use this presentation as an opportunity to highlight your unique personality and perspective. TL;DR BE YOU. We’re here for it.


MAS Values:

  • KEEP GOOD COMPANY - It’s about showing up in all the right ways — the friend, the devil’s advocate, the hype squad — and keeping it a damn good time through it all.

  • HAVE SOME GUTS - This is about being bold with purpose — pushing the envelope to inspire new ideas, surprise our audiences, and go beyond the expected.

  • HOLD NOTHING BACK - It’s about never settling for anything less than more — or whatever you define as the best. Day to day, it’s showing up with fiery passion, big dreams (because why the hell not), and the determination to take your shot and challenge what’s comfortable.

  • GET EMOTIONAL - This is about being madly devoted to giving a shit — they seriously can’t help the fact that they’re so passionate.

  • STAY HUNGRY - This is about always exploring, tinkering, expanding skill sets, soaking up inspiration, and asking those what if questions.

Submissions should be submitted as a PDF, but can consist of:

  • An Image/collage or mood board

  • A Word Doc (1 page max)

  • A Deck (5 slides max)

  • A Video or Audio recording (1 minute max - embedded link)

Opportunity to Present:

There will be an opportunity to present for no more than 5 minutes during the 2nd round interviews.

SUBMISSION PROCESS

  1. Create your Presentation

  2. Submit your Resume, Presentation, and other relevant Candidate Info via this Job Posting


APPLICATION DEADLINE

Applications and presentations will be accepted till filled.


NOT SURE IF YOU SHOULD APPLY?

Studies show that those identifying as under-represented individuals might have talked themselves out of applying at this point. Don’t worry about checking every single box. At MAS, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic team – so if you’re excited about this role, but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every single qualification in this job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may just be the right candidate for this role or we may have other roles that better align with your skillset.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

Individuals will be required to sit for the majority of the day and may be required to stand as needed. May require ability to ambulate primarily on a level surface for periodic periods throughout the day. Individuals may be required to travel via airplane, train, taxi, car and/or other means of transportation, as needed.

OTHER DUTIES AND ACKNOWLEDGEMENT

The above noted job description is not intended to describe, in detail, the multitude of tasks that may be assigned but rather to give the employee/candidate a general sense of the responsibilities and expectations of the position. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice. This does not create an employment contract, implied or otherwise, other than an "at will" relationship. This employer participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S.

Opus Agency does not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. All employment is decided based on qualifications, merit, and business need. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

title: Strategy Associate - Veeva Link
description:
Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

Veeva Link is transforming how the global life sciences industry connects with Key Opinion Leaders in Healthcare. Our applications span every stage of market maturity, from established industry standards to fast-growing emerging solutions, so there is always something new to learn and real room to grow.
Our Strategy team owns the market success of our products, from shaping product direction to making sure customers realise lasting value. We are now expanding the Strategy team with a new client value function, and we are looking for a highly motivated Strategy Associate to join the team.
Working side by side with our Strategy Directors, you will take direct ownership of client engagement across some of the world's leading pharmaceutical companies. You will build trusted relationships with key stakeholders, equip client teams to get the most from our products, and drive day-to-day product adoption.
Along the way, you will analyze user engagement trends, turn end-user insights into input for our product roadmap, and show clients how our products deliver measurable business impact.

title: Compliance and Licensing Associate
description:

With eleven offices nationwide, the firm specializes in Traditional Life Insurance, Business Continuation Insurance, Private Placement Life Insurance and Annuities, and Corporate-Owned Life Insurance portfolios.

Position Summary:
The Associate, Compliance and Licensing provides critical operational support for the firm's compliance and licensing functions across both broker-dealer and insurance operations. This role ensures that representatives maintain proper registrations, licenses, and appointments while supporting the firm's regulatory compliance obligations. The Associate works closely with internal teams, the firm's broker-dealer, insurance carriers, and regulatory bodies to maintain seamless compliance operations and licensing administration.

Position Responsibilities:

Broker-Dealer Compliance Support
  • Track the firm's broker-dealer compliance reporting requirements and ensure timely submission of all required filings.

Licensing and Appointment Administration
  • Apply for, track, and renew firm and individual state insurance licenses, registrations, and carrier appointments.
  • Manage FINRA state registrations for applicable registered representatives
  • Complete and file contracting paperwork as needed with new insurance carriers.
  • Manage offshore resource responsible for carrier appointments.
  • Ensure applicable registered representatives are covered under annual Errors & Omissions (E&O) insurance renewals.
  • Ensure applicable registered representatives are covered under annual Errors & Omissions (E&O) insurance renewals.
  • Coordinate E&O insurance for offshore brokerage operations.
  • Ensure applicable marketer retirement agreements are recorded and implemented by the broker-dealer.
Process Management and Documentation
  • Document all compliance and licensing processes and update procedures when applicable.
  • Maintain accurate records in compliance management systems and licensing databases.

  • Generate reports on licensing status, CE completion, and compliance metrics for management review.

  • Identify opportunities for process improvements and operational efficiencies.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree required.

  • Prior broker-dealer compliance and/or licensing experience strongly preferred.
  • Familiarity with FINRA regulations, including OBA and PST reporting requirements.
  • Understanding of state insurance licensing and appointment processes.
  • Experience with state registration systems and carrier contracting preferred.
  • Strong organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Experience utilizing AI for project based work
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite; experience with licensing and compliance management systems a plus.
  • Self-motivated with ability to work independently and collaboratively.
Working Conditions/Demands/Complexity:
  • Required to work on a computer for a substantial part of the day
  • A strong fundamental skillset in the above areas from the outset. Candidate will have a unique opportunity to apply and grow these skills in a highly productive, successful, and challenging environment

  • Eligible for annual performance-based bonus

You own the technical relationship end to end, from first discovery through production and expansion. Your job is to turn a customer's problem into a working architecture on Arango's multi-model platform and its GraphRAG and knowledge-graph capabilities, prove value early, and guide the customer's team through deployment and adoption. The role sits where solution architecture, graph data modeling, and applied AI meet. It suits someone who can hold a design conversation with a customer's chief architect in the morning and review a GraphRAG retrieval design with their engineers in the afternoon. Deep graph expertise is not optional here. It is the core of how Arango's AI suite delivers value, and the CSA is expected to be the customer's most trusted source of graph and GraphRAG design judgment.

Key responsibilities
  • Own the technical customer relationship as the primary professional services contact across the full lifecycle: discovery, design, pilot, production, and expansion.
  • Run discovery with customer sponsors, domain experts, and operators to identify high-value use cases for Arango's AI product suite, and qualify them against real business outcomes.
  • Design target architectures on Arango's multi-model platform, including graph data models, AQL query and traversal patterns, and GraphRAG retrieval design tailored to the customer's domain.
  • Define success criteria, SLAs/SLOs, data access and governance requirements, and a phased delivery plan from proof of value to production.
  • Build reference implementations and prototypes that prove value early: graph schema, data connectors, GraphRAG pipelines, tool and agent orchestration, APIs.
  • Guide production deployment into secure, observable services alongside the customer's engineers, with CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, and proper testing.
  • Architect retrieval across graph traversal, vector search, and hybrid approaches (chunking, embeddings, ranking, caching), and orchestrate tool and agent calls.
  • Establish evaluation practices and iterate on prompts, models, retrieval strategy, and graph structure using offline and online metrics and A/B tests.
  • Design data pipelines (ETL/ELT), vector indices, graph ingestion, and metadata governance.
  • Define monitoring for quality, drift, hallucination and guardrail events, latency, and cost, and stand up alerting and dashboards with the customer.
  • Architect role-based access, secrets management, audit logging, PII redaction, and content safety controls.
  • Meet customer compliance requirements (SOC 2/ISO 27001, GDPR/CCPA, HIPAA as applicable).
  • Produce architecture documentation, runbooks, and reusable patterns, and train customer engineers and end users.
  • Act as the voice of the customer to Arango's product and engineering teams, shaping the roadmap with what we learn in the field.
Required qualifications
  • Deep graph knowledge (central to this role). Hands-on expertise in graph data modeling, graph query and traversal (AQL, or equivalents such as Cypher or Gremlin), graph algorithms, and knowledge-graph design for AI. Direct experience building GraphRAG or knowledge-graph-backed retrieval for LLM applications.
  • 3+ years in software engineering, solution architecture, or technical professional services, including building and operating production systems.
  • Strong applied AI and Python skills, with a solid grasp of data structures, systems design, concurrency, and networking.
  • Strong database skills across graph, NoSQL, key-value, and document models. Multi-model experience is valued given Arango's platform.
  • Hands-on experience with modern LLMs and tooling (OpenAI/Anthropic/Llama, Hugging Face, LangChain/LlamaIndex, function and tool calling).
  • Retrieval and vector databases (FAISS, pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate, or similar), and hybrid retrieval that combines graph and vector.
  • Cloud and containers (AWS/GCP/Azure), Docker/Kubernetes, IaC (Terraform/CloudFormation), and CI/CD.
  • Observability (metrics, logs, traces) and performance tuning for latency-sensitive services.
  • Excellent customer-facing communication, with the ability to lead technical conversations from the executive level down to the engineering team.
Nice to have
  • Direct ArangoDB experience, or prior work deploying a graph database in production.
  • Search and IR fundamentals (BM25, hybrid retrieval, re-ranking, ColBERT, cross-encoders).
  • Front-end or full-stack experience (TypeScript/React, Next.js) for light UI prototyping.
  • MLOps platforms and evaluation frameworks (MLflow, Weights & Biases, Ragas, promptfoo, DeepEval).
  • Model adaptation and inference optimization awareness (LoRA/PEFT, DPO, distillation, quantization, vLLM/TGI/TensorRT-LLM), enough to advise on tradeoffs rather than to hand-build.
  • Domain experience in finance, healthcare, public sector, manufacturing, or retail.
  • Security and compliance familiarity: data residency, KMS/HSM, private networking.
  • French government or industry experience.
What success looks like (6–12 months)
  • 2 to 4 customer deployments of Arango's AI suite live in production against agreed uptime, latency, and cost targets.
  • Measurable quality and business outcomes (task accuracy, deflection rate, cycle time) backed by evaluation and telemetry.
  • Reusable graph and GraphRAG reference architectures and connectors adopted by the broader delivery team and by customers.
  • Customer teams enabled and self-sufficient, with runbooks, documentation, and training in place, and strong satisfaction and NPS.
  • A credible field feedback loop feeding Arango's product and engineering roadmap.
Our toolset
  • Platform & Graph: ArangoDB multi-model (graph, document, key-value), AQL, graph algorithms, GraphRAG
  • Models & SDKs: OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta Llama, Hugging Face
  • Retrieval: graph traversal plus FAISS, pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate; rerankers (ColBERT, cross-encoders)
  • Pipelines & Orchestration: LangChain, LlamaIndex, Ray, Airflow
  • MLOps & Evals: MLflow, Weights & Biases, Ragas, promptfoo, Great Expectations
  • Serving & Infra: vLLM, TGI, FastAPI/gRPC, Docker/K8s, Terraform, GitHub Actions
  • Observability & Guardrails: OpenTelemetry, Prometheus/Grafana, Llama Guard/Content Safety, custom filters
  • Data: Postgres/BigQuery/Snowflake; Kafka; object storage
Location: San Francisco, CA (Remote)

What Makes Arango Special?

At Arango, we believe that AI is only as powerful as the data foundation. Our mission is to help organizations build AI systems that can reason, decide and act based on unified, current, and trusted business context at scale. We are helping define a new category of infrastructure: the contextual data layer for AI.
Working at Arango means:
  • Contributing to cutting-edge AI and data infrastructure
  • Collaborating with experienced engineers, marketers, and product leaders
  • Helping shape how enterprises build AI-powered applications
If you're excited about the intersection of AI, data, and social media, we’d love to hear from you.

title: SUBSTANCE ABUSE COUNSELOR II-HSOM PSYCH
description:
SUBSTANCE ABUSE COUNSELOR II-HSOM PSYCH

University of Alabama at Birmingham

The counselor facilitates evidence-based substance abuse/mental health screenings to determine the need for treatment services using a state-certified treatment placement assessment that addresses both SA and MH needs.

General Responsibilities

  • Under general supervision, provides clinical assessment, counseling, drug education, and case management for substance abuse clients in accordance with government and department standards.

  • Provides general orientation and supervision for Substance Abuse Counselor I’s as needed.

  • Responds to the unique needs of neonatal, pediatric, adolescent and geriatric patients as the need arises.

Key Duties & Responsibilities

  • Provides psychosocial clinical assessments and develops individualized treatment plans. Determines patient eligibility for treatment. Conducts accurate and professional intake interviews, securing family, social, medical, and drug histories, leading to a DSM II R diagnostic impression. Administers and accurately standardizes tests. Develops appropriate individualized treatment plans using problem-oriented concept. Updates plans regularly as indicated by client progress or lack of progress.

  • Provides counseling and drug education to substance abuse clients in accordance with government and department standards. Establishes rapport with clients, motivating them to change. Provides assigned levels/units of counseling to clients, individually and in groups, maintaining a therapeutic, accepting, and professional relationship. Conducts family substance abuse education and counseling sessions as assigned, demonstrating knowledge of chemical dependency. Introduces clients to Twelve Step Programs.

  • Explains concepts of addiction and provides specific relapse prevention strategies. Effectively orients new clients and families of new clients to the program, answering questions relating to substance abuse and dependency. Provides professional and prompt case consultation as requested or directed by supervisor.

  • Conducts accurate and professional interviews to secure family, social, medical, and drug histories; involves the parents or guardians of clients as appropriate. Develops appropriate individualized treatment plans using the problem-oriented concept. Updates plans regularly as old problems are resolved and new ones are identified. Provides individualized, continuing care plan, ensuring retention in treatment. Refers health and social services needs of clients to appropriate resources as needed, and as appropriate within the treatment plan.

  • Maintains appropriate records and files and completes necessary forms and paperwork in accordance with government and department standards. Collects and analyzes data and prepares a variety of special and recurring analyses and reports. Completes intake forms, progress notes, monthly reports, and 90-day evaluations by established deadlines. Updates treatment plans routinely. Tracks client’s treatment progress. Records urinalysis test results and follows up with reporting procedures to appropriate personnel. Monitors random urinalysis testing, changes schedule as needed, and arranges for equitable payment plans.

  • Attends and participates in various committee/department meetings and other related conferences. May host educational awareness groups as needed. Assumes responsibility for keeping abreast of changing treatment strategies, trends, and therapeutic techniques in the substance abuse field. Reads appropriate publications and attends and participates in continuing education workshops, conferences, or seminars. Participates in in-service training. Attends mental health and other outside meetings as required. Participates in weekly team meetings to discuss client treatment plans.

  • Serves as liaison with other agencies/organizations and provides information regarding various programs and services. Makes contact and maintains good relationships with other organizations such as Vocational Rehabilitation Services, the Department of Hough Services, Criminal Justice System Agencies, and other organizations as appropriate. Responds to other agencies regarding this program and utilizes appropriate referral mechanisms. Appears in court with clients, prepares timely reports for judges, probation officers, district attorneys, and other officials in the Criminal Justice System. Demonstrates knowledge of state and community resources and utilizes them appropriately.

  • Provides crisis intervention as required. Obtains pre-assessment information and urinalysis on all clients referred by judges and probation officers. Effectively addresses client problems that may arise when primary counselor is unavailable for consultation; provides appropriate crisis intervention.

  • Provides case management for patients on Methadone maintenance. Evaluates patients for dose increases or decreases based on clinic impressions and program rules. Appropriately determines patient eligibility for take-home status. Arranges for traveling patients to receive doses at clinics in other cities. Confronts patients when unauthorized drugs are used and determines appropriate consequences.

  • Reviews and approves treatment plans developed by Substance Abuse Counselor I’s and provides general supervision as required. Provides orientation and supervision of Counselor I’s as assigned by the supervisor. Reviews and approves treatment plans developed by Counselor I’s as necessary or as directed by the supervisor. Assumes program management duties in the absence of the supervisor. Provides case consultation as needed.

  • Performs other duties as assigned.

Additional Duties

  • Facilitates evidence-based substance use and mental health screenings utilizing a state-certified treatment placement assessment.

  • Obtains and maintains all required consent and release-of-information documentation.

  • Provides Intensive Outpatient Treatment (Level 2.1) and Outpatient Treatment (Level 1.0) services to adolescent clients, including group counseling, treatment planning, and individual counseling.

  • Collaborates with community partners and participates in multidisciplinary staffing meetings to coordinate patient care.

Preferred

  • Master’s in counseling and social work

  • Experience commensurate with licensure requirements

  • Knowledge of the use of substance and mental health disorders, to include diagnosis/treatment standards.

  • Knowledge of community substance use/mental health treatment resources.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills

  • Interpersonal skills

  • Active listener

  • Service oriented

  • Conflict resolution skills

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities

  • Proficient with Microsoft Word and Excel software applications

In this role, you will:

  • Own the monetization platform that carries a product from beta to general availability: packaging, entitlements, metering, rating, and provisioning.
  • Own time to market and margin. Set the targets, instrument both, and improve them launch over launch.
  • Define how Samsara prices new AI products, including agent work, MCP and API access, and products billed on the results they produce.

title: Automation Technician I
description:
No matter the role, everyone at Expanse brings it. EVERY. DAY.

Our smart, gritty team supports, challenges, and motivates each other to think hard, work with craft, and build things that last. We serve a broad operating footprint, with headquarters in Oklahoma City and field offices across New Mexico, North Dakota, Oklahoma, Pennsylvania, Texas, and Utah. Across the energy value stream, from energy production through the delivery of electricity, Expanse delivers scalable, data-driven solutions that reduce costs and increase productivity for our customers. We shorten timelines. We increase uptime. And we push the energy industry forward.

Everything we do runs on GRIT: Grit, Reciprocity, Innovation, and Trust. It's how we show up, how we decide, and how we hold each other accountable.

Got what it takes to join us? Bring it.

Position Summary:

The Automation Technician I is responsible for supporting the installation, programming, troubleshooting, repair, and maintenance of automation, electrical control, and instrumentation systems used in the onshore Oil & Gas industry. This position works with PLCs, HMIs, communication systems, Variable Frequency Drives (VFDs), telemetry equipment, and field instrumentation while supporting new automation installations and existing systems. The Automation Technician I works closely with Automation Technicians, Foremen, Electricians, Supervisors, and management to ensure automation systems are installed, configured, tested, and maintained safely and effectively. This position requires a safety-minded individual with a strong interest in automation technology and continued technical development.

Essential Functions

  • Assist with the installation, configuration, programming, testing, troubleshooting, and repair of automation systems.
  • Troubleshoot and repair electrical control and instrumentation systems used in onshore Oil & Gas operations.
  • Support new automation system installations and upgrades to existing systems.
  • Install, upgrade, configure, troubleshoot, and repair Programmable Logic Controllers (PLCs).
  • Install, configure, troubleshoot, and repair Human Machine Interface (HMI) systems.
  • Work with automation platforms and equipment including Schneider Electric, Allen-Bradley, and Red Lion.
  • Assist with PLC and HMI programming, testing, and field startup activities.
  • Implement and troubleshoot industrial communication systems.
  • Work with communication protocols including Modbus RTU, Modbus TCP/IP, EtherNet/IP, and HART.
  • Configure and troubleshoot Variable Frequency Drive (VFD) systems.
  • Install and troubleshoot radio communication and cellular telemetry equipment.
  • Install, configure, test, and troubleshoot field instrumentation.
  • Work with pressure, temperature, flow, and level measurement devices.
  • Assist with identifying communication, instrumentation, electrical, and control-system faults.
  • Verify proper operation of automation equipment following installation or repair.
  • Assist with system startup and commissioning activities.
  • Read and interpret applicable electrical drawings, control drawings, schematics, wiring diagrams, and technical documentation.
  • Properly use electrical and instrumentation testing equipment appropriate to assigned responsibilities.
  • Maintain tools, test equipment, and assigned company equipment in safe operating condition.
  • Document completed work, system changes, troubleshooting activities, and other required information.
  • Communicate system conditions, technical issues, and required repairs to appropriate field leadership.
  • Coordinate with Electricians and other field personnel during installation and troubleshooting activities.
  • Maintain professional working relationships with management, Supervisors, Foremen, Electricians, coworkers, and customers.
  • Follow company and customer safety requirements at all times.
  • Participate in required safety meetings, job briefings, training, and other company activities.
  • Maintain awareness of new technologies, equipment, and automation practices applicable to the Oil & Gas industry.
  • Travel to customer and field locations as required.
  • Work flexible or extended hours based on project, startup, service, or customer requirements.
  • Maintain regular and timely attendance.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

The technical scope above preserves the core responsibilities from your current description: electrical and control instrumentation troubleshooting, PLC/HMI work, Modbus/EtherNet-IP/HART communications, VFDs, radio/cellular telemetry, and pressure, temperature, flow, and level instrumentation.

Variable Frequency Drives – Configure and troubleshoot VFD systems within assigned training and responsibilities.

Instrumentation – Install and troubleshoot pressure, temperature, flow, and level instruments and associated field devices.

description:

  • Interface with military and civilian personnel to ensure mission continuity

title: Make Ready Technician
description:
Make Ready Technician
Job Type: Full-Time | Onsite
Pay: Competitive hourly rate + commission

Turn Units. Take Pride. Build a Career.
At CAF Management, Make Ready Technicians play a key role in preparing apartments for new residents. You’ll ensure each unit meets our quality standards by completing repairs, cleaning touch-ups, and detailed inspections—helping create a strong first impression that reflects the care we put into our communities.

This is a great opportunity for someone who’s handy, detail-oriented, and eager to grow in the property management industry. Many of our maintenance leaders started in this role.

  • Replace light fixtures, hardware, screens, locks, blinds, and other standard items
  • Report major repair needs to the Lead Maintenance Technician or Property Manager
  • Support the maintenance team with curb appeal projects and minor work orders
  • Ensure make-ready timelines are met to support leasing goals
  • Maintain a clean and organized make-ready area and supply inventory

  • Ability to manage time and complete tasks independently
  • Strong attention to detail and pride in workmanship
  • Availability to work Saturdays (closed Sundays) and maintain a flexible weekday schedule
  • Valid driver’s license and reliable transportation

Preferred:

  • Experience in apartment maintenance, turns, or construction
  • Bilingual abilities
  • Willingness to grow into a full maintenance technician role

What You’ll Get
CAF offers one of the most competitive benefits packages in the industry—because we believe when we take care of you, you can take care of everything else.

  • Commission opportunities based on performance
  • 15 Paid Holidays (including CAF Impact Day)
  • PTO based on tenure:
  • 0–4 years: 15 days
  • 5–9 years: 20 days
  • 10–14 years: 25 days
  • 15+ years: 30 days
  • 3 Flex Days per year
  • Medical, Dental & Vision (employee medical starts at $65/month)

  • Paid Parental Leave (10 days)
  • 30–50% Employee Housing Discount (after 30 days, if applicable)
  • Recognition programs and a people-first culture

Grow With a Company That Invests in You
We believe in growing our people from within. Whether you’re just getting started in maintenance or looking for your next opportunity, CAF provides the tools, support, and opportunities to succeed.

Ready to take the next step with CAF? Apply now.
We’re excited to meet motivated individuals who want to grow their career with CAF.

  • On your feet: 75% to 100% of the time
  • Physical activities (75% to 100%):
