title: 7 Hour Educational Assistant - Inclusion - Summit High School - Regular
description:
Bend-La Pine Schools

Bend, Oregon 97703

Bend-La Pine Schools is committed to the principle of equity. Equity supersedes the notion of equality, where all are treated the same. Pursuing equity requires the removal of barriers and the promotion of inclusive practices so that all students fully benefit. The principle of equity will inform all BLS policies, regulations, programs, operations, practices, and resource allocations.

Studies have shown that some individuals (women and people of color, for example) are less likely to apply for jobs unless they believe they meet every single qualification in a job description. Our goal is to find the best candidate for the position, and we acknowledge that that candidate may be an individual from a less traditional background. We encourage you to apply, even if you don't believe you meet every one of our qualifications described. If you are unsure whether you meet the qualifications of a position, or how this would be determined, please feel free to contact Human Resources to discuss your application.

Position Title: EDUCATIONAL ASSISTANT – INCLUSION

Department: Special Programs

Reports To: Assigned Teacher and Site Administrator

JOB DEFINITION:

Under direct supervision, the Educational Assistant – Inclusion, provides supported education services in classrooms, resource centers, or other school-related areas. The Educational Assistant is directly involved in the instructional program for assigned students and their identified special needs. The responsibilities include in and out of class supervision of students; small group and one on one instruction of students; and general assistance to the teacher. The employee works independently after becoming familiar with the instructional needs of the special needs students and seeks clarification from the teacher for new or unusual situations. The employee works on a daily basis with disabled students who require special attention to meet their unique needs. The employee works under the supervision of a special education teacher and/or administrator.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:

  • Assists with implementing individualized education plan (IEP).
  • Assists special education teaching staff responsible for preparation, implementation, and evaluation of individual and group instructional programs.
  • Assists in communicating with teachers and parents on students’ progress.
  • Assists with record keeping to monitor students’ daily and monthly data on progress.
  • Assists students’ in their understanding of instructional concepts by reemphasizing the basic elements of teacher directed activities.
  • Provides students with additional practice on identified skill areas.
  • Assists with the correction of student work as assigned by the classroom teacher.
  • Prepares instructional materials and operates instructional equipment.
  • Supervises students during recess, lunch periods, and before / after school by keeping a calm and disciplined atmosphere on the playground, in the cafeteria, library, hallways, and bus lines.
  • Assists in monitoring the daily school routines of a small group and / or individual low functioning student.
  • Participates in the various vocational / recreational activities developed for ILSC / FLSC students.
  • Assists the special education teaching staff in maintaining the practical life skills such as dressing, toileting and feeding students with mildly to profoundly disabling conditions in the District’s ILSC / FLSC program.
  • Follows the assigned daily schedule.
  • Fulfills other related duties as assigned.
  • Fulfills performance standards identified in the evaluation process as required by the position.
  • Fulfills working conditions and physical effort listed below.

WORKING CONDITIONS:

Work is performed primarily indoors in classroom or specialized instructional settings, with occasional outdoor supervision. The position requires standing, walking, bending, kneeling, and assisting students with mobility or personal care needs. The role may involve lifting or supporting students or equipment consistent with assigned duties.

The employee may be exposed to escalated student behaviors and may encounter bodily fluids while providing direct support. Work follows the assigned school schedule and may include participation in school activities.

The role requires attentiveness, patience, consistent implementation of intervention strategies, and collaboration with licensed staff to support student learning and safety. The employee must be able to perform the essential functions of the position with or without reasonable accommodation.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES:

Knowledge:

  • Teaching methods and procedures.
  • Filing and record keeping systems.
  • Computers, audio-visual equipment and office machines, and their operation.
  • Instructional materials and their uses.
  • Basic provisions of PL-142, due process procedures, and the IEPs for students identified as disabled.
  • Student behavior and methods to assure proper conduct.
  • Safety practices.

Skills & Abilities:

Possess the physical ability to regularly attend work and fulfill the essential functions of the position, with or without reasonable accommodation.

  • Read, understand and carry out oral and written instructions.
  • Learn the operation of telephones, computers, and other equipment used in the work, as required by the position.
  • Accurately transfer, record and convey information, and materials as required by the position.
  • Train and supervise student helpers.
  • Communicate clearly and appropriately in speech and in writing in accordance with educational standards.
  • Promote the success of special education programs and the students served by these programs.
  • Maintain patient, positive, persistent attitude and a warm, accepting personality toward persons with disabilities.
  • Ability to learn how to deal with bodily fluid spills.
  • Adhere to the district requirements for a drug-free workplace.
  • Abide by confidentiality requirements.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:

At least two years of related college education, an AA degree, or meet the Highly Qualified requirements by passing the Paraprofessional Assessment Exam with a score of 455 or higher

The position requires general knowledge of technical procedures. Knowledge of School District practices or policies is necessary. Job proficiency can be acquired in twelve to twenty-four months.

CERTIFICATION AND LICENSING:

NCLB (No Child Left Behind) Paraprofessional qualifications for positions at sites that are designated as Title I School- wide programs.

Expectations of Professional Conduct:

Employees of Bend-La Pine Schools are expected to adhere to all Bend-La Pine Schools policies and regulations, ensuring compliance with established procedures and expectations. They are to prioritize the well-being of students, aligning their conduct with the core values of public education and the mission, vision, and goals of Bend-La Pine Schools. This entails maintaining consistent and punctual attendance while adhering to site and/or district protocols for reporting absences.

Professionalism extends to personal presentation, with employees expected to maintain attire and grooming appropriate to their roles. While carrying out everyday tasks independently, it's essential to maintain professionalism in how you communicate, both verbally and nonverbally, with students, parents/guardians, the public, and colleagues. This includes valuing and respecting cultural and background differences. Employees of Bend-La Pine Schools are entrusted with fostering a respectful working and learning environment, upholding confidentiality regarding student, staff, and district information at all times.

The statements herein reflect the general nature and level of work expected in this position and are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, or qualifications.

Employees may be assigned additional duties as needed to support district operations, provide coverage, and ensure the effective functioning of the organization. This may include location changes to the assignment in order to address developing district needs.

Please Provide:

Resume

Evidence of Highly Qualified status

Note to Current Employees: The system will not allow you to directly upload supporting materials, so please email supporting documents to hr-recruitment@bend.k12.or.us

title: Caregive (part-time)
description:
SUMMARY
Pay Rate: $9.00/hour

Position Type: Non-exempt, full-time or part-time, hourly role.
Scope of Role:

Responsible for providing direct support within a single program or unit within a program, typically supporting 4 - 6 individuals in residential settings, or up to 10 individuals in periodic programs.

Key Responsibilities:

Deliver support per individual service/program plans, including socialization, health maintenance, medication administration, skill/behavioral development.
Assist with daily activities: Personal care, housekeeping, recreational activities, transportation, community integration, shopping, citizenship, and other activities of daily living.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to satisfactorily perform each essential function listed below.
Services and Supports:

Direct Support: Provides direct support or assistance in accordance with individual service or program plans; assists with socialization and behavioral development, personal care, housekeeping, recreational activities, transportation, community orientation, shopping, financial management, citizenship, and other activities of daily living.
Records: Accurately documents progress and activity; reviews records and logs to stay abreast of changes in service plans; maintains confidentiality.
Management of Individuals’ Assets: Makes cost-effective and appropriate purchases within the budget of the individual served and according to their choice / preference
Relationships: Maintains healthy and professional relationships with individuals, friends, families, guardians and case managers; greets family members and other visitors; implements Sevita Customer Service Standards.
Reporting: Reports any instance of alleged abuse or neglect according to internal and external standards; reports medical, behavioral and other incidents in accordance with Sevita policy and external requirements.
Rights: Maintains confidentiality, respects the rights of persons being served, according to applicable the bill of rights; practices universal precautions; assists individuals in exercising their rights.

Health Care:

Appointments: As needed, may accompany individuals to medical appointments; relays orders and information to and from medical providers as required.
Medications: If assigned, accurately administers or supports self-administration of medication and documents delivery of medications and treatments; promptly reports administration errors; maintains appropriate security of controlled medications and other medications and supplies.
General Health Care: Monitors individual’s health; documents health concerns; communicates with nurse or supervisor as appropriate; calls 911 in the event of emergency; follows individual health care directives.
Medical Supplies and Equipment: Correctly follows procedures in utilizing medical equipment; reports malfunction or disrepair.
Meal Preparation: Prepares or supports individuals to prepare food in accordance with planned menus and individual choice; knows special diets and prepares individual meals accordingly; monitors mealtime and correctly implements any dining plans.

Employment Responsibilities:

Training: Attends orientation and on-going training as directed; participates in monthly staff meetings.
Employee Scheduling: Works scheduled hours; arrives for work on time; stays on shift until replacement arrives; notifies supervisor in advance when unable to work as scheduled or as soon as possible after the designated start time; may fill in for other shifts where required without causing unapproved overtime, or in the event of emergency.
Teamwork: Works together with others, values others contributions; is courteous; communicates openly; listens; and shows respect to others.
Workplace Safety: Every employee plays a role in developing and maintaining a safe workplace; complies with all established safety policies, procedures, and rules; reports unsafe hazards to their supervisor and participates in safety related training or activities.

Maintenance:

Vehicles: May transport individuals into the community; drives safely and according to local laws; ensures proper use of safety equipment including seat belts, lifts and wheelchair ties; reports accidents to appropriate authorities immediately; reports accidents and safety concerns immediately to supervisor or maintenance personnel.
Housekeeping: Performs daily and seasonal housekeeping as directed; maintains neat, clean and safe environment; reports hazards or safety concerns.
Maintenance and Repair: Monitors environmental safety and may make minor repairs, change light bulbs, etc.; may perform yard maintenance including keeping walkways safe and snow removal; reports equipment or facilities requiring repairs to supervisor or maintenance personnel as required.
Safety: Checks water temperature as required when assisting with bathing; participates in safety drills and protects persons being served in the event of emergency.

Other:

Performs other duties and activities as required.
MPA = Mobile Punch Authorized for timekeeping.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES

None

Minimum Knowledge and Skills required for the Job
The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or abilities required to perform the job.

Education and Experience:

High school diploma or equivalent preferred
Six months of experience in human services preferred.
Must be 18 years of age.
Working knowledge of computers

Certificates, Licenses, and Registrations:

Valid driver’s license in good standing.
Car registration and vehicle insurance if providing transportation for individuals receiving services.
All state-required training(s) and certification(s) completed in mandated timeframes.
Maintain valid driver’s license, meet all insurance requirements, and be approved by management to be a driver for the company. If an employee is determined to have lost their driving privileges by failing the company MVR driving record requirements per company policy, the employee will be required to sign a Non-Driver form and restricted from driving on behalf of the company until their MVR report satisfies the company requirements for a good driving record.

Work Environment:

Works at the program location and may accompany individuals into the community.

Physical Requirements:

Heavy Work. Exerting up to 100 pounds of force occasionally, and/or up to 50 pounds of force frequently, and/or up to 20 pounds of force constantly to move objects.

Addendum:

CS New Jersey – Refer to: CS NJ Addendum – Direct Support Professional _1001 _ MPA 3429

Employees must cooperate with the licensee and Department of Human Services staff in any inspection, inquiry, or investigation.
Must have a valid driver’s license in good standing in The State of New Jersey; however, in the event the person lives in another state and is commuting, they must have a valid driver’s license in good standing for the state in which they live.
At minimum, a High School Diploma/Equivalent is required
All employees hired after 6/15/2018 shall submit to drug testing prior to employment. All employees shall submit to drug testing randomly and for cause/suspicion.
Employees must submit to criminal background checks, and be determined not to be disqualified by the Department of Human Services prior to working with individuals served. In addition to this, it is a requirement that all employees agree to have their name checked against the Central Registry of Offenders Against Individuals with Developmental Disabilities, as well as completing an application to have their name checked against the Child Abuse Registry Information (CARI).
Employees must successfully complete and demonstrate proficiency in all areas of required trainings.
Shall be at least 18 years of age.

title: Architect (Data Centers & Workplace) - Memphis
description:
SpaceXAI’s mission is to create AI systems that can accurately understand the universe and aid humanity in its pursuit of knowledge. Our team is small, highly motivated, and focused on engineering excellence. This organization is for individuals who appreciate challenging themselves and thrive on curiosity. We operate with a flat organizational structure. All employees are expected to be hands-on and to contribute directly to the company’s mission. Leadership is given to those who show initiative and consistently deliver excellence. Work ethic and strong prioritization skills are important. All employees are expected to have strong communication skills. They should be able to concisely and accurately share knowledge with their teammates.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

As Architect for the Data Centers & Workplace, you will lead the strategic planning, design, and execution of facilities and infrastructure solutions for SpaceXAI's data centers and site builds. Drawing on expertise in complex, multi-stakeholder projects, you'll collaborate across engineering, procurement, construction, and business teams to deliver integrated, compliant designs that align with aggressive timelines and innovation goals. This position reports to the Facilities Leadership team and is an opportunity that requires travel to different locations and cross-site collaboration.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Plan, design, and support the construction of advanced data centers and AI infrastructure, including high-performance computing facilities at new and existing sites.
  • Collaborate with civil, structural, MEP, and fire protection disciplines, as well as procurement and construction teams, to develop integrated solutions optimized for scalability, efficiency, and reliability.
  • Create Basis of Design documents and Request for Quotation (RFQ) packages for external consultants, architects, and vendors; respond to RFIs and iterate based on feedback.
  • Conduct site visits and assessments to refine designs, incorporating existing site conditions, risk mitigation strategies, and delivery objectives for seamless project execution.
  • Ensure compliance with local building codes, zoning, and environmental standards while providing technical guidance on architectural elements.
  • Initiate, scope, design, estimate costs, and execute facility and infrastructure projects critical to AI operations, production ramps, and business continuity.
  • Build and maintain strong cross-functional partnerships with internal stakeholders, including engineering leads, operations teams, and executive leadership, to align on project expectations and streamline workflows.
  • Drive strategic workplace program planning and delivery, overseeing CAPEX/OPEX budgets, financial reporting, and space optimization for SpaceXAI's workforce across multiple sites.
  • Partner with real estate and leasing teams on site selection, due diligence, and lease negotiations for new facilities, contributing architectural insights to strategic expansion decisions.
  • Lead global portfolio management for offices, labs, and data centers, including scenario planning for lease renewals, fit-outs, and adaptive reuse projects.
  • Oversee external partners (architects, engineers, builders, vendors) to ensure design excellence, cost-effective procurement, and adherence to Master Service Agreements (MSAs).

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor's degree in Architecture (10-year professional program preferred) from an accredited institution.
  • Active Architectural licensure in at least one U.S. state (CA or NY licensure highly transferable); NCARB certification strongly preferred.
  • LEED AP certification or equivalent in sustainable design.
  • 15+ years of progressive experience in architectural design and project management, with direct hands-on involvement in data center development, site construction, and workplace planning in high-tech environments.
  • Proven track record leading complex, multi-disciplinary projects in fast-scaling organizations (e.g., automotive, tech, or AI infrastructure).

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Expertise in high-performance computing facilities, such as supercomputer deployments or AI-optimized data centers.
  • Proficiency in design and collaboration tools: AutoCAD/Revit, SketchUp, Jira/Bluebeam, Adobe Creative Suite, Microsoft Office Suite.
  • Experience delivering flagship projects for leading tech companies (e.g., HQ relocations, R&D labs, wellness centers with integrated data infrastructure).
  • Strong background in global portfolio management, including lease scenario planning and cross-functional collaboration with IT, security, HR, and legal teams.
  • Familiarity with agile project methodologies for rapid prototyping, site adaptations, and vendor negotiation.

SpaceXAI is an equal opportunity employer. For details on data processing, view our Recruitment Privacy Notice.

title: Reporting Analyst2
description:
Position Overview

BLOC Resources is seeking an experienced and highly analytical Reporting Analyst 2 to support Southern Company operations in Atlanta, Georgia.

The Reporting Analyst 2 will be responsible for analyzing business processes, collecting and validating data, developing reports and dashboards, investigating reporting and data discrepancies, and providing actionable insights that support operational efficiency and data-driven decision-making.

This position requires a professional with approximately 5–10 years of experience in reporting, business analysis, data analytics, process improvement, business intelligence, or a related discipline.

The successful candidate will work collaboratively with business stakeholders, process owners, subject-matter experts, reporting teams, and technical teams to gather requirements, analyze complex datasets, develop meaningful performance metrics, identify process inefficiencies, investigate reporting issues, and communicate findings to both technical and nontechnical audiences.

The ideal candidate will bring strong experience with Power BI, SQL, Microsoft Excel, data visualization, reporting dashboards, data validation, and business-process analysis. Experience with Databricks or a comparable cloud data and analytics platform is highly valuable.

Key Responsibilities

Data Analysis & Business Insights

  • Collect, analyze, interpret, and validate data associated with business processes and operational performance.

  • Analyze complex datasets to identify trends, patterns, anomalies, and opportunities for improvement.

  • Utilize analytical and statistical techniques to generate meaningful business insights.

  • Perform expected-versus-actual comparisons and data reconciliations.

  • Translate data findings into actionable recommendations.

  • Investigate discrepancies and determine whether issues originate from source data, business rules, reporting logic, configuration, security, or user interpretation.

  • Support management and business stakeholders with reliable information for decision-making.

Reporting & Dashboard Development

  • Develop, maintain, and enhance reports, dashboards, KPIs, and performance metrics.

  • Create reporting solutions that provide meaningful visibility into business and process performance.

  • Develop clear, visually effective, and easy-to-understand reports for stakeholders at multiple organizational levels.

  • Support Power BI reports, dashboards, paginated reports, parameters, refreshes, subscriptions, and report validation.

  • Monitor reporting outputs for accuracy, completeness, and consistency.

  • Validate calculations, filters, parameters, relationships, and business rules used within reports.

  • Assist with production validation following report changes, fixes, reruns, or deployments.

Power BI & Business Intelligence

  • Utilize Microsoft Power BI to analyze, visualize, and communicate business information.

  • Support existing Power BI reporting solutions and dashboards.

  • Investigate report questions, data discrepancies, refresh issues, and access concerns.

  • Validate Power BI report behavior against expected business results.

  • Assist users in understanding report calculations, definitions, filters, refresh timing, and known limitations.

  • Support reporting adoption and business-user understanding.

  • Work with reporting-development teams when issues require technical escalation.

SQL & Data Investigation

  • Write and interpret SQL queries for data analysis, investigation, reconciliation, and validation.

  • Use joins, filters, aggregations, and other query techniques to analyze data.

  • Trace data through applicable source and reporting environments.

  • Compare source information against report outputs to identify discrepancies.

  • Investigate anomalies and support root-cause analysis.

  • Validate transformations and business rules when troubleshooting reporting issues.

  • Document analytical findings and supporting evidence.

Databricks & Data Platform Support

  • Utilize Databricks or comparable cloud data and analytics platforms to support reporting investigations.

  • Navigate data environments to identify relevant tables, views, and reporting data.

  • Use SQL-based analysis to investigate data anomalies and discrepancies.

  • Trace information from source systems through data-processing and reporting layers.

  • Review data transformations, joins, filters, aggregations, and source-to-target results.

  • Recognize potential data-quality, processing, transformation, or reporting issues.

  • Partner with Data Engineering and reporting-development teams when deeper technical investigation is required.

  • Support testing, release validation, and post-deployment monitoring.

Business Process Analysis

  • Collaborate with process owners and subject-matter experts to understand and document current business processes.

  • Develop or support process maps and related documentation.

  • Identify process bottlenecks, inefficiencies, control gaps, and improvement opportunities.

  • Analyze how data and reporting can improve operational performance.

  • Evaluate existing processes using quantitative and qualitative information.

  • Recommend practical solutions based on analytical findings.

Process Improvement

  • Work with cross-functional teams to identify opportunities to improve business processes.

  • Recommend changes designed to enhance efficiency, effectiveness, accuracy, and consistency.

  • Assist with the design and implementation of process improvements.

  • Support continuous-improvement initiatives.

  • Apply process-improvement principles and methodologies when appropriate.

  • Monitor results following implementation to determine whether changes are producing the intended outcomes.

  • Proactively identify opportunities to improve reporting processes and analytical methodologies.

Data Quality & Validation

  • Ensure data used for analysis and reporting is accurate, complete, consistent, and reliable.

  • Develop and perform data-quality checks.

  • Conduct reconciliation and validation activities.

  • Identify missing, inaccurate, duplicated, or inconsistent information.

  • Investigate data-quality issues and coordinate appropriate resolution.

  • Validate source-to-report results.

  • Document data issues, findings, corrective actions, and outcomes.

  • Support data-governance and quality-management practices.

Reporting Support & Incident Management

  • Serve as a resource for reporting questions, data discrepancies, access concerns, refresh issues, and report-related inquiries.

  • Investigate reporting issues using available data and supporting evidence.

  • Triage issues based on operational impact and urgency.

  • Develop clear problem statements when escalating technical defects.

  • Coordinate with analysts, developers, data engineers, platform teams, and business subject-matter experts.

  • Provide timely status updates regarding findings, ownership, next steps, and resolution.

  • Validate that reported issues have been resolved.

  • Maintain appropriate records of investigations and outcomes.

  • Participate in root-cause reviews and identify opportunities to prevent recurring issues.

Stakeholder Communication

  • Communicate analytical findings through:

    • Written reports

    • Dashboards

    • Data visualizations

    • Presentations

    • Business summaries

  • Translate complex analytical findings into clear, actionable business information.

  • Present information appropriately for technical, operational, management, and leadership audiences.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather reporting and analytical requirements.

  • Build productive relationships with process owners, subject-matter experts, technical teams, and business stakeholders.

  • Manage stakeholder expectations professionally when resolving reporting or data issues.

Requirements Gathering

  • Work with stakeholders to understand business and reporting needs.

  • Gather and document requirements for reports, dashboards, metrics, and analytical projects.

  • Translate business requirements into reporting and data-analysis specifications.

  • Clarify definitions, calculations, business rules, and expected outcomes.

  • Validate completed reporting solutions against stakeholder requirements.

  • Identify opportunities to standardize recurring reporting needs.

Data Governance, Security & Compliance

  • Follow applicable data-governance policies and procedures.

  • Ensure data handling and reporting activities comply with relevant security and regulatory requirements.

  • Maintain appropriate controls when accessing and analyzing business data.

  • Protect sensitive and confidential information.

  • Support audit and compliance requirements when applicable.

  • Maintain appropriate documentation and analytical evidence.

  • Follow established reporting, security, escalation, and documentation standards.

Documentation & Knowledge Management

  • Maintain clear documentation of reporting processes, business rules, data definitions, analytical methodologies, and investigation findings.

  • Create and maintain reporting support documentation when appropriate.

  • Document recurring issues and proven solutions.

  • Develop process documentation and stakeholder-ready summaries.

  • Support knowledge sharing and cross-training.

  • Help establish repeatable reporting and analytical processes.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Data Science, Data Analytics, Business Analytics, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field.

  • 5–10 years of relevant experience in business analysis, reporting, process improvement, data analysis, business intelligence, analytics, or a related role.

  • Strong experience collecting, analyzing, validating, and interpreting business data.

  • Experience developing reports, dashboards, KPIs, and performance metrics.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • Strong attention to detail.

  • Experience with process mapping and business-process documentation.

  • Ability to translate complex data into actionable business insights.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • Strong organizational and project-management capabilities.

  • Ability to manage multiple assignments and priorities simultaneously.

  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively within cross-functional teams.

Required/Highly Relevant Technical Skills

Candidates should demonstrate experience with several of the following:

  • Microsoft Power BI

  • SQL

  • Microsoft Excel

  • Data Analysis

  • Data Visualization

  • Dashboard Development

  • KPI & Metrics Reporting

  • Data Reconciliation

  • Data Validation

  • Business Intelligence

  • Reporting Analytics

  • Process Mapping

  • Process Improvement

  • Requirements Gathering

  • Data Quality

  • Data Governance

  • Root-Cause Analysis

Advanced Excel capabilities should include experience with reconciliation, analysis, lookups, PivotTables, and structured data validation.

Preferred Technical Qualifications

  • Working knowledge or hands-on experience with Databricks.

  • Databricks SQL experience.

  • Experience with cloud-based data and analytics platforms.

  • Experience with Tableau or comparable visualization platforms.

  • Microsoft Fabric experience.

  • Familiarity with data warehouses and enterprise semantic models.

  • Knowledge of Delta Lake or lakehouse concepts.

  • Understanding of data lineage and source-to-report data flows.

  • Experience with enterprise scheduling or job-monitoring tools.

  • Experience with ticketing/work-management platforms such as ServiceNow, Jira, Remedy Helix, or similar systems.

  • SharePoint experience.

  • Experience supporting regulated or controlled reporting environments.

Process Improvement Knowledge

Familiarity with process-improvement methodologies is highly desirable, including:

  • Lean

  • Six Sigma

  • Lean Six Sigma

  • Root-Cause Analysis

  • Continuous Improvement

  • Process Mapping

  • Workflow Optimization

A relevant professional certification, such as Lean Six Sigma, is considered advantageous.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master's degree in a relevant discipline.

  • Lean Six Sigma or related process-improvement certification.

  • 5–10 years of progressively responsible reporting, analytics, or business analysis experience.

  • Experience supporting enterprise-scale reporting environments.

  • Experience with Power BI production support.

  • Experience investigating complex reporting or data-quality issues.

  • Utility-industry experience.

  • Knowledge of customer operations, billing, payments, field operations, or related utility business processes.

  • Knowledge of data governance and data quality principles.

  • Understanding of data security and compliance requirements.

  • Experience collaborating with Data Engineering, Reporting Development, IT, and business teams.

Core Competencies

The successful candidate should demonstrate:

  • Analytical Thinking

  • Data-Driven Decision Making

  • Problem Solving

  • Business Analysis

  • Reporting & Visualization

  • Process Improvement

  • Data Quality

  • Attention to Detail

  • Root-Cause Analysis

  • Stakeholder Management

  • Technical Communication

  • Business Communication

  • Collaboration

  • Project Management

  • Organization & Prioritization

  • Ownership & Accountability

  • Customer Focus

  • Adaptability

  • Risk Awareness

  • Continuous Improvement

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is an experienced Reporting Analyst, Business Intelligence Analyst, Data Analyst, Business Analyst, Process Improvement Analyst, Power BI Analyst, or Reporting Support Analyst with approximately 5–10 years of relevant professional experience.

The strongest candidate will combine business-analysis capabilities with hands-on technical reporting skills, particularly Power BI, SQL, Excel, data reconciliation, dashboard development, and data-quality validation.

Experience using Databricks to investigate data, trace source-to-report information, validate transformations, and support reporting issue resolution would be particularly valuable.

The candidate should be comfortable working at the intersection of business operations, data, reporting, and technology and must be capable of explaining complex analytical findings in clear business language.

title: Director of Management
description:

We’re thought leaders, innovators, and problem solvers. Whatever the issue: we have an expert under this roof who can solve it. We’re a team of financial services professionals, facilities maintenance experts, risk managers, and business managers and we’re looking for the next generation of problem solvers to join us and be a part of our rapid growth. We implement intelligent solutions, exceptional service, and the RISE way so that we can create a vibrant future and quality of life today. We connect community association, financial, and facility expertise with communities who need it.

We are problem solvers and business managers who just happen to be in the business of community association management. Together, we’re capable of so much more. Together, we RISE.

Our Core Values:

  • Honoring Commitments
  • Precision
  • Unquenchable Curiosity
  • Stewardship
  • Being a Great Partner
  • Inspire Others with Your Attitude
  • Finding A Way, despite any obstacles
  • Taking Ownership

Director of Management

Company: Rise AMG Position: Director of Management Reports To: Executive Leadership Team Employment Type: Full-Time Location: Houston TX

About Rise AMG

Rise AMG is a growth-focused organization committed to building high-performing teams, developing leaders, and creating scalable systems that drive long-term business success. We are seeking an experienced, strategic, and people-focused Director of Management to help lead our management organization and strengthen the systems, culture, and performance standards that support continued growth.

Position Overview

The Director of Management is a senior leadership role responsible for overseeing the effectiveness and development of Rise AMG's management team. This individual will work closely with executive leadership to translate company strategy into operational priorities, establish clear accountability, develop managers and leaders, and ensure teams consistently execute against organizational goals.

The ideal candidate is an exceptional people leader who can operate strategically while remaining close to day-to-day business operations. They should be comfortable managing managers, building organizational systems, solving complex problems, and creating a culture of ownership, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities

Leadership & Management

  • Lead, coach, and develop managers and department leaders across Rise AMG.
  • Establish clear expectations, performance standards, and accountability structures for management teams.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor and leadership resource for managers throughout the organization.
  • Identify leadership gaps and create development plans to strengthen the management pipeline.
  • Promote a culture centered on ownership, accountability, professionalism, and high performance.
  • Facilitate effective communication and collaboration between departments and leadership levels.

Organizational Performance

  • Partner with executive leadership to establish and execute organizational priorities.
  • Translate company goals into measurable departmental and individual objectives.
  • Monitor key performance indicators and management performance to identify opportunities, risks, and areas requiring intervention.
  • Develop and implement management processes that improve productivity, efficiency, and consistency.
  • Identify operational bottlenecks and lead initiatives to resolve them.
  • Ensure managers have the resources, information, and support necessary to achieve their objectives.

People Development & Culture

  • Build and maintain leadership development programs for current and emerging managers.
  • Establish consistent performance-management practices across the organization.
  • Support succession planning and talent development initiatives.
  • Help attract, retain, and develop high-performing employees.
  • Partner with leadership and HR on employee engagement, retention, performance, and organizational development initiatives.
  • Reinforce Rise AMG's values and ensure they are reflected in management practices and employee experiences.

Strategic Execution

  • Work with executive leadership to turn strategic initiatives into actionable plans.
  • Lead cross-functional initiatives that require coordination among multiple departments.
  • Maintain visibility into organizational priorities, deadlines, and execution.
  • Anticipate organizational challenges and proactively develop solutions.
  • Help build scalable systems and processes that support Rise AMG's continued growth.

Communication & Accountability

  • Establish regular management reporting and leadership communication rhythms.
  • Ensure managers communicate priorities and expectations effectively to their teams.
  • Address performance issues promptly and constructively.
  • Provide executive leadership with clear insight into organizational performance, challenges, and opportunities.
  • Promote transparency and accountability at every level of management.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Management, Organizational Leadership, or a related field preferred.
  • 7+ years of progressive management or leadership experience, with demonstrated success managing managers or multiple teams.
  • Experience working in a fast-paced, growth-oriented organization.
  • Strong understanding of organizational management, performance management, and leadership development.
  • Proven ability to build and implement scalable processes and systems.
  • Demonstrated success developing managers and high-performing teams.
  • Strong business judgment and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • High level of discretion, professionalism, and emotional intelligence.
  • Ability to influence and collaborate effectively across all levels of an organization.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience leading a rapidly growing organization or business unit.
  • Experience building management systems, KPIs, performance dashboards, or accountability frameworks.
  • Experience with organizational development, leadership training, or talent management.
  • Experience working directly with executive leadership.
  • Demonstrated success leading organizational change or transformation initiatives.

Core Competencies

The successful candidate will demonstrate:

  • Strategic Leadership — Connects day-to-day management with long-term organizational objectives.
  • People Leadership — Develops managers and creates an environment where people can perform at their best.
  • Accountability — Establishes clear expectations and follows through on commitments and results.
  • Operational Excellence — Builds systems and processes that create consistency and scalability.
  • Communication — Communicates clearly, directly, and effectively across all levels.
  • Problem Solving — Identifies root causes and develops practical, sustainable solutions.
  • Executive Presence — Demonstrates confidence, sound judgment, professionalism, and credibility.
  • Adaptability — Thrives in a changing, growth-oriented environment.
  • Culture Building — Helps create a workplace characterized by trust, ownership, performance, and continuous improvement.

Measures of Success

Success in this role will be measured by the Director's ability to:

  • Improve the effectiveness and consistency of Rise AMG's management team.
  • Develop stronger managers and future leaders.
  • Establish clear accountability and performance expectations.
  • Improve cross-functional communication and execution.
  • Increase organizational efficiency and operational consistency.
  • Support employee retention, engagement, and development.
  • Successfully execute strategic initiatives across departments.
  • Build management systems capable of supporting the company's continued growth.

What We Offer

  • Opportunity to play a significant role in the growth and development of Rise AMG.
  • Direct partnership with executive leadership.
  • Significant influence over organizational culture and management strategy.
  • Professional growth and leadership-development opportunities.
  • Competitive compensation and benefits package.
  • A high-accountability, collaborative, and growth-oriented environment.

Why Join Rise AMG?

At Rise AMG, we believe in fostering growth and creating a supportive environment where employees can thrive. As a Rise employee, you will have the opportunity to lead, solve problems creatively, and make a tangible difference in a vibrant community.

Ready to take the next step in your career? Apply now to join the Rise AMG team and be part of a company dedicated to excellence in property management.

title: Member of Client Experience, CXM
description:
At Anchorage Digital, we are building the world’s most advanced digital asset platform for institutions to participate in crypto.
Anchorage Digital is a crypto platform that enables institutions to participate in digital assets through custody, staking, trading, governance, settlement, and the industry's leading security infrastructure. Home to Anchorage Digital Bank N.A., the first federally chartered crypto bank in the U.S., Anchorage Digital also serves institutions through Anchorage Digital Singapore, Porto by Anchorage Digital, and other offerings.
The company is funded by leading institutions including Andreessen Horowitz, GIC, Goldman Sachs, KKR, and Visa, with its Series D valuation over $3 billion. Founded in 2017 in San Francisco, California, Anchorage Digital has offices in New York, New York; Porto, Portugal; Singapore; and Sioux Falls, South Dakota. Learn more at anchorage.com, on X @Anchorage, and on LinkedIn.

With the evolving landscape of digital threats and an increasing volume of sophisticated attacks by malicious actors, we have a security policy mandating all new hires complete an in-person onboarding process - no exceptions. Security is our foundation and we prioritize physical identity verification and secure IT setup. While our security and IT logistics require physical presence to protect our infrastructure from sophisticated global threats, this move is equally about our Village culture. We believe that a laptop can be shipped, but our culture cannot.


As a Member of Client Experience, you are responsible for delivering unparalleled white glove service to our institutional clients throughout the onboarding process and on-going account management activities that may rotate from client experience, custody activity and settlements. In this role, you are responsible for ensuring an excellent onboarding experience and providing attentive care to our clients by responding to their inquiries in a timely and thoughtful manner and managing their transactions in a risk conscious way. You will become intimately familiar with the operations of our clients and their use of our platform, anticipate their needs, and serve as an advocate for them internally. You will support client interactions across multiple teams and work closely with your Client Operations teammates in ensuring processes and procedures are developed and continuously refined.
We have created the Factors of Growth & Impact to help Villagers better measure impact and articulate coaching, feedback, and the rich and rewarding learning that happens while exploring, developing, and mastering the capabilities and contributions within and outside of the Member of Client Experience role:

Technical Skills:

  • Takes accountability for understanding Anchorage Digital’s expanding business lines and services.
  • Applies concepts, knowledge and implements Anchorage policies and procedures to resolve a variety of issues.
  • Understands of how institutional clients such as VCs, Sovereign Wealth Funds, PEs etc operate.
  • Understands prospecting and onboarding flows within a bank (e.g., Know Your Client (“KYC”), contracts, account authorization and maintenance, etc.).
  • Demonstrates general understanding of the crypto industry’s landscape, tokens/protocols, and different verticals in which they’re deployed (staking, governance, etc.)
  • Executes and oversees the end-to-end processing of client operations for institutional clients. This includes receiving, verifying, and reviewing operations accurately and in a timely manner.

Complexity and Impact of Work:

  • Provide white-glove service during the clients’ onboarding lifecycle, including account go-live, and coordinating with internal stakeholders on process development and refinement.
  • Responsible for day-to-day fielding and resolving of client issues proactively and swiftly.
  • Handle time-sensitive custody and settlement operations, prioritize competing demands, and meet deadlines to ensure efficient and timely execution.
  • Demonstrate a keen ability to adapt and learn quickly as business strategies evolve and new products and tasks are introduced.
  • Provide shift coverage to ensure continuous operation, including weekends and public holidays, on a rotating basis.
  • Able to contribute in the writing and enhancement of runbooks as new processes develop.

Organizational Knowledge:

  • Stay updated with the evolving cryptocurrency industry trends, regulatory guidelines, and best practices related to Know Your Client (“KYC”), settlements and custodial services.
  • Can research and source answers from available information (SalesForce, Notion, Slack, JIRA) and properly engage subject matter experts as needed.
  • Remains aware of the strategy of Anchorage Digital and what it means for Client Experience, Custody Operations and Settlements.
  • Understands how the company’s priorities relate to their clients, the impact of changes to process, pricing, and new features.

Communication and Influence:

  • Work collaboratively and thoughtfully with team members and interdepartmental stakeholders, including compliance, product, and sales departments.
  • Comfortable, confident, and effective communicating with the full spectrum of clients, from start ups/protocols to C-suite partners at established venture capital firms.
  • Actively contributes to discussions within the team to improve processes and productivity, and thoughtfully conveys information and insights with impact when working with other teams to address project & issues.

You may be a fit for this role if you have:

  • 1-3 years of client-facing experience, in financial services and/or digital asset industry.
  • Experience supporting institutional client operations in financial services, back office experience or another heavily regulated industry.
  • Able to face off directly with clients and internal stakeholders to reach resolution to complex problems.
  • Able to work collaboratively with Sales & key stakeholders throughout the client lifecycle in furtherance of meeting clients’ needs.
  • Knowledge of institutional client onboarding, lifecycles, and structures.
  • General understanding of Know Your Client (“KYC”) and anti-money laundering concepts.
  • Conviction, curiosity, and knowledge of crypto, with strong desire to continually improve knowledge.
  • Capable of operating in a fast-paced, dynamic environment with autonomy
  • Proactive, open-minded, and with a keen ability to adapt and learn quickly as business strategies evolve and new products are introduced.

Although not a requirement, bonus points if:

  • You were emotionally moved by the soundtrack to Hamilton, which chronicles the founding of a new financial system. :)
About Anchorage Digital: Who we are
The Anchorage Village, what we call our team, brings together the brightest minds from platform security, financial services, and distributed ledger technology to provide the building blocks that empower institutions to safely participate in the evolving digital asset ecosystem. As a diverse team of more than 600 members, we are united in one common goal: building the future of finance by providing the foundation upon which value moves safely in the new global economy.
Anchorage Digital is committed to being a welcoming and inclusive workplace for everyone, and we are intentional about making sure people feel respected, supported, and connected at work—regardless of who you are or where you come from. We value and celebrate our differences and we believe being open about who we are allows us to do the best work of our lives.

JOB DESCRIPTION:

The successful candidate will be based at our Millersville-MD office (onsite). We develop advanced sonar systems and support software that enables system control, data acquisition, and analysis. A strong understanding of UI design on Windows and Linux platforms is preferred, and additional hardware related responsibilities may be assigned based on skill set.

QUALIFICATIONS:
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer / Electrical, or Electronics Engineering or equivalent and minimum 9 years of prior relevant experience. Or, Graduate Degree and a minimum of 7 years of prior related experience. In lieu of a degree, minimum of 13 years of prior related experience.
  • 5+ years of experience designing and implement software in C/C++, C# languages.

  • At least 2 years of practical knowledge of project management.

PREFERRED ADDITIONAL SKILLS:

title: Applied AI Architect,  Beneficial Deployments (Life Sciences Community & Enablement)
location: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY
description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About Beneficial Deployments

Beneficial Deployments ensures AI reaches and benefits the communities that need it most. We partner with nonprofits, foundations, and mission-driven organizations to deploy Claude in education, global health, economic mobility, and life sciences — focusing on raising the floor for those who need it most.

About the Role

We're looking for an Applied AI Architect to join our Beneficial Deployments, Life Sciences team, focused on helping scientists everywhere get the most from Claude, especially Claude Science. You'll run enablements, workshops and hackathons, build demos that show what frontier models can do for the field, and grow a community of scientists building with Claude. You'll also scale scientific enablement inside Anthropic, so our Applied AI and customer teams can support scientists without you in the room.

Responsibilities

  • Be the DRI for scientific enablement: decide what to run, build the materials, deliver them, and measure whether research teams reach daily use of Claude.

  • Lead our programs for activating scientists at scale, such as LSVP and Claude for Researchers: set the goals, design the program and run it.

  • Build demos, notebooks and tutorials that show scientists what frontier models can do in their own work, and be an active voice where scientists share tools online (X, LinkedIn, etc.).

  • Scale scientific enablement inside Anthropic: train our Applied AI and Customer Success teams, and build playbooks they can run without you.

  • Build and lead a scientist community around Claude, and be its ambassador (and support ambassador programs), from small meetups to large conferences.

  • Be the voice of scientists inside Anthropic: turn what you hear into concrete asks and see them through to launch, and partner with Marketing and Comms so campaigns and content reach the scientific community.

You Might Be a Good Fit If You Have

  • Deep hands-on expertise with AI tools for science such as Claude Science: you know where they shine and where they break.

  • Real credibility as a scientist: hands-on experience doing science in academic labs, biotechs, pharma or research institutes, ideally as a user of the kind of tools you'll help scientists adopt. Experience building or running programs for scientific communities is a plus.

  • A track record of helping many scientific teams adopt a new tool through demos, trainings, workshops or hackathons.

  • Up to date on AI for science, such as agentic analysis and AI co-scientists, and able to explain it to working scientists.

  • Hands-on experience building with LLM APIs: you can prototype a working demo. You don't need to write production code.

  • Clear written and spoken communication: talks, tutorials and docs that scientists find useful.

  • A track record of taking programs or products from idea to results: you set the direction, did the work and were accountable for the outcome, often with no playbook.

  • Comfort operating in ambiguity: you bring clarity to fuzzy problems, wear multiple hats and do whatever it takes to further the mission.

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:
$275,000—$315,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

title: IT Engineer
description:
About Zipline

Zipline is the world’s largest and most experienced drone delivery service. We are on a mission to serve all humans equally by ensuring access to food, medicine and essential goods anytime, anywhere. We design, build, and operate the world’s largest autonomous logistics system, delivering critical supplies quickly and reliably. Today, Zipline operates on four continents, makes a delivery somewhere in the world every 30 seconds, and has completed millions of deliveries to date, including blood, vaccines, medical supplies, food, and retail products.

Our customers include the world’s largest and most prominent healthcare systems, governments, retailers, restaurants and global businesses who rely on us to save lives, reduce emissions, increase economic opportunity, and provide delivery from point A to point B as fast as possible. The drone is only 15% of what we’ve built to enable seamless, reliable, global operations.

Our system strengthens supply chains, reduces congestion, and gives people time back. With more than 140 million commercial autonomous miles safely flown, Zipline is redefining access to healthcare, consumer products, and food across the globe.

We operate at a global scale and are looking for practical problem solvers who thrive on real-world challenges and rapid growth. Our team is motivated by building systems that have a direct, meaningful impact on people’s lives and by scaling the future of logistics. We are seeking people who sculpt from first principles, enjoy facing adversity, and can do the impossible at record breaking speeds.

About You and The Role

We’re looking for a hands-on IT Engineer who is passionate about delivering an excellent employee technology experience across a globally distributed workforce.

This role will be a key part of our day-to-day IT operations, supporting employees across hardware, software, identity, devices, conference rooms, and core business systems. You’ll help ensure employees have the tools, access, and support they need to be productive from day one, while continuously looking for ways to reduce friction and improve the overall IT experience.

The ideal candidate is technically curious, customer-focused, and comfortable taking ownership of problems from initial request through resolution. You should enjoy troubleshooting, learning new systems, improving processes, and finding better ways to deliver IT services at scale.

What You'll Do

Deliver an Excellent Employee IT Experience

  • Provide fast, thoughtful, and high-quality technical support to employees
  • Troubleshoot hardware, software, connectivity, access, and application issues
  • Own support issues through resolution and ensure employees have a clear understanding of next steps
  • Look beyond simply resolving tickets to identify ways IT can reduce friction and improve the employee experience
  • Contribute to strong support SLAs, service quality, and employee satisfaction
  • Escalate complex or high-impact issues when appropriate while remaining engaged through resolution

Support Onboarding & Offboarding

  • Support employee onboarding and offboarding across systems, devices, and applications
  • Ensure new employees have the correct equipment, access, and tools available on day one
  • Work with HR, Security, and other teams to maintain reliable and auditable lifecycle processes
  • Identify and help resolve gaps in onboarding, offboarding, and employee access workflows

Device & Asset Lifecycle Management

  • Support procurement, inventory, deployment, replacement, and lifecycle management of laptops, accessories, and other IT equipment
  • Configure and deploy devices for employees
  • Coordinate shipping, repairs, replacements, and equipment returns
  • Maintain accurate asset records and inventory
  • Help ensure endpoints meet company security and configuration requirements

Core Systems & Infrastructure

  • Administer and support core IT systems including identity, SSO, device management, productivity, and collaboration platforms
  • Troubleshoot account provisioning, authentication, permissions, and application access issues
  • Support macOS, Windows, and Linux environments
  • Assist with system configuration, integrations, access policies, and platform improvements
  • Help maintain reliable, secure, and scalable IT systems as the company grows

Automation & Process Improvement

  • Identify repetitive work and opportunities to improve IT workflows
  • Help build and maintain scripts, integrations, automations, and lightweight internal tools
  • Improve documentation and repeatable operational processes
  • Look for opportunities to use AI and automation to make IT support faster, more consistent, and easier for employees

Conference Rooms & A/V

  • Support A/V hardware and technology in conference rooms, all-hands spaces, and common areas
  • Troubleshoot meeting room hardware, displays, microphones, cameras, speakers, and conferencing systems
  • Help maintain a reliable and easy-to-use meeting experience for employees

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with teams across the business to understand and support their technology needs
  • Communicate technical issues clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Work closely with other IT team members on infrastructure, networking, security, and workplace technology initiatives
  • Contribute to IT projects and company-wide technology deployments

What You'll Bring

If you don’t meet every requirement but are excited about the role, we encourage you to apply.

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in IT support, IT operations, systems administration, or a similar technical role
  • Strong customer-service mindset with a focus on delivering an excellent employee experience
  • Proven ability to troubleshoot and resolve technical issues across hardware, software, identity, and access
  • Hands-on experience supporting macOS and Windows environments; Linux experience is a plus
  • Experience with endpoint management, device deployment, and access controls
  • Familiarity with Identity & Access Management concepts such as SSO, SAML, and SCIM
  • Experience supporting onboarding and offboarding processes
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and take ownership of issues through resolution
  • Comfortable working onsite at our South San Francisco HQ 5 days per week, with flexibility as needed
  • Experience working in a high-growth or operationally complex environment is a plus
  • Experience supporting a globally distributed workforce is a plus
  • Familiarity with compliance frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, or GDPR is a plus
  • Experience supporting A/V systems and conference room technology is a plus
  • Experience using AI-powered tools or building AI-driven automations to improve IT support, troubleshooting, workflows, scripting, or internal operations is a strong value-add
  • Experience with tools such as ChatGPT, Codex, Claude Code, or similar AI-assisted development and automation platforms is a plus

What Else You Need To Know

Zipline is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws or our own sensibilities.

We value diversity at Zipline and welcome applications from those who are traditionally underrepresented in tech. If you like the sound of this position but are not sure if you are the perfect fit, please apply!

description:
## **Location**

## **Position Summary**

The Kim Lab is seeking a highly motivated and creative Postdoctoral Fellow to join our team and advance our understanding of auditory function, hearing loss, and emerging inner ear therapeutics using cutting-edge in vivo approaches. Our lab has developed a unique experimental platform that enables real-time visualization and manipulation of cochlear cellular activity in living, hearing animals. By combining in vivo two-photon imaging, single-cell optogenetics, auditory physiology, and targeted inner ear drug and gene delivery, we investigate how sound is encoded and transformed from sensory hair cells to auditory neurons. Our research spans sensory coding, cochlear injury and repair, and the development of new approaches to study and treat hearing loss. Current projects explore how populations of hair cells encode sound, how sensory information is transformed into subtype-specific auditory nerve activity, and how drugs and therapeutic agents can be delivered to and monitored within the living inner ear. We are particularly interested in bridging advanced in vivo technologies with clinically relevant questions in hearing loss, otoprotection, and emerging inner ear therapeutics.

title: Senior Demand Planning Analyst
description:
HOURGLASS COSMETICS — Senior Demand Planning Analyst (Hybrid Role)

Connected by creativity and driven by purpose. Hourglass Cosmetics is a vegan and cruelty-free beauty brand, redefining luxury cosmetics with high-performance products, innovative formulas, and award-winning franchises. The Senior Demand Planning Analyst is responsible for owning end-to-end demand forecasting for an assigned region, acting as the primary forecast lead and cross-functional partner across commercial, operations, and supply chain teams.   • Create and manage top-down and bottom-up finished goods wholesale and retail forecasts

  • Contribute to the monthly S&OP process, aligning demand plans with supply and finance
  • Support team members in training and development
  • Compile monthly SKU-level global forecasts by retailer and region including:
  • Work alongside local market teams to analyze retailer and product performance trends and variances to forecast
  • Proactively partner with operations and supply chain teams to identify and close inventory gaps and mitigate overstock risk
  • Consolidate and analyze data from various sources across retail sales, wholesale, and operational data
  • Identify and initiate action in response to trends/issues
  • Technology including:

    • Develop and implement processes to drive continuous improvement in demand planning
  • Perform analysis and reporting including:

  • Strong Excel and analytical skills required; PowerBI and Oracle Planning Cloud experience preferred

  • Passion for product, specifically cosmetics and skincare

title: Software Engineer Intern (Summer 2027)
description:

We inform and empower decision makers, policy professionals and citizens through our award-winning journalism and data – delivering profound insights to help our customers decode and act on state politics and policy. You’ll work across the full stack: React/Next.js interfaces, Node APIs, and Postgres data models that keep up with petabyte-scale content. One sprint you might help prototype a semantic-search UI backed by vector embeddings. The next, you might build part of a real-time collaboration layer that lets policy analysts co-author annotations and compare version histories without refreshing the page.

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
Hi developer! Would you like to work for a growth company striving for internationalization? How would you feel about developing software related to crisis management and security? If this sounds interesting to you, keep reading!

We at NSION’s product development team are looking for a full stack expert to develop our communication platform used for critical safety operations.

What kind of job is this?

As a full stack developer, you will work with our NSC3 platform and its development. NSC3 is a video and data transmission platform which enables fast and efficient communication and task management between the field and the control room during tactical safety operations.

Our service provider in Finland is Suomen Erillisverkot, through which our platform (https://www.erillisverkot.fi/palvelut/ryhmavideopalvelu/) is currently used by public safety authorities. We are aiming for substantial growth, and cannot wait to expand our business internationally.

Your tasks and responsibilities will be related to the development of our platform, but the role is not fixed yet. Your area of responsibility will be tailored to suit your expertise and interests, and you will get to work on your own project that matches your skill set. You will have the freedom to work on the project relatively independently, but the rest of the team is always there to help you. Regardless of your experience level, we guarantee that you will meet plenty of technological challenges and learning opportunities. Due to the nature of our customer base, we also pay close attention to information security, so we hope that the topic piques your interest, as well.

In our work, we use the following languages and technologies: Kotlin, Quarkus, Postgres, Redis, TypeScript, React, Redux, Docker, Kubernetes, Azure and Kotlin and Swift on mobile.

How do we work?

NSION is a growing company with 25 employees.

We plan the objectives of our dev team for approximately one month at a time. The one-month plan is split into developers’ own areas of responsibility, on which they work in a way that they best see fit. Each of us works quite independently, because we believe our experts know best how things should be done. However, this does not mean that you will be left alone with the most difficult tasks. Our team members are happy to help each other when needed, and we use code reviews to ensure not only code quality but also mutual learning.

We work at our Tampere office approximately three days a week. Hybrid working is supported, which means that the rest of the week can be remote work. If you live far from Tampere, we hope that you would be able to be present in the Tampere office at least once a week.

What do we have to offer?

  • A challenging job that makes a difference: you are building software that helps to save lives.
  • A possibility to influence your responsibilities both now and later on. When you start working with us, you won’t have to dive into an already existing piece of software, but instead you will get the chance to present your skills by working on your own development project.
  • A competitive salary that will be negotiated together with you during the recruitment process. We want to pay you fair compensation in return for the expertise you bring to our team.

And what do we expect from you?

Ideally you already have a few years of experience as a full stack developer. The most important thing for us, however, is your ability to learn new skills. Hence, you can also be a junior developer who has got software development experience from e.g. studies, hobbies or voluntary projects.

The technologies we use are listed above. Knowledge of those technologies is an asset but not required – we believe that your previous experience will help you to get to know our tech stack. Experience in Java, Python and/or Node forms a good basis.

As we collaborate a lot with each other, we expect you to have good communication skills. Our working language is English.

If you want to talk about the position or NSION in more detail, our CTO Juho (or) will be happy to tell you more.

This is how the process will continue:

  • Apply no later than 26 October. We will process the applications as they come in.
  • The first discussion will be held on the phone. The idea is to get to know each other a little better and talk about the expectations on both sides.
  • After the phone interview you will meet us for a technical interview, during which we will talk about your technical skills and knowledge in more detail. No live or whiteboard coding is done during this step. If necessary, small homework is assigned to you.
  • On the third discussion you will meet your future team members. The objective is to find out if our ways of working fit together.
  • The last step of the process is a standard security clearance conducted by the Finnish Security and Intelligence Service (more information can be found on the Finnish Security and Intelligence Service website).
