title: Database Developer
description:
About Us:

ImageTrend, LLC. is dedicated to connecting life’s most important data in the healthcare and emergency response community. We deliver software solutions, data analytics and services for EMS, hospitals, community paramedicine (CP), critical care, fire, and preparedness to enable fully integrated patient-centric healthcare and public safety. Our commitment to innovation, its clients, and providing world-class implementation and support is unsurpassed. Based in Eagan, MN, ImageTrend combines business analysis, creative design and data driven architecture to offer scalable solutions and strategies for today and the future.

Employment at ImageTrend is not just about doing a job; it's about being a part of a community. We are top-notch talent, passionate about making a difference through the work we do together!

Description:

Under the direction of the Manager, Systems Engineering, the Database Developer is responsible for improving the performance, reliability, security, and maintainability of ImageTrend product databases. This role serves as a key partner to Development and DBA teams by proactively reviewing database changes prior to release, monitoring production database performance, optimizing queries and execution plans, and implementing effective indexing and database design strategies. The Database Developer helps ensure database environments are scalable, secure, recoverable, and operationally reliable while supporting continuous improvement through automation, documentation, monitoring, and best practices. This role also provides database administration and operational support, including incident response, maintenance, backup and recovery, compliance support, capacity planning, and platform optimization across SQL Server and Azure-based data platforms.

What You'll Do:

  • Review SQL queries, stored procedures, schema changes, and database deployment scripts before application releases, with emphasis on performance, scalability, correctness, and operational risk
  • Assess execution plans and analyze query performance using estimated and actual row counts, join strategies, statistics, parameter sensitivity, blocking risks, memory grants, I/O, and CPU utilization
  • Monitor query performance across production environments using approved monitoring and observability tools to identify regressions, recurring bottlenecks, high-resource workloads, and opportunities for optimization
  • Partner with developers and DBAs to rewrite and tune queries, improve data-access patterns, validate changes using representative workloads, and provide database-focused review and performance guidance
  • Recommend, test, and implement indexing strategies in coordination with Development and DBA stakeholders while balancing performance, storage utilization, maintenance costs, and overall database efficiency
  • Provide database design guidance related to tables, keys, constraints, partitioning, data types, indexing strategies, data distribution, and database development standards
  • Support performance testing and post-release validation activities by documenting findings, recommendations, tradeoffs, performance baselines, and release-readiness criteria
  • Coach developers on SQL development best practices, execution-plan interpretation, and database performance principles
  • Monitor and maintain the health, availability, security, capacity, and reliability of production and non-production database environments
  • Administer and support SQL Server and Azure data platforms, including Azure SQL Managed Instance, Azure SQL Database, Hyperscale, Microsoft Fabric, and Azure Databricks
  • Support backup and recovery, disaster recovery, high availability, maintenance, patching, and recovery validation activities
  • Investigate database incidents involving performance degradation, blocking, deadlocks, resource saturation, failed jobs, connectivity issues, storage concerns, and data integrity issues
  • Support database recommendations with execution plans, monitoring data, testing results, workload evidence, and documented operational risk assessments
  • Automate database maintenance, monitoring, validation, and reporting processes using approved tools and scripting technologies
  • Maintain technical documentation related to database configurations, operational procedures, performance decisions, and recovery processes
  • Support database security, access controls, encryption requirements, audit activities, compliance obligations, and HIPAA-related controls
  • Contribute to capacity planning and cost optimization efforts related to database compute, storage, and platform resources
  • Participate in an on-call rotation for critical database support and incident response after the initial training period and as required
  • Travel to orientation, industry or company events, training opportunities, or other onsite meetings as required
  • Perform additional duties or tasks as assigned

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field, or the equivalent combination of education and relevant experience
  • Proven professional experience as a Database Developer or similar role supporting enterprise software, SaaS applications, cloud-based solutions, database administration, performance engineering, data integration, or related technology environments
  • Advanced SQL proficiency with demonstrated experience reviewing, troubleshooting, optimizing, and tuning complex queries, stored procedures, and database workloads
  • Hands-on experience interpreting SQL Server execution plans and diagnosing performance issues involving indexing, statistics, blocking, deadlocks, CPU, memory, storage, and I/O bottlenecks
  • Experience designing, evaluating, and implementing indexing strategies for transactional and analytical workloads
  • Experience supporting production database environments and partnering effectively with software development, infrastructure, operations, and database administration teams
  • Proven working knowledge of database security, access controls, encryption, backup and recovery, disaster recovery, high-availability solutions, data integrity practices, and regulatory compliance requirements
  • Proven experience with SQL Server, Azure SQL Managed Instance, Azure SQL Database, Azure SQL Hyperscale, Microsoft Fabric, Azure Databricks, Azure Data Factory, Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Query Store, and related monitoring or diagnostic tools
  • Experience supporting ETL/ELT processes, data warehouses, lakehouse architectures, data lakes, dimensional modeling, star-schema designs, and large-scale datasets
  • Experience automating database administration, monitoring, maintenance, validation, and reporting processes using PowerShell, T-SQL, CI/CD pipelines, scripting languages, or related tools
  • Strong ability to analyze information, troubleshoot issues, and identify effective solutions with attention to detail
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills with the ability to share technical information and collaborate with team members across functions
  • Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to prioritize work, manage multiple assignments, and meet established deadlines
  • Ability to maintain discretion when handling proprietary and confidential information
  • Enthusiasm for learning and expanding knowledge or skills
  • Strong work ethic, integrity, honesty, collaboration, and team orientation
  • Ability to travel as required, up to 10%

This role can be performed 100% virtually anywhere in the US while following our Remote Work Policy. Deadline to apply is at least 3 days after the posting date listed.

Position Salary Range: The annual base salary range for this full-time role is $90,000- $120,000 USD + bonus + benefits + perks + community gains. Within the range, individual pay is determined by job-related skills, education or training and other relevant qualifications.

title: AEROSPACE MANUFACTURING INTERN
description: Job Summary Focus may be in one of three (3) work areas with potential exposure to all through the course of the assignment: Bonding, Fabricating Process Operation. Essential Functions Key Responsibilities Performs routine and some non-routine developmental learning assignments and applies standard solutions to problems or work situations of a routine or repetitive nature. May perform a variety of routine duties related to the work area which assigned. BONDING Assists in performing tasks associated with determining the method and sequences of operation to be followed in fabrication of parts using materials such as graphite, fiberglass, plastic, boron, flock, mat, epoxy resins, rubber and like materials. Assists in planning, fabricating and building adhesive bonded assemblies of metallic and nonmetallic composite materials. Fabricates composite and metal parts into subassemblies for the purpose of pre-fitting in preparation for bonding/curing in presses, ovens, and autoclaves. Performs vacuum bagging for Autoclave cures up to 100 psi. Learns to read and interpret blueprints, drawings, manuals, specifications sketches, job orders, planning documents and engineering drawings. Selects tooling and materials compatible with the processing techniques identified in the work instructions. FABRICATING Performs fabrication and assembly tasks following established methods and procedures. Assists in layout, pre-fit and assembly and layup of a variety of metal to metal and composite bonded assemblies. May layout and mark dimensions and reference lines on material with templates or shop aides. Uses hand and power tools such as hand routers, hand sanders, drills, die grinders and other like hand tools to complete the required operations. Trims parts to fit and files, grinds, deburrs, bevels edges, polishes surfaces, and otherwise finishes out the material, part or assembly to specifications. Assembles detail parts into subassemblies and complete assembles using written and verbal work instructions, Installs simple solid and blind rivets, bolts, screws and clips and prepares and applies adhesives to details parts to assemble products to confirm to specifications. Operates production machines and equipment such as bank saws, drill presses, and other like production machines to fabricate parts, components and material for production uses. Assists in reviewing production and process documentation and production scheduling and planning and in expediting the flow of material, parts and assemblies. PROCESS OPERATION Reviews work instructions, operations manuals, blueprints and other documentation to define the requirement for the processing of parts or material to be cleaned. Reads pick ticket to determine the parts to be processed. Ensures parts picked are correct for the pick order and hangs the parts on the process rack per instructions. Assists in loading process racks onto the clean line conveyor for processing through the various cleaning and rinsing tanks. Assists in selecting the computer operating programs that control the clean line equipment, monitors and makes adjustments to the equipment as required to ensure proper overall operation of the clean line. Assists in monitoring the chemical solution in the process tanks to maintain the specified liquid level and chemical mixture. Adds specified amount of chemical to solutions as directed. Assists in draining, cleaning, and refilling process tanks with chemicals on a periodic basis as instructed. Confirms right parts have been processed and kits are complete then distributed to appropriate areas. Performs other duties as required. These duties may include assignments in job classifications and departments other than the primary assignment.

title: Production Assistant – Deburrer
description:
Production Assistant – Deburrer

Location: Burbank, California
Company: WET (Design)

WET Design creates experiences that stop people in their tracks. From the Fountains of Bellagio to the Dubai Fountain—the world’s largest choreographed fountain—WET has reimagined what water, fire, fog, ice, light, sound, and motion can do together.

Our work is equal parts art, engineering, precision manufacturing, and imagination. We design and build one-of-a-kind kinetic water features and immersive environments for some of the world’s most recognizable destinations, brands, developers, governments, and cultural institutions.

We are looking for a hands-on, detail-driven Production Assistant – Deburrer to join our Burbank manufacturing team immediately. This is an essential production role for someone who takes pride in precision, works safely, moves with urgency, and understands that the quality of every individual component contributes to an extraordinary finished experience.

The Opportunity

As a Production Assistant – Deburrer, you will prepare machined components for assembly, finishing, and installation by removing burrs, sharp edges, and machining imperfections. You will also wash and clean parts to ensure they meet WET’s high standards for craftsmanship, functionality, safety, and appearance.

This role requires excellent hand and finger dexterity, strong attention to detail, and the ability to work efficiently with a high volume of parts while maintaining consistent quality. You will support material movement, shop organization, basic equipment care, and other production activities as needed.

The right person is reliable, mechanically inclined, safety-focused, and eager to contribute wherever needed in a fast-paced, custom manufacturing environment.

What You’ll Do:

  • Deburr machined parts using grinders, polishers, hand tools, and other shop equipment
  • Wash, clean, dry, and prepare finished and in-process parts for the next stage of production
  • Inspect parts for sharp edges, burrs, surface defects, cleanliness, dimensional concerns, and overall quality
  • Handle parts carefully to prevent scratches, contamination, damage, or loss of traceability
  • Organize, stage, label, and move raw materials, work-in-process material, and finished parts throughout the production shop
  • Cut material and fulfill cut orders accurately and on schedule according to drawings, specifications, and production priorities
  • Examine and verify cut lengths, angles, and material condition before releasing work
  • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work area, including material yards, wash areas, equipment, and production stations
  • Minimize scrap and rework through careful handling, precision, and consistent inspection
  • Troubleshoot basic production issues and escalate quality, equipment, or safety concerns promptly
  • Perform equipment start-up, shut-down, routine inspection, lubrication, and basic maintenance at designated critical points
  • Follow all WET safety procedures, PPE requirements, quality standards, and workplace policies
  • Support other production areas and cross-train on saws, shop equipment, and additional manufacturing processes as assigned
  • Work overtime and weekends as needed to help the team meet critical project schedules and delivery commitments

What You Bring:

  • 4+ years of experience deburring parts in a production, machine shop, fabrication, or manufacturing environment
  • Demonstrated experience using grinders, polishers, hand tools, and related shop equipment safely and effectively
  • Experience washing, cleaning, or preparing metal or machined components for assembly, finishing, coating, or shipment is strongly preferred
  • Exceptional hand-eye coordination and high finger dexterity for detailed, repetitive, precision-oriented work

title: Supply Chain Analyst, Supply Chain & Integration
description:
We’re on the lookout for the curious, those who think big and want to define the world of tomorrow. We are looking for a Supply Chain Analyst to join our team in Brazil, supporting the management, consolidation, and analysis of large volumes of data and KPIs related to the company’s warehouses. This role combines a strong analytical mindset with cross-functional collaboration, driving data-informed decisions that directly impact inventory operations, liquidation processes, and overall warehouse performance.
At Amazon, we are working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. To get there, we need talented, bright, and driven people who are passionate about data and thrive in dynamic environments. You will play a key role in generating reports, building documentation, and providing actionable insights to support strategic forums and decision-making across the supply chain organization. If you are detail-oriented, love digging into data, and enjoy partnering with diverse teams to solve complex problems, this is the role for you.


Key job responsibilities
Manage, consolidate, and analyze large volumes of data and KPIs related to the company’s warehouses, generating actionable insights for leadership forums and strategic decision-making.
Perform inventory, warehousing, and liquidation operations analysis, identifying root causes, trends, and opportunities for improvement.
Track and support B2B sales operations, including liquidation sales, damaged goods resale, and third-party product sales.
Support the accelerated inventory reduction and cleanup plan at the Cajamar warehouse, monitoring weekly sales and liquidation operations.
Participate actively in weekly meetings with warehouse teams, presenting key findings, data-driven recommendations, and improvement opportunities identified through analysis.
Partner with key stakeholders across Operations, Transportation, Sales, Seller Support, Legal, and Compliance to collect, validate, and act on data insights, ensuring alignment with company policies and standards.
Create and maintain documentation in English describing inventory situations, identified problems, analyses, and proposed solutions, following internal templates and compliance standards.
Map and track problems, workflows, and improvement opportunities related to inventory and warehouse operations, leveraging internal tools, databases and queries.

title: Purchasing Agent (ETI)
description:
The Purchasing Agent is responsible for procuring the raw materials, components, supplies, equipment, and services required to support ETI Precision’s manufacturing operations and calibration laboratories.

This position manages purchasing activities from supplier sourcing and quotation through purchase order issuance, order follow-up, delivery, and resolution of purchasing-related issues. The Purchasing Agent works with internal departments and suppliers to ensure materials and services are available when needed and meet established requirements for quality, cost, delivery, and documentation.

The position also supports purchasing requirements for ETI Precision’s calibration laboratory operations in Frederick, Maryland; Roanoke, Texas; and the Huntersville, North Carolina area.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

Procure raw materials, components, finished goods, equipment, supplies, consumables, and services required to support ETI Precision’s manufacturing and calibration laboratory operations.

Review inventory levels, production requirements, forecasts, open orders, lead times, and operational priorities to determine purchasing needs and timing.

Prepare, issue, and maintain accurate purchase orders, including specifications, quantities, pricing, delivery requirements, shipping instructions, and applicable quality or documentation requirements.

Obtain and evaluate supplier quotations and negotiate pricing, lead times, payment terms, and other commercial conditions.

Monitor open purchase orders and proactively follow up, expedite, reschedule, or resolve issues that may affect production, laboratory operations, or customer commitments.

Source and evaluate new or alternate suppliers and materials, monitor supplier performance, and address quality, delivery, responsiveness, lead-time, and cost issues to ensure continuity of supply and reduce supply-chain risk.

Ensure purchased materials and services meet applicable technical, quality, traceability, certification, and documentation requirements.

Maintain accurate procurement records, including supplier, item, pricing, lead-time, purchase order, and supporting documentation, within the company’s ERP or purchasing system to meet company, customer, quality, and accreditation requirements.

Resolve purchasing-related issues involving shortages, receiving discrepancies, rejected or damaged materials, invoice variances, returns, credits, and supplier performance.

Maintain professional and ethical relationships with suppliers and protect confidential company, customer, supplier, pricing, and technical information.

Perform other related duties and special projects as assigned.

Required Qualifications:

Associate degree in Supply Chain Management, Business, Operations, Engineering Technology, or a related field; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.

Minimum of three years of experience in purchasing, procurement, materials management, supply chain, or a related field, preferably in a manufacturing, technical-service, calibration, or quality-regulated environment.

Demonstrated experience preparing and managing purchase orders and working directly with suppliers.

Ability to read and understand product specifications, bills of material, technical requirements, and supplier quotations.

Strong organizational, analytical, negotiation, and problem-solving skills.

Ability to manage multiple priorities and respond effectively to changing operational requirements and material shortages.

Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Proficiency with ERP or MRP systems and Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, Outlook, and Word.

High level of accuracy and attention to detail.

Preferred Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Business, Operations, Engineering, or a related field.

Purchasing experience involving metals, electronic or electromechanical components, machined parts, chemicals, packaging, or other technical materials.

Experience supporting calibration laboratories, testing laboratories, or technical-service operations.

Familiarity with ISO 9001, ISO/IEC 17025, or similar quality-management and laboratory accreditation requirements.

Experience with supplier qualification, supplier performance management, corrective actions, or audit support.

Professional certification such as CPSM, CPIM, CSCP, or equivalent.

Experience supporting purchasing activities across multiple locations.

Physical and Work Requirements:

Ability to work at a computer and communicate by telephone, email, and virtual meeting for extended periods.

Ability to work in and around warehouse, production, and laboratory environments as needed to review materials, packaging, labels, documentation, and receiving issues.

Ability to occasionally lift or move items weighing up to 50 pounds, with or without reasonable accommodation.

Occasional travel to ETI Precision facilities, suppliers, or other business locations may be required.

Additional hours may occasionally be required to address urgent production, laboratory, or supply-chain needs

We are a network of calibration companies that blends local relationships with the reliability and resources of a national brand. We partner with established regional labs known for their deep community roots and long-standing customer trust and empower them with top-tier infrastructure and ISO/IEC 17025 accreditation. Whether onsite or in-lab, we maintain the personalized service customers depend on and deliver a consistent, compliant experience across every location.

title: Controller

The result is vibrant, livable communities where residents can truly thrive. At Woodbridge, building quality homes isn’t just what we do - it’s who we are.

The Controller reports to the VP Finance and will be responsible for managing and leading the accounting and finance team at Woodbridge. This role will be critical in strengthening existing processes and controls while overseeing the financial reporting for corporate, income-producing properties and development projects, ensuring the accuracy, integrity and timeliness of all financial information. The Controller will collaborate with the VP of Finance to provide oversight of the company’s budgets, financial reporting and overall financial strategy.

Our recently constructed office building (320 Granville) is conveniently located next to waterfront station in downtown Vancouver. Amenities include bike storage room, gym, showers, large lounge and roof top deck space.

title: Director of Products (REMOTE)
description:
Job Title: Director of Products

Location: USA

Reports To: Chief Product Officer

About Cyware

Cyware delivers an innovative approach to cybersecurity that unifies threat intelligence, automation, threat response, and vulnerability management with data insights gleaned from assets, users, malware, attackers, and vulnerabilities. Cyware’s Cyber Fusion platform integrates SOAR and TIP technology, enabling collaboration across siloed security teams. Cyware is widely deployed by enterprises, government agencies, and MSSPs, and is the leading threat intelligence sharing platform for global ISACs and CERTs.

Your next opportunity starts here!

More on Cyware: ()

Built and designed by SecOps practitioners and cybersecurity leaders, Cyware offers multiple technologies within its Cyber Fusion platform, including advanced threat intelligence solutions (TIP) for large and small security teams, vendor-agnostic security automation (SOAR), and purpose-built security case management. As a result, organizations can increase speed and accuracy while reducing costs and analyst burnout. Cyware's Virtual Cyber Fusion solutions make secure collaboration, information sharing, and enhanced threat visibility a reality for enterprises, sharing communities (ISAC/ISAO), MSSPs, and government agencies of all sizes and needs. Cyware's integrated product offering and solutions also include in-product AI and Agents, and are trusted by Fortune 500 enterprises, federal agencies, and the world's largest threat sharing communities.

Why We’re Hiring

We are looking to expand our team with a visionary Product Manager to help lead the development and evolution of our product portfolio. As our business grows and the competitive landscape evolves, we need a dedicated professional to bridge the gap between customer needs, business strategy, and product innovation. This role is critical to defining our product roadmap, enhancing usability, and ensuring seamless collaboration across teams to deliver exceptional value to our customers. By hiring for this role, we aim to drive forward our mission of innovation, maintain our competitive edge, and create products that resonate deeply with our users. If you're ready to take ownership, inspire change, and make a significant impact, we want you on board!

What You Will Do

  • Help define product roadmap based on business leader’s strategy, competitive landscape and customer requirements.
  • Own the Product Management Lifecycle (PMLC) and Product Development Lifecycle (PDLC) end-to-end for your product area — from discovery, PRDs, and prioritization through delivery, launch, adoption, and end-of-life — with a strong bias for shipping iteratively.
  • Manage the development of current and future features, user stories, and requirements while evaluating their potential and practicality by analyzing customer needs. Drive rapid prototype development to validate hypotheses with customers and internal stakeholders before committing engineering cycles. Leverage AI-assisted tooling to move from concept to clickable prototype in days, not weeks.
  • Collaborate with SE, SA & CSM to understand feedback, help develop use cases and triage feature requests. Lead Go-To-Market (GTM) and stakeholder enablement in partnership with Product Marketing, Sales, Sales Engineering, Customer Success, and Support — including positioning, messaging, launch collateral, demo scripts, competitive battlecards, and internal training.
  • Own use-case development for target buyer personas across commercial and public sector segments — including SOC operations, CTI, threat hunting, incident response, and cross-organization intelligence sharing use cases.
  • Liaise closely with the India-based Product Management and Engineering teams to align priorities, unblock delivery, and collaborate in roadmap and sprint decisions. Comfortable working across time zones with distributed teams.
  • Drive the implementation of AI-native product capabilities including model selection tradeoffs, evaluation frameworks, guardrails, and measuring real analyst time-to-value.
  • Guide GTM & product marketing for segments, pricing etc. based on product capabilities, value proposition etc.
  • Drive the usability vision for the product and user interface designs.
  • Manage the entire product lifecycle from ideation, design, development, launch, end-of-life and migration.
  • Manage the product backlog and recommend alternative technical approaches to meet design requirements when needed.
  • Participate in development, testing, and deployment reviews to assure requirements are being properly addressed.
  • Provide Proof-of-Concept (POC) assistance to Sales Engineering and prospective customers — scoping success criteria, unblocking technical questions, translating field feedback into the roadmap, and helping convert strategic POCs into closed-won enterprise deals.
  • Product demonstration and training for the field, operational teams and critical customers.
  • Report directly to the Chief Product Officer (CPO) and act as a thought partner on product strategy, portfolio decisions, and North American customer priorities.
  • Represent the product externally — customer briefings & demo’s, QBRs, and other sessions.
  • Act as a leader within the company; help drive product innovation into the corporate culture.

Who You Are

  • Demonstrated success defining and launching excellent products or custom solutions.
  • Proven ability to influence cross-functional teams without formal authority.
  • Strong PM experience: 7+ years as a Product Manager in a B2B focused product based enterprise, with proven capability leading product initiatives across internal and external stakeholders.
  • U.S. Citizenship required — this role supports public sector customers and products operating in FedRAMP-authorized environments.
  • Cybersecurity background is preferred. Hands-on experience building and shipping enterprise security products; Threat Intelligence, TIP, SOAR, or SIEM experience strongly preferred. Can credibly discuss and validate product decisions with security practitioners.
  • Public sector & FedRAMP experience: has shipped products used by U.S. federal, state, or local government customers, with working knowledge of FedRAMP (Moderate/High) authorization, ATO processes, and the associated product, deployment, and roadmap constraints (e.g., GovCloud, IL4/IL5, boundary controls, continuous monitoring).
  • Applied AI product expertise: has personally shipped AI/ML-powered features and managed roadmaps around them. Understands model tradeoffs, latency, hallucination risk, evaluation pipelines, and what "AI-native" actually means in a security product context.
  • Agent & agentic-workflow understanding: working knowledge of LLM agent architectures such as tool use, planning, memory, multi-agent orchestration, retrieval, and evaluation.
  • Strong understanding of security personas & their tools: fluent in the day-to-day of SOC analysts, CTI leads, threat hunters, IR responders, and CISOs — how they work, the tools in their stack (SIEM, SOAR, EDR, TIP, ticketing), and how buying decisions actually get made and renewed.
  • Startup execution mindset: has 0-1 experience and thrives in a fast-paced environment with a mindset to help mature it. Writes their own PRDs, runs customer discovery, defines success metrics, and ships iteratively while collaborating tightly with Engineering, GTM, CSM and Sales. Leverages AI wherever applicable across the PDLC.
  • Metrics & data-driven mindset: makes hard tradeoff decisions using usage data, NPS signals, and win/loss patterns. Comfortable with ambiguous data and uses frameworks to guide decisions. Experienced with metric driven execution.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; comfortable presenting to executives and to technical practitioners.
  • Strong analytical skills.
  • Comfortable with startup culture.
  • Willingness to travel domestically (~15–25%) for customer meetings, POCs, and industry events.
  • A technical bachelor's degree required; MBA preferred. A technical bachelor’s degree and MBA preferred.
  • UX and/or User Interface Design skills will be a key plus.
  • ISAC / ISAO / threat sharing community experience.

Nice to Have:

  • Prior experience selling into or supporting DoD, IC, or civilian federal agencies.
  • Deep AI & LLM knowledge — hands-on with evals, fine-tuning, RAG, or agent frameworks.
  • Has been part of a team that has grown significantly, quickly.

You’ll love working at Cyware because:

  • We foster an exciting and challenging start-up culture.
  • We’re not just employees. We’re people. We offer a comprehensive benefits package including time off, paid holidays, retirement plans, insurance coverage and much more.
  • We’ll invest in your career. Our company is growing quickly and we will give you the opportunity to do the same. You will have access to a number of professional development opportunities so that you can keep up with the company’s evolving needs.
  • We offer competitive compensation packages. We deeply value the talent our team brings to the table and believe that fair and equitable total compensation packages are part of our commitment to everyone who works here.
  • We value diversity of people, culture, and ideas.

Apply right here. You've found the application!

title: Operational Quality Lead
description:
Who we are

PolyNovo is a disruptive medical technology company, headquartered in Melbourne. We design, develop, and manufacture innovative dermal regeneration solutions, using our patented bioabsorbable polymer technology NovoSorb®. Our lifesaving products have revolutionised the treatment of burns, major trauma as well as multiple emerging indications, and impacted the lives of over 70,000 patients globally.

With a footprint in 46 countries and 300+ staff across a range of locations, PolyNovo continues to grow, and opportunity awaits.

Learn more about PolyNovo by visiting our Website or our LinkedIn page.

About The Role

PolyNovo is seeking an Operational Quality Lead to join our Quality team. In this role, you will play a key part in strengthening our Operational Quality function, leading the team and partnering closely with Manufacturing to embed quality into day-to-day operations.

Your responsibilities will include overseeing batch documentation and review, nonconformance investigations and CAPAs, change controls, label control, and maintenance and calibration activities. You will also provide hands-on quality support to Manufacturing through Gemba walks, spot checks and proactive quality monitoring, helping to drive continuous improvement

Key Responsibilities

Batch Documentation & Review

  • Oversee review and approval of incoming goods inspections
  • Oversee the issuance, control, and reconciliation of batch manufacturing records (BMRs).
  • Ensure batch records are accurately prepared, reviewed, and approved in a timely manner.
  • Perform detailed batch record reviews to ensure completeness, accuracy, and compliance with Good Documentation Practices (GDP).
  • Identify and escalate discrepancies, deviations, or compliance risks.

Label Control & Reconciliation

  • Manage label generation, approval, printing, and issuance processes.
  • Ensure traceability and reconciliation of all printed labels, including destruction of obsolete or excess labels.
  • Maintain strict controls to prevent mix-ups and ensure compliance with regulatory labelling requirements.

Nonconformance & Investigation Management

  • Lead and oversee nonconformance investigations related to manufacturing activities, including operator interviews.
  • Ensure timely root cause analysis using structured methodologies (e.g., 5 Whys, Fishbone).
  • Drive implementation of effective corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).
  • Monitor trends and identify systemic issues for continuous improvement.
  • Support internal and external audits and regulatory inspections.

Manufacturing Quality Support & Spot Checks

  • Provide real-time QA support to manufacturing operations to ensure compliance during production activities.
  • Coordinate and conduct production Gemba walks, spot checks and other proactive quality monitoring activities.
  • Review production documentation and records within delegated responsibilities.
  • Provide guidance on operational Quality queries and escalate significant or emerging issues as required.
  • Support the Operational Quality team to maintain effective Quality presence across manufacturing activities.

Maintenance & Calibration Oversight

  • Review and approve new asset enrolments in the computerised maintenance management system.
  • Review and approve maintenance and calibration work orders for production equipment.
  • Ensure all production assets are maintained and calibrated in accordance with approved schedules and procedures.
  • Verify that equipment status supports product quality and regulatory compliance.

Logbook Management

  • Establish and maintain controlled production logbooks (equipment, area, and usage logs).
  • Ensure logbooks are compliant with GDP and data integrity requirements.
  • Periodically review logbooks for completeness and accuracy.

Change Management

  • Support and oversee change control activities impacting manufacturing processes, materials, and equipment.
  • Support and oversee documentation change control activities impacting manufacturing processes, materials, and equipment.
  • Assess quality and compliance risks associated with proposed changes.
  • Ensure appropriate verification/validation activities are defined and executed.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to ensure effective implementation of changes.
  • Identify continuous improvement opportunities and drive quality initiatives

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Science, Engineering or a related field preferred

Experience:

  • Minimum 5–8 years’ experience in Quality Assurance within medical device or regulated manufacturing
  • Demonstrated experience supporting manufacturing operations
  • Strong experience with batch record review and nonconformance investigations
  • Experience leading or managing teams

Skills & Competencies:

  • Demonstrated expertise in GMP, medical device quality systems and regulatory compliance.
  • Ability to lead, coach and develop Operational Quality team members to achieve high standards of performance and engagement.
  • Strong investigation, root cause analysis and problem-solving capability.
  • Proven ability to influence and collaborate effectively across cross-functional teams.
  • Well-developed planning, organisational and prioritisation skills.
  • Strong analytical capability with the ability to interpret quality and operational data.
  • Effective verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to present quality-related information to diverse stakeholders.

I-GTM Leads are responsible for identifying where the business can accelerate growth, shaping the GTM themes and priorities that cross-functional teams rally around, designing the campaigns to capture that growth, and influencing specialist sales, partners, marketing, and demand generation to execute as one coordinated motion to create a best-in-class sales motion. This is business development at the operating-model level, which shapes how an entire sales division goes to market, not just pursuing individual deals.

We are seeking an Integrated GTM Lead to serve as the embedded strategic partner to a divisional sales director. You will own the GTM campaign portfolio and aligned Agents (AI) that support your division; influencing cross-functional stakeholders around the right inputs, themes, and customer signals to drive go-to-market priorities. You will define the strategic “what” and “how” in highly ambiguous environments, translate those priorities into campaign strategies, build the GTM packages that enable the field, and orchestrate diverse teams into unified motions that create pipeline and accelerate revenue.

This role sits at the intersection of business development and GTM strategy. It requires someone who can independently set strategic direction for their domain and frame the theses for senior leaders, inventing mechanisms that scale beyond their own scope, and delivering division-level revenue impact through influence rather than authority.

Key job responsibilities
GTM Strategy & Influence:
- Own the go-to-market campaign portfolio and aligned agents for your assigned sales division(s); independently define, which campaigns to launch, sequence, and retire based on pipeline gaps, market signals, and strategic priorities
- Influence senior cross-functional stakeholders (ex. specialist sales leaders, partner leaders, solution architecture leaders, field marketing, demand generation) around the right inputs, themes, and customer signals to shape unified go-to-market priorities
- Synthesize pipeline health, goal attainment trends, competitive dynamics, and customer demand signals into a strategic GTM point of view that aligns diverse organizations around shared priorities, while operating with minimal direction in ambiguous, fast-moving environments
- Identify structural white space where the business is under-penetrated and influence leadership to invest in campaign strategies that close those gaps

GTM Playbook Development:
- Build end-to-end GTM sales playbooks for each campaign; including executive positioning decks, persona-anchored outreach sequences, competitive battlecards, ROI narratives, and discovery frameworks
- Develop propensity-to-buy account lists leveraging AI-driven analytics, internal platforms, and third-party market signals to ensure campaigns target accounts with the highest conversion potential
- Create field-ready GTM materials that enable account teams to execute campaign motions that reduce time-to-engagement and protecting field capacity from fragmented, uncoordinated requests
- Design campaign playbooks that prescribe the go-to-market approach, customer engagement model, and partner activation strategy for each motion

Cross-Functional Orchestration:
- Bring together specialist sales, partners, solution architecture, field marketing, and demand generation into a single, accountable campaign team with named ownership and shared goals
- Resolve overlapping go-to-market motions when multiple campaigns target the same accounts or compete for the same specialist capacity—making trade-off decisions and owning the outcome
- Become a trusted partner to Sales Leaders and field sellers, ensuring the campaigns you run are high-quality and raise the bar

Performance & Strategic Advisory
- Serve as the primary GTM strategist to divisional sales leadership, providing evidence-based recommendations on campaign performance and portfolio investment decisions
- Track campaign outcomes against pipeline creation, conversion rates, and revenue targets—identifying which GTM patterns drive outsized results and codifying them into repeatable mechanisms that others adopt
- Translate complex business problems—competing priorities, constrained capacity, overlapping coverage—into clear GTM recommendations for senior leadership, proactively raising the bar for how the organization approaches go-to-market execution

A day in the life
You might start your morning reviewing campaign performance data and preparing a strategic GTM recommendation for your divisional sales leader—market signals show an emerging opportunity in a high-growth domain, and you’re building the case for a new campaign including the target account universe, partner activation model, and resource requirements.

Mid-day, you’re facilitating a cross-functional working session—influencing specialist sales, partners, and marketing around the key themes and customer signals that should drive next quarter’s go-to-market priorities. You’re synthesizing inputs from multiple teams into a unified campaign thesis, building alignment through data and strategic framing rather than hierarchy.

In the afternoon, you’re finalizing a GTM sales package for a campaign launching next week—reviewing the first-call deck, outreach sequence, and competitive positioning with your cross-functional counterparts to ensure the field has everything they need to execute on day one. Before signing off, you’re facilitating a deal review for a complex opportunity within one of your active campaigns, bringing the right experts together to unblock progress.

You think like a consultant, build like a business developer, and measure yourself by the pipeline and revenue your go-to-market campaigns produce.

title: Fulfillment & Logistics Supervisor
description:
The Role

The Fulfillment and Logistics Supervisor will oversee the day-to-day processing and shipping operations for products manufactured at GTI, including the creation, scheduling, and tracking of outbound product delivery appointments.

Responsibilities:

  • Ensure all order discrepancies (overage, shortage, damage, quality issues, invoicing adjustments, etc.) are recorded in the 3-way match log by end of business the day of delivery.
  • Performs daily routing of vehicles to various customer and company locations throughout the service area while maintaining compliance with both DOT rules and regulations and achieving a high level of customer satisfaction.
  • Works closely with Production, Inventory, and Sales Departments to meet objectives and address service-related issues.
  • Manage daily activities related to warehousing, inventory control, shipping, and receiving.
  • Ensures that company Delivery Drivers operate in compliance with all Federal, State, Local and company regulations/policies, and procedures.
  • Monitor and maintain fulfillment process schedule to meet delivery schedule goals.
  • Plan and schedule maintenance of all Powered Industrial Trucks (PIT) and Delivery Vehicles.
  • Assist in completing medical cannabis waste profiles, manifests, and shipping documents, and maintain waste processing records.
  • Conducting weekly finished product inventory audits & reporting results to the Logistics Manager.
  • Confer with Lead’s, Production Supervisors, and Department Managers to coordinate operations and activities within or between departments.
  • Must understand and maintain compliance with all state laws and/or regulations that affect Green Thumb Industries (GTI) operations.
  • Expected to adhere to safe work practices, follow GMP and HACCP guidelines, maintain sanitary conditions and ensure that product quality is maintained. Report to management any conditions or practices that may adversely affect product safety, product quality, or personnel safety.

Train employees to:

  • Package all final products following GTI product specifications.
  • Identify quality issues that could negatively impact the final product.
  • Achieve production rates set by the Logistics Manager.
  • Perform essential BioTrack functions as needed.
  • Complete vault and flower inventories.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

Working Conditions:

  • While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to perform reaching, grasping, bending, stooping, talking, hearing, seeing and repetitive motions.
  • Must be able to sit and/or stand for extended periods of time while maintaining focus.
  • Must be able to lift, carry, and balance up to 50 pounds (and up to 100 pounds with assistance) AND must be able to do so with extreme care and caution when working with product.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, changing, and challenging environment.
  • Work involves daily exposure to allergens (such as cannabis, tree nuts, and coconut oil).

Qualifications:

  • 5+ years’ experience in a production environment, 2+ years in supervisory experience preferred.
  • High school diploma or GED required; BS/BA preferred.
  • Experience in directing and evaluating hourly employees.
  • Highly motivated, self-directed, innovative, and able to work independently or among teams with keen judgement, common sense, and resourcefulness.
  • Adapts and thrives in a demanding, start-up, fast-paced environment.
  • Operates with a high level of professionalism and integrity, including dealing with confidential information.
  • Excellent organizational and communication skills.
  • Knowledge in Continuous improvement, ex. Kaizen, Gemba Walks.
  • Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with all employees and customers.
  • Must understand and comply with the rules, regulations, policies, and procedures of Green Thumb.

Additional Requirements:

  • Must pass any and all required background checks.
  • Must be and remain compliant with all legal or company regulations for working in the industry.
  • You must be a minimum of 21 years of age.
  • Must be able to obtain, and maintain, state badging requirements to work in the cannabis industry (requires background check and state review).

title: Summer 2027 Quantitative Research Intern

title: Accounts Resident
description:
Job Title: Accounts Resident

Group/Team: Accounts

Reports to: Accounts Mentor

Location: Remote

Employment Type: Part-time, 20-week contract, hourly

Time Period: Jan. 25–Jun. 11, 2027

WHO WE ARE

We're all creatives here, even if your title doesn't say so.

MAS is an award-winning experiential agency driven by people who care deeply about the work and the impact it creates. We design immersive environments, live moments, and digitally integrated experiences that challenge brands to move beyond the expected.

At MAS we don't settle for anything less than more.

We'd rather hear the idea that scares us than the one that plays it safe, so bring your boldest self, we’re built for it. We're not for everyone. But we're everything for our people.

MAS is a member of the Opus Group, a collective of agencies including Verve and Opus Agency who together create experiences that create action for the world's most influential brands. That gives us shared services across IT, HR, Finance, and Legal, and a network of teams we lean on for best practices and global resources.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

The MAS Residency program is a 20-week tasting of our MAS special sauce — who we are, what we do, and how we do it. It's a deep dive into the experiential marketing industry, where fresh minds can immerse themselves in our world (and our clients’). During this time, residents will have the opportunity to hone and grow their skills, while also uncovering new interests and opportunities along the way. Ultimately this is a unique chance to collaborate closely with leading experts in the field, forge invaluable professional connections, actively contribute to the agency’s perspective, and depart with substantial portfolio work.

We’re not looking for coffee runners, we’re looking for cultural collaborators! We're looking for standout candidates ready to go above and beyond what is asked for. We want relentless learners, envelope-pushers, and creatives who are immune to ordinary thinking. You’re not just here to sit in and watch how the magic happens; you’re here to roll up your sleeves and help shape the future for the world’s most influential brands.

This role will require an exceptional communicator, a desire to create a budding network and passion to meet new and interesting brands. This role will be a part of the Accounts team, where we will provide many learning opportunities and the potential of working on real projects alongside the Account Managers and Directors.

Feeling it? Awesome, we’d love to have you!

YOU SHOULD HAVE

  • Working knowledge of Google Workspace (including Slides, Sheets, Docs, and Drive).

  • A natural ability to connect with others and build relationships, a foundational skill for client services.

  • A drive to soak up industry knowledge, ask questions, and be proactive in every task you take on.

  • A genuine interest in researching major brands, cultural trends, and industry news.

  • Comfort learning and navigating new digital tools and platforms.

  • Clear and confident written and verbal skills, across drafting emails, participating in video calls, messaging the team, and more.

  • Solid time-management and basic project-management abilities to help keep fast-moving projects on track.

  • A collaborative attitude amid shifting timelines and priorities.

  • A desire to learn the ins and outs of how agencies manage client expectations and pitch new business.

  • Note: you will need access to a personal laptop for the duration of the 20-week program.

ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Participate in a special capstone project with fellow residents that will result in a one-of-a-kind portfolio piece and an opportunity to present your work to the broader agency.

  • Work closely with your Accounts mentor to tackle project tasks and learn the lifecycle of a campaign from pitch to execution.

  • Sit in on client calls to practice active listening, ensure agenda goals are met, and accurately capture crucial next steps.

  • Share your unique perspective during internal debriefs by offering fresh observations and insights after client meetings.

  • Support the foundational, operational aspects of account management, such as routing SOWs, tracking projects, and updating trackers.

  • Assist the team with data gathering, research, and analysis to help inform team decisions.

  • Help identify target brands for new business and support the team with quarterly analysis of account reviews and acquisitions.

  • Keep the team inspired by sharing interesting brand activations, emerging platforms, or experiential trends you spot in the wild.

  • Act as an engaged team member who contributes to the culture, perspective, and overall growth of MAS.

WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT IN RETURN

  • Temporary contract position with potential for extension or conversion.

  • A collaborative, inclusive, and enthusiastic team

HOW WE’LL TAKE CARE OF YOU

Our job titles may span more than one career level. The starting pay for this role is $22.00 per hour. Our pay ranges are based on third-party national average market compensation analysis. The actual pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs, and market demands. The pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future.

SUBMISSION PROCESS

  • Submit your resume and Candidate Info via this job posting.

CREATIVE SUBMISSION

*SUBMIT A CREATIVE PRESENTATION ABOUT YOURSELF*

We want to get to know you! In place of a cover letter, this creative presentation is an opportunity to share how you work, projects you’re proud of, what you’re passionate about, and why MAS. Choose 1 of the MAS values, (outlined below), and share an experience that shaped you. Don’t be shy; use this presentation as an opportunity to highlight your unique personality and perspective. TL;DR BE YOU. We’re here for it.


MAS Values:

  • KEEP GOOD COMPANY - It’s about showing up in all the right ways — the friend, the devil’s advocate, the hype squad — and keeping it a damn good time through it all.

  • HAVE SOME GUTS - This is about being bold with purpose — pushing the envelope to inspire new ideas, surprise our audiences, and go beyond the expected.

  • HOLD NOTHING BACK - It’s about never settling for anything less than more — or whatever you define as the best. Day to day, it’s showing up with fiery passion, big dreams (because why the hell not), and the determination to take your shot and challenge what’s comfortable.

  • GET EMOTIONAL - This is about being madly devoted to giving a shit — they seriously can’t help the fact that they’re so passionate.

  • STAY HUNGRY - This is about always exploring, tinkering, expanding skill sets, soaking up inspiration, and asking those what if questions.

Submissions should be submitted as a PDF, but can consist of:

  • An Image/collage or mood board

  • A Word Doc (1 page max)

  • A Deck (5 slides max)

  • A Video or Audio recording (1 minute max - embedded link)

Opportunity to Present:

There will be an opportunity to present for no more than 5 minutes during the 2nd round interviews.

SUBMISSION PROCESS

  1. Create your Presentation

  2. Submit your Resume, Presentation, and other relevant Candidate Info via this Job Posting

APPLICATION DEADLINE

Applications and presentations will be accepted till filled.

NOT SURE IF YOU SHOULD APPLY?

Studies show that those identifying as under-represented individuals might have talked themselves out of applying at this point. Don’t worry about checking every single box. At MAS, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic team – so if you’re excited about this role, but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every single qualification in this job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may just be the right candidate for this role or we may have other roles that better align with your skillset.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:

Individuals will be required to sit for the majority of the day and may be required to stand as needed. May require ability to ambulate primarily on a level surface for periodic periods throughout the day. Individuals may be required to travel via airplane, train, taxi, car and/or other means of transportation, as needed.

The job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change, or new ones may be assigned at any time with or without notice.

OTHER DUTIES AND ACKNOWLEDGEMENT

The above noted job description is not intended to describe, in detail, the multitude of tasks that may be assigned but rather to give the employee/ candidate a general sense of the responsibilities and expectations of the position. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice. This does not create an employment contract, implied or otherwise, other than an "at will" relationship. title: Product Manager - Platform
description:
About Mixpanel

Mixpanel is the leading product intelligence and analytics platform, trusted by more than 29,000 companies to help understand how people use the products they build. By combining powerful analytics with AI that knows your business, Mixpanel helps teams see what’s working, diagnose what’s not, and decide what to build next. Learn more at .

About the Role

As Mixpanel scales into the enterprise, this role is strategic: you'll own the systems and surface area that determine whether IT and security teams can confidently standardize on Mixpanel. Product Platform's mission is to earn the trust of enterprise-grade customers — organizations with formal procurement, security review functions, and a long institutional memory of rolling software out — across three dimensions: reliable performance at scale, security and compliance, and frictionless adoption by large organizations.

You'll own Mixpanel's core enterprise management surface: identity and access management (RBAC, SSO, passkeys, audit logging), admin and account orchestration (settings, provisioning, organization setup), the public API and extensibility surface, and the consistency of the design system and shared components every product team builds on. The surface area is growing, too — conversations are underway about extending the platform's remit into adjacent areas like plan management as Mixpanel's enterprise footprint expands.

What You'll Do

  • Define and drive the roadmap for Mixpanel's enterprise management surface — identity and access management, SSO and authentication, audit logging, admin controls, and account/org settings
  • Anticipate requirements from enterprise security reviews, compliance obligations, and the large organizations evaluating Mixpanel, and translate them into a prioritized roadmap
  • Own the consistency and reliability of shared platform foundations — the design system and components, public APIs, and the patterns every other product team builds on
  • Partner with engineering leads on architecture-level tradeoffs: reliability and performance at scale, and what belongs in the platform versus what individual product teams own
  • Build the business case for platform investments, making the indirect ROI of trust, security, and compliance work legible to leadership
  • Stay directly connected to enterprise customers and the GTM teams (Sales, CS) who see platform gaps show up in live deals, and translate that signal into roadmap decisions
  • Define and maintain measurement standards for platform health — reliability, security posture, and the onboarding experience for large organizations
  • Help shape how the platform's remit evolves as Mixpanel's enterprise footprint grows, including adjacent surface area like plan management

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of PM experience owning meaningful, technically complex problems end-to-end
  • Direct experience with identity, access management, enterprise administration, or security-adjacent product work
  • Systems thinker who understands how platform-layer decisions ripple across products, user journeys, and engineering teams
  • A track record of driving alignment and delivering outcomes across engineering, security, and GTM functions without relying on formal authority
  • Experience building business cases for security, compliance, or infrastructure investments with long or indirect ROI
  • Technical fluency with engineers on identity, auth, and security infrastructure tradeoffs
  • Clear, direct written and verbal communication

Nice to Have

  • Deep familiarity with SSO protocols (SAML, OIDC), passkeys/WebAuthn, or RBAC design patterns
  • Experience navigating SOC 2, GDPR, or enterprise security review processes as a PM
  • Hands-on Mixpanel user
  • Experience at a company navigating single-product to multiproduct platform complexity

Compensation

The amount listed below is the total target cash compensation (TTCC) and includes base compensation and variable compensation in the form of either a company bonus or commissions. Variable compensation type is determined by your role and level. In addition to the cash compensation provided, this position is also eligible for equity consideration and other benefits including medical, vision, and dental insurance coverage. You can view our benefits offerings here.

Our salary ranges are determined by role and level and are benchmarked to the SF Bay Area Technology data cut released by Radford, a global compensation database. The range displayed represents the minimum and maximum TTCC for new hire salaries for the position across all of our US locations. To stay on top of market conditions, we refresh our salary ranges twice a year so these ranges may change in the future. Within the range, individual pay is determined by experience, job-related skills, qualifications, and other factors. If you have questions about the specific range, your recruiter can share this information.

Mixpanel Compensation Range
$175,000—$210,000 USD

Benefits and Perks

  • Comprehensive Medical, Vision, and Dental Care
  • Mental Wellness Benefit
  • Generous Vacation Policy & Additional Company Holidays
  • Enhanced Parental Leave
  • Volunteer Time Off
  • Additional US Benefits: Pre-Tax Benefits including 401(K), Wellness Benefit, Holiday Break

*please note that benefits and perks for contract positions will vary*

Culture Values

  • Make Bold Bets: We choose courageous action over comfortable progress.
  • Innovate with Insight: We tackle decisions with rigor and judgment - combining data, experience and collective wisdom to drive powerful outcomes.
  • One Team: We collaborate across boundaries to achieve far greater impact than any of us could accomplish alone.
  • Candor with Connection: We build meaningful relationships that enable honest feedback and direct conversations.
  • Champion the Customer: We seek to deeply understand our customers’ needs, ensuring their success is our north star.
  • Powerful Simplicity: We find elegant solutions to complex problems, making sophisticated things accessible.

Why choose Mixpanel?

We’re a leader in analytics with over 29,000 customers and $277M invested from prominent investors: like Andreessen-Horowitz, Sequoia, YC, and, most recently, Bain Capital. Mixpanel’s pioneering event-based data analytics platform offers a powerful yet simple solution for companies to understand user behaviors and easily track overarching company success metrics. Our accomplished teams continuously facilitate our expansion by tackling the ever-evolving challenges tied to scaling, reliability, design, and service. Choosing to work at Mixpanel means you’ll be helping the world’s most innovative companies learn from their data so they can make better decisions.

Mixpanel is an equal opportunity employer supporting workforce diversity. At Mixpanel, we are focused on things that really matter—our people, our customers, our partners—out of a recognition that those relationships are the most valuable assets we have. We actively encourage women, people with disabilities, veterans, underrepresented minorities, and LGBTQ+ people to apply. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance or other similar laws that may be applicable, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. We’ve immersed ourselves in our Culture and Values as our guiding principles for the impact we want to have and the future we are building.

POSITION SUMMARY
Integrative Emergency Services, LLC ("IES") is looking for a Provider Enrollment Coordinator to support the division in facilitating the enrollment (payer applications) of both the Provider Groups and individual providers with the various government and commercial health insurance plans, network managed care contracting plans, and third-party billing entities that require provider enrollment. Role will be Hybrid format 3 days in office at 4835 LBJ Fwy, Dallas, TX, 75244.

  • Completes CAQH applications for new and existing providers. Will maintain CAQH reporting and attest provider applications every 120 days.
  • Following established enrollment procedures and sound practices directly or by working with Enrollment Coordinators.
  • Prepares applications for new providers for multiple contracts sites, payers, and states requiring an acute attention to detail, accuracy and knowledge of complex and varied requirements.

title: Community Coordinator
description:
Creator Support & Community Coordinator

About Creator

Creator is a leading Influencer Marketing Platform (currently ranked #3 on Influencer Marketing Hub), and one of the fastest growing startups in Vancouver. We're looking for a strategy driven SaaS product marketing professional with a passion for influencer marketing and digital marketing to help us continue to build on our triple digit annual growth.

Our vision is to be the destination for Brands and Creators to connect, collaborate, grow, and earn more money.

Creator.co is an innovative platform that empowers creators, influencers, and brands to collaborate and thrive in the digital space. We're revolutionizing the way brands and influencers connect by streamlining the creative process, optimizing marketing campaigns, and delivering measurable results.

Role Overview

Creators are at the center of our platform, and this role is a first point of contact for many of them. You will answer support tickets, keep our CRM and community platform running well, and help creators get started and stay active.

This role offers the opportunity to learn how a fast-growing creator platform works from the inside, with guidance from the Community Manager and room to take on more responsibility as you grow.

We are a growing team, so priorities can shift. Your day may include responding to creator support tickets, engaging with our community, coordinating program tasks, preparing reporting data, or testing new Creator Space features. While this is not primarily a social media management role, you will also support our social channels and contribute occasional content and ideas. During busy periods or urgent situations, flexibility and a willingness to jump in where needed are important.

The candidate who would excel in this role looks for answers before asking them, suggests improvements, and takes ownership of their work. They also use AI thoughtfully to work smarter and faster, in line with us being an AI-forward company.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage incoming creator support tickets from first reply to resolution, escalating complex issues to the Community Manager when needed Support creators through onboarding, program updates, and ongoing questions, ensuring they have the information they need to participate successfully.
  • Help build and maintain an engaged creator community by posting updates, answering member questions, encouraging participation, and keeping conversations helpful and active.
  • Represent Creator.co across community and social channels, contributing content ideas and occasional short-form posts with support from the team.
  • Keep CRM data accurate and up to date, and track action items across creator programs and partner sign-ups through completion.
  • Prepare and organize data for monthly performance reporting.
  • Identify and implement opportunities to improve support workflows
  • Keep SOPs and process documentation current as workflows evolve.
  • Share creator feedback and feature ideas for Creator Storefronts with the Product team and help test new features as they are released.
  • Support administrative, research, and other team priorities as needs evolve.

What You Bring

  • 1–2 years of experience in customer support, customer success, community, or a similar customer-facing role
  • Experience with Zendesk or a similar helpdesk platform
  • Clear, friendly, and professional written English communication
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills
  • A proactive approach to problem-solving, with a focus on finding answers, taking ownership, and following issues through to resolution
  • Ability to learn new software and tools quickly
  • Practical experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT or Claude to improve how work gets done, not just for basic drafting or research, but to streamline workflows, solve problems, reduce repetitive tasks, and improve efficiency.
  • Confidence representing Creator.co on social media, including creating posts and appearing on camera for short-form content

Nice to Have

  • Experience with a CRM or community platform such as Attio, Circle, or similar
  • Familiarity with creator, influencer, or affiliate marketing
  • Light content creation skills (captions, simple graphics, short copy) is a plus, though not a core part of this role
  • Background in business, communications, or marketing

What We Offer

  • A competitive salary and benefits package (health, dental, and vision insurance)
  • A transit benefit to help support your commute to our downtown Vancouver office
  • An annual education allowance to support your professional growth and development
  • A vibrant, dog-friendly office in downtown Vancouver with the flexibility of remote work up to 2 days per week
  • An inclusive environment with a team of passionate and creative individuals
  • Opportunities for growth and development, including access to industry events and mentorship
  • A supportive company culture that values innovation, collaboration, and transparency
  • The opportunity to grow with a rapidly expanding team in a booming industry

Compensation

We offer a starting annual salary of $50,000 to $57,000 CAD

Total compensation includes salary, bonus, benefits, and other perks

title: Account Director, Digital
description:
Account Director, Digital – Corporate

As an Account Director, Digital, you will be responsible for planning, executing, and optimizing multi-channel marketing campaigns for our clients. With your expertise in digital channels and campaign management, you will drive the success of client campaigns by effectively activating and leveraging various marketing channels. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless execution and deliver exceptional results that align with client objectives and maximize return on investment (ROI).

Here’s what you’ll be doing:

  • Build executive visibility and thought leadership programs from the ground up, including positioning, audience strategy, content pillars, tone of voice, platform strategy, editorial frameworks and measurement.
  • Define the role digital should play within broader communications programs and ensure strategy ladders up to business and reputation objectives.
  • Counsel clients on where executives and brands should participate, which conversations they should own and when they should stay out.
  • Lead executive immersion sessions, workshops, strategic planning sessions and senior-level presentations.

Content & Platform Leadership

  • Set the strategic direction for executive and corporate content programs social media, video and emerging platforms.
  • Develop differentiated executive positioning that balances company priorities with credible, human and ownable POVs.
  • Lead strategic audits, benchmarking and content analyses and translate findings into clear frameworks and testing roadmaps.
  • Provide senior editorial oversight across executive content, playbooks, strategies and high-profile deliverables.
  • Guide experimentation with new formats, vertical video, creator-led executive content, paid thought leadership and emerging platform opportunities.
  • Establish repeatable content frameworks and best practices that can scale across accounts.

Measurement, Innovation & Emerging Channels

  • Define measurement frameworks that connect digital performance to communications, reputation and audience objectives.
  • Translate performance into senior-level strategic recommendations and program evolution.
  • Advise clients on emerging platform behavior, AI-driven discovery and generative engine optimization.

Integrated Communications Leadership

  • Partner with senior account leads to connect earned media, executive visibility, corporate social, influencer, paid amplification and content strategy.
  • Identify how key corporate narratives can be extended across channels and sustained beyond individual earned moments.
  • Provide digital counsel on major announcements, reputational issues, executive positioning and high-visibility moments.
  • Lead cross-functional teams across digital, PR, creative, influencer, video and paid media.

Client Leadership, Team Development & Growth

  • Serve as a senior strategic partner to client leadership and executive stakeholders.
  • Lead high-level client presentations, recommendations and difficult strategic conversations.
  • Identify opportunities to expand existing client relationships and develop new digital scopes.
  • Scope programs, determine appropriate staffing and protect teams from work outside agreed deliverables.
  • Lead and mentor AS and AE talent, developing their strategic thinking, writing, client counsel and platform expertise.
  • Contribute to new business through audits, strategic POVs, pitch development, scope creation and presentations.
  • Help establish processes, standards and intellectual property that strengthen the corporate digital practice.

Here’s what you’ll have:

  • Bachelor's degree in marketing, advertising, business, or a related field.
  • 6+ years of experience in channel activation, campaign management, or digital marketing within a digital agency or marketing environment.
  • Strong knowledge of PR and digital marketing channels, including social media, search, display, influencer, email, and content marketing.
  • Solid understanding of campaign tracking, measurement, and analytics tools, such as Google Analytics or similar platforms.
  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret data and derive actionable insights to optimize channel performance.
  • Excellent project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple campaigns simultaneously and meet deadlines.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams.
  • Proactive mindset, staying updated on industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in channel activation and campaign management.

Why you'll love working here:

  • Competitive salary with comprehensive benefits & wellness programs including partnership with ClassPass!
  • Flexible PTO
  • Summer Fridays and Winter, Spring, and Fall Fridays too!
  • Hybrid work model offering flexibility and work-life balance
  • Expanded parental leave and family planning support
  • Continuous learning through "5W University" and development initiatives
  • Student Loan Reimbursement
  • Professional Development Support
  • Exclusive access to season tickets for pro sports teams along with Broadway shows, and more!
  • Charitable giving, including matching donations
