title: Software Engineer, Internal Identity
description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Stripe's mission depends on the trust of the businesses that run on us. Internal Identity builds the infrastructure that keeps access to Stripe's systems secure: strong authentication and authorization that stays out of people's way. We decide how every engineer, service, and AI agent at Stripe gets access to what it needs, and nothing more.

We're building the next generation of authorization at Stripe. It reasons about how people, services, and resources relate to each other, and it enforces policy consistently everywhere. We’re actively making the secure path the easiest one for every team at Stripe. The technical challenges we’re solving include building systems with 99.999%+ availability, expanding authorization controls to model agents as first-class identities, and making authorization policy authorship more approachable. Engineers here own big problems end to end and work closely with teams across the company.

Internal Identity is largely a distributed team with a small presence in-person in Seattle.

What you'll do

We’re looking for an engineer who is passionate about addressing tough problems in the authorization space. This role is critical, not only for Stripe, but for the future of the commercial internet.

Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain reliable, performant and scalable authorization infrastructure (e.g. libraries, frameworks, services).
  • Build comprehensive understanding of authorization needs of our users (e.g. product teams and infrastructure teams).
  • Build comprehensive, easy-to-use, and policy driven authorization solutions.
  • Collaborate with our users to adopt our authorization solutions to protect their resources by providing a great user experience.
  • Build access visibility and continuous policy governance to empower resource owners, legal and compliance to put risk of inappropriate access under control.

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 2-5 years of professional hands-on software development experience
  • Experience in the security domain
  • Strong communication and cross-functional skills; drives clear next steps when there aren’t clear lines of ownership
  • Prefer simple solutions and designs over complex ones; have a good intuition for what is lasting and scalable.
  • Good product sense; able to seek out requirements from dependent teams and align them with business needs

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience in the identity and authorization domain
  • Experience with Go, Java or Ruby

title: VP - Data Governance & Strategy
description:
The Opportunity

The VP of Data Governance & Strategy is a senior leadership role within Ookla’s Chief Data & Analytics Office responsible for defining and operationalizing the enterprise data governance strategy, policies, standards, and data ownership frameworks that enable trusted, high-quality, secure, and compliant data across Ookla. This role reports directly to the CDAO.

This leader will establish the governance vision, operating model, and cross-functional practices that ensure Ookla’s data is discoverable, well-defined, properly owned, and fit for purpose. Working across product, engineering, analytics, legal, compliance, and business teams, the role will drive a culture of data accountability, data literacy, and responsible data use aligned to enterprise strategy and regulatory expectations.

This position operates in a hybrid work environment and includes approximately 25% travel to support stakeholder engagement, governance program delivery, data quality initiatives, and team collaboration.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define and lead Ookla’s enterprise data governance strategy, operating model, policies, standards, and multi-year roadmap.

  • Establish and operationalize data ownership, data stewardship, and accountability frameworks across all data domains.

  • Oversee enterprise data quality programs, including data quality rules, monitoring, observability, lineage, and remediation.

  • Lead data security and privacy governance, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements and enterprise data protection standards.

  • Build and run the enterprise data catalog, metadata management practices, and data discovery capabilities.

  • Drive data literacy, data enablement, and change management programs to build a data-fluent, governance-aware organization.

  • Partner with legal, compliance, engineering, product, analytics, and CDAO leadership to embed governance into data platforms, pipelines, and workflows.

  • Build, mentor, and develop a high-performing data governance, quality, security, and enablement organization.

Job Qualifications

Required Knowledge, Skills and Attributes

  • Deep expertise in enterprise data governance, data quality, metadata management, data stewardship, and data catalog platforms.

  • Strong understanding of data privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA), data security frameworks, and regulatory compliance requirements.

  • Experience defining and operationalizing governance operating models, data ownership frameworks, and enterprise data policies at scale.

  • Proven ability to build and sustain data quality programs, observability practices, and data lineage frameworks in complex organizations.

  • Familiarity with modern data governance tooling, data catalogs, metadata management, and cloud-native data platforms.

  • Strong executive communication, stakeholder management, and organizational leadership skills.

  • Strategic mindset with the ability to balance governance rigor, data enablement, change management, and business value delivery.

Required Education and/or Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Management, Computer Science, Data Management, Business Administration, or a related field.

  • Advanced degree preferred.

  • 15+ years of experience in data governance, data quality, data management, compliance, or related technology disciplines.

  • 7+ years of leadership experience managing data governance, data quality, data stewardship, or data enablement teams and programs.

  • Experience building and scaling enterprise data governance programs, including policy

frameworks, stewardship networks, and data catalogs.

  • Relevant certifications in data governance, data management (e.g., CDMP), privacy, or related disciplines are preferred.




About

Ookla, an Accenture company, is a global leader in connectivity intelligence that brings together the

trusted expertise of Speedtest®, Downdetector®, Ekahau®, and RootMetrics® to deliver unmatched network and connectivity insights. By combining multi-source data with industry-leading expertise, we transform network performance metrics into strategic, actionable insights.

Our solutions empower service providers, enterprises, and governments with the critical data and insights needed to optimize networks, enhance digital experiences, and help close the digital divide. At the same time, we amplify the real-world experiences of individuals and businesses that rely on connectivity to work, learn, and communicate. From measuring and analyzing connectivity to driving industry innovation, Ookla helps the world stay connected.



About Accenture

Accenture helps the world’s leading enterprises reinvent by building their digital core and unleashing the power of AI to create value at speed for organizations across industries. Our strategy is to be the reinvention partner of choice for our clients and lead in the safe, widespread adoption of AI, and to be the most client focused, AI-enabled, great place to work in the world. We bring together the talent of our approximately 799,000 people with proprietary assets and platforms, deep process and industry expertise, and leading ecosystem relationships to deliver end-to-end solutions and measurable outcomes at scale. Through our Reinvention Services, we offer broad expertise across Cybersecurity, Digital Core, Finance, Industry and Enterprise, Song, Supply Chain and Engineering, and Talent, with advanced capabilities in AI and Data, Industry and Process, and Technology. We serve approximately 9,000 clients and generated approximately $70 billion in FY25 revenue. Visit us at .

Compensation Range

Ookla provides a range for the base pay. Factors that may be used to determine your actual pay may include your specific job related knowledge, skills, experience, and geographic location. The salary compensation for this role is $170,000 - $280,000. Individual pay within the compensation range for this business unit specific role is determined based on a variety of factors including experience, scope of the role, capabilities to perform the role, education and training, as well as business and company performance.

title: Account Director (Europe - Remote)
description:
Mission – Why we exist, what we do, and why we need you

SpotMe is a leading B2B event platform that helps enterprises increase the impact of their events by delivering CRM-connected, high-quality experiences across in-person, virtual, hybrid events, and webinars. With a strong focus on life sciences, SpotMe powers Onomi: an HCP engagement product that enables medical and commercial teams to run impactful congresses, symposia, advisory boards, and webinars. Together, SpotMe and Onomi turn events into a company’s most effective engagement channel.

This position is the ideal role for experienced talents in tech/services sales. With a self-driven resilient mindset, positive energy, and strong business acumen, you'll thrive in a fast paced environment. You will negotiate multi-year enterprise contracts, drive revenue and usage growth across our largest Fortune 500 accounts, and shape the long-term success of our most valued partnerships. Our top-performing Account Directors typically progress to sales leadership roles.

The Account Director role is key in our sales team and reports directly to the VP of Account Management. Following our Onomi launch, life sciences expansion pipeline is the #1 company objective, and driving revenue growth within existing customers is a key component.

As the account leader, you will be the primary point of contact for 7-15 key accounts with a total revenue of ~$3M and:

  • [40%] Identify and close expansion, upgrade and renewal opportunities.
  • [20%] Account retention and expansion plan execution: inserting Onomi into centers of excellence and delivery units, designing operating procedures for flawless execution, coordinating implementation and key integrations, evangelizing buying centers, functions and geo/affiliates with workshops and webinars, and partner engagement, briefing and certification.
  • [15%] Build relationships with key account stakeholders: engaging with new users, fostering trust-based relationships with champions and above-event stakeholders (commercial excellence, medical, IT, procurement), establishing open lines of communication with economic buyers, influencing HQ-prescribed technology usage guidelines, facilitating introductions and exec touchpoints at director/VP level with a meaningful briefing, demonstrating value in absolute ROI terms, and securing customer presence at customer advisory boards and 3rd-party events and roundtables.
  • [10%] Perform account research, mapping and planning: capturing intelligence on organization design, strategic priorities, Onomi's share of wallet, other vendors' scope, and integration, usage and investments for each use case; understanding budget cycles; partner mapping; and creating pricing benchmarks against other solutions.
  • [10%] Handle first-line account compliance, administrative and product inquiries.
  • [5%] Report on sales activities: CRM updates, sales forecasts and pipeline calls.

Objectives - The problems you will solve

In your first 1 month, you will:

  • Join our leadership team at live industry events: staff the booth at tradeshows and walk congresses with them
  • Master our core sales plays: rehearse them, listen to past winning calls, and successfully conduct an expansion mock demo call that convinces the team you can do it alone
  • Master our sales processes and systems (Salesforce, Google Suite, PowerPoint, Fathom) to be able to manage a sales lifecycle from customer request to contract expansion deals autonomously
  • Get introduced to all customers in your portfolio and secure face time with 80% of them.

In your first 3 months, you will:

  • Close your first deal autonomously
  • Identify 2 expansion levers for each account, with goals and steps documented in Salesforce
  • Attend your first congress solo, with a pre-event target list, a floor contact log, and 100% follow-up
  • Complete your account research and planning for every account in your portfolio, including renewal strategy and budget insertion

After the first 6 months, key indicators (usage and logo revenue) are trending up

After 12 months, you will:

  • Have met 100% of your customer portfolio in person at least once and met 1-3 new influential stakeholders per account
  • Have executed your account plans and achieved an aggregate 20% YoY revenue growth on your portfolio through services and/or software expansion

What you need to be great at:

  • Account leadership: You are above all a true account leader in B2B SaaS or services/consulting - you have managed large accounts ($200K-$2M) in large companies (>500 employees) over time, and you are able to truly understand the decision-making process and buying centers, and establish and nurture relationships with key people to expand scope and volume. You know what it means to operate a global, large-scale account in a first-class fashion.
  • Industry expertise with business orientation: You bring SaaS experience selling into critical industries - pharma, financial services, professional services, or tech - with demonstrated experience working with the most demanding customers. Above all, you have a flair for spotting pain points, helping customers form business cases, and guiding them towards execution. Pharma HCP engagement expertise, with all its nuances (medical, commercial, marketing), is a plus but not a must.
  • Autonomy and resourcefulness: You make decisions with confidence and don't wait to be told what to do. When you hit a wall, you find a way around it - you are scrappy, creative, and solution-oriented by nature. You move fast and act proactively, even when there is no immediate commercial upside.
  • Commercial sharpness: You run numbers quickly, think several steps ahead in negotiations, and understand what truly drives your customers' business. You can build a solid business case that holds up in front of a C-suite or procurement team, and you are comfortable making decisions and forming working hypotheses even when you don't have all the facts.

title: Continuous Improvement Lead
description:
Continuous Improvement Lead
Onsite in Wapato, Washington

Advancing the Future of Freshness™, Together

AgroFresh is a fast-moving, dynamic company dedicated to delivering integrated near- and post-harvest solutions for more freshness and quality, every step of the way from harvest to home. From next-gen digital monitoring and analytics and plant-based coatings to integrated fungicide solutions and SO2 generating sheets for more intelligent packaging, you can count on us for a full suite of near- and post-harvest solutions that help enhance quality and extend the shelf life of your fruits and vegetables.

When you work at AgroFresh, you work with the leading experts in near- and post-harvest technologies to proactively solve the most pressing challenges. Imagine a world where the produce supply chain has more time every step of the way. Where products get to consumers exactly as the grower intended. Where food loss is minimized, sustainability maximized, and business empowered. This is the world of Smarter Freshness.

What the Role Delivers

The Continuous Improvement Lead advances operational excellence across the Wapato site by combining deep manufacturing expertise, engineering methods, and data-driven problem-solving to deliver sustainable improvements in product quality, process yield, operating cost, and efficiency. This role is uniquely accountable for leading process optimization, supporting scale-up and new product development, resolving complex manufacturing issues, and addressing significant sources of operational loss through structured root cause analysis and DMAIC methodologies. As a member of the site leadership team, the specialist also builds a culture of continuous improvement by coaching colleagues, strengthening problem-solving capabilities, and leading cross-functional initiatives that produce measurable and lasting results.

Key Responsibilities

  • Subject matter expert in the manufacturing process with use of engineering methods to execute optimization to provide sustainable gains in product quality, process yields, operating costs and efficiency.
  • Responsible for scale up, daily process troubleshooting in manufacturing (i.e., in-process adjustments, documentation of deviations, and quality reworks) and new product development
  • Develop and maintains site operating procedures which contribute to safety, maintenance, and quality control as necessary.
  • Executes root cause analysis & DMAIC-Type problem solving through data analysis related to the largest source of losses
  • Drives and manages site-wide continuous improvement initiatives through coaching, training and capability development of colleagues

Who to Work With

Primary internal and external stakeholders

  • A member of the senior team reporting directly to Site Lead
  • Collaboration and support of all business functions: Production, Logistics, Quality, Supply Chain, EHS, and Maintenance
  • Strong partnership with external stakeholders such as suppliers, distributors, global procurement

How We Work
AgroFresh core competencies – those in italics apply for people leaders

  • Accountability for Results
  • Mindset for Growth
  • Customer Centricity
  • One AgroFresh
  • Owns the Talent

What the Job Requires

  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant subject such as Engineering or Business Administration or equivalent experience
  • Minimum of two years of relevant industrial experience, preferably in manufacturing or primary food production
  • Proficiency in inventory software and ERP systems (e.g., SAP)
  • Demonstrated proficiency in Microsoft Office applications required
  • Strong attention to detail, analytical skills and problem-solving
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with an ability to summarize results clearly, effectively, and action oriented
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment

What to Have Done and Know How to Do

These skills and experiences are highly desirable; however, they do not preclude exceptions based on an individual’s performance history and demonstrated potential.

  • Six sigma, lean manufacturing, and Statistical Process Control experience with certifications preferred.
  • Ability to lead change through coaching and train of colleagues regarding procedural changes and continuous improvement initiatives

Why Work Here

  • We work every day to improve the quantity and quality of fresh produce and reduce food waste – that is important to every person on the planet!
  • We have a rich history and are known for our quality products.
  • We have an enterprising spirit and are looking for like-minded problem-solvers to help us accomplish our goals.
  • We focus on the Critical Few priorities that are important for us and our customers and then hold ourselves accountable to deliver.
  • We are growing and transforming – both our business and the industry.
  • We are committed to developing our colleagues and helping you advance in your career.
  • We offer competitive compensation and benefits packages.

title: Part-Time Key Lead (Mission)
description:
Knix is an award-winning intimate apparel and activewear brand that is re-inventing intimates for real life. Through our innovative products and our engaged community, we are empowering people everywhere to be unapologetically free. Launched in 2013, we are one of the fastest-growing intimate apparel brands in North America and are globally recognized as an innovator within the apparel space. Qualifications

  • 1–2+ years of retail experience, with previous keyholder, supervisory, or leadership experience preferred.
  • Proven success in hitting sales targets and understanding core retail metrics (Conversion, AOV, UPT), with strong proficiency in structured retail selling models.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with a passion for mentoring, coaching, and building strong relationships.
  • Resourceful and proactive, with a proven ability to calmly resolve conflicts and de-escalate challenging situations with both team members and customers.

Eligibility Requirements

  • Ability to lift and handle packages weighing up to 25lbs.
  • Ability to move efficiently through the store for long periods of time and as needed for an entire shift.
  • Flexible to work 15 to 20 hours per week, up to 29 hours during peak, with availability to work evenings, weekends, and holidays.

Compensation

  • $22.70 CAD per hour
  • Employer-paid health benefits

How we Hire
Our people are what make Knix, Knix! Our people are passionate and have a strong belief in our mission. Our people are naturally curious and ambitious by nature. Employees feel respected and supported at Knix. We take an inclusive and equitable approach offering the same interview experience to every candidate we meet with. They are organized and results-driven with great critical thinking skills with the ability to work independently or as part of a team. Great communication, a strategic mindset, and great data analysis skills are essential for the role.

An excellent production planning coordinator (PPC) is well-versed in production procedures and products while finding ways to optimize them ensuring goods manufactured by RFRK are produced cost-effectively that meet quality specifications. They will work and collaborate with Menu Planners and stakeholders to help develop and plan seasonal menus for clients while keeping in mind the constraints of production employees, equipment, and time management.

The PPC will be effectively trained in our Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems and work daily using these tools alongside various other departments to ensure each week’s production and distribution of products flow through the system smoothly without incident.

Key Responsibilities

Production Planning and Scheduling

Support the translation approved menus, demand forecasts and service requirements into accurate weekly and daily production schedules for childcare, snack club, substitute meal and future service programs.

Create, release, revise and maintain production orders in Business Central in accordance with established planning deadlines and approval requirements.

Confirm that production schedules are achievable based on labour availability, equipment capacity, ingredient and packaging availability, shelf life, storage capacity and required completion times.

Production Coordination and Execution

Sequence production to support allergen controls, sanitation requirements, product changeovers, cooling requirements, packing timelines and distribution cut off times.

Monitor production progress against the approved schedule and coordinate recovery actions when there are production disruptions or operating conditions change.

Communicate schedule changes, significant demand fluctuations and operational constraints promptly to Production, Supply Chain, Quality Assurance, Pack, Warehouse, Logistics and other affected stakeholders.

Menu and Product Planning

Support seasonal/annual menu planning, new product/recipe launches, packaging changes and equipment or process changes by evaluating production feasibility and identifying resource constraints.

Production Analysis and Continuous Improvement

Support the analysis of completed production orders and reporting of key variances.

Planning Systems, Inventory and Performance Improvement

Maintain accurate and current production planning data within Business Central, scheduling tools, approved spreadsheets and supporting documentation.

Ensure production orders contain the correct items, quantities, production dates, locations, batch sizes and other required planning information.

Monitor finished goods and work in process inventory, investigate discrepancies and coordinate authorized inventory adjustments with the appropriate departments.

Support shelf life and first expired first out controls by considering available inventory, expiry dates and product requirements when developing production schedules.

Review completed production orders and analyze significant variances involving yield, labour, materials, waste, production time, overproduction and underproduction.

Review demand, finished goods inventory and work in process inventory before finalizing production requirements, identifying potential shortages, excess production or capacity constraints.

Additional Responsibilities

Support additional planning, scheduling, and operational duties as assigned.

Required Education & Experience

1 to 2 years of Food manufacturing experience, production planning, scheduling, or manufacturing coordination experience.

Experience scheduling production runs around demand, inventory, labour, and capacity.

Knowledge and commitment to health and safety standards, regulations, project management responsibilities, and best practices.

Proficient with ERP systems (Business Central), Microsoft 365, and Excel/Google Sheets for production planning and reporting.

Post-Secondary degree or diploma

Strong communication skills and command of English language (written and verbal)

Must be legally entitled to work in Canada

Skills & Personal Attributes

Ability to communicate plans clearly, drive action, and coordinate effectively across multiple departments.

Ability to work independently with minimal supervision while maintaining a structured, organized approach to project work.

Ability to consistently meet targets and deadlines while managing competing priorities and maintaining accuracy.

Strong time management and organizational skills, including maintaining clear and reliable notes.

Ability to think critically, problem-solve, and make effective decisions

title: Concessions and Catering Lead
description:
Job Summary

The San Mateo County Event Center is a public assembly facility that hosts a wide variety of events and produces the San Mateo County Fair, and operates the Jockey Club - a satellite wagering facility for horse racing, as well as a full-service catering and food service operation. The Concessions & Catering Lead will help to facilitate the operations of food and beverage service throughout the facility.


Essential Functions/Responsibilities

Essential and other important responsibilities and duties may include, but are not limited to the following:

  • Stay hands-on: take on tasks directly rather than just delegating, and help other departments (catering, setup, prep) when needed
  • Assist with the production and execution of all concession and catering operations
  • Assign tasks, monitor progress, and ensure satisfactory execution by the Culinary department staff
  • Communicate with vendors on inventory and ordering needs to keep in-stock conditions ready for service for all events and concessions operations
  • Create daily prep lists and production plans, making sure cooks meet quality standards
  • Support inventory control by keeping stock organized and following FIFO rotation practices
  • Maintain safety, sanitation, and cleanliness in the kitchen and work areas in compliance with ANSI, OSHA, and local health department regulations
  • Provide administrative support, as directed by the Supervisor and Manager
  • Pitch in wherever needed, as directed by the Supervisor and Manager

Qualifications

  • Proven leadership experience managing teams or projects; prior roles in operations, management, or supervisory positions
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills
  • Proficiency with Restaurant POS (Preferred Toast experience) and basic computer applications such as Microsoft Word, Excel, and Outlook
  • Strong focus on guest satisfaction and client retention
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and follow-through
  • Strong business acumen and professionalism
  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • A positive attitude, with the ability to build good working relationships with managers, co-workers, and guests
  • Reliability and accountability in meeting job responsibilities
  • Flexibility to work irregular hours, including evenings, weekends, holidays, and overtime as needed


Minimum Requirements

  • Associate's degree or equivalent from a two-year college or technical school (culinary degree preferred); and/or five years’ experience in a kitchen/culinary environment with no less than 2 years in a supervisory role; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Ability to obtain valid CA Food Handlers and CA ABC Responsible Beverage Server Training certifications within 30 days of employment.

Physical Demands

The physical demands described here represent those that an employee must meet to perform the essential functions of this job successfully. Reasonable accommodations may enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit, stand, and walk. The employee is frequently required to make repetitive hand movements to perform daily duties. The employee is occasionally required to reach with hands and arms and stoop, kneel, or crouch. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 pounds. description:

Looking for more than just a job? We provide paid training, tuition reimbursement, and opportunities to advance as you grow with our company.

Do you want to be the best part of someone else's day? This is exactly what we strive for every day at Reaching Beyond Limits Behavioral Health.

What Makes This Role Exciting:

We are looking for an enthused and passionate professional committed to improving the lives of individuals with autism and intellectual disabilities. The ideal candidate will be independently motivated to provide excellent service while effectively communicating with your team and supervisor. Summary:

Qualifications:

  • Be licensed in PA as a psychologist, professional counselor, marriage and family therapist, clinical social worker, social worker, behavior specialist, certified registered nurse practitioner or a professional with a scope of practice that includes overseeing the provision of ABA services
  • Have a certification as a Board Certified Behavior Analyst (BCBA) or other graduate-level certification in behavior analysis that is accredited by the National Commission for Certifying Agencies on the American National Standards Institute

Attributes:

  • Experience creating an individualized treatment plan, analyzing problem behaviors, and developing interventions to reduce these types of behaviors
  • Excellent oral, listening, communication, and self-awareness skills
  • Analytical minded and solutions-driven thinking
  • Self-motivated with the willingness and accountability to exceed member expectations

Benefits:

title: Materials Planner
description:
Why LeoLabs?

At LeoLabs, we’re building the living map of activity in space. Through our proprietary global radar network and AI-enabled analytics platform, we collect millions of measurements daily on more than 25,000 objects in low Earth orbit (LEO). Our radar-powered intelligence protects billions in assets, monitors adversarial behavior, and ensures safe operations for commercial and government missions.

We’re not just building technology, we are redefining global security, safety, and transparency in space. As orbital activity accelerates and threats grow more complex, LeoLabs is a trusted partner for Space Domain Awareness, Space Traffic Management, and Satellite Operations for top-tier space operators and allied defense organizations.

If you're looking to work on mission-critical challenges at the forefront of aerospace, national security, and AI, your impact starts here.

The Opportunity

We are hiring a Materials Planner on the Radar Supply Chain Management team to drive production material readiness in support of LeoLabs’ radar manufacturing and deployment schedules.

This role translates production priorities and approved BOM requirements into clear, actionable material-readiness plans. The Materials Planner will determine what can be picked from existing inventory, what must be purchased, and what discrepancies or open actions could prevent Production from starting on schedule.

The Materials Planner will own BOM scrubs, kit-readiness reporting, production shortage visibility, and Material Movement coordination. This role will work closely with Production and Warehouse to validate pick readiness, with Purchasing to communicate buy requirements and urgent shortages, with Engineering to confirm BOM readiness, and with the Senior Supply Chain Planner to translate project-level readiness into detailed production material actions.

Because LeoLabs operates with a foundational NetSuite environment, this role requires advanced Excel capability. The Materials Planner must be able to combine ERP exports, BOM data, inventory balances, open purchase orders, and production requirements into reports that clearly dictate tasks across the Supply Chain team.

This role does not own routine NetSuite inventory transactions or overall project-level forecasting. Its primary accountability is ensuring Production has timely, accurate visibility into material readiness and that shortages have clear owners and recovery actions.

You will be responsible for:

  • Support NPI, production ramp, and continuous process improvement by establishing scalable BOM scrub, shortage-management, kit-readiness, and material-planning processes as products transition into Production.
  • Develop and maintain Excel- and ERP-based planning reports and tools that provide visibility into kit readiness, shortages, open supply, purchasing requirements, and unresolved material actions.
  • Partner with Production and the Senior Supply Chain Planner to translate build schedules and project priorities into detailed material-readiness actions and communicate material risks and recovery dates.
  • Partner with Engineering to identify and resolve BOM discrepancies, revision issues, missing part numbers, quantity discrepancies, and other issues affecting material planning.
  • Partner with Purchasing to communicate procurement requirements, monitor incoming supply and ETAs, support urgent material needs, and escalate shortages that could impact production.
  • Coordinate Material Movement and pick readiness with Warehouse and Inventory teams to ensure available material is properly identified and ready to support Production.
  • Categorize material requirements into actionable statuses such as Clear to Pick, Purchasing Required, Engineering Action Required, or Supply Chain Action Required.
  • Identify, maintain, and communicate production shortages and material risks, including required quantities, need dates, responsible owners, recovery plans, and expected resolution dates.
  • Perform BOM scrubs and kit-readiness analysis by comparing build requirements against inventory, allocated material, open purchase orders, and incoming supply.
  • Own production material readiness for assigned builds and programs, ensuring material requirements are aligned with production priorities and schedules.

Qualifications

  • Experience in materials planning, production planning, supply planning, inventory planning, or manufacturing supply chain; experience in electronics, aerospace, defense, or high-tech manufacturing preferred.
  • Strong experience working with Bills of Materials (BOMs), including multi-level BOMs and subassemblies, and performing BOM scrubs or material-readiness analysis.
  • Experience supporting production kitting, shortage management, and material readiness across active manufacturing builds.
  • Strong understanding of the relationship between production schedules, BOM demand, inventory availability, open supply, and purchasing requirements.
  • Experience working cross-functionally with Production, Warehouse, Purchasing, Inventory, Engineering, and Supply Chain Planning.
  • Experience with ERP/MRP systems; NetSuite experience preferred but not required.
  • Advanced Excel skills, including formulas, lookups, pivot tables, conditional logic, data validation, and reconciliation of large data sets.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to combine multiple data sources, identify discrepancies, and translate findings into clear Supply Chain actions.
  • Basic purchasing/procurement experience, including familiarity with RFQs, purchase orders, supplier lead times, follow-up, and expedite requests.
  • Strong attention to detail, organization, communication, and follow-through, with the ability to proactively identify and escalate material risks in a fast-paced or high-growth environment.

Within 1 month, you'll

  • Complete onboarding and gain an understanding of LeoLabs’ products, Supply Chain structure, production processes, NetSuite environment, and material flow.
  • Become familiar with LeoLabs’ BOM structures, production schedules, inventory locations, purchasing processes, and Warehouse operations.
  • Learn the existing BOM scrub, kit-readiness, Material Movement, and shortage-management processes.
  • Understand how Production, Engineering, Warehouse, Purchasing, Inventory, and Supply Chain Planning interact to support manufacturing.
  • Become familiar with existing Excel reports and data sources used to determine material readiness.

Within 3 months, you'll

  • Independently perform BOM scrubs for assigned production requirements.
  • Generate and maintain kit-readiness and shortage reports for upcoming production builds.
  • Identify material as Clear to Pick, Purchasing Required, or Action Required.
  • Work directly with Warehouse and Purchasing to drive shortage actions through resolution.
  • Maintain Material Movement Forms and ensure required actions have clear owners and due dates.
  • Identify BOM discrepancies and coordinate with Engineering to resolve issues affecting material planning.
  • Begin supporting urgent purchasing requirements that could impact production.
  • Partner with the Senior Supply Chain Planner on material readiness for active projects.

Within 6 months, you'll

  • Independently manage material readiness across multiple production builds or programs.
  • Provide Production and Supply Chain with clear visibility into kit status, shortages, purchasing requirements, and material risks.
  • Proactively identify shortages before they impact scheduled builds.
  • Manage BOM scrub demand and prioritize requests based on production requirements.
  • Develop and improve Excel-based material-planning reports that translate production demand into actionable tasks for Purchasing, Warehouse, and Inventory.
  • Drive shortage-resolution follow-up activities as needed.
  • Support NPI and production ramp by establishing material-readiness analysis for new and changing BOMs.
  • Provide backup purchasing support for urgent production requirements.

Within 12 months you'll

  • Serve as a key point of accountability for production material readiness across assigned programs.
  • Establish scalable BOM scrub, kit-readiness, Material Movement, and shortage-management processes.
  • Drive measurable improvements in material readiness and reduction of production delays caused by material shortages.
  • Establish reporting that provides clear visibility into upcoming shortages and required Supply Chain actions.
  • Improve coordination between Production, Warehouse, Purchasing, Engineering, Inventory, and Supply Chain Planning.
  • Develop repeatable Excel-based planning tools that improve visibility beyond the capabilities of the current ERP environment.
  • Proactively identify material risks far enough in advance for Supply Chain to take corrective action before the production schedule is affected.

Compensation

This position is benchmarked to Menlo Park, CA with a base salary range of $147,000, plus bonus, and equity. Actual base salary will be determined based on the candidate’s work location, experience, skills, and other applicable factors.


Perks and Benefits

  • Global workforce: flexible remote/hybrid opportunities
  • Work on complex, meaningful missions with real-world impact
  • Unlimited paid time off for most roles
  • Competitive salary and equity packages
  • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage
  • Access to the forefront of commercial space operations and defense innovation

ITAR Requirements

To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) you must be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. More information regarding ITAR can be found at DDTC’s website.

Vendor Notification

LeoLabs does not engage external staffing agencies or third-party recruiting firms for this role. Unsolicited candidate submissions will not be considered.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

title: Youth Development Leader - Lorah Park Elementary School
description:
Teacher Assistant / Activity Leader


About Big Ideas Educational Services

Big Ideas Educational Services provides high-quality after-school and summer programming in a safe, structured, and engaging environment. Our programs are designed to support the whole child by integrating academic enrichment, social-emotional learning, physical fitness, STEM exploration, and recreational activities.

Through intentional, standards-aligned programming, students strengthen their academic skills, build positive relationships with peers and adults, develop confidence, and participate in meaningful learning experiences beyond the traditional school day.

We are committed to creating positive, engaging, and high-quality out-of-school experiences that help every child discover their potential and achieve success in school and in life.


Position Summary

The Teacher Assistant / Activity Leader plays an essential role in supporting the daily operation of the program by assisting certified teachers, supervising students, preparing instructional materials, and creating a safe, engaging learning environment.

This position supports academic instruction while also leading physical fitness activities, social-emotional learning experiences, recreational games, homework assistance, snack distribution, and daily site operations. The Teacher Assistant serves as a positive role model who helps ensure students remain safe, engaged, and excited to learn throughout the program day.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Assist certified teachers with daily instruction, classroom management, and small-group learning activities.
  • Prepare lesson materials, classroom resources, bulletin boards, demonstrations, and student supplies.
  • Provide homework and academic support to students during designated learning periods.
  • Lead physical fitness and recreational activities that promote healthy lifestyles and teamwork.
  • Reinforce social-emotional learning (SEL) strategies embedded throughout daily programming.
  • Maintain direct supervision of students at all times to ensure a safe and structured environment.
  • Support positive student behavior using appropriate redirection and encouragement.
  • Assist with indoor and outdoor activities, including games, STEM projects, arts, and enrichment experiences.
  • Distribute snacks while following all health and safety procedures.
  • Assist with daily site setup and breakdown, including organizing materials and preparing activity spaces.
  • Follow daily schedules and support smooth transitions between activities.
  • Collaborate with site leadership and instructional staff to ensure a positive experience for all students.
  • Communicate professionally with parents, guardians, and school staff when appropriate.
  • Attend required staff meetings, trainings, and professional development sessions.
  • Follow all Big Ideas policies, procedures, and chain of command as outlined in the Employee Handbook.
  • Perform other duties as assigned to support successful program operations.


Minimum Qualifications

  • High School Diploma or GED required.
  • Associate's degree or college coursework in Education or a related field preferred, but not required.
  • 1–2 years of experience working with elementary-aged children in an educational, childcare, recreation, or youth development setting.
  • Ability to successfully complete a Level II Background Screening.
  • Ability to successfully complete the Florida Department of Children and Families (DCF) 40-Hour Introductory Child Care Training (if required for the position).
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Excellent organizational and time-management skills.
  • Ability to multitask and work independently while remaining flexible in a fast-paced environment.
  • Demonstrates professionalism, integrity, reliability, and accountability.
  • Passion for working with children and helping every student reach their full potential.


Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

The successful candidate will demonstrate:

  • A positive, energetic, and student-centered attitude
  • Excellent classroom and behavior management skills
  • Strong teamwork and collaboration
  • Patience, flexibility, and sound judgment
  • Dependability and punctuality
  • The ability to build positive relationships with students, families, school staff, and coworkers
  • Commitment to safety, professionalism, and continuous improvement


Working Conditions

This position requires the ability to:

  • Work both indoors and outdoors throughout the program day.
  • Supervise students during instructional, recreational, and transition periods.
  • Stand, walk, bend, lift, and actively participate in student activities.
  • Occasionally lift and carry materials weighing up to 25 pounds.


Equal Opportunity Employer

Big Ideas Educational Services is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where all employees and students are respected, valued, and provided equal opportunities to succeed.


Employment History & Reference Requirements

Pursuant to Section 402.302(13), Florida Statutes, all child care personnel are subject to an employment history review as part of the required background screening process.

Applicants must provide:

  • Employment history in chronological order (most recent employer first).
  • At least one (1) previous employer, even if employment extends beyond the past two years.
  • If employed by more than three employers within the past two years, all employers during that period must be listed.
  • Volunteer applicants must provide a minimum of one professional reference.

title: Sr Software Engineer - BIOS, AWS Hardware Engineering, Firmware Development
description:
The AWS BIOS Engineering team creates and maintains custom firmware solutions for Amazon's innovative server platforms. Our BIOS/UEFI implementations are industry-leading in security, performance, and operational excellence, and are critical to the success of AWS's massive-scale infrastructure that millions of customers rely on daily. Our BIOS engineers solve complex firmware challenges and build robust, secure bootloader solutions that enable AWS to maintain its competitive edge in data center infrastructure.

The ideal candidate will be a senior firmware engineer with 7+ years of hands-on embedded or BIOS/UEFI development experience. You will bring deep expertise in x86 platform architecture, secure boot implementations, and low-level system programming. You will have a track record of leading complex firmware projects end-to-end and collaborating with silicon vendors on platform bring-up and reference code integration. You will gain intimate understanding of AWS's custom server firmware stack and analyze it for both current needs and future scalability. You will leverage your system-level expertise to find optimal solutions to complex boot-time challenges. You will collaborate with internal teams (hardware, validation, security) and external partners (silicon vendors, ODMs) while leading critical firmware development efforts.

What you will do:

- Design and implement custom UEFI/BIOS features for AWS server platforms
- Debug complex firmware issues using tools like ITP, ScanTool, and JTAG
- Optimize boot time performance and platform initialization sequences
- Implement secure boot mechanisms and firmware security features
- Develop and maintain Power-On Self Test (POST) code
- Create firmware update mechanisms and recovery solutions
- Work with hardware teams on board bring-up and platform validation

Why it matters:

AWS's custom server platforms require specialized firmware solutions that maximize performance, security, and reliability at scale. Your BIOS developments will directly impact millions of servers running in AWS data centers worldwide, requiring unique optimizations that benefit our infrastructure and customers.

Why you will love it:

- Work on cutting-edge server platforms and next-generation silicon
- Direct impact on AWS infrastructure efficiency and security
- Ownership of critical firmware components from design through deployment
- Collaboration with industry leaders in data center infrastructure
- Access to advanced hardware labs and debug equipment
- Opportunity to influence future server architecture decisions
- Work with a team of experienced firmware engineers
- Join our diverse engineering organization where you'll help deliver the firmware foundation for AWS's global infrastructure. You'll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes innovative ideas and empowers you to own complex technical challenges through to completion.

Key job responsibilities
UEFI/BIOS Development:
- Develop and maintain UEFI/BIOS code for server platforms
- Implement ACPI tables and power management features
- Create and maintain Platform Reference Code (PRC)
- Debug complex firmware issues using ITP, and JTAG tools

ODM/OEM Collaboration:
- Work directly with ODM partners
- Coordinate BIOS development efforts
- Review and validate ODM-provided BIOS code
- Support manufacturing bring-up and validation

Platform Integration:
- Interface with CPU/GPU vendors (Intel, AMD and Nvidia) for new platform bring-up
- Integrate and rebase Reference Code packages
- Support system validation and debugging

Leadership Responsibilities:
- Provide technical leadership in advanced features
- Mentor junior BIOS engineers
- Review technical specifications and design documents
- Lead architecture discussions and technical planning
- Establish coding standards and best practices

Project Management:
- Coordinate between international teams (US and Taiwan)
- Track project timelines and deliverables
- Interface with product management and customer teams

Ecosystem Management:
- Maintain relationships with silicon vendors
- Participate in industry forums and standards bodies
- Keep up with emerging technologies and industry trends

About the team
"*Why AWS*
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

*Diverse Experiences*
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

*Work/Life Balance*
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

*Inclusive Team Culture*
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

*Mentorship and Career Growth*
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional."

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

- 7+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 6+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
- 6+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team
- 6+ years of bare-metal firmware OR BIOS/UEFI development experience in C (not embedded Linux or kernel driver development)
- 6+ years of bare-metal firmware development experience in C on MCUs, SoCs, or server platforms

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
- BIOS/UEFI/EDK2/Coreboot development experience on x86 or ARM server platforms
- Experience with ACPI, SMM, PCIe enumeration, secure boot, or platform RAS features
- Experience interfacing with silicon vendors (Intel, AMD, NVIDIA) on reference code integration

title: Fulfillment Tech I
description:
Job Description

Fulfillment Tech I involves accurately picking, packing, and preparing customer orders for shipment, ensuring timely delivery by locating merchandise, verifying quantities, and properly labeling packages according to order details. Often utilizing warehouse management systems (Infoplus) and material handling equipment in a fast-paced environment.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Locates and retrieves products from warehouse shelves based on customer orders using the warehouse management system (Infoplus) or pick sheets.

  • Uses the warehouse management system (Infoplus) for receiving new inventory.
  • Moves all products to their categorized, designated storage space within the vault until fulfillment is ready to pull these products for delivery orders.

  • Utilizes pallet jacks, WAV, or other material handling equipment to move inventory efficiently.

  • Ability to multitask

  • Experience with Excel
  • Familiarity with warehouse management systems

title: Junior Graphic Designer
description:
At Murj, we do what we love and love what we do!

Murj was founded in 2014 to solve a problem witnessed first-hand. Founder and CEO, Todd, worked with cardiology practices as an implantable cardiac device sales representative for Medtronic. He watched clinicians struggle to manage these sophisticated devices using outdated and inadequate tools. Having previously worked in product management at Apple, Todd knew that brilliant design can profoundly impact the user experience -- so why not design a better way to care for patients with implantable devices?

In Murj, Todd created an enterprise SaaS cardiac device management software solutions company that reimagines and transforms patient care through thoughtful design and a passion for quality and a commitment to customer satisfaction. Today, Murj continues this transformative innovation with intuitive, elegant, and imaginative technology solutions that improve the lives of cardiac care professionals and their patients.

What Murj offers.

Murj is for people seeking a fast-paced, ever-changing environment surrounded by a supportive team that works hard and strives for innovation and professionalism, with a steady diet of humility and camaraderie.

Every employee is treated like family, with love, respect, and responsibility. The individual and collective success of every employee is at the forefront of what we do and believe.

And in joining Murj, you are joining a community that believes in evolution and promotion from within; there is a high degree of opportunity for progression, creativity, and ownership.

From your first day at Murj, you are eligible for full medical, dental, and vision insurance along with an open vacation policy, more than 10 annual company holidays, and competitive compensation and equity participation, and a 401(k) after 3 months of service.

How We Work at Murj

Murj is the right place for people who excel in fast-paced, dynamic environments. Murj embodies a high-performance culture where every team member is expected to exceed expectations and take ownership beyond their role to drive our collective success.

Employees should be comfortable working independently and taking initiative to identify and address needs. This proactive approach is essential to thriving at Murj.

We believe in working hard together, with a shared sense of purpose and drive. We’re not afraid to ask tough questions, and we support each other in reaching for bold new ideas.

Let us leave you with this.

If this role sounds intriguing - we encourage you to apply. And we encourage applicants to embrace new challenges, as the right fit at Murj is often more about the person and the challenges they seek, not just what they have accomplished in the past.

About The Role.

Murj is seeking a resourceful and highly organized Junior Graphic Designer to help strengthen how our brand is created, maintained, and used across the organization. This role is about more than producing one-off designs. You will help us build a thoughtful, reusable system of brand assets, templates, and resources that enables teams to work efficiently while presenting Murj consistently.

Working closely with the Head of Graphic Design and Director of Marketing, you will support a wide range of creative needs, including presentations, marketing collateral, social graphics, video, and print materials. You will primarily work within Murj’s existing visual identity while contributing ideas that help the brand and its supporting resources evolve.

This role is well suited to someone who combines strong visual fundamentals with a systems-oriented mindset—someone who enjoys making great work, organizing it well, and finding solutions when the path is not already defined.

What You’ll Do.

  • Build and Manage Our Brand Asset Library: Organize, maintain, and improve Murj’s shared library of graphics, templates, presentations, video elements, and other reusable creative resources. Establish practical systems for naming, versioning, finding, and using assets.
  • Steward Brand Guidelines and Templates: Help maintain and expand the Murj brand guide, translating brand standards into useful templates and tools for teams across the organization. Support colleagues in using those resources effectively and consistently.
  • Create High-Quality Marketing Materials: Design and refine presentations, campaign graphics, sales and marketing collateral, graphic elements, and other materials based on the needs of the design and marketing teams.
  • Support Social and Digital Content: Create engaging, on-brand graphics for social media and digital campaigns, with an emphasis on developing reusable systems rather than rebuilding common assets each time.
  • Edit and Create Video Content: Help clean up, edit, assemble, and prepare video content for marketing, social, sales, and internal use. Create titles, graphic elements, and simple motion treatments as appropriate.
  • Prepare and Refine Print Materials: Produce polished, print-ready materials and ensure files meet visual, technical, and production requirements.
  • Explore Smarter Creative Workflows: Help Murj evaluate and responsibly incorporate AI-enabled creative tools into its brand and asset workflows. Look for practical ways to improve efficiency while maintaining quality, accuracy, and brand consistency.
  • Support Website and Special Projects: Contribute visual assets and design support for Murj’s upcoming website work and other cross-functional initiatives. This role is not primarily focused on product UI, but familiarity with web design or Figma is valuable.

What Makes You a Great Fit.

  • A Systems Mindset: You enjoy organization, clear naming conventions, and turning one-off designs into scalable, reusable templates.
  • Resourcefulness: Faced with an unfamiliar tool or assignment, you take the initiative to research, experiment, and figure it out.
  • Balanced Stewardship: You collaborate smoothly with non-design stakeholders, incorporating their input while protecting brand consistency.
  • Versatility: You easily switch contexts—moving between presentation decks, video edits, social graphics, and asset management without missing a detail.
  • Modern Workflow Curiosity: You are excited to test new tools, automation, and AI features to work smarter and cut down on repetitive tasks.

What You Bring.

  • Graphic design experience demonstrated through a strong portfolio, internships, freelance work, or comparable projects.
  • A portfolio demonstrating strong typography, layout, visual hierarchy, and attention to detail across digital and print work.
  • Proficiency with Adobe Creative Cloud, particularly Illustrator, Photoshop, and InDesign.
  • Experience creating and refining presentations in PowerPoint or Google Slides.
  • Experience with shared asset libraries or digital asset-management systems.
  • Working knowledge of print-production requirements and file preparation.
  • Strong organizational skills and an interest in building clear, reusable systems for assets and templates.
  • The ability to receive feedback, manage multiple assignments, and follow work through to completion.
  • A resourceful, curious approach to unfamiliar tools or assignments—you are comfortable researching, experimenting, and figuring out how to move the work forward.
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills.

Nice To Haves.

  • 2-3 years of relevant graphic design experience.
  • Motion graphics or animation experience, particularly in After Effects.
  • Experience editing video using Premiere Pro or a comparable tool.
  • Familiarity with Figma, website design, or digital design systems.
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted creative tools and responsible creative-use practices.
  • Basic knowledge of HTML/CSS.
  • Experience in healthcare, SaaS, or another technical industry.

What Success Looks Like (First 90 Days).

During your first 90 days, success means learning Murj’s brand, becoming a reliable creative partner, and beginning to improve how our design resources are organized and used. You will have:

  • Built a working understanding of Murj’s brand, products, audiences, and visual standards.
  • Audited existing brand assets, templates, and shared resources and identified opportunities to improve their organization and usability.
  • Established an initial structure for maintaining, naming, updating, and distributing commonly used assets.
  • Updated or improved priority templates and internal brand resources.
  • Begun delivering dependable creative support across presentations, graphics, social content, video, and print projects.
  • Started positively influencing how teams find, use, and apply Murj’s brand assets.
  • Identified practical opportunities to improve creative workflows, including the responsible use of AI-enabled tools.

Location and schedule.

This is a remote-friendly position; however, the role requires core working hours of 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM in the employee's timezone to support our clinical customers and internal teams.

Travel expectations: 1-10%: Minimal to no travel; maybe a few meetings or events

title: VP, Global Communications
description:
ABOUT VAYNERX

VaynerX () is the most contemporary family of companies, working together to build and grow brands. Subsidiaries include VaynerMedia, Eva Nosidam Productions, The Sasha Group, Gallery Media Group, Tingley Lane Trading, VaynerSpeakers, and VaynerCommerce.

In a Nutshell

We’re looking for an experienced PR and communications leader to join us and lead PR for VaynerX. This role includes managing VaynerX’s corporate communications and building VXPR as an agency offering for brand clients. You must LOVE all things social, and be passionate about the marriage of social and PR can play in building brands and connecting to audiences in an authentic way. This is an always-on role that moves daily and will put you at the epicenter of culture.

Our teams are lean, and you will need to dip down to support the team in a hands-on capacity, but at the same time be able to delegate, making sure the day-to-day is being run smoothly and efficiently in order to deliver industry-leading PR work on a daily basis, on behalf of Vayner and our clients. You will be passionate about the work you do, about the agencies you represent, and in doing so will be at the forefront of strengthening client & industry relationships across the global company.

Think “lab” and not “agency”. We get excited about solving business problems, not creating advertising for the sake of making advertising. Our entrepreneurship DNA runs deep. We’re willing to break rules, try new things, and test hypotheses if it means better understanding our craft. It’s fun!

Our environment (and pace) feels much more like a start-up than most agencies you might be used to. Hopefully that, and the opportunity to collaborate with the talented and enthusiastic crew on amazing brands, excites you, as it does us.

Here’s where you come in.

This is an in-person role based at VXHQ; Hudson Yards in NYC; but you’ll work seamlessly across VaynerX offices. You’ll deliver best-in-class PR strategies; sharpening the narratives of VaynerMedia and other VaynerX entities, while refining the VXPR narrative as an additional service offering for clients. You’ll manage a team of PR professionals, with dotted-line reports in international markets.

On the corporate communications side, you’ll help drive talkability and reputation management for VaynerX companies - focused on the pillars of our philosophies, our work, our people, and our culture. This will include traditional corporate communications responsibilities - award entries, case study development, crisis management, and industry relations.

On the client side, you’ll work closely with the CMO and the VXPR team to service our existing PR business and grow it significantly. With client demand across the globe, and a great team of current practitioners, this role will be responsible for driving new PR business, delivering excellent PR work that complements current Vayner client initiatives, and recruiting/developing a team to take this to the next level.

You will report directly to the Global Chief Marketing Officer.

What You'd Do

Strategy & Communication

  • Drive a clear communications strategy for VaynerX and the companies within it, aligned with Vayner’s philosophies; establish clear messaging, target audiences, and channels for effective communications
  • Develop and execute strategies to build brand reputation, including: proactive external communications; presence at industry events; position executives as innovative industry leaders.
  • Set and measure clear, meaningful, and consistent KPIs across the VXPR Team
  • Oversee media relations, press releases, and thought leadership initiatives.
  • Serve as a primary spokesperson for the company.
  • Drive Executive Communications plans for Vayner executives and B2B clients
  • Lead real-time crisis management and establish a framework for crisis preparedness; proactively identify and address reputational risks and lead responses.
  • Be a trusted advisor and collaborate closely with the CEO, C-Suite and specialist leaders (Creative, Media, Strategy, Production, Platforms, DEI etc..) to maintain a finger on the pulse of the organization to provide strategic counsel and help inform brand communications.

People & Culture

  • Build a cohesive and high-performing team, that is both innovative and accountable, and acts with empathy
  • Embody the VX cultural values and consistently exhibit them through your behavior.
  • Inspire, motivate and mentor the PR team and broader MarComms team, driving a commitment to VM cultural values, and best-in-class social & digital marketing across creative & media disciplines.
  • Drive the career growth of your team, overseeing local L&D programs and talent development paths to ensure we are building future VX leaders from within the team.

title: CNC Programmer II
description:
Role Overview
CNC Milling, Turning & Multi-Axis Programmer using Mastercam responsible for creating, optimizing, and verifying CNC programs for milling, lathe, and mill-turn machines producing aerospace, defense, and precision manufactured components.


Key Responsibilities

  • CNC Programming: Develop and optimize CNC programs in Mastercam for milling (3-axis, 4-axis, and true 5-axis), lathe, and mill-turn operations.
  • Simulation & Verification: Use Mastercam and simulation tools (e.g., CIMCO Simulation) to verify programs before machine run.
  • Production Support: Load, verify, and support machine-side prove-out of programs; assist with setup and changeover, as necessary.
  • Process Development: Improve cycle times, machining efficiency, and manufacturability; participate in fixture design, tooling selection, and tool vendor evaluation.
  • Blueprint Interpretation: Read and interpret complex engineering drawings, apply GD&T, and manage multi-datum tolerances.
  • Collaboration: Work with planning, quality, engineering, purchasing, and production teams to meet shop goals and optimize processes.
  • Documentation: Generate setup and technical documentation from programs for shop use.
  • Machine Maintenance: Support CNC machine setup, troubleshooting, and maintenance, as necessary.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Software: Proficiency in Mastercam (milling & turning).
  • Machines & Controls: Experience with CNC mills (3–5+ axis), lathes (2–5+ axis), and controls FANUC, Haas, Mazak, Makino.
  • Technical Knowledge: Strong understanding of GD&T, DFM, G-code/M-code, CNC tooling, and machine geometry.
  • Materials: Experience machining metals such as aluminum, stainless steel, titanium, Inconel, plastics, composites used in aerospace.
  • Standards: Familiarity with aerospace/defense quality standards (e.g., DPD, AS9100).

Preferred Experience

  • 5+ years hands-on CNC programming and machining.
  • 3+2 Indexing and true 5-axis simultaneous motion programming.
  • Aerospace or defense manufacturing background.
  • Ability to mentor junior machinists and lead process improvement initiatives.



In summary, this role blends CAM software mastery with CNC machine operation, requiring both technical precision and process optimization skills to deliver high-quality parts in complex manufacturing environments.

  • Basic understanding of modeling and controls of electric motors and solid background in PMSM motor fundamentals

  • Digital and analog signal electronics design, development and verification.

  • Use of software/firmware configuration management tools such as GIT, Subversion or similar tools

  • Ability to work hands-on in teams and to articulate, in both oral and written form, to technical, non-technical and management audiences

  • Motivation to continue developing and learning on-the-job skills
