title: Program Manager, Carrier Operations & Governance
description:
Who we are

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.
.

Hiring and how we work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.
.

See yourself at Twilio

Join Twilio as a Program Manager, Carrier Operations & Governance — a tech-forward business analyst and program manager within a brand-new function built from the ground up to reshape how Twilio manages, governs, and optimizes its global telecom carrier and wholesale supplier ecosystem.

About the job

This isn't a role that inherits an existing playbook — it's a role that writes one. Twilio is building a highly visible, cross-functional operations & governance team dedicated to optimizing its telecom carrier and wholesale supplier ecosystem. Reporting into leadership that maintains regular cadences with Twilio's CEO, CFO, CRO, and Audit Committee, you will serve as the primary owner of critical end-to-end improvements spanning multiple areas of the business, and build internal operating models that unlock new levels of operational maturity and rigor.

In this role, you will bring together, understand, and implement the policies, processes, systems, tools, and controls necessary to build a world-class operating environment. You will own the creation and stand-up of the team operating model, cadences, and runbooks while taking direct ownership of the team's internal Run-the-Business (RTB) engine.

If you thrive in high-visibility environments, love designing systems from first principles, and want to own program execution end-to-end, this opportunity is built for you.

Responsibilities

In this role, you will lead program execution across four core pillars:

Cross-Functional Governance & Leadership

  • Drive Visible Governance Programs: Serve as the core Program Manager for a highly visible, cross-functional governance initiative spanning multiple areas of the business - including building and operationalizing programs from diagnosis, design, implementation, and change management
  • Maintain Executive Visibility: Package and present operational narratives, risks, and performance metrics to cross-functional leadership, feeding into C-suite and Audit Committee reviews.
  • Implement Core Infrastructure: Lead end-to-end process improvements across carrier operations — understanding, synthesizing, and deploying cohesive policies, workflows, systems/tools, and data-driven controls.

Operating Model, Enablement & Team Infrastructure

  • Build Team Foundations: Design and stand up the new Carrier Operations & Governance operating model, operational cadences, and internal team structures.
  • Author Runbooks & Standards: Author, maintain, and roll out standard operational runbooks, supply policies, and Rules of Engagement (ROEs) for internal stakeholders and carrier partners.
  • Design Enablement & Change Management: Design and create comprehensive enablement programs, training materials, and frameworks to accelerate organizational transformation — actively shifting teams from relationship- and assumption-driven decision-making to a rigorously governed, data-informed operating model.

Insights & Reporting

  • Business Intelligence: Leverage quantitative research, machine learning models, performance monitoring, and scalable data foundations that enable fast, economically sound insights.
  • Data & Reporting Quality: Execute analytical requests from IRSG, Legal, Finance, and GTM stakeholders, delivering accurate data pulls, ad-hoc analyses, and structured summaries. Perform data quality checks and validation to ensure accuracy and consistency across reporting pipelines.
  • Design Enablement & Change Management: Design and create comprehensive enablement programs, training materials, and frameworks to accelerate organizational transformation — actively shifting teams from relationship- and assumption-driven decision-making to a rigorously governed, data-informed operating model.
  • Drive Team RTB Engine: Own and manage the day-to-day Run-the-Business (RTB) cadence at the team level, ensuring operational momentum and accountability.
  • Facilitate Operational Rhythms: Facilitate regular operational forums, including team OKR tracking, and deal approval workflows.

Run-the-Business (RTB) Ownership

  • Drive Team RTB Engine: Own and manage the day-to-day Run-the-Business (RTB) cadence at the team level, ensuring operational momentum and accountability.
  • Facilitate Operational Rhythms: Facilitate regular operational forums, including team OKR tracking, and deal approval workflows.

Qualifications

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

*Required:

  • 5+ years of experience in management consulting or as a Program Manager or Chief of Staff in telecom, RevOps, or strategy and operations.
  • Proven track record leading highly visible, cross-functional programs across business, technical, legal, and financial stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated expertise driving end-to-end process improvements by integrating policies, business processes, IT/systems tools, and operational controls.
  • Direct experience standing up operating models, team cadences, and operational documentation (runbooks, frameworks, ROEs).
  • Proven track record in designing enablement content and driving organizational change.
  • Experience driving Run-the-Business (RTB) cadences, OKR tracking, and operational reporting.
  • Strong capability in process mapping, business case writing, and translating complex operational needs into IT system specs.
  • Sharp written and verbal communication skills with experience presenting to executive leadership.
  • Strong analytical proficiency using data tools (Excel/Google Sheets, SQL, or Looker) to measure performance and policy compliance.
  • Team player who thrives in a fast-paced environment.

Desired:

  • Background in management consulting, high-growth tech, or global telecom environments.
  • Six Sigma or formal Program / Process Management / Prosci Change Management certification.
  • Operational experience within commercial Deal Desks, supplier QBR management, or revenue assurance.
  • Domain knowledge of A2P SMS, international voice/messaging, carrier billing, or AIT/IRSF fraud frameworks.
  • Familiarity with workflow and dashboarding tools (Airtable, Jira, Confluence) and operational automation (Python, Coefficient, AI tooling).

Location

This role will be remote and based in Ontario, British Columbia or Alberta, Canada.

Travel

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings.

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location. Based on role, employees may also be eligible for additional compensation and benefits, including but not limited to incentive programs, commissions, equity grants, health and wellness benefits, retirement contributions, and paid time off.

The estimated pay ranges for this role are as follows:

    • $90,800.00- $113,500.00
    • Target Bonus Percentage 12.5%

The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location.

Application deadline information

Applications for this role are intended to be accepted until November 1, 2026 but may change based on business needs.

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.

.

Stay alert to recruitment fraud

We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @ email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps.

.

Twilio is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Additionally, Twilio participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law.

title: Head of Retail Stores & Operations
description:
Adventure is our Culture. Join a team that celebrates a lifestyle as bold as the terrain we love. At Backcountry, we are rooted in adventure, recognition, and wellbeing on and off the mountain. We spotlight employee stories, celebrate milestones, and offer exclusive outdoor perks. Whether you are at HQ, in a retail store, or remote, you will be part of a team that thrives on energy, exploration, and connection.

Reports to: Senior Vice President of Retail and Culinary

Location: Salt Lake City, Utah (Hybrid - 3x/week in-office)

About the Role:

The Head of Stores is responsible for leading and growing a high-performing retail organization across Backcountry and Backcountry Outlet. This executive will drive profitable growth by developing people, fostering a customer-obsessed culture, expanding rentals and services, and delivering operational excellence across an evolving store portfolio.

As the retail business continues to expand, this leader will build the capabilities, talent, and operating model needed to support growth while leveraging AI, technology, and data-driven insights to improve decision-making, simplify operations, and enhance the customer and employee experience.

This is a lean team. You will own a lot, move fast, and make decisions with full end-to-end responsibility.

What You'll Do:

  • Lead and develop a high-performing field organization by coaching leaders, building succession plans, and ensuring the right organizational structure to support a growing retail business.
  • Drive sales, profitability, and sustainable business growth through disciplined execution, financial stewardship, and operational excellence.
  • Grow the business by expanding equipment rentals, services, memberships, and other revenue opportunities while maximizing operational efficiency.
  • Foster a customer-obsessed culture that delivers exceptional service, builds loyalty, increases conversion, and strengthens the Backcountry and Backcountry Outlet brands.
  • Oversee equipment rental operations, including fleet management, seasonal staffing, safety, compliance, and operational performance across all locations.
  • Recruit, develop, and retain top talent while building a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.
  • Establish clear performance expectations through KPIs, reporting, and accountability, ensuring field leaders consistently deliver results and uphold brand standards.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Merchandising, Marketing, Finance, HR, Real Estate, and Operations to execute strategic initiatives and support business growth.
  • Champion the use of AI, analytics, and emerging technologies to simplify operations, improve productivity, enhance decision-making, and elevate both the employee and customer experience.
  • Develop and continuously improve operating procedures, training programs, and best practices to create a scalable, efficient, and consistent retail organization.

Required Qualifications:

  • 10+ years of progressive multi-unit retail leadership experience.
  • Proven success driving sales, profitability, operational excellence, and a customer-obsessed culture.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop high-performing leaders and scale a growing retail organization.
  • Strong financial acumen with experience managing P&L, budgeting, forecasting, and labor.
  • Experience leading equipment rental or service-based retail operations, including oversight of fleet management, operational execution, and profitability.
  • Experience leading organizational change and implementing scalable operating practices.
  • Proven ability to leverage AI, technology, and analytics to improve business performance, productivity, and decision-making.
  • Exceptional communication, collaboration, and cross-functional leadership skills.
  • Based in, or willing to relocate to, the Salt Lake City area, with the ability to travel frequently.

Why Join:

The people who do best here are builders. They take ownership, move fast, and want to see the direct impact of their work.

  • Executive Access: Work directly with the SVP of Retail and Culinary and Backcountry's C-suite to shape the future of the brand's retail footprint.
  • Leadership Opportunity: Build a retail organization from the ground up — define the structure, hire the team, and set the standards across a growing portfolio.
  • Portfolio-Level Impact: Own strategy and P&L across all stores and rental operations, with the autonomy to make decisions that drive measurable business outcomes.
  • Competitive Benefits: Paid time off policies, 401(k) match, medical/dental/vision and a variety of supplemental policies, and employee discounts across our portfolio of brands.

Interview Process:

  1. Recruiter Screen - A 30- to 45-minute conversation with our recruiting team to align on the role, your background, and what you are looking for.
  2. Hiring Manager Interview - Conversation with the SVP of Retail and Culinary focused on your experience building retail organizations, driving selling culture, and managing multi-unit P&L.
  3. Panel Interview - Discussion with cross-functional leaders from Merchandising, Finance, and HR to assess strategic alignment and partnership approach.
  4. Executive Interview - Conversation with senior executive leadership to discuss vision, organizational build, and long-term growth strategy.
  5. In-Person Interview - We'd like to meet you at our Salt Lake City office. Details and logistics will be arranged with your recruiter.
  6. Reference Checks - Conducted in parallel with the final stages where possible.
  7. Offer - We move quickly for the right candidate.

Interview process is subject to change. Any updates will be communicated promptly and clearly.

Please Note:

  • Part of our interview process is a mandatory in-person interview with someone on our team prior to an offer. Candidates that are unwilling or unable to meet for an in-person interview will be removed from consideration immediately.

title: Hospitality & Lifestyle Fellowship (Spring 2027)
description:

M18 is part of Orchestra, a strategic communications and marketing company built for today’s complex and fragmented world. From decoding audiences to designing bold strategies, Orchestra integrates people, platforms, and stories that stick to help clients build lasting influence. Strategic narrative development for lifestyle, fashion, beauty, wellness brands, and advisory and communications support for teams, leagues, brands, and investors at the intersection of sports, media, and culture.

Technology

WHAT YOU'LL DO
As a Fellow, you will:

  • Support client and internal projects from planning through execution
  • Participate in meetings, brainstorming sessions, client calls, and events
  • Collaborate across teams on integrated initiatives

title: Service Desk Support Specialist
description:
At Accenture Federal Services, nothing matters more than helping the US federal government make the nation stronger and safer and life better for people. Our 13,000+ people are united in a shared purpose to pursue the limitless potential of technology and ingenuity for clients across defense, national security, public safety, civilian, and military health organizations.
Join Accenture Federal Services, a technology company within global Accenture. Recognized as a Glassdoor Top 100 Best Place to Work, we offer a collaborative and caring community where you feel like you belong and are empowered to grow, learn and thrive through hands-on experience, certifications, industry training and more.
Join us to drive positive, lasting change that moves missions and the government forward!

Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary escalation point for complex Tier 2 technical and operational incidents, taking full ownership of resolution.
  • Diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve multi‑layered platform, database, API, and system interface issues that extend beyond Tier 1 capabilities.
  • Conduct advanced root‑cause analysis for persistent or systemic issues, identifying underlying technical drivers and documenting permanent fixes or strategic workarounds.
  • Utilize enterprise monitoring and analysis platforms—including SQL, Splunk, Dynatrace, and CloudWatch—to extract logs, query databases, and evaluate system performance during escalations.
  • Act as a critical liaison between front‑line support and Tier 3 engineering/development teams, converting complex findings into structured, actionable escalations.
  • Manage the Tier 2 escalation pipeline, directing work assignments and ensuring timely, high‑quality resolution of incidents.
  • Translate complex technical solutions into clear knowledge articles and standard operating procedures (SOPs) for Tier 1 teams.
  • Provide clear, real‑time updates to client managers and stakeholders during high‑priority incidents, explaining technical problems in accessible business terms.
  • Coordinate high‑pressure triage efforts, manage client expectations, and maintain control of incident communication flows.
  • Document complex technical findings and resolutions for both technical and non‑technical audiences.

Required Qualifications

  • Must be a U.S. Citizen with ability to obtain a Public Trust clearance
  • Demonstrated experience in Tier 2 or advanced service desk support roles within enterprise environments.
  • Strong troubleshooting ability across platforms, databases, APIs, and system interface integrations.
  • Proficiency with SQL, Splunk, Dynatrace, and CloudWatch for log analysis, querying, and performance monitoring.
  • Proven experience performing root‑cause analysis and documenting long‑term resolutions or workarounds.
  • Ability to manage escalations, coordinate triage, and interface effectively with Tier 3 engineering teams.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, especially in translating technical issues into clear business‑level explanations.
  • Experience creating SOPs, knowledge articles, or other technical documentation for support teams.
  • Ability to perform effectively under pressure during high‑priority or time‑sensitive incidents.

Preferred Experience

  • Background supporting complex, multi‑system enterprise platforms or high‑reliability environments.
  • Experience analyzing database mismatches, API failures, system latency, or network‑related issues.
  • Familiarity with ITIL service management practices or similar operational frameworks.
  • Prior involvement in high‑severity incident communications or escalation leadership.
  • Experience bridging support and engineering teams, especially in environments with strict SLAs.
  • Demonstrated ability to optimize escalation workflows or improve Tier 1/Tier 2 knowledge bases.

title: Exhibits & Meetings Coordinator
description:
The American Veterinary Medical Association (AVMA), the national nonprofit association established in 1863 representing 111,000+ veterinarians working in private & corporate practice, government, industry, academia, & uniformed services, is seeking an Exhibits & Meetings Coordinator to join our Convention & Meeting Planning team, located at our Headquarters office in Schaumburg, Illinois – a northwest suburb of Chicago. AVMA’s mission is to lead the profession by advocating for its members & advancing the science & practice of veterinary medicine to improve animal & human health.

Reporting to the Assistant Director of Convention Sponsorship & Exhibits, the Exhibits & Meetings Coordinator provides support for exhibits & internal meeting management for the Convention & Meeting Planning Division. They will assist with exhibit management & support, logistics & scheduling for meetings held at AVMA offices, as well as onsite support during the AVMA Convention & Veterinary Leadership Conference (VLC). Up to 10% travel.

To be successful in this role you must be highly collaborative & passionate about AVMA’s mission. Additional qualifications include:
  • BS/BA Degree or equivalent experience.
  • Minimum of 5 years of related administrative or meeting planning experience, not-for-profit association experience preferred.
  • Must have excellent verbal & written communication skills & be capable of delivering clear messages through verbal, written, & listening skills.
  • Must be highly organized with strong attention to detail, as well as excellent project management, planning, & organizational skills.
  • Professional attitude & appearance.
  • Must be able to work as a proactive, collaborative member of the Division team to plan events
  • Must be analytical & a problem solver.
  • Must be proficient in Windows applications, spread sheets, databases & have aptitude to learn new programs.
  • Able to work independently with limited instruction & exercise sound judgment within defined parameters.
  • Must be able to travel on behalf of the association as needed.
  • Must be able to work outside of normal business hours as needed.

Deadline for application is 11/6/26. Submit cover letter, resume, & salary requirements to: apply@avma.org .

The AVMA offers a supportive & flexible hybrid work environment & excellent benefits including heath, dental, vision, life, AD&D, short-term disability, & long-term disability insurance; FSA & HSA plans; 401(k) Plan; generous vacation & sick time; 11 Paid Holidays; Floating Holiday, Paid Parental Leave, an Employee Assistance Program, tuition & professional certification reimbursement, Compensatory Time Off, casual dress, 37.5 hour workweek, Association Forum/ASAE membership, & veterinary pet insurance.

A reasonable estimate of the current base pay range for this position is $55,000 - $62,000. Compensation decisions take into account a wide range of factors, including but not limited to relevant experience, skills, certifications, geographic location, business needs, & organizational policies. In addition to these factors, we believe in the importance of pay equity & consider internal equity of our current team members as a part of any final offer.
About the AVMA:
Located in Schaumburg, Illinois, with an office in Washington, D.C., the AVMA is structured to work for its members, & acts as a collective voice for its membership & for the profession. The AVMA provides many benefits to its members, including information resources, state & federal advocacy, opportunities to address issues affecting policies that govern the profession & practice of veterinary medicine, continuing education opportunities, quality publications, & discounts on personal & professional products, programs & services. title: Quality Analyst II
description:
What does a Quality Analyst II do at Modea?

The Quality Analyst II at Modea is a consultant and investigative specialist responsible for evaluating the integrity and excellence of digital products for our healthcare clients. This individual acts as a bridge between complex technical requirements and the end-user experience, utilizing methodical exploration and deep analytical thinking to protect product quality.

We are looking for a resourceful problem solver who doesn't just check boxes but actively consults with clients and project teams to diagnose deep-seated defects and mitigate risk. You must possess a sharp investigative instinct for uncovering non-obvious problems and the professional discipline to maintain high standards through every development cycle. You are a student of the craft, constantly looking for ways to integrate modern tools like AI and automated frameworks to make our testing lifecycle smarter and more efficient.

Here are a few specific things we’d be looking for you to do:
Investigative Consulting & Strategy

  • Strategic Risk Analysis: Learn the product deeply to identify potential risks and consult with clients and teams on recommended actions and quality improvements.
  • Critical Issue Diagnosis: Use exploratory testing techniques and high-level analytical thinking to find and investigate bugs across multiple browsers and devices, focusing on the root cause rather than just the symptoms.
  • Quality Advocacy: Serve as the primary advocate for the end-user, verifying that functionality, design, and ADA accessibility are never compromised.
Technical Execution & Performance
  • Performance & API Integrity: Design and execute performance testing scripts using JMeter to verify stability under load, and conduct thorough API testing to validate data communication between services.
  • Security Fundamentals: Evaluate web applications against core security principles to identify vulnerabilities.
  • Automation & AI Integration: Create and maintain automated test suites using Mabl and Appium, while proactively leveraging AI-assisted tools to optimize the testing lifecycle.
Documentation & Delivery
  • Technical Communication: Author clear, reproducible bug reports and technical user guides that translate complex defects into actionable items for developers and stakeholders.
  • Process Leadership: Oversee the use of quality best practices throughout the SDLC, verifying that specifications are met across all platforms from discovery to post-launch.

Here is a list of skills and qualities that are critical to this role:

  • Analytical Depth: Strong critical thinking and test design skills used to navigate conflicting priorities and diagnose complex, underlying product issues.
  • Consulting Mindset: Ability to communicate technical testing concepts to a diverse range of stakeholders and influence product direction through data-backed quality insights.
  • Technical Versatility: Deep understanding of the languages of development and design, specifically as they relate to API structures, web security, and automated patterns.
  • Methodical Precision: A commitment to high standards and the ability to maintain a high level of focus in structured, technical environments without losing sight of the big picture.

Here is a list of minimum requirements for this role:

  • Experience: 2+ years of context-driven testing experience or equivalent education.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in IT, Management, Marketing, (or a related field) or equivalent experience

Additionally, here is a list of preferred skills and qualities:

  • Previous experience working within healthcare or for a consulting agency.
  • Experience with JMeter for performance benchmarking and familiarity with API testing tools like Postman.
  • Foundational knowledge of web security fundamentals, Web Accessibility Guidelines and experience building or maintaining automated test suites.
  • Hands on experience with modeling, test design, and working with mind maps.
  • Experience with Rapid Software Testing (RST), and using AI tools to enhance testing workflows.
If you believe you can be successful in this role but don't meet all the qualifications, please apply! Share with us the unique value you can add to this role.

Who is Modea?
We are a technology consultancy with a mission to infuse greater control, transparency, and choice into the consumer healthcare experience. To do this, we work with large healthcare providers to help them build out a digital roadmap, then design and build mobile, web, and other digital experiences. We fundamentally believe that this work helps consumers have better information and access to care, and our clients to build stronger customer relationships.

Here are a few ways to get to know our work in healthcare:

  • Learn about our award-winning EHR-integrated mobile app development for Children’s Wisconsin. This app delivers a fully integrated MyChart to allow parents to manage their children’s health in one place.
  • Discover Luminis Health’s website development that was built with a firm accessibility standard and patient-centric solutions.
  • If you’re interested in learning more, we encourage you to dive into some of our other work.

Here are a few other reasons why you should apply:
First, you’ll love the work we do and the people you’ll get to do it with. We’ve assembled an exceptionally smart and hardworking team and you’ll enjoy the work associations and general camaraderie with other “Modeans.” We also work with great clients who value our contributions and work side-by-side with us.

Second, Modea offers a great benefits package that provides both a fun and enjoyable workplace and great perks that will improve your quality of life:

  • Generous paid time off
  • Generous health, dental, and vision insurance
  • 401k with fully vested company matching
  • Long-term & short-term disability

Estimated Salary Range: $69,656 - $98,368. The posted range represents the employer’s good-faith estimate of the breadth of the compensation for this position at the time of posting, based on applicable factors. Actual starting compensation may vary based on factors including experience, qualifications, specific skills, internal equity considerations, and business needs.

Work environment:
We offer a modern office located in Blacksburg, VA. Our office provides an indoor space with moderate temperatures and noise levels. This allows employees to choose a fully-office, fully-remote, or hybrid work experience. Employees may occasionally need to travel to our offices or other locations for items such as training or client visits. We will also provide employees with tools to do their job at home as well as in the office.

Physical Demands:
Must be able to remain in a stationary position during the duration of the workday. Individuals must have the ability to constantly operate a computer. Must have the ability to converse with and exchange information with clients and coworkers both in person and through a computer. Capable of occasionally transporting items of 10 lbs or less to and from the office.

We aspire to be a highly inclusive employer - providing fair and appropriate opportunities to as many people from different backgrounds as possible, being welcoming, and meeting their needs as best as we can. We are committed to keeping great people representative of a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills, not just because it's the right thing to do, but because we believe it makes Modea stronger.

This is not a requirement, but if you need accommodations or assistance to perform as best as possible to apply for this role or have any questions, feel free to reach out to hr@modea.com.

You must be legally authorized to work in the United States for this position.

Modea participates in the E-Verify program.

Modea is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. Modea is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status.

title: Lead Physical Security Hardware Specialist
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

LEAD PHYSICAL SECURITY HARDWARE SPECIALIST

Help SpaceX protect life and property anywhere company assets are deployed by leading the Security Systems and Technology Organization. This role is responsible for the global physical security technology stack and hardware organization supporting all SpaceX sites and personnel worldwide; encompassing strategy, systems and hardware integration, architecture, implementation, and lifecycle operations of access control systems (ACS), closed-circuit television (CCTV)/video management systems (VMS), intrusion detection systems (IDS), and related platforms. The Security Systems and Technology Senior Manager will build, mentor, and direct a high-performing global team of specialists while driving enterprise-wide projects, organizational change, system reliability, and continuous improvement through cutting-edge technology.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Lead the Security Systems and Technology Organization, providing strategic direction and organizational leadership for the entire hardware and systems function
  • Lead, mentor, train, and develop the global Security Hardware Specialist organization, including performance management, career progression, and knowledge transfer
  • Develop and communicate the overall security systems and technology strategy, roadmap, and change management plans, aligning with SpaceX business objectives
  • Drive end-to-end systems and hardware integration of access control, video management, intrusion detection, analytics, and related platforms with IT infrastructure, network security, facilities, HR systems, and other enterprise tools to deliver unified, scalable, and resilient security capabilities company-wide
  • Serve as Principal Administrator and License Manager for enterprise platforms (Genetec Security Center, Lenel, Avigilon, and equivalents); provision and integrate new servers/systems; coordinate closely with IT, INFOSEC, and Purchasing
  • Demonstrate and apply strong knowledge of Genetec platforms for unified access control, video surveillance, analytics, intrusion management, and related functions; evaluate and implement advanced capabilities
  • Set and enforce enterprise standards for equipment selection, configuration, installation, training, certifications, and best practices; evaluate measures of effectiveness for new equipment types and technologies
  • Ensure on-schedule completion of complex, multi-site projects with minimal supervision; standardize equipment, pricing, processes, and best practices
  • Lead vendor/contractor management for design, installations, large-scale facility security infrastructure, and special projects
  • Collaborate as senior representative on SCIF development, data centers, MDFs, and other high-priority security technology initiatives; maintain TS/SCI eligibility
  • Oversee preventive maintenance programs, system health monitoring, troubleshooting protocols, inventory of hardware/tools/materials, and documentation of job status, changes, and project records
  • Drive process improvements, creative applications of existing and new systems to solve emerging or systemic problems, and continuous reliability enhancements
  • Maintain SOPs, Confluence pages, and JIRA tracking for enterprise projects
  • Own budget planning, resource allocation, headcount, and performance metrics for the global Security Systems and Technology Organization; report program effectiveness and strategic progress to senior leadership

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • High school diploma or equivalency certification
  • 5+ years of experience managing enterprise-level physical security systems such as CCTV, access control, VMS, intrusion detection systems, fire and alarm systems), or alert systems
  • 1+ years of direct leadership responsibility across global sites

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field (engineering, security management, information systems, or related) preferred
  • Strong expertise and certifications in Genetec Security Center, Lenel Access Control, and/or Avigilon systems; prior experience as principal system administrator or license manager for large-scale global deployments
  • Proven track record managing complex multi-site security technology projects, vendor portfolios, enterprise standardization, organizational change, and large-scale technology transformations at global scale
  • Experience with International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR)
  • Experience managing a portfolio of programs and projects, including owning enterprise programs in addition to site leadership responsibilities
  • Experience with JIRA (or similar tools) to track work, issues, and project status
  • 10+ years of progressive experience in physical security technology, systems engineering, or hardware in space exploration, aviation, military, or other high-reliability operating environments
  • Experience with SCIF design/support (ICD-705 / NISPOM), TS/SCI environments, and special programs
  • Established skills in strategic and critical thinking, decision-making, communications, and relationship-building
  • Highly organized, detail oriented, and possess a proven ability to thrive under pressure and to execute on a number of projects simultaneously
  • Successful experience working in a fast-paced, dynamic, results-oriented team environment

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Must be willing to work all shifts, extended hours, and/or weekends as needed
  • Willingness to travel as needed (up to 35% or more) to support global sites and projects
  • Must be able to obtain a TS/SCI clearance
  • An active clearance may provide the opportunity for you to work on sensitive SpaceX missions; if so, you will be subject to pre-employment drug and random drug and alcohol testing
  • Position is subject to random drug and alcohol testing

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

Pay Range:
$125,000.00 - $175,000.00

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks. You may also accrue 3 weeks of paid vacation and will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year. Employees accrue paid sick leave pursuant to Company policy which satisfies or exceeds the accrual, carryover, and use requirements of the law.

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

  • To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.

Applicants wishing to view a copy of SpaceX’s Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should reach out to EEOCompliance@spacex.com.

title: Propulsion Assembly Technician II/III - B Shift
description:
ABOUT ROCKET LAB

Rocket Lab is the end-to-end space company building rockets, spacecraft, and critical subsystems that keep the world connected, protected, expand humanity’s reach to the Moon, Mars, and beyond. We move fast, build real hardware for meaningful missions, and make the impossible routine. Come shape the future with us.

NEUTRON

Neutron is a medium lift launch vehicle capable of delivering the mega constellations of tomorrow, high assurance payloads, and human spaceflight. As a highly reusable launch platform, Neutron will deliver a highly cost-effective and reliable launch solution leveraging Rocket Lab’s proven execution history with the Electron program. If you’re interested in joining a high performing team, pushing the boundaries with a clean sheet development of re-usable liquid launch vehicle, this is your opportunity!

PROPULSION ASSEMBLY TECHNICIAN II/III - B SHIFT

Based out of Rocket Lab's Headquarters in Long Beach, CA the Propulsion Assembly Technician is responsible for building sub-assemblies for the Rutherford rocket engine. The engine consists of a thrust chamber, pumps, valves, plumbing, TVC actuators, motor controllers, and other mechanical components. You will support the Propulsion Production Manager and Production organization, with deliverables required for internal leadership, board of directors, and investors.

(Please note: this position can be hired at the Propulsion Assembly Technician II or Propulsion Assembly Technician III level)

WHAT YOU'LL GET TO DO:

  • Work on a high caliber cross functional team
  • Test rocket hardware
  • Build turbo pumps and rocket engines.
  • Watch the hardware you build make fire and go to space.

YOU'LL BRING THESE QUALIFICATIONS AS A PROPULSION ASSEMBLY TECHNICIAN II:

  • 2+ years of mechanical assembly experience in aviation, aerospace, or similar industry
  • Talented with mechanical assembly tools (i.e.: pressure testing equipment and welding preparation)
  • Talented with electrical assembly tools (i.e.: bench testing and measuring instruments)
  • High school diploma or GED.

YOU'LL BRING THESE QUALIFICATIONS AS A PROPULSION ASSEMBLY TECHNICIAN III:

  • 5+ years of mechanical assembly experience in aviation, aerospace, or similar industry
  • Talented with mechanical assembly tools (i.e.: pressure testing equipment and welding preparation)
  • Talented with electrical assembly tools (i.e.: bench testing and measuring instruments)
  • High school diploma or GED.

THESE QUALIFICATIONS WOULD BE NICE TO HAVE:

  • 8+ years of mechanical assembly and/or mechanical fitting experience
  • Experience performing; torquing, safety and/or lock wire installation, assembly per work instructions, and environment tests (proof and leak). .
  • A&P, trade, or industry certified.
  • Experience with in-space mechanical assemblies preferred.
  • Knowledgeable in manufacturing processes and continued product development.

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS

  • Willing to work Monday - Thursday (3:15pm - 1:45am)
  • Standing for long periods of time, climbing up and down ladders, bending, grasping, sitting, pulling, pushing, stooping, and stretching may be required to perform the functions of this position
  • Able to lift up to 25lbs. unassisted
  • Must be able to climb ladders and be comfortable working in tight spaces.
  • Must be able to move repetitively, bend or twist, and use hands to handle, control, or feel objects, tools or controls.
  • Must be able to walk or stand for extended periods – 8 hours min
  • Must be able to stoop, bend, crawl, and being able to maneuver in tight spaces

Level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one component of our total rewards package at Rocket Lab. Our comprehensive benefits package includes our industry-leading Employee Stock Purchase Program (with a 15% discount on company stock), top-tier medical plans (HMO, PPO, and a zero cost HDHP option with a significant HSA company contribution), dental and vision coverage, paid vacation and sick time, 11 paid holidays, flexible spending and dependent care accounts, paid parental leave, disability and life insurance, and a 401(k) retirement plan with company match.

Additional perks include subsidized EV charging, onsite fitness centers (where available), discounted gym memberships, complimentary snacks and beverages, 50% employee discount on our popular merch store, and a variety of other employee discounts.

Eligibility for benefits may vary based on employment status, please check with your recruiter for a comprehensive list of the benefits available for this role. Benefit programs are subject to change at the company’s discretion.

Hourly Pay Range (CA Only)
$25—$40 USD

WHAT TO EXPECT

We’re on a mission to unlock the potential of space to improve life on Earth, but that’s not an easy task. It takes hard work, determination, relentless innovation, teamwork, grit, and an unwavering commitment to achieving what others often deem impossible. Our people out-think, out-work, and out-pace. We pride ourselves on having each other’s backs, checking our egos at the door, and rolling up our sleeves on all tasks big and small. We thrive under pressure, work to tight deadlines, and our focus is always on how we can deliver, rather than dwelling on the challenges that stand in the way.

Important information:

description:

Sony Pictures Imageworks Canada Inc.

658 Homer Street., Suite 405, Vancouver, BC, V6B 2R4

title: Security and Loss Prevention Specialist, NA
description:
Worldwide Operations Security (WWOS) is the global organization that supports field Security and Loss Prevention and is designed to support Amazon’s Worldwide Operations, as well as affiliate and retail businesses.

The Security and Loss Prevention Specialist (SLP Specialist) is a key hourly position within Amazon Operations. The SLP Specialist leads the effort to efficiently and effectively protect people, product and data (lives, physical property, equipment, inventory, data, & intellectual property) in a designated building. The SLP Specialist reports to the Security and Loss Prevention Cluster Manager responsible for their geographical area, and aids them in supporting the operational team, and cross functional teams throughout the organization.

Key job responsibilities
* Conduct confidential investigations and prepare prompt written reports of theft, fraud, and critical incidents
* Contribute to the identification of vulnerabilities (e.g., loss, associate experience, process improvement, data protection, physical security infrastructure) and define appropriate mitigating actions while ensuring compliance with legal and ethical standards
* Serve as department liaison and security/crisis management subject matter expert for site leadership keeping them informed on key issues, strategies, and the department’s performance
* Develop strategies for alarm reduction and conduct system diagnostic for problematic devices by engaging and resolving issues with internal and external partners
* Domestic regional travel up to 25% of the time when applicable.
* Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach; Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts; Work in an environment where the noise level varies and can be loud; Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments); Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs).
* This role covers 24/7 operations and must be able to work all shifts, including nights, weekends, and holidays.

A day in the life
As a SLP Specialist, you will join a team of Security and Loss Prevention professionals providing security as a service to business customers across multiple business units within a dedicated geographical area. You will perform regular physical security audits and investigate policy violations, security-related incidents, and loss events. During your investigations, you collect information by monitoring systems and tools, analyzing data reports, and conducting interviews. Your findings help to identify vulnerabilities in our processes, and you contribute to developing mitigating measures to address them. You play a key role in maintaining the physical integrity of our fulfillment, logistics and retail operations locations by auditing and monitoring the health status of our systems with subject matter experts and external suppliers to maintain their functionality. You will interact on a daily basis with our external security service providers to ensure delivery of high-quality security services and a smooth customer experience. You also act as point of contact for multiple internal and external departments (e.g., legal, HR, security service providers, local law enforcement) and subject matter expert in Security and Loss Prevention-related matters. Finally, you deliver loss prevention-related education and awareness programs to other teams and liaise with various stakeholders on policy and procedure across all management levels.

About the team
Worldwide Operations Security (WWOS) is the global organization that supports field Loss Prevention and is designed to support Amazon’s Worldwide Operations, as well as affiliate and retail businesses, by creating and maintaining a work environment that is both prepared and secure through global security centers of excellence staffed by subject matter experts in people and asset protection. We accomplish this by creating policy and implementation guidelines; training leadership and staff; using technology to eliminate subjectivity, complexity, and variation; identifying, preparing for, and mitigating risk; and auditing our practices to ensure compliance.

description:
We are a growth stage company that creates software solutions combining lean principles, predictive and prescriptive analytics, and machine learning to transform hospital and infusion center operations. More than 190 health systems and over 1,200 hospitals and centers across 49 states rely on our award-winning products and expert change management services to increase patient access, decrease wait times, and reduce healthcare delivery costs. We have raised more than $300 million from top-tier investors such as Bain Capital, Insight Partners, and Goldman Sachs. We have been named among the top 100 AI companies in the world.

If your state is not listed, we may not be able to proceed with your application. We have offices in Santa Clara, CA and Charlotte, NC for employees who prefer to work regularly or occasionally from an office.

Join our Customer Onboarding team, where we partner with hospitals and health systems to implement technology that improves patient flow, optimizes capacity, and helps patients get the right care at the right time.

As a Senior Program Manager supporting Inpatient Flow, you will own healthcare technology implementations from pre-kickoff through go-live, serving as the primary driver of the project plan and day-to-day execution. You will bring together customer and LeanTaaS teams to manage the many interconnected pieces of a successful implementation—from discovery and technical readiness to workflow alignment, testing, training, go-live preparation, and launch.

You will build and manage detailed project plans, drive customer meetings and decisions, coordinate clinical and technical workstreams, manage risks and dependencies, and ensure teams remain aligned and accountable to their commitments. You’ll anticipate what could impact the implementation, create clear paths to resolution, and keep customers and internal stakeholders informed and moving forward.

Our implementations range from individual hospitals to complex, enterprise-wide deployments spanning multiple workflows, facilities, and stakeholder groups. You will partner closely with Clinical Workflow Implementation Managers, Product Implementation, Data Engineering, Customer Success and customer teams to bring structure and accountability to each engagement and ensure customers are prepared for a successful go-live.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Lead Customer Implementations
  • Own and lead a portfolio of complex Inpatient Flow implementations from kickoff through go-live and transition to Customer Success
  • Build, maintain, and execute detailed implementation plans, including milestones, deliverables, dependencies, resources, decisions, and timelines
  • Lead implementations that span multiple workflows in multiple hospitals across a health system
  • Run customer and internal implementation meetings, establish clear action items and owners, and drive accountability for commitments across customer and LeanTaaS teams
  • Coordinate discovery, technical implementation, workflow design, training, testing, readiness, and go-live activities across all implementation workstreams
  • Maintain implementation momentum by proactively following up on deliverables, resolving blockers, and ensuring decisions are made when needed
  • Drive high-quality implementations by ensuring consistent execution against established standards, proactively identifying gaps, and maintaining a high bar for customer experience and delivery excellence
  • Coordinate and participate in onsite meetings and activities
Manage Risk, Dependencies & Escalations
  • Continuously assess implementation health and proactively identify risks, dependencies, resource constraints, and decisions that could impact delivery
  • Develop and drive mitigation plans before risks become implementation delays or customer escalations
  • Identify and escalate issues requiring additional leadership, product, technical, or clinical support and ensure they remain actively managed through resolution
  • Manage changes to implementation scope and timelines, clearly communicating impacts and establishing alignment on the path forward
  • Maintain clear documentation of decisions, risks, action items, dependencies, and customer commitments throughout the implementation
  • Provide internal and customer stakeholders with clear, consistent visibility into implementation status, risks, accomplishments, and next steps
Drive Customer & Cross-Functional Alignment
  • Build strong working relationships with customer project leaders, executives, clinical leaders, operational stakeholders, and technical teams
  • Facilitate customer governance and implementation meetings that drive decisions, resolve open issues, and maintain alignment across stakeholders
  • Partner closely with Clinical Workflow Implementation Managers to incorporate workflow transformation, change management, training, and adoption activities into the overall implementation plan
  • Coordinate across Product Implementation, Data Engineering, Product, Customer Success, and other LeanTaaS teams to ensure workstreams and dependencies remain aligned
  • Navigate competing priorities and differing stakeholder perspectives while maintaining focus on implementation goals and customer outcomes
  • Ensure a thorough handoff to Customer Success at the completion of implementation, including outcomes, open items, commitments, risks, and opportunities for continued optimization

Contribute to Implementation Excellence

  • Identify opportunities to improve implementation processes, templates, tools, and documentation based on lessons learned from customer engagements

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

  • Experience leading health system-wide initiatives involving multiple hospitals, workstreams, stakeholder groups, or technology solutions
  • Strong project management fundamentals, including project planning, dependency management, risk mitigation, issue management, scope management, and stakeholder communication

title: Senior Offensive Security Engineer
description:
Who We Are

HP IQ is HP’s new AI innovation lab. Combining startup agility with HP’s global scale, we’re building intelligent technologies that redefine how the world works, creates, and collaborates.

We’re assembling a diverse, world-class team—engineers, designers, researchers, and product minds—focused on creating an intelligent ecosystem across HP’s portfolio. Together, we’re developing intuitive, adaptive solutions that spark creativity, boost productivity, and make collaboration seamless.

We create breakthrough solutions that make complex tasks feel effortless, teamwork more natural, and ideas more impactful—always with a human-centric mindset.

By embedding AI advancements into every HP product and service, we’re expanding what’s possible for individuals, organisations, and the future of work.

Join us as we reinvent work, so people everywhere can do their best work.

About The Role

As an Offensive Security Engineer within HP IQ’s Product Security team, you will partner closely with engineering teams to identify, validate, and mitigate security risks across the product lifecycle. You’ll influence design decisions, embed security into development workflows, and continuously assess attack surfaces to guide and enhance secure development.

What You Might Do

  • Lead penetration tests and security assessments for product and feature releases.
  • Conduct continuous security engagements, proactively identifying vulnerabilities and driving remediation to closure.
  • Advise engineering and product teams on remediation strategy, validating fixes and tracking measurable improvements to security posture over time.​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​
  • Assess attack surfaces across internet-facing services, APIs, and device interfaces (Wi-Fi, BLE, USB).
  • Perform threat modeling and security architecture reviews that directly shape product decisions.
  • Define and lead end-to-end risk reduction initiatives with internal and external stakeholders, aligning offensive findings to strategic security investments.​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​
  • Shape the offensive security roadmap, defining assessment scope, tooling, and methodology standards.

Essential Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience as an offensive security engineer or equivalent.
  • Experience threat modeling (e.g., STRIDE) and mapping adversary techniques (e.g., MITRE ATT&CK).
  • Expertise in identifying and exploiting common vulnerabilities (e.g., OWASP Top 10, SANS 25).
  • Hands-on experience testing embedded systems, firmware, and device software, including bootloader security, OS hardening, and low-level interface exploitation (e.g., JTAG, UART, SPI/I2C).
  • Demonstrated experience with hardware-assisted attack techniques such as fault injection, side-channel analysis, and glitching, using tools like ChipWhisperer, OpenOCD, Ghidra, Binwalk.
  • Proficiency in at least one modern language (Go, Python, Java, or TypeScript), applied to building offensive tooling, exploits, or automation.
  • Ability to communicate security findings, risk posture, and strategic recommendations to both engineering teams and executive stakeholders.

Preferred Skills

    • Experience securing AI products or edge-connected systems at scale.
    • Experience building or maturing an offensive security practice within a product-focused organization.
    • Experience validating technical controls to meet compliance standards such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, or PCI DSS.
    • Experience formalizing secure-by-design standards across diverse environments, including applications, cloud services, and device software, translating principles into enforceable controls and engineering patterns.​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​
    • Security research background with demonstrated findings, CVE disclosures, or public contributions to the offensive security community.
    • Track record of driving cross-functional security outcomes without direct authority, including aligning engineering and product roadmaps to offensive findings.​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​

Salary: $150,000- $240,000

title: Incoming Quality Control (IQC) Inspector - Mechanical
description:
ABOUT ROCKET LAB

Rocket Lab is the end-to-end space company building rockets, spacecraft, and critical subsystems that keep the world connected, protected, expand humanity’s reach to the Moon, Mars, and beyond. We move fast, build real hardware for meaningful missions, and make the impossible routine. Come shape the future with us.

NEUTRON

Neutron is a medium lift launch vehicle capable of delivering the mega constellations of tomorrow, high assurance payloads, and human spaceflight. As a highly reusable launch platform, Neutron will deliver a highly cost-effective and reliable launch solution leveraging Rocket Lab’s proven execution history with the Electron program. If you’re interested in joining a high performing team, pushing the boundaries with a clean sheet development of re-usable liquid launch vehicle, this is your opportunity!

ABOUT INCOMING QUALITY CONTROL INSPECTOR AT ROCKET LAB

As an Incoming Quality Control Inspector - Mechanical, you're the gate between our suppliers and our production floor. When hardware arrives, whether it's a machined manifold, a 3D-printed injector, or a batch of fasteners, you verify that it matches the drawing, the purchase order, and the paperwork before it goes anywhere near an engine or stage.

If it's right, you release it. If it's not, you quarantine it, write it up, and make sure it doesn't come back the same way twice

WHAT YOU’LL GET TO DO:

  • Inspect a wide range of hardware, including purchased parts, 3D-printed components, CNC-machined parts, and electro-mechanical assemblies, against drawings, specifications, and purchase order requirements.
  • Carry out precision inspections at every stage, from receiving through in-process to final assembly, using hand measuring tools and CMMs.
  • Document non-conformances clearly and accurately in our ERP, MES, and issue-tracking systems, following Rocket Lab procedures, so issues can be resolved quickly and traced to root cause.
  • Work with Engineering and management to improve work instructions and identify critical inspection points in the build process.
  • Coordinate with Production to prioritise inspection workload and help the team hit key delivery milestones without compromising quality.
  • Live a Built-In Quality mindset (Don't accept a defect. Don't pass a defect.) by catching non-conformances early and stopping them from reaching downstream teams or customers.

YOU'LL BRING THESE QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 2+ years in a quality assurance or inspection role in a mechanical manufacturing environment.
  • Hands-on experience with precision measuring instruments, such as calipers, micrometers, depth gauges, feeler gauges, pin gauges, thread gauges, surface roughness testers, and inspection microscopes.
  • Working knowledge of Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing (GD&T) and confidence reading and interpreting engineering drawings.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
  • A proactive, self-motivated approach, with strong attention to detail and a genuine willingness to learn.

THESE QUALIFICATIONS WOULD BE NICE TO HAVE:

  • Experience in a space manufacturing environment, particularly in-process inspection on engine builds.
  • Experience with advanced measuring equipment, such as optical comparators, Romer arms, and CMMs (Aberlink or PC-DMIS).
  • Visual inspection experience using borescopes on internal features and passages.
  • Inspection experience with aerospace components and assemblies.
  • Experience working with Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems.

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Shift: Able to work Monday to Thursday, 3:00 pm – 1:30 am.
  • Vision: Good close, distance, and peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to focus on fine detail for accurate visual and dimensional inspection.
  • Physical: Comfortable with seated bench work, fine hand and finger tasks, and regular computer use.
  • Mobility: Able to move between buildings on site.
  • Communication: Clear verbal and written communication skills.
  • Environment: Occasional exposure to dust, fumes, and moderate noise. PPE is provided.

If this sounds like you then apply now.

WHAT TO EXPECT

We’re on a mission to unlock the potential of space to improve life on Earth, but that’s not an easy task. It takes hard work, determination, relentless innovation, teamwork, grit, and an unwavering commitment to achieving what others often deem impossible. Our people out-think, out-work, and out-pace. We pride ourselves on having each other’s backs, checking our egos at the door, and rolling up our sleeves on all tasks big and small. We thrive under pressure, work to tight deadlines, and our focus is always on how we can deliver, rather than dwelling on the challenges that stand in the way.

title: Senior Avionics Hardware Development Engineer
description:
About Varda

Low Earth orbit is open for business. Varda is accelerating the development of commercial space infrastructure, from in-orbit pharmaceutical processing to reliable and economical reentry capsules. Varda’s W-Series vehicles are built, designed, and operated by Varda in-house, including the pharmaceutical processing payloads, the capsules, the C-PICA heat shields, and the satellite buses.

From life-saving pharmaceuticals to more powerful fiber optics, there is a world of products used on Earth today that can only be manufactured in space. Varda is accelerating innovation in the orbital economy by creating both the products and infrastructure needed so space can directly benefit life on Earth. Our mission is to expand the economic bounds of humankind.

Our team is uniquely suited to accomplishing this goal, with leadership and staff comprised of veterans from SpaceX, Blue Origin, major pharmaceutical companies and Silicon Valley. Varda was founded in January 2021 by Will Bruey and Delian Asparouhov with significant backing from world class investors including Khosla Ventures, Lux Capital, Founders Fund, Caffeinated Capital, General Catalyst, and Also Capital.

Varda is headquartered in El Segundo, California, where we have offices and a production facility where our vehicles, equipment, and materials are built, integrated, and tested. Varda also has offices in Washington, DC and Huntsville, AL.

Join Varda, and work to create a bustling in-space ecosystem.

About This Role

As a Senior Avionics Hardware Development Engineer at Varda, you will design and deliver flight-critical electrical hardware for our satellite bus, reentry vehicle, and customer payloads — owning your hardware domain from schematic capture through flight qualification. You will define subsystem requirements based on high level mission and company objectives, design to those requirements, and ensure the system as manufactured meets those requirements. In addition to designing and building electrical hardware, you will define its safe operating criteria and support our mission operations team on the risk tradeoffs of operating near the bounds of those criteria.

At Varda, we believe that the trip to space and back is the easiest trip our hardware takes. We stress our components above and beyond the levels it should expect to see in flight and investigate our failures thoroughly.

Responsibilities

  • PCB level electronics design at all lifecycle stages, from schematic capture, to layout, to design validation, fabrication/assembly, and manufacturing test.
  • Distilling high level company or mission objectives into requirements, designs, and developmental milestones for your subsystems.
  • Avionics subject matter expert for satellite, reentry vehicle, and payload hardware. Providing support to those using your products, namely the Varda GNC, pharmaceutical, mission operations, and integration teams.
  • Actively collaborate with cross functional teams such as flight software, thermal, GNC, and structures to determine across vehicle system impacts of design decisions.
  • Ownership of product acceptance and qualification testing for space environments (Thermal, Vibe, Shock, TVAC, and EMI) with support from the Avionics Test team.
  • Provide direction on system-level integration test plans to verify your hardware performs as expected at the vehicle level.
  • Perform root cause analysis on test failures and implement holistic mitigation strategies for flight risks.
  • Mentor junior engineers on their projects, challenges, and design methodologies setting a high bar for the future leaders of Varda.

Basic Qualifications

  • B.S. in Electrical or Computer Engineering or related engineering discipline.
  • 5+ years of direct experience in electronics hardware development.
  • Demonstrated experience designing and delivering flight-critical electrical hardware — schematic capture through environmental qualification — on programs where hardware physically flew or was qualified for flight.
  • Demonstrable knowledge of signal integrity, power and grounding board layout principles.
  • Strong hands-on lab experience with oscilloscopes, function generators, benchtop digital multimeters, and power supplies.
  • Experience programming in Python, MATLAB, or another scripting/data analysis language.
  • Demonstrated experience implementing the hardware layer of numerous on-board and over-harness communication protocols such as SPI, RS422, and 1000BASE-T.
  • Experience designing analog/digital filtering and mixed-signal circuits.
  • Power electronics design experience including load switches and switch mode DC:DC converters.

Preferred Skills & Experience

  • Industry leading electronic circuit design and analysis skills.
  • Strong supporting general knowledge in physics, math, and chemistry fundamentals for designing electronics that experience unique environments.
  • Understanding of aerospace sensor and actuator technologies including: RTDs, pressure transducers, brushless motors, solenoid valves, thermocouples, stepper motors, and rotary/linear Encoders.

title: Associate Director, Biostatistics
description:
The opportunity

As Associate Director, Biostatistics, you will be accountable for delivery, integrity and quality of Relay Tx’s clinical data analyses across the clinical studies. You will be an integrated member of the Relay Tx clinical development team, responsible for the in-house biostatistics expertise for the execution of clinical studies that will translate Relay’s innovative science into impactful medicines for patients. You will report to the Head of Biostatistics.

Your role

  • You will function as lead biostatistician for a clinical program and provide technical and business expertise in support of statistical activities.
  • You will oversee the day-to-day biostatistics activities, timelines and deliverables for in house biostatistics as well as outsourced services.
  • You will be an integral part of clinical study and program team and contribute to various activities from clinical protocol development to statistical analysis plan to clinical study reports.
  • You will apply statistical expertise to ensure optimal complex and innovative clinical trial designs, analysis methods and data displays.
  • You will ensure scientific integrity of the statistical methodology applied to clinical studies.
  • You will collaborate with other functional areas within the company (Clinical Operations, Clinical Research & Development, Clinical Pharmacology, Translational Medicine, Clinical Data Management, Pharmacovigilance, Regulatory and Project Management).
  • You will lead/support the planning and preparation of regulatory submissions- briefing books and integrated summary documents.
  • You will support the presentation and publication of clinical trial results and contribution to advances on statistical topics and presents at scientific conferences.
  • You will help develop department SOPs
  • You will work with the Head of Biostatistics on project budget/resource planning, re-forecasting, and program milestones, along with CPMs and Clinical Development Operations management

Your background

  • You should ideally have a PhD in statistics, biostatistics, or related scientific field.
  • You have 6+ years of experience in the pharmaceutical/biotechnology industry as a statistician. Oncology experience is highly preferred.
  • You have in-depth knowledge of methodologies applied in clinical trials with focus on registration and life-cycle management.
  • You have strong programming skill using SAS or R.
  • You have working knowledge of CDISC SDTM/ADaM models.
  • You have experience in CRO and vendor oversight.
  • You are a highly motivated self-starter who is capable of flourishing in a fast-paced small company environment.
  • You are a creative problem-solver with excellent communication.
  • You have strong interpersonal and organizational skills, with a high degree of attention to detail and ability to interact with cross-functional teams.
  • You are flexible to changing priorities, detail-oriented, and work well under pressure.
  • You can communicate statistical information to non-scientists and are willing to educate internal team on complex statistical concepts.

Estimated Salary Range: [$160,000 - $228,000].

The range provided above is based on what we believe to be a reasonable estimate for this job at the time of posting. Actual base salary will depend on a number of factors, including but not limited to, a candidate’s education, experience, skills and location.

#BP1

About Relay Therapeutics

Relay Therapeutics is a clinical-stage precision medicines company transforming the drug discovery process with the goal of bringing life-changing therapies to patients. Built on unparalleled insights into protein motion and how this dynamic behavior relates to protein function, we aim to effectively drug protein targets that have previously been intractable, with an initial focus on enhancing small molecule therapeutic discovery in targeted oncology. Our Dynamo platform integrates an array of leading-edge experimental and computational approaches to provide a differentiated understanding of protein structure and motion to drug these targets. We have built a world-class team of leading experts from each of these disciplines, and they are driven by a deep collaboration at every step of our drug discovery process.

Our team is equal parts fearless and relentless, with a shared passion for working collaboratively in intellectually stimulating environments. If you’re excited by the challenge of putting protein motion at the heart of drug discovery and passionate about making a difference in the lives of patients, join us!

title: Weekend Sign Installer - Marysville, WA

Directed is seeking an independent contractor to place and pick up temporary weekend signs in the Marysville, WA area in the community Lakewood Heights.

  • Pay is issued via direct deposit every two weeks
  • $20.00 Signing bonus
  • $100.00 bonus after 4 weeks of completed work

Requirements

  • Valid driver’s license and current auto insurance
  • 18+ years old
  • Reliable vehicle with enough space to transport 30+ signs
  • A smartphone (Android or iPhone), roughly four years old or newer, capable of running our mobile app
  • Ability to lift and place signs and work outdoors
  • Ability to hammer stakes 6–8 inches into the ground during the first weekend only

This is a 1099 independent contractor position. Contractors are not employees of Directed and are responsible for their own fuel, expenses, taxes and insurance.
