title: Senior Manager, Digital & Mixed-Signal Hardware
description:
Please Note: To conform with the United States Government Space Technology Export Regulations, the applicant must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., conditional resident, asylee or refugee (protected individuals as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3)), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.

At CesiumAstro, we are developers and pioneers of out-of-the-box communication systems for satellites, UAVs, launch vehicles, and other space and airborne platforms. We take pride in our dynamic and cross-functional work environment, which allows us to learn, develop, and engage across our organization. If you are looking for hands-on, interactive, and autonomous work, CesiumAstro is the place for you. We are actively seeking passionate, collaborative, energetic, and forward-thinking individuals to join our team.

CesiumAstro is seeking a Senior Engineering Manager, Digital & Mixed-Signal Hardware to lead a growing team developing high-performance electronics for our communications systems, including software-defined radios, space-computing platforms, and phased-array control systems. You will be accountable for the technical quality and on-time delivery of your team’s hardware, from architecture and design through production.

This is a deeply technical management role, but not an individual-contributor design role. You will stay close to the engineering through technical guidance, design and architecture reviews, mentorship, and critical debug, while building a team that consistently produces excellent work. You will also help establish the standards, tools, processes, and reusable engineering approaches that allow CesiumAstro’s hardware teams to execute rigorously and efficiently across sites.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

  • Your team delivers high-quality, manufacturable hardware to our product lines predictably and on schedule. Accountability does not stop when prototypes work.
  • Designs transition successfully into repeatable production at the required scale, with technical and manufacturing risks identified and addressed early.
  • Engineering quality improves as the organization grows. You stay close enough to the technical details to identify weaknesses, mentor engineers through them, and turn lessons learned into better standards, tools, reviews, and processes.
  • Teams benefit from shared engineering practices and technical knowledge across CesiumAstro. Engineers reuse proven components, designs, and approaches where appropriate, while common processes and standards enable rigorous engineering without unnecessary bureaucracy.
  • You build a stronger engineering organization, not just successful individual programs. Engineers grow in technical judgment and responsibility, strong technical and people leaders emerge, and the organization develops the capability and leadership structure needed to scale.
  • The initial team will include approximately 8-12 direct reports, primarily in Austin and Westminster, with a smaller presence in El Segundo. As CesiumAstro grows, people management is expected to become increasingly site-focused while this role continues to provide technical and process leadership across the company.

JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Maintain technical integrity and engineering excellence for board-level digital and mixed-signal electronics development across the company.
  • Establish, mature, and scale engineer-friendly digital hardware development processes, including high-speed interface design guidelines, signal integrity simulation workflows, and schematic and layout standards for dense, high-layer-count PCBs.
  • Provide detailed technical review and mentorship through architecture and design reviews, identifying design risks and errors early, helping engineers develop stronger engineering judgment, and ensuring appropriate subject matter expert (SME) engagement across digital, RF, power, firmware, and mechanical disciplines.
  • Occasionally contribute directly to board-level digital and mixed-signal designs, particularly to close temporary gaps in high-risk or schedule-critical programs.
  • Lead or support complex debug efforts involving high-speed interfaces, large FPGA and processor implementations, and related technical topics.
  • Ensure digital hardware designs are buildable and testable at scale using DFM and DFT best practices.
  • Drive disciplined handoff from engineering to manufacturing through close collaboration with manufacturing engineering, supply chain, and production test engineering.
  • Ensure designs meet quality, reliability, and scalability requirements for aerospace and defense production environments.
  • Partner with Supply Chain to ensure component availability, lifecycle risk mitigation, and cost awareness.
  • Drive design reuse, modular architectures, and platform commonality across products to accelerate execution and reduce risk.

TEAM LEADERSHIP, STAFFING & PERFORMANCE RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Build, scale, and lead a high-performing digital and mixed-signal hardware engineering team that delivers reliably to multidisciplinary product teams.
  • Lead, coach, and develop an initial team of approximately 8-12 engineers distributed primarily across Austin and Westminster, with a smaller presence in El Segundo.
  • Partner with product and program leadership to plan work, allocate resources, surface technical risk early, and hold the team accountable to realistic delivery commitments.
  • Own staffing and team development, including hiring, performance management, career development, coaching, and succession planning.
  • Provide one-on-one coaching, mentoring, and deep technical guidance.
  • Plan and manage budgets related to staffing, lab equipment, capital equipment, and design/simulation software.
  • Maintain strong working relationships across Engineering, Quality, and Operations.

JOB REQUIREMENTS AND MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Electrical Engineering or Computer Engineering required.
  • Minimum of 7 years of direct digital or mixed-signal hardware engineering experience, preferably in aerospace environments. 1–3 years of small-team technical leadership or engineering management experience preferred but not required.
  • Demonstrated expertise in high-speed digital and mixed-signal board design.
  • Strong understanding of signal integrity (SI) and timing.
  • Experience supporting design for manufacturability (DFM), design for test (DFT), and transition from development to production.
  • Proven ability to conduct rigorous technical reviews, mentor engineers, and communicate effectively across disciplines.
  • Ability to balance rigor with execution speed in a fast-paced development environment.
  • Proficiency with high-speed simulation and analysis tools such as Ansys SiWave or ADS SiPro.
  • Deep hands-on experience with schematic capture and PCB layout tools such as Altium.
  • Familiarity with FPGA toolchains (e.g. Xilinx Vivado) preferred.
  • Strong technical and non-technical communication skills.
CesiumAstro considers several factors when extending an offer, including but not limited to, the role and associated responsibilities, a candidate’s work experience, education/training, and key skills. Full-time employment offers include company stock options and a generous benefits package including health, dental, vision, HSA, FSA, life, disability and retirement plans.

title: FINANCIAL OFFICER I
description:
FINANCIAL OFFICER I

University of Alabama at Birmingham

The Financial Officer I will support the financial operations of the UAB Center for AIDS Research (CFAR), an interdisciplinary research center that promotes and facilitates HIV-related research across UAB and its partner institutions. This position will assist the CFAR fiscal team by providing daily fiscal services that include monitoring budgets and expenditures against sponsor and internal budgets, reconciling financial activity, and providing timely financial information to CFAR leadership, faculty and staff.

General Responsibilities

  • Serves as a key contributor to the financial integrity and operational stability of the assigned unit by applying established principles of accounting, financial analysis, and budget management.

  • Supports informed decision-making through consistent evaluation of financial activity, reliable reporting practices, and adherence to institutional policies.

  • Strengthens fiscal operations by maintaining effective financial systems, coordinating with university stakeholders, guiding departmental personnel, and ensuring alignment with broader organizational standards.

  • Contributes to the responsible use of financial resources and fosters continuity across financial, administrative, and vendor-related processes.

Key Duties & Responsibilities

  • May make decisions regarding the use of financial resources. Provides financial guidance to assigned staff and appropriate University personnel and coordinates integration with university accounting system.

  • Uses knowledge of fundamental concepts, practices and procedures specific to accounting, financial analysis and budgetary processes.

  • Manages assigned departmental accounts and provides ongoing financial analysis of departmental accounting functions.

  • Assures proper accounting for state, grant, contract and/or revenue accounts assigned.

  • Provides analysis of gross expenditures and makes recommendations for maintaining fiscal stability.

  • Assists in developing and administering budgets. Provides fiscal and budgetary services to an assigned unit.

  • May establish and maintain financial management databases and systems which conform to standard accounting practices.

  • Monitors adherence to financial policy and procedure. Develops and provides financial statements and reports to upper management on regular or requested basis.

  • May supervise departmental accounting operations and activities which could include approval and processing of disbursement and internal requisitions.

  • May prepare and/or supervise processing of departmental personnel action forms and as well as assume some payroll duties. Acts as liaison with appropriate University financial staff.

Preferred

  • Preferred degree fields include Business, Finance, Accounting, Program Management or another related field.

  • Related experience may include financial account management, budget monitoring, account reconciliation, financial reporting, grants or contracts administration, program management, or financial administration in a university, healthcare or research environment.

TM Camping Statement of Faith


The Statement Of Faith outlines the beliefs of TM Camping . All beliefs are listed and founded in God's Word, the Bible.


Preamble

TM Camping , in accordance with the historic Baptist tradition, hold to Believers Baptism by Immersion, Liberty of Conscience, the Separation of Church and state, and the Priesthood of the Believer. We also affirm the following distinctive which need emphasis at the present time:


I. THE AUTHORITY OF SCRIPTURE

The Bible is the inspired, authoritative and infallible Word of God and is our sole rule of faith and practice. It is the standard by which all human conduct and creeds should be tried.


II. THE TRINITY

There is only one true and living God who is manifested in three eternal and coequal person; Father, Son and Holy Spirit. God possesses holiness, omnipotence, omniscience, omnipresence, love, mercy, and all other perfections. All humankind owed to Him supreme faith and obedience.


III. HUMANKIND

Humankind has been created in the image of God but through Adam’s fall is now sinful, lost and condemned. By deliberate choice all participate in sin which is open rebellion to God’s law. Notwithstanding the fall, all human life through creation has value and dignity.


IV. JUSTIFICATION BY FAITH

Human beings can be forgiven of sin and justified solely through the redeeming work of Jesus Christ who died for sinners and rose again from the dead. Only by repentance from sin and faith in Jesus Christ the Lord can acceptance with God be attained.


V. REGENERATION

Regeneration is the work of the Holy Spirit by which the believer receives a new nature from God. Christian growth or sanctification is the continuation of the new life principle which begins in the new birth.


VI. THE CHURCH

The church in its widest sense includes all believers of all ages. The church is manifested visibly in the local body of baptized believers who covenant together to worship, observe the ordinances, and evangelize.


VII. HUMAN DESTINY

Jesus Christ will eventually return visibly at which time He will raise the dead and judge all people. Believers will enjoy an eternal state of blessedness in heaven while unbelievers will experience eternal separation from God in hell.


VIII. EVANGELISM AND SOCIAL CONCERN

The church has been called to preach the gospel so that individual people can receive salvation. Also the church is to become involved in the improvement of society by advocating biblical principles which militate against poverty, racism, violence, and all forms of injustice against humankind.


IX. HUMAN SEXUALITY

God’s design is that man and woman either be joined together in a perpetual monogamous relationship or live in a single state. Extra-marital sex, adultery and homosexuality are inconsistent with biblical teaching.


Faith History


At TM Camping we desire to have a distinctly Christian atmosphere and influence. Though campers and attendees come from many Christian and non-Christian backgrounds, all are included in chapel services, prayer, devotions, etc. Ministry team members participate in leading campers, attendees and other staff in these and other Christian activities. In addition, no matter where one works, all staff are expected to live exemplary Christian lives before campers and staff alike.

title: Senior Engineering Manager, RF Hardware
description:
Please Note: To conform with the United States Government Space Technology Export Regulations, the applicant must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., conditional resident, asylee or refugee (protected individuals as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3)), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.

At CesiumAstro, we are developers and pioneers of out-of-the-box communication systems for satellites, UAVs, launch vehicles, and other space and airborne platforms. We take pride in our dynamic and cross-functional work environment, which allows us to learn, develop, and engage across our organization. If you are looking for hands-on, interactive, and autonomous work, CesiumAstro is the place for you. We are actively seeking passionate, collaborative, energetic, and forward-thinking individuals to join our team.

CesiumAstro is seeking a Senior Engineering Manager, RF Hardware to lead a growing team developing high-performance electronics for our communications systems, including phased arrays, beamforming networks, RF front-ends, and software-defined radios. You will be accountable for the technical quality and on-time delivery of your team’s hardware, from architecture and design through production.

This is a deeply technical management role, but not an individual-contributor design role. You will stay close to the engineering through technical guidance, design and architecture reviews, mentorship, and critical debug, while building a team that consistently produces excellent work. You will also help establish the standards, tools, processes, and reusable engineering approaches that allow CesiumAstro’s hardware teams to execute rigorously and efficiently across sites.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

  • Your team delivers high-quality, manufacturable hardware to our product lines predictably and on schedule. Accountability does not stop when prototypes work: designs transition successfully into repeatable production at the required scale, with technical and manufacturing risks identified and addressed early.
  • Engineering quality improves as the organization grows. You stay close enough to the technical details to identify weaknesses, mentor engineers through them, and turn lessons learned into better standards, tools, reviews, and processes.
  • Teams benefit from shared engineering practices and technical knowledge across CesiumAstro. Engineers reuse proven components, designs, and approaches where appropriate, while common processes and standards enable rigorous engineering without unnecessary bureaucracy.
  • You build a stronger engineering organization, not just successful individual programs. Engineers grow in technical judgment and responsibility, strong technical and people leaders emerge, and the organization develops the capability and leadership structure needed to scale.
  • The initial team will include approximately 8-12 direct reports, primarily in Austin and Westminster, with a smaller presence in El Segundo. As CesiumAstro grows, people management is expected to become increasingly site-focused while this role continues to provide technical and process leadership across the company.

JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Maintain technical integrity and engineering excellence for board-level RF electronics development across the company.
  • Establish, mature, and scale engineer-friendly RF hardware development processes, including signal chain design and analysis, simulation, and schematic and layout standards for dense, high-layer-count PCBs.
  • Provide detailed technical review and mentorship through architecture and design reviews, identifying design risks and errors early, helping engineers develop stronger engineering judgment, and ensuring appropriate subject matter expert (SME) engagement across digital, RF, power, firmware, and mechanical disciplines.
  • Occasionally contribute directly to RF designs, particularly to close temporary gaps in high-risk or schedule-critical programs.
  • Lead or support complex debug efforts involving RF electronics and related technical topics.
  • Ensure RF hardware designs are buildable and testable at scale using DFM and DFT best practices.
  • Drive disciplined handoff from engineering to manufacturing through close collaboration with manufacturing engineering, supply chain, and production test engineering.
  • Ensure designs meet quality, reliability, and scalability requirements for aerospace and defense production environments.
  • Partner with Supply Chain to ensure component availability, lifecycle risk mitigation, and cost awareness.
  • Drive design reuse, modular architectures, and platform commonality across products to accelerate execution and reduce risk.

TEAM LEADERSHIP, STAFFING & PERFORMANCE RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Build, scale, and lead a high-performing RF hardware engineering team that delivers reliably to multidisciplinary product teams.
  • Lead, coach, and develop an initial team of approximately 8-12 engineers distributed primarily across Austin and Westminster, with a smaller presence in El Segundo.
  • Partner with product and program leadership to plan work, allocate resources, surface technical risk early, and hold the team accountable to realistic delivery commitments.
  • Own staffing and team development, including hiring, performance management, career development, coaching, and succession planning.
  • Provide one-on-one coaching, mentoring, and deep technical guidance.
  • Plan and manage budgets related to staffing, lab equipment, capital equipment, and design/simulation software.
  • Maintain strong working relationships across Engineering, Quality, and Operations.

JOB REQUIREMENTS AND MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Electrical Engineering required.
  • Minimum of 9 years of direct board-level RF hardware engineering experience, preferably in aerospace environments. 2–5 years of small-team technical leadership or engineering management experience preferred but not required.
  • Demonstrated deep expertise in RF board design, including strong working knowledge of the digital and power electronics required to make an RF board come alive.
  • Experience supporting design for manufacturability (DFM), design for test (DFT), and transition from development to production.
  • Proven ability to conduct rigorous technical reviews, mentor engineers, and communicate effectively across disciplines.
  • Ability to balance rigor with execution speed in a fast-paced development environment.
  • Proficiency with RF simulation and analysis tools such as Pathwave System Design (SystemVue) and RF Synthesis (Genesys) and HFSS.
  • Deep hands-on experience with schematic capture and PCB layout tools such as Altium.
  • Strong technical and non-technical communication skills.
CesiumAstro considers several factors when extending an offer, including but not limited to, the role and associated responsibilities, a candidate’s work experience, education/training, and key skills. Full-time employment offers include company stock options and a generous benefits package including health, dental, vision, HSA, FSA, life, disability and retirement plans.

  • Writing and managing labor schedules
  • EKOS (ERP) management and processing
  • Communicating the next day’s plan at the end of the day

  • Strong people management skills and experience
  • Related degree or professional qualification would be highly beneficial
  • A passion for the beer industry, including a strong knowledge of Reuben’s

  • Glass Backwards mentality – taking unique, solution-focused approaches to problems

title: Quality Control (QC)Inspector Steel Fabrication
description:
About the Role

We are seeking an experienced and hands-on Quality Control (QC) Inspector to oversee quality operations in the shop for our steel fabrication projects. This role ensures that fabricated components, welds, and assemblies meet all customer specifications, project drawings, and industry standards. You will work closely with the Shop Manager to identify issues, enforce quality requirements, and drive continuous improvement from fabrication through final installation.

Responsibilities:

Shop Responsibilities

  • Oversee daily quality checks on fabricated parts and assemblies.
  • Perform inspections on welds, layouts, dimensions, and finishes against shop drawings and specifications.
  • Verify welding procedures (WPS), welder qualifications, and compliance with AWS, AISC, and customer standards.
  • Conduct non-destructive testing (NDT), including Visual Testing (VT).
  • Review and maintain fabrication records, and project documentation.
  • Investigate nonconformities and recommend corrective actions to minimize rework.
  • Support customer and third-party inspections/audits in the shop.

Field Responsibilities

  • May require occasional jobsite inspections

Qualifications

  • 3–5+ years of quality control experience in steel fabrication or structural steel.
  • Strong knowledge of welding processes (SMAW, GMAW, FCAW) and fabrication/erection practices.
  • Familiarity with AWS D1.1, AISC, and ISO 9001 standards.
  • Ability to read and interpret blueprints, shop drawings, erection drawings, and weld symbols.
  • Strong communication and leadership skills with the ability to coach and collaborate with shop and field crews.
  • Experience with project management and construction software (e.g., Bluebeam, Procore, Autodesk).

Preferred

  • Certified Welding Inspector (CWI) or equivalent.
  • NDT certifications.
  • Field erection and installation experience.
  • Lean/continuous improvement experience in fabrication and field operations.

Benefits

Competitive pay, health, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) with company match, and paid time off.

title: Client Advocate
description:
Every day, people across Albuquerque face impossible choices between health, housing, safety, and survival. For more than four decades, Albuquerque Health Care for the Homeless has stood alongside our community’s most vulnerable neighbors, providing compassionate care, creating pathways to stability, and championing systemic change. More than 5,000 people each year find support through our integrated model of care, but our impact extends far beyond the walls of our clinic. Through advocacy, partnership, and innovation, we are working to transform the systems that drive homelessness and build a community where everyone has the opportunity to live with dignity, health, and hope.


Step into a purpose-driven role where empathy meets action: we are hiring an energetic, compassionate Client Advocate to bring warmth, dignity, and real-time solutions to our Resource Center! Working alongside the Resource Center Coordinator, you will be the front-line champion our clients count on meeting immediate needs, navigating complex social service networks, and unlocking vital community resources that rebuild lives. From greeting individuals with radical hospitality on campus to jumping in on dynamic outreach efforts across the city, no two days are ever the same. If you are a natural connector with a big heart, sharp problem-solving skills, and a passion for empowering others, bring your vibrant energy to our team and make an indelible mark on our community; apply today!


This is a full-time, non-exempt position.


Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Performs daily tasks to maintain space, equipment, supplies, and resources in the Resource Center.
  • Maintains a warm and welcoming environment for clients and representatives from other community resources.
  • Provides administrative and clerical support for Resource Center, including answering phones, maintaining files, organizing and stocking supplies, monitoring client usage of phones, computers, and showers.
  • Identifies social needs, make referrals and provide assistance to assist in access to appropriate social services, resources, benefits, and support networks.
  • Assists clients in applications for housing, motel vouchers, public benefits (Medicaid and SNAP) and State ID/Birth Certificates.
  • Completes required documentation and data entry tasks.
  • Participates in agency outreaches as needed.
  • Complies with organization policies and procedures.


Minimum Qualifications:

  • High school diploma or equivalent
  • Relevant work or volunteer experience in social services or direct customer service
  • Valid drivers license with a clean driving record


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Associate Degree in Human Services or related field
  • Experience working with underserved populations, experience working with persons experiencing behavioral health issues or lived experience of behavioral health recovery.
  • Knowledge of Social Service resources in Albuquerque.
  • Bi-lingual Spanish/English



All benefits start the month after you begin work:


  • Low cost medical, vision, and dental insurance with health club membership
  • Life insurance and Accidental Death and Dismemberment fully paid for by organization
  • Long Term Disability fully paid for by organization
  • Paid Time Off - 24 days in first year of employment
  • Catastrophic Sick Time accrual
  • 7 Paid holidays
  • Health Care and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts
  • 401k with employer match
  • Student loan forgiveness eligible

We're an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.



This organization participates in E-Verify.

title: Sanitation
description:
COMPANY INTRODUCTION

Manzana Products Co. has been in business for over 100 years and is a leading producer of organic apple juice, apple sauce, and apple cider vinegar. Manzana is owned by Agrial, a prominent French co-op of 12,000 farmer members and a force in agriculture and food production.

Manzana’s mission is to create quality apple products by placing the highest value on people, suppliers, customers, and continuous improvement in manufacturing capabilities, with social and environmental responsibility at the heart of our actions.

We are in the process of relocating our manufacturing facility from Sebastopol, CA to Sunnyside, WA. While the facility is essential, we believe that building a strong, dedicated team is the key to success. At Manzana, we work each day to foster a culture focused on food safety, employee health and safety, customer service, continuous improvement, and an inclusive, respectful environment where all team members’ contributions are valued, and feedback is encouraged.

At Manzana, all employees are required to actively participate in our comprehensive Food Safety Program to ensure the consistent production of the highest quality and safest food products. This commitment is essential to maintaining our standards and protecting our customers.

Join us as we grow and make a difference together

Job Summary:

The Sanitation Specialist is responsible for cleaning and sanitizing production areas, equipment, floors, and other facility surfaces to maintain a safe and sanitary food-processing environment. The position plays an important role in preventing contamination and supporting compliance with food-safety requirements.

This is a 3rd shift position with the start time of 5pm

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Manzana Food Products charges all employees with the responsibility to fully participate in all company policy and program initiatives for Food Legality, Food Safety, Food Quality and Food Defense; each employee, no matter their position or job function serves a key role in contributing to safe, quality food.
  • Learn and understand the daily cleaning procedure forms; properly fill out and sign off on these forms on a daily basisdaily.
  • Learn the time frames given for each job and utilize the time efficiently to assure that the job is done correctly and on time.
  • Use personal protective equipment as required for each cleaning task performed.
  • Return all cleaning tools, equipment, chemicals, etc. to the sanitation room after job duties have been completed.
  • Understands correct labeling of chemicals and containers. Understand the use of, and safely use, cleaning chemicals. Aspects which include safety, measurements and applications of the chemical.
  • Be able to follow SSOP's.
  • Clean and sanitize processing equipment, conveyors, floors, walls, drains, and production areas.
  • Follow established sanitation procedures, schedules, and chemical-use instructions.
  • Disassemble and reassemble equipment for sanitation as trained.
  • Properly use cleaning tools, equipment, chemicals, and PPE.
  • Inspect cleaned areas and equipment to ensure sanitation standards are met.
  • Identify and report sanitation, equipment, or food-safety concerns.
  • Maintain accurate sanitation records and checklists.
  • Follow OSHA, food-safety, GMP, HACCP, and company sanitation requirements as applicable.
  • Maintain a clean and organized sanitation area.
  • Work closely with production and quality personnel.
  • Perform additional sanitation duties as directed by the Sanitation Process Supervisor.

Qualifications:

  • Previous sanitation, food-processing, or agricultural-processing experience preferred.
  • Knowledge of food-processing sanitation practices is a plus.
  • Ability to safely handle approved cleaning chemicals after proper training.
  • Ability to read and follow sanitation procedures and chemical labels.
  • Ability to lift, push, pull, bend, kneel, and stand for extended periods.
  • Dependable attendance and ability to work assigned shifts.
  • Must be 18 years or older to apply

Skills:

· Ability to read, write and speak English at a basic level

· Basic computer skills

Working Conditions

· This position is performed in a food-processing/production environment and may involve exposure to moving equipment, conveyors, high-pressure water, noise, wet surfaces, varying temperatures, and agricultural materials. Employees must follow all required safety, sanitation, and PPE requirements. Proper PPE and safety procedures are required at all times. The employee must be able to safely perform the physical requirements of the position, including standing, walking, bending, kneeling, reaching, pushing, pulling, and lifting as required for assigned duties.

· This position regularly works 8- to 10-hour shifts, Monday through Friday, with occasional Saturday work based on production and business needs consistent with applicable laws and company policies.

Required PPE may vary by work area and assigned task. Employees must wear all PPE required by company policy, hazard assessments, food-safety requirements, and posted area-specific requirements.

PPE may include:

· Hairnet

· Beard net

· Safety glasses or approved eye protection.

· Chemical-resistant gloves appropriate for the chemical and task.

· Chemical/water-resistant protective clothing.

· Safety boots with appropriate slip-resistant soles.

· Hearing protection in designated areas.

· Gloves or other task-specific PPE when required.

· Additional PPE identified through the applicable safety assessment, SDS, sanitation procedure, or posted area requirements.

· Employees are responsible for properly wearing, maintaining, and using required PPE at all times.

To protect food safety and prevent contamination, employees entering production areas must comply with all personal hygiene and GMP requirements.

The following are not permitted in production areas:

· Glitter, sparkles, or loose decorative materials.

· False eyelashes or eyelash extensions that present a contamination risk.

· False, artificial, or acrylic nails.

· Nail polish or other nail coatings.

· Jewelry, including rings, bracelets, watches, necklaces, earrings, piercings, or other loose accessories, except as specifically permitted by company policy.

· Items or clothing containing loose, fraying, dangling, or shedding materials that could present a contamination risk.

· Loose personal items that could fall into or contaminate product.

· Any other personal item, accessory, cosmetic, or material prohibited by company GMP and food-safety policies.

Employees must follow all posted hygiene, handwashing, personal protective equipment, and food-safety requirements when entering or working in production areas.

Employment is contingent upon successfully completing applicable pre-employment screening requirements, which may include:

· Background check.

· Drug screening.

· DMV check and satisfactory driving record for positions that require driving or where driving-related qualifications are required.

· For forklift operation, successful completion of required forklift training and evaluation and compliance with all company requirements for authorized forklift operators.

Manzana Products Co. is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities to enable them to perform the essential functions of their position. Applicants and employees who require a reasonable accommodation during the application process or to perform the essential functions of the job are encouraged to contact Human Resources.

Manzana Products Co. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees and maintaining a workplace that is inclusive, respectful, and free from unlawful discrimination and harassment. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, experience, business needs, and other legitimate job-related factors in accordance with applicable law.

title: Water Treatment Specialist
description:
JOB OPENING

CITY OF FARMINGTON

JOB POSITION #174: Water Treatment Specialist

NUMBER OF VACANCIES: 1

DEPARTMENT: Electric Utility / Generation

WORK LOCATION: Bluffview Power Plant

SALARY RANGE: $48.4942 / Hour

PAY GRADE: 625

TYPE OF POSITION: Regular / Full-Time

DAYS WORKED: Monday - Friday

HOURS WORKED: 6:30 a.m. - 4:00 p.m.

APPLICATIONS WILL BE RECEIVED THROUGH: October 23, 2026

JOB DUTIES

ESSENTIAL DUTIES:

Works under the supervision of the Generation Superintendent.

Maintains the water treatment program for the generation facilities by inspecting water/steam systems daily and identifying and solving problems relative to the treatment of water including discharges.

Adjusts and calibrates electronic equipment used to monitor steam systems and cooling tower systems.

Collects and analyzes water samples to determine treatment needs. Analysis includes, but is not limited to, determination of hardness, dissolved solids, conductivity, pH, and residual amounts of control chemicals in water systems.

Calibrates and sets metering pumps to dispense amounts of chemicals to maintain the prescribed amounts of chemical residuals in water/steam systems.

Orders and receives various types of chemicals for the treatment of water at the generation facilities by consulting with various chemical vendors and purchasing the proper quantity and quality of chemicals needed to maintain the water treatment programs.

Performs a variety of on-the-spot maintenance and repair tasks to assure the continuous and proper operation of the water treatment equipment and informs facility repair personnel of more complicated and extensive repair requirements.

Develops procedures and techniques whereby the water treatment standard programs of the gas-fired generation facilities may be implemented and improved to ensure that the proper chemicals and chemical balances are maintained throughout the water/steam systems.

Compiles, prepares, and submits various reports to water treatment contractors and/or consultants describing the results of various self-performed tests obtained at regularly scheduled times.

Maintains and properly regenerates water softeners, demineralizers, reverse osmosis units, and other associated water treatment equipment.

Ensures the gas-fired generation facilities have an effective water treatment program to prevent deterioration of boilers, turbines, and related equipment.

Ensures that the water treatment equipment is maintained and in good working order to insure proper operation of the water treatment programs at the gas-fired generation facilities.

Performs testing as required by municipal, state, and federal agencies and documents results of NPDES and storm water discharges.

Required to perform occasional shift work as a Relief Operator in a rotation of days, evenings, and nights including weekends and holidays.

NON-ESSENTIAL DUTIES:

May serve on various employee committees, as required and assigned.

The duties listed above are intended only as illustrations of the various types of work that may be performed. The omission of specific statements of duties does not exclude them from the position if the work is similar, related or a logical assignment to the position.

QUALIFICATIONS

A pre-employment physical and drug/alcohol test is required for this position.

This position is subject to the City's Drug and Alcohol Free Workplace Program. This includes: pre-employment testing, post-accident testing, reasonable suspicion testing, return-to-duty testing, and follow-up testing.

Valid New Mexico driver's license with acceptable driving record for the past three years.

Extensive background checks required.

Must possess a two year Associates Degree from an accredited Industrial Water Treatment Program or equivalent In-Plant training with three years experience as an operator of an industrial water treatment program. Other education and/or experience may be considered.

Must possess a thorough knowledge of electronic and pneumatic systems associated with industrial water treatment.

Must be capable of determining the proper action to be taken with various pieces of equipment in cooling towers, steam generation equipment, and gas turbine generation equipment.

Must posses a working knowledge of spreadsheets/word processing computer skills.

Must have a thorough knowledge of the proper chemicals needed to maintain the gas-fired generating facilities water treatment programs.

Must possess good oral and written communication skills.

Must have a telephone and be able to be at the generation facilities within thirty minutes after receiving a call.

Must possess the ability to establish and maintain working relationships with co-workers, supervisors, other City personnel and the public.

Must possess the ability to follow verbal and/or written instructions.

Must possess the ability to work under stress and handle stressful situations.

Must possess the ability to meet deadlines.

Must possess the ability to operate tools and equipment listed.

TOOLS AND EQUIPMENT USED:

Calculator, phone, radio, fax and copy machine, computer (desk top and lap top), motor vehicles, water treatment testing equipment, laboratory equipment and various hand tools.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS:

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of the job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

The employee is required to perform occasional shift work as a Relief Operator in a rotation of days and nights including weekends and holidays.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently required to stand; walk; use hand to finger, handle, feel or operate objects, tools or controls, and reach with hands and arms. The employee is frequently required to sit, climb ladders and stairs, balance, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, talk or hear; employee is occasionally required to smell.

The employee must frequently lift and/or move up to 50 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 100 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.

WORK ENVIRONMENT:

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Work is performed inside/outside in all types of weather conditions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee occasionally works near moving mechanical parts and in outside weather conditions. The employee is occasionally exposed to wet and/or humid conditions and lightning.

The noise level in the work environment is moderate to extreme.

WE ARE AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER, M/F/D/V.

title: Backend Software Engineer II- Data Platform
description:
ABOUT US

At Vida, we help people get better- and we're helping the healthcare system get better, too.

Vida is a virtual, personalized obesity care provider that uses evidence-based treatment to help patients manage obesity and related conditions like diabetes, high blood pressure, anxiety and depression. Vida's team of Obesity Medicine-Certified Physicians, Registered Dietitians, Expert Coaches and Licensed Therapists takes a whole-person approach to care, helping people lose weight, reduce stress and improve their overall health.

By combining advanced technology with top-notch healthcare providers, Vida is breaking down the barriers that have historically kept people from getting the best care. It's trusted by Fortune 100 companies, major national payers and large providers to enable their employees to live their healthiest lives.

Vida is looking for a Backend Software Engineer II to help build the data platform that supports much of Vida's business. Our team builds the systems that turn data from health plans, employers, and other partners into reliable information that Vida's products and operations can use. That includes member identity, eligibility, billing, partner integrations, and the data foundations behind reporting and analytics. You will work on backend services and data-intensive systems, primarily in Python, and take features from design through production. You will start with well-defined problems and grow toward owning services and technical decisions independently.

Responsibilities:

  • Build backend services that ingest, validate, reconcile, and serve data from external partners.
  • Develop systems for member identity, eligibility, billing, and other core business domains.
  • Design APIs, asynchronous workflows, and data pipelines used across Vida.
  • Make systems resilient to incomplete, duplicated, delayed, and inconsistent real-world data.
  • Build safe ways to retry, replay, and recover data when something goes wrong.
  • Improve the reliability, observability, testing, and performance of production systems.
  • Work with Engineering, Product, and Operations to figure out what needs to be built when the requirements are incomplete or messy.
  • Additional responsibilities as needed.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree at a minimum.
  • 2+ years of professional experience building backend software.
  • Strong programming fundamentals- we primarily use Python.
  • Experience working with relational databases and SQL.
  • Experience building systems that process, transform, or move significant amounts of data.
  • A solid understanding of testing, debugging, APIs, and common distributed-system failure modes.
  • Experience deploying or operating software in a cloud environment.
  • Good instincts around correctness, including validation, idempotency, retries, and edge cases.
  • The ability to get into an unfamiliar codebase, understand how it works, and improve it without making it more complicated.
  • Clear written communication and an ability to explain technical decisions and tradeoffs.
  • You do not need previous healthcare experience or experience with every technology we use.

Preferred:

  • Data-intensive backend systems, ETL/ELT pipelines, or event-driven architectures.
  • PostgreSQL, analytical warehouses, or data modeling.
  • Infrastructure as code, containers, or workflow orchestration.
  • Identity resolution, entity matching, eligibility, claims, or other healthcare data.
  • Regulated or security-sensitive production environments.

title: Senior HRIS Analyst (Workday)
description:
About EarnIn

As one of the first pioneers of earned wage access, our passion at EarnIn is building products that deliver real-time financial flexibility for those with the unique needs of living paycheck to paycheck. Our community members access their earnings as they earn them, with options to spend, save, and grow their money without mandatory fees, interest rates, or credit checks.

We’re fortunate to have an incredibly experienced leadership team, combined with world-class funding partners like A16Z, Matrix Partners, DST, Ribbit Capital, and a very healthy core business with a tremendous runway. We’re growing fast and are excited to continue bringing world-class talent onboard to help shape the next chapter of our growth journey.

POSITION SUMMARY

We are seeking a Senior HRIS Analyst to own and evolve our Workday platform, primarily focused on Core HCM and Security. This role designs, configures, and optimizes scalable people systems that enable business growth and operational efficiency. You will act as a strategic partner to People, Finance, and IT teams—translating business needs into system solutions while ensuring data integrity, security, and streamlined processes across the employee lifecycle. We are in the midst of an exciting Intelligent Work Systems transformation, evolving from manual operations to designing AI-enabled, cross-system workflows that scale across the enterprise. We’re looking for someone with a strong Workday foundation and an inventor mindset to help build what’s next.

This is a remote position, though it could also be a hybrid role from our Mexico City office as part of our expanding site. EarnIn offers excellent benefits, including healthcare, internet and cell phone reimbursement, a learning and development stipend, and potential opportunities to travel to our Mountain View headquarters. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. We are unable to provide visa sponsorship or immigration support for this position.

POSITION SUMMARY

We are seeking a Senior HRIS Analyst to own and evolve our Workday platform. This role primarily focuses on payroll administration, and payroll administration experience is required. You'll also bring strong Core HCM expertise and support other Workday functional areas, including Time and Absence and Advanced Compensation. This role designs, configures, and optimizes scalable payroll and people systems that enable business growth and operational efficiency. You will act as a strategic partner to People, Finance, Total Rewards, and Payroll teams—translating business needs into system solutions while ensuring payroll accuracy, data integrity, and streamlined processes across the employee lifecycle.

We are in the midst of an exciting Intelligent Work Systems transformation, evolving from manual operations to designing AI-enabled, cross-system workflows that scale across the enterprise. We’re looking for someone with a strong Workday payroll foundation and an inventor mindset to help build what’s next.

The Mountain View base salary range for this full-time position is $184,000-$226,000, plus equity and benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. If based in or near Mountain View, CA, the role requires in-office work 2 days a week, though we are open to remote candidates in PT or CT time zones.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Payroll & Workday Configuration Ownership

  • Administer Workday Payroll configuration end-to-end, including pay groups, earnings, deductions, and payroll-impacting business processes
  • Serve as the primary systems point of contact for Payroll Operations, ensuring accurate, on-time pay processing
  • Own configuration and ongoing optimization of Workday Payroll and also other areas in Core HCM, including security frameworks as assigned
  • Support configuration and troubleshooting across other Workday functional areas, including Time and Absence
  • Design and maintain business processes, workflows, and system controls across the employee lifecycle
  • Lead system enhancements, releases, and feature adoption in areas assigned

System Strategy & Optimization

  • Ensure Workday is not operated in isolation but as part of a broader enterprise ecosystem; design solutions that support end-to-end business processes across systems, including access governance, compliance, and cross-functional workflow orchestration
  • Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, and automate People processes through Workday and integrated systems
  • Drive scalable solutions that reduce manual effort and improve data accuracy
  • Contribute to the Workday roadmap by defining and prioritizing enhancements based on business impact, scalability, and system health
  • Establish and maintain system governance and best practices
  • Partner with People Operations and external Workday support to manage escalations, prioritize issues, and drive systemic resolution of recurring problems
  • Ensure data consistency and integrity across Workday and downstream financial systems, including reconciliation of headcount, compensation, and organizational structures used in financial reporting and planning.
  • Develop and maintain system documentation (business processes, decision logic, architecture diagrams); leverage AI tools to accelerate documentation, identify logic gaps, and propose enhancements
  • Troubleshoot system issues, root-cause errors, and implement scalable fixes

Reporting & Insights

  • Build and maintain advanced Workday reports, dashboards, and calculated fields
  • Partner with stakeholders to deliver actionable insights across People and Finance
  • Ensure consistency and integrity of workforce data

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Partner with People Ops, Accounting, Payroll, Total Rewards, Finance, and IT to translate business requirements into system solutions
  • Act as a subject matter expert on Workday capabilities and limitations
  • Act as a key partner to Finance in supporting workforce planning, budgeting, and actuals reporting by ensuring accurate and timely workforce data
  • Support testing strategy (UAT) and ensure high-quality system deployments
  • Leverage AI and structured methodologies to define test strategies, generate test cases, support design reviews, and proactively identify logic gaps or architectural improvements prior to deployment

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • 3+ years of hands-on Workday Payroll configuration and administration experience, required
  • 5+ years of HRIS experience with deep Workday expertise
  • Strong configuration experience in Workday Payroll and Core HCM
  • Experience with Workday configuration including Business Process Framework, Security, and Advanced Reporting (Calculated Fields)
  • Experience partnering cross-functionally with stakeholders in People, Accounting, Payroll, Finance, and IT
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Experience creating structured documentation and leveraging AI tools to enhance system design, testing, and analysis
  • Advanced analytical and technical skills for translating and analyzing business needs into requirements, driving implementations, and delivering effective, value-adding solutions
  • Exceptional technical aptitude and strong desire for learning new technologies and solution architectures
  • Experience with Workday’s tools below is a plus:
    • Advanced Compensation
    • Time and Absence
    • Talent/Performance modules
    • Workday Extend
  • Experience in global and matrixed organizations is a plus
  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Information Systems, or equivalent is a plus
  • Experience designing workflows across different areas in the employment lifecycle (recruiting, onboarding, career development, off-boarding) is a plus

title: Consumer & Sports Fellowship (Spring 2027)
description:
ABOUT ORCHESTRA

Orchestra is a strategic communications and marketing company built for today’s complex and fragmented world. From decoding audiences to designing bold strategies, Orchestra integrates people, platforms, and stories that stick to help clients build lasting influence. The company offers programs that span from the highest level strategic business counsel through to tactical execution. Orchestra brings together 700+ people with experience across consumer and lifestyle, technology, nonprofit and philanthropy, real estate, sports, travel, hospitality, and more. Made up of leading firms BerlinRosen, Civitas Public Affairs Group, Derris, Glen Echo Group, Inkhouse, M18, Message Lab, Onward, and Small Girls PR, Orchestra also launched Brightmode, a talent acquisition firm for communications professionals, and Versus Media Group, a strategy-first political media team. Learn more at .

People of all backgrounds and abilities are strongly encouraged to apply. Orchestra is committed to building and maintaining a diverse staff, and recognizes that its continued success depends on hiring and retaining high-quality creative professionals with a variety of backgrounds and experiences. Opportunities for advancement exist, and we are committed to helping all staff develop and grow.

ABOUT THIS ROLE

Orchestra is seeking highly motivated individuals to join our Spring 2027 Fellowship Program. This is a hands-on opportunity for college graduates that provides meaningful experience across strategic communications, public affairs, media engagement, brand storytelling, and business operations.

Fellows are embedded within a specific practice area and contribute to active client work and business initiatives while gaining exposure to how integrated communications strategies are developed and executed.

Duration: January 13, 2027 - July 2, 2027
Location: Hybrid based in New York, NY. Minimum 3 days per week in-office
Compensation: $24/hour

This program offers the potential for permanent, full-time employment. While full-time opportunities may become available, they are not guaranteed and are contingent upon individual performance and the company's hiring needs at the time.

COMMUNICATIONS TRACKS

Applicants should apply to and will be considered for one primary practice area based on their background, interests, and prior experience. Candidates should select the area that best aligns with their experience and career interests.

Important Eligibility Requirement

To be considered, applicants must have already graduated (or be graduating before the start date) and have prior internship or relevant work experience in their selected practice area.

PRACTICE AREAS

Integrated Marketing

Supports integrated communications campaigns that blend media relations, social media, content, influencer engagement, events, and brand storytelling across multiple industries and client types.

Public Affairs, Impact & Urbanism

Provides strategic communications, public affairs, and research support across government relations, public policy, real estate development, housing, economic development, and community engagement. Partners with foundations, nonprofit organizations, advocacy groups, and mission-driven brands to build awareness, drive engagement, and advance social impact initiatives.

Hospitality & Lifestyle

Supports clients across arts and culture, travel, tourism, hospitality, food and beverage, architecture, design, and lifestyle brands.

Consumer & Sports

Strategic narrative development for lifestyle, fashion, beauty, wellness brands, and advisory and communications support for teams, leagues, brands, and investors at the intersection of sports, media, and culture.

Technology

Works with startups, technology companies, investors, and innovators to build visibility, shape narratives, and support business growth.

Corporate (Business Development, Operations, Marketing, HR & Finance)

Supports the internal operations and growth of Orchestra, including business development, marketing, human resources, talent, finance, and other corporate functions.

THIS OPPORTUNITY: CONSUMER & SPORTS

This fellowship program is part of Orchestra's Consumer & Sports practice area.

WHAT YOU'LL DO
As a Fellow, you will:

  • Conduct research and monitor industry, market, and media trends
  • Draft content, reports, presentations, and communications materials
  • Support client and internal projects from planning through execution
  • Participate in meetings, brainstorming sessions, client calls, and events
  • Collaborate across teams on integrated initiatives
  • Gain exposure to strategic communications, public affairs, and agency operations in a fast-paced environment

QUALIFICATIONS:
Candidates should possess:

  • A bachelor's degree (or will graduate before the start date)
  • Prior internship or relevant work experience in their selected practice area
  • Strong writing, research, analytical, and communication skills
  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Proficiency with Google Workspace and Microsoft Office
  • Digital fluency and eagerness to learn new platforms
  • A strong interest in communications, marketing, public affairs, business, or related fields

HOW TO APPLY:
To be considered, applicants must submit:

Resume (1-2 pages)

  • Highlight relevant professional, academic, internship, volunteer, or extracurricular experience.

Application Form

  • As part of the application, candidates will be asked to select one practice area of interest and complete a brief essay (500 words or less) describing how their experiences have prepared them for success in that area and why they are interested in pursuing a career in the field.

Application Deadline

  • Sunday, November 1, 2026. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis beginning before the deadline, so we encourage candidates to apply early.

Due to application volume, we are unable to respond to all submissions. We will reach out directly to candidates selected for interviews. We kindly ask that you do not call, email, or contact us to confirm receipt of your application or inquire about your status.

title: Controls Programmer
description:
Intermediate and Senior Level Positions Available!


Are you energized by solving complex technical challenges? Do you enjoy seeing your work move from concept to commissioning? Are you looking for an environment where no two projects are the same? If so, Mecsmart wants to hear from you!


As a Controls Programmer, you'll play a key role in designing, programming, and commissioning advanced automation systems that power some of today's most innovative manufacturing environments. From robotics and vision systems to material handling and assembly equipment, you'll work on projects that push the boundaries of automation technology.


🎥 Check out this video showcasing some of the work we do: Large Business of the Year Award Winner - Mecsmart Systems Inc.

Located in Newmarket, Ontario, Mecsmart Systems is a world-class automation integrator specializing in custom automation solutions for the industrial, commercial, service, and assembly sectors.


Our team is passionate about engineering excellence, customer success, and continuous innovation. We collaborate across disciplines to develop smart, reliable, and cost-effective automation systems that help our customers solve real-world manufacturing challenges.

We're looking for a full-time Controls Programmer to develop software and control systems for specialized automated equipment.


This role is ideal for someone who embraces continuous learning, enjoys problem-solving, and thrives in a fast-paced, project-driven environment. Technology evolves quickly, and successful members of our Controls team are curious, adaptable, and excited by new challenges.


You'll have the opportunity to work with industry-leading PLC, HMI, robotics, vision, and motion control technologies while helping bring innovative automation systems to life.

At Mecsmart, we take pride in having a culture built on pride, respect, community, satisfaction, family, and safety, for all employees. title: Chief Engineer, Long-Range Missile Systems
description:
CHAOS Industries is redefining modern defense with a multi-product portfolio that gives the ultimate advantage—domain dominance. The company's products are powered by Coherent Distributed Networks (CDN™), empowering warfighters, commercial air operators, and border protection teams to act faster, adapt rapidly, and stay ahead of evolving threats.

CHAOS Industries was founded in 2022 and has raised a total of $1 billion in funding from leading investors, including 8VC, Accel, and Valor Equity Partners. The company is headquartered in Los Angeles, with offices in Washington, D.C., San Francisco, San Diego, and London. For more information, please visit .

Role Overview:

CHAOS is seeking a Chief Engineer to own the technical direction of our long range missile program, from concept and architecture through qualification, flight test, and production transition. You will lead a multidisciplinary engineering team and be the senior technical authority across airframe, guidance, propulsion, integration, and test. This is a build-and-fly environment where you will be accountable for getting real hardware flying.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as the senior technical authority for missile system architecture, requirements, and design decisions
  • Lead system-level trade studies, technical risk management, and design reviews (SRR, PDR, CDR, TRR)
  • Direct integration of airframe, guidance and navigation, propulsion, and avionics subsystems
  • Own system verification and validation, including test planning and flight test readiness
  • Provide technical leadership across mechanical, electrical, software, firmware, and systems teams, and mentor senior engineers
  • Partner with program management, manufacturing, and customers to translate mission needs into executable technical plans
  • Drive configuration control and the transition from prototype to production and fielding

Minimum Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Aerospace, Mechanical, Systems, or Electrical Engineering, or a related field
  • 15+ years of experience developing missile, munition, or high-TRL flight systems, including technical leadership of a program or major subsystem
  • Demonstrated experience taking a system through full lifecycle development, including flight test
  • Detailed understanding of tactical aircraft carriage environments and missile employment envelopes
  • Intuitive knowledge of propulsion systems and airframe controls as well as guidance/navigation techniques for long range strike systems
  • Detailed understanding of target phenomenology and defeat mechanisms
  • Strong command of systems engineering practice and DoD standards for safety, environments, and test
  • Current or recent DoD SECRET clearance

Preferred Requirements:

  • Master's degree or higher
  • Current or recent DoD TOP SECRET security clearance; eligibility for SAP and/or SCI indoc.
  • Prior role as Chief Engineer, Lead Systems Engineer, or Technical Director on a fielded missile program
  • Detailed understanding of ground launcher and shipboard integration environments
  • Full grasp of the long-range kill chain starting at intelligence collection, mission planning, pre-launch and post-launch mission execution
  • Experience with a prime integrator or in a fast-moving defense startup

Why CHAOS?

  • Health Benefits: Medical, dental, and vision benefits 100% paid for by the company
  • Additional benefits: 401k (+ 50% company match up to 6% of pay), FSA, HSA, life insurance, and more
  • Our Perks: Free daily lunch while you're working onsite, fully-stocked kitchen, unlimited PTO, casual dress code
  • Compensation Components: Competitive base salaries, generous pre-IPO stock option grants, relocation assistance, and (coming soon!) annual bonuses
  • Team Growth: 500+ employees and counting across 5 global offices
Salary Range: $220,000 - $300,000

The stated compensation range reflects only the targeted base compensation range and excludes additional earnings such as bonus, equity, and benefits. If your compensation requirements fall outside of the range, we still encourage you to apply. The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations.

Recruiting Agencies: CHAOS Industries does not accept unsolicited resumes or outreach. Unsolicited submissions will not be reviewed or compensated.

title: Staff/Senior Software Engineer - Cloud Platform Engineering
description:
Harness is the AI Software Delivery Platform company, led by technologist and entrepreneur Jyoti Bansal (founder of AppDynamics, acquired by Cisco for $3.7B). Harness has raised approximately $570M in funding and is valued at $5.5B, backed by leading investors including Goldman Sachs, Menlo Ventures, IVP, Unusual Ventures, Citi Ventures, and more. As AI accelerates code creation, the real bottleneck has shifted to everything after the code – testing, deployments, application security, reliability, compliance, and cost optimization. Harness brings AI and automation to this “outer loop,” helping teams ship software faster while maintaining security and governance throughout the entire software delivery lifecycle.

Powered by Harness AI and the Software Delivery Knowledge Graph, the Harness Platform applies deep context and intelligent automation across the software delivery lifecycle with governance and policy-driven controls embedded throughout the platform.

Over the past year, Harness powered over 185M deployments, 82M builds, 18T flag evaluations, 8M security scans, 9.1B optimized tests, 3T protected API calls, and helped manage $2.8B in cloud spend — enabling customers like United Airlines, Morningstar, and Choice Hotels to accelerate releases by up to 75%, reduce cloud costs by up to 60%, and achieve 10x DevOps efficiency.

With a global team across 26 offices and 27 countries, Harness is shaping the future of AI software delivery — and we’re looking for exceptional talent to help us move even faster.

Position Summary

As a Principal/Staff Cloud Engineer at Harness, you will play a pivotal role in designing, building, and maintaining our cloud infrastructure. You will be responsible for ensuring the reliability, scalability, and performance of our systems, incorporating a blend of Cloud Engineering and Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) practices. This role requires a strong technical background, a passion for innovation, and the ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.

Key Responsibilities

Cloud Infrastructure Design & Implementation:

  • Design, build, and manage scalable, secure, and reliable cloud infrastructure using GCP, AWS or Azure.
  • Develop infrastructure-as-code using tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, or similar.

Site Reliability Engineering (SRE):

  • Develop and maintain monitoring, logging, and alerting systems to detect and address issues proactively.
  • Perform capacity planning and demand forecasting to ensure system scalability and performance.

Automation & CI/CD:

  • Utilize Helm for packaging, deploying, and managing applications on Kubernetes.
  • Design and implement continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines to automate the delivery of applications and infrastructure.
  • Develop automation scripts and tools to streamline operations and improve efficiency.

Security & Compliance:

  • Ensure cloud infrastructure and applications meet security and compliance standards.
  • Implement security best practices and perform regular security audits and assessments.

Collaboration & Mentorship:

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including developers, product managers, and operations to deliver high-quality solutions.
  • Mentor and guide junior engineers, sharing best practices and fostering a culture of continuous improvement.

About You

Technical Expertise:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • 7+ years of experience in cloud engineering, site reliability engineering, or related roles.
  • Strong experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) and cloud-native services.

title: ML Software Engineer, Data Plane
description:
The MLIL DataPlane team is looking for a Software Development Engineer to own the design and implementation of our inference data plane. We build the software that makes large models run efficiently on custom hardware - spanning model execution, memory management, data movement, and serving integration.
Our work covers the full inference path: integrating serving engines with custom hardware, developing high-performance compute kernels, enabling efficient data movement, and driving models from early validation through production. We operate at frontier scale with large distributed models.
This is a ground-up effort with rapidly evolving hardware and software. We are looking for an individual contributor who can write and optimize low-level code for custom hardware, validate model architectures end-to-end, build test and profiling infrastructure, and drive performance across the stack.

Key job responsibilities
- Develop and optimize compute kernels for a custom ML accelerator architecture, targeting production-level performance for large language model inference.
- Implement and validate LLM architectures end-to-end - from PyTorch model definition through distributed execution on custom hardware.
- Integrate custom accelerator backends into open-source ML serving frameworks (vLLM, PyTorch), including scheduler extensions, memory management, and model parallelism.
- Build and maintain test infrastructure for model correctness validation across CPU, GPU, simulator, and hardware targets.
- Profile and optimize inference workloads - identify bottlenecks, instrument critical paths, and drive latency and throughput improvements from simulation through hardware bring-up.
- Own features end-to-end: from design through implementation, testing, and integration into the broader software stack.
- Contribute to CI/CD pipelines that gate model and kernel changes on correctness and performance regressions.
BASIC QUALIFICATIONS - Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- 4+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Knowledge of computer architecture, operating systems, and parallel computing
- Knowledge of Linux fundamentals
- Strong proficiency in C/C++
- Experience developing compute kernels for GPUs, DSPs, or custom accelerators
- Proven track record of owning and delivering complex software features end-to-end
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS - Knowledge of Machine Learning and LLM fundamentals, including transformer architecture, training/inference lifecycles, and optimization techniques
- Knowledge of ML frameworks including JAX, PyTorch, vLLM, SGLang, Dynamo, TorchXLA, and TensorRT
- Experience in developing and deploying LLMs in production on GPUs, Neuron, TPU or other AI acceleration hardware
- Experience with distributed systems - collective communication, RDMA, or high-speed interconnect programming
- Experience with hardware simulation environments and model validation workflows
- Demonstrated early adopter of AI-assisted development tools - uses LLMs or code-generation agents as part of daily workflow

  • Assist in the inventory of returned specimens

  • Contact receiving labs prior to shipment to confirm shipping address and ensure contact will be available to receive specimens
  • Ship samples (dangerous and non-dangerous goods) by Commercial or local courier

Miscellaneous:

  • Perform annual competency assessments for Repository staff
  • Label vials and shipping boxes
  • Perform dry shipper QC
  • Coordinate and execute the quarterly temporary freezer inventory
  • Coordinate Repository Equipment preventative maintenance
  • Keep current on IATA Shipping Regulations and maintain certification and standards
  • Carry out other duties/projects as assigned

Minimum Required:

  • High School Diploma or equivalent combination of education and experience
  • 2 years’ of general working experience

Other Required:

  • Must possess basic laboratory skills
  • Experience in written and verbal communications and a strong documentation background in a laboratory setting with respect to regulatory requirements (cGMP, cGLP or ISO) and Standard Operating Procedures
  • Current knowledge of IATA Shipping Regulations and maintenance of certification and standards
  • Requires good attention to detail, excellent documentation skills and must work well in a group environment
  • Familiarity with excel and basic functions with the program

  • Ability to lift and carry between 31-50 lbs.; Ability to lift up to 50 lbs. overhead with assistance; frequently required to sit, stand and walk for prolonged periods; occasionally required to squat, bend, stoop, push, kneel, reach and perform tasks with repetitive motion; Will be exposed to a cold freezer environment (Freezer temperatures range between -20ºC -196ºC)
