title: Lead Physical Security Hardware Specialist
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

LEAD PHYSICAL SECURITY HARDWARE SPECIALIST

Help SpaceX protect life and property anywhere company assets are deployed by leading the Security Systems and Technology Organization. This role is responsible for the global physical security technology stack and hardware organization supporting all SpaceX sites and personnel worldwide; encompassing strategy, systems and hardware integration, architecture, implementation, and lifecycle operations of access control systems (ACS), closed-circuit television (CCTV)/video management systems (VMS), intrusion detection systems (IDS), and related platforms. The Security Systems and Technology Senior Manager will build, mentor, and direct a high-performing global team of specialists while driving enterprise-wide projects, organizational change, system reliability, and continuous improvement through cutting-edge technology.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Lead the Security Systems and Technology Organization, providing strategic direction and organizational leadership for the entire hardware and systems function
  • Lead, mentor, train, and develop the global Security Hardware Specialist organization, including performance management, career progression, and knowledge transfer
  • Develop and communicate the overall security systems and technology strategy, roadmap, and change management plans, aligning with SpaceX business objectives
  • Drive end-to-end systems and hardware integration of access control, video management, intrusion detection, analytics, and related platforms with IT infrastructure, network security, facilities, HR systems, and other enterprise tools to deliver unified, scalable, and resilient security capabilities company-wide
  • Serve as Principal Administrator and License Manager for enterprise platforms (Genetec Security Center, Lenel, Avigilon, and equivalents); provision and integrate new servers/systems; coordinate closely with IT, INFOSEC, and Purchasing
  • Demonstrate and apply strong knowledge of Genetec platforms for unified access control, video surveillance, analytics, intrusion management, and related functions; evaluate and implement advanced capabilities
  • Set and enforce enterprise standards for equipment selection, configuration, installation, training, certifications, and best practices; evaluate measures of effectiveness for new equipment types and technologies
  • Ensure on-schedule completion of complex, multi-site projects with minimal supervision; standardize equipment, pricing, processes, and best practices
  • Lead vendor/contractor management for design, installations, large-scale facility security infrastructure, and special projects
  • Collaborate as senior representative on SCIF development, data centers, MDFs, and other high-priority security technology initiatives; maintain TS/SCI eligibility
  • Oversee preventive maintenance programs, system health monitoring, troubleshooting protocols, inventory of hardware/tools/materials, and documentation of job status, changes, and project records
  • Drive process improvements, creative applications of existing and new systems to solve emerging or systemic problems, and continuous reliability enhancements
  • Maintain SOPs, Confluence pages, and JIRA tracking for enterprise projects
  • Own budget planning, resource allocation, headcount, and performance metrics for the global Security Systems and Technology Organization; report program effectiveness and strategic progress to senior leadership

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • High school diploma or equivalency certification
  • 5+ years of experience managing enterprise-level physical security systems such as CCTV, access control, VMS, intrusion detection systems, fire and alarm systems), or alert systems
  • 1+ years of direct leadership responsibility across global sites

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field (engineering, security management, information systems, or related) preferred
  • Strong expertise and certifications in Genetec Security Center, Lenel Access Control, and/or Avigilon systems; prior experience as principal system administrator or license manager for large-scale global deployments
  • Proven track record managing complex multi-site security technology projects, vendor portfolios, enterprise standardization, organizational change, and large-scale technology transformations at global scale
  • Experience with International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR)
  • Experience managing a portfolio of programs and projects, including owning enterprise programs in addition to site leadership responsibilities
  • Experience with JIRA (or similar tools) to track work, issues, and project status
  • 10+ years of progressive experience in physical security technology, systems engineering, or hardware in space exploration, aviation, military, or other high-reliability operating environments
  • Experience with SCIF design/support (ICD-705 / NISPOM), TS/SCI environments, and special programs
  • Established skills in strategic and critical thinking, decision-making, communications, and relationship-building
  • Highly organized, detail oriented, and possess a proven ability to thrive under pressure and to execute on a number of projects simultaneously
  • Successful experience working in a fast-paced, dynamic, results-oriented team environment

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Must be willing to work all shifts, extended hours, and/or weekends as needed
  • Willingness to travel as needed (up to 35% or more) to support global sites and projects
  • Must be able to obtain a TS/SCI clearance
  • An active clearance may provide the opportunity for you to work on sensitive SpaceX missions; if so, you will be subject to pre-employment drug and random drug and alcohol testing
  • Position is subject to random drug and alcohol testing

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

  • To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.

Applicants wishing to view a copy of SpaceX’s Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should reach out to EEOCompliance@spacex.com.

title: Operations Stockroom Supervisor- Part-time
description:
About REP:

REP designs world-class, innovative gym equipment that is sold around the world, and we are now expanding into apparel, supplements, athletes, and events. REP was established in 2012 by two brothers who shared a deep passion for fitness. From our humble beginnings of selling bumper plates out of a small garage, REP has experienced remarkable growth, now occupying over 300,000 square feet of office and distribution space in the USA and internationally. With a dedicated team of over 180 fitness enthusiasts, our mission is to "Improve Lives by Sharing our Passion for Strength." Our commitment to innovation, customer service, and value sets us apart.

We believe in building a culture centered around fitness, so we specialize in outfitting home gyms, commercial gyms, and strength and conditioning facilities. Our dedication to excellence has been recognized many times – as one of Inc. 5000’s fastest-growing private companies; as Newsweek’s Reader’s Choice Best Exercise Equipment Brand; and as the most popular brand in the home gym market (with cost in mind) by Garage Gym Experiment. From Men’s Health to Self.com, Garage Gym Reviews, and Men’s Journal, REP’s products are consistently named the best in their class. We also boast impressive partnerships, such as providing F45’s functional racks worldwide. Our team works out together, and we regularly invite fitness superstars to join us. We organize fun challenges to test our limits – and the limits of our equipment.

At REP, we continue to grow and bring new opportunities for those who want to be a part of a winning team. We firmly believe that being surrounded by like-minded individuals fuels creative energy and fosters a fun and collaborative work environment.

This role is based in Lafayette, CO at our brand-new, state-of-the-art showroom — and yes, the views of the Rocky Mountains are just as epic as they sound. Nestled in one of Colorado's most charming towns, just minutes from REP headquarters, this is a workplace that actually inspires.

Fuel your best work with a fully stocked kitchen loaded with healthy snacks, energy drinks, and protein — because we believe great people deserve great fuel. This is an in-person role, five days a week, and honestly? With a team this passionate and an environment this dialed-in, you'll want to be here.

Our Core Values:

Think Like a Customer – We empathize with our customers; understand the “why” behind every decision we make.

Progress, not Perfection – We don’t let perfect get in the way of good; we are better today than we were yesterday.

Positive Attitude – Be a glass half-full kind of person and remember to have fun.

Teamwork without Ego – We put the team above ourselves; we only win together.

Take Initiative – We drive momentum; if there is an opportunity to make us better, we want to hear it.

About the Role:

Keep the engine running at REP Fitness! As our part-time Operations Stockroom Supervisor, you'll be the backbone of our Denver Showroom - managing the daily rhythm of the stockroom and ensuring every product gets where it needs to go, on time and with precision.

The expected hours for this role will be Saturday 10:00 AM – 6:00 PM and Sunday 12:00 PM – 5:00 PM.

From coordinating schedules to overseeing shipping, receiving, loading and unloading, picking and packing, and keeping the space in top shape, you'll bring order to the operation and set the standard for efficiency and accuracy. If you're someone who takes pride in a well-run operation and leads by example, we want you on our team.

Essential Functions: include the following. Other duties may be assigned.

  • Ensures a safe and compliant operation according to both regulatory standards and company standards.
  • Establishes and maintains department standards for productivity, reliability, and accuracy.
  • Supervise, motivate, and coach team members to meet stockroom standards and ensure customer satisfaction.
  • Utilize docks and stockroom layout to maximize efficiencies.
  • Ensure team is adequately staffed, trained, and managed.
  • Forecasts team needs to meet peak demands of the business.
  • Maintain all housekeeping and safety standards.
  • Leads team by example by loading trucks, packing orders, or other duties as necessary.
  • Recommends changes in procedures to improve operating efficiencies.
  • Serve as a coach and mentor, helping team members grow while using performance-based feedback to set expectations.
  • Performs required administrative tasks; prepares required reports and correspondence.
  • Implement standard operating procedures (SOPs), ensuring orders are picked, packed, and shipped in accordance with standards and designated cut-off times and timely unloading, verification, and put away of inbound materials.

Supervisory Responsibilities:

  • Assigns, trains, schedules, or oversees work of others.

What You'll Bring:

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • Ability to read, analyze, and interpret general business periodicals, professional journals, technical procedures, or governmental regulations. Ability to write reports, business correspondence, and procedure manuals. Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from groups of managers, clients, customers, and the general public.
  • Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions. Ability to interpret an extensive variety of technical instructions in mathematical or diagram form and deal with several abstract and concrete variables.
  • Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide in all units of measure, using whole numbers, common fractions, and decimals. Ability to compute rate, ratio, and percent and to draw and interpret bar graphs.
  • Ability to calculate figures and amounts, such as discounts, interest, commissions, proportions, percentages, area, circumference, and volume. Ability to apply concepts of basic algebra and geometry.

Education and/or Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree (B.A.) from four-year college or university; or one to three years related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Ability to use and operate WMS systems.
  • Ability to produce work tasks from WMS systems.
  • Proficient in basic Excel skills for reporting of KPIs.
  • Proficient in Word documentation for procedures and standards.

Core Competencies:

Action Oriented – Taking on new opportunities and tough challenges with a sense of urgency, high energy and enthusiasm.

Resourcefulness – Securing and deploying resources effectively and efficiently.

Collaborates – Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.

Self-Development – Actively seeking new ways to grow and be challenged using both formal and informal development channels.

Decision Quality – Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward.

Directs Work – Providing direction, delegating, and removing obstacles to get work done.

Ensures Accountability – Holding self and others accountable to meet commitments.

Drives Results – Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.

Manages Conflict – Handling conflict situations effectively, with a minimum of noise.

Being Resilient – Rebounding from setbacks and adversity when facing difficult situations.

What's in it For You:

Our commitment to quality and transparency applies not only to our products, but also to our people. We are focused on creating a fun, exciting, collaborative space that’s centered around health and well-being. We empower everyone on our team to take control of their careers and balance their work and life in a modern, fast-paced environment.

We offer an exceptional compensation package that includes:

Compensation base range: $23.00 - $24.00 hourly with sales bonus potential

Day One Benefits!

  • 401k and Roth options (no company match)

Recharge Yourself!

  • 48 hours of sick leave annually
  • 7 paid company holidays

Pumped-up Perks!

  • Full access to employee gym

Physical Requirements:

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is constantly required to sit and use hands to operate the telephone, type and operate the computer and mouse. Physical effort may include stooping, kneeling, touching, feeling, reaching, standing, walking, pushing, pulling, lifting, grasping, talking, hearing, and repetitive motions. The employee is frequently required to talk, hear, and bend and twist neck. The employee may occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 pounds and rarely lift and/or move up to 100 pounds assisted. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision and distance vision.

REP provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or genetics. In addition to federal law requirements, REP complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities.

This specification is intended to indicate the kinds of tasks and levels of work difficulty that will be required of positions that will be given this title and shall not be construed as declaring what the specific duties and responsibilities of any particular position shall be. It is not intended to limit or in any way modify the right of any supervisor to assign, direct, and control the work of employees under his/her supervision. The use of a particular expression or illustration describing duties shall not be held to exclude other duties not mentioned. Ability to competently perform all the essential duties of the position, with or without reasonable accommodation, demonstrated commitment to effective customer service delivery, and the ability to work productively as a member of a team or work group are basic requirements of all positions at REP.

title: Senior Product Manager, Digital
description:
Senior Product Manager, Digital Product

Department: Digital

Reports to: VP of Digital

Employment Type: Full-Time

Location: Remote, United States (East Coast preferred)

Pay Range: $130k-$160k, commensurate with experience

Margaux is a new kind of footwear brand rooted in friendship, collaboration, and community. Co-founders Sarah Pierson and Alexa Buckley launched Margaux in 2015, setting out to create a modern footwear wardrobe for women on the go, powered by thoughtful design and an innovative approach. Each pair is designed in New York and handmade in Spain, and thoughtfully crafted to withstand the test of time.

Position Overview

Reporting to the VP of Digital, you will guide our day-to-day site operator and work alongside our development, platform and app partners, supporting four businesses — DTC, wholesale, marketplace and retail — that share one digital backbone. This is a foundation-building role: much of the structure is still taking shape, and your first year will be about helping put it in place.

Responsibilities

  • Build high-caliber site capabilities and customer-facing interactions that elevate overall user engagement.
  • Track emerging tech trends and e-commerce innovation to spot new feature opportunities for the brand.
  • Evaluate potential site updates, balancing technical effort against revenue and commercial impact.
  • Turn high-priority roadmap concepts into polished, user-centric site enhancements.
  • Track performance metrics against target KPIs, establishing ongoing site optimizations based on quantitative data.
  • Maintain standard operating procedures across full feature rollouts, from initial scoping to site deployment.
  • Partner with cross-functional operations leads to streamline team workflows, align on organizational targets, and support internal growth.
  • Define and execute product strategy, requirement definitions, and release schedules aligned with overall business goals.
  • Oversee compliance and accessibility identifying the proper process and partners to support
  • Support and develop the day-to-day site operations, and manage agency and vendor relationships — scope, SLAs, budget and performance.

Qualifications

  • Proven ability to collaborate strategically with cross-functional partners to achieve shared business outcomes
  • A passion for digital brand experience and the customer journey
  • Deep, hands-on Shopify Plus experience (or a comparable enterprise platform) — themes, apps and integrations.
  • Owned onsite merchandising through seasonal launches and promotional periods, balancing commercial targets against brand and customer experience.
  • A real CRO track record, backed by fluency in the stack that supports it.
  • Directed internal or agency developers from business requirements through QA and release.
  • Brought order to an unstructured request environment — an intake or prioritization process that enabled scale.
  • Ability to set clear objectives and design strategies that inspire and align the team
  • Deep understanding and commitment to the industry, staying informed about best practices and trends in both tech and retail

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary commensurate with experience, plus medical, dental and vision coverage
  • Paid time off so you can rest and recharge, as well as paid sick leave
  • Employee discount on all Margaux products
  • A close-knit, mission-driven team culture

title: Principal in Charge - Healthcare
description:
Who We Are

HMC Architects is an employee-owned design firm with an inherent desire to make a difference in our communities. As a purpose-driven brand based on values, our mission to design for good drives everything we do. And our ownership culture creates alignment and increased commitment to that mission, keeping us on track to being successful.

What We Do

Founded with the purpose of anticipating community needs, HMC aims to create designs that have a positive impact, now and into the future. We focus primarily on opportunities to have the most direct contribution to communities–through healthcare, education, and civic spaces.

Why Join HMC

As an employee owned company you become an owner after one year—receiving company-provided shares at no cost and building long-term financial growth as the firm succeeds. We also give back through our volunteerism with our Designing Futures Foundation, which advances sustainable and regenerative design and supports the next generation of innovators. In addition to this, we also support our team through:

  • Culture: We put people over profits, giving them the flexibility to manage their work and life. We believe in fairness, equality in opportunity, and rewarding those who perform.
  • Wellness: company paid wellness courses, on-site gyms (at select locations), access to financial advisors and discounts to wellness platforms, gyms and more.
  • Professional Development: LinkedIn learning access, business development training, supportive mentorship, company-paid ARE study materials, exam fees, and licensure completion bonuses.
  • Comprehensive Comp and Benefits: Base+Bonus+Equity+401k, including student loan repayments, wellness programs, full medical, dental, vision, time off and holidays above industry standard.

Summary

The Principal in Charge will be responsible for planning, coordinating, and overseeing a major project or projects through all phases of development. Where applicable, gives direction to assigned staff. Leads the client relationship. Assigns appropriate staff.

Will establish and maintain budgets, schedules, and monitor adherence of terms of contract expectations. Has responsibility for client contact and authority to direct, control, and monitor all project activities. Strong ability to multi-task and prioritize. Ability to oversee several groups performing work or supporting work. Responsible for ongoing marketing and business development and maintaining a consistent backlog of work. Responsible for becoming a known presence in community and/or specific HMC markets segment.

This position is based in our Los Angeles or Ontario, California office. The position requires 3 days in the office and the ability to work from home Mondays and Fridays.

Position Responsibilities

Business Development/Client Engagement

  • Procure and manage an average of $4M of gross project revenue per year and achieve an average of $5.3M in new contracts annually through existing clients\repeat work or new business development activities
  • Serve as the primary proponent on project pursuits, establish strong relationships with clients, and leading a team that will present to clients
  • Use market and client intelligence in locating new opportunities, prepositioning, preparing quals/proposals, and interviewing
  • Generate new business development leads by reaching out to prospective clients
  • Successfully achieve competitive project wins and transition the management of projects to Project Management staff where appropriate
  • Work with existing clients to identify upcoming architectural needs that can lead to project opportunities
  • Lead the project team for Go/No Go decisions of project pursuits
  • Ensure that additional services requested by client are billed and invoiced appropriately
  • Maintain an appropriate backlog of work that ensures the viability of the studio and its staff
  • Develop a network of current and past clients and industry partners
  • Develop relationships with agency leaders in their markets
  • Maintain strong relationships with existing clients and ensure that they are satisfied with HMC’s services
  • Attend conferences, events, and other networking opportunities to grow HMC’s presence in the marketplace
  • Market HMC capabilities through public presentations and professional publications
  • Direct overall verbal and graphic communication of complex project concepts to clients, public agencies, and project team members; serve as the primary point of contact for all client issues
  • Write RFP’S and negotiate contracts and fees with clients and consultants
  • Write articles for professional publications of architecture and construction industry
  • Write and develop project marketing interview materials
  • Participate and lead in project marketing interview
  • Resolve "lost opportunity" issues, including staffing adjustments, review of contractual obligations, and scope of service
  • Represent HMC in the industry and in the community

Leadership

  • Demonstrate and promote the values and culture of HMC; serve as an HMC advocate, internally and externally; be a source of inspiration and encouragement to staff, with a positive attitude and genuine care for the firm, staff, community and clients
  • Drive accountability across the studio on adherence to HMC technical protocols and standards
  • Supervise and manage multiple clients and project at once through all phases of projects
  • Direct and coordinate project work with team members and consultants
  • Ensure that coaching, mentoring, and performance-enhancing feedback of assigned team members are provided, particularly related to technical proficiency
  • Monitor employee performance and take appropriate action to provide feedback on both positive and negative performance
  • Establish productive working relationships, and deal effectively and cooperatively with practice leadership, clients, team members, consultants, and government agencies
  • Give assignments to office support staff, consultants, and vendors clearly, effectively, and professionally
  • Display willingness to make decisions; exhibit sound and accurate judgment; support and explain reasoning for decisions; include appropriate people in decision-making process; make timely decisions
  • Resolve issues related to team members and consultants
  • Collaborate with other studio leaders to ensure studio leadership is unified and supportive of each other; work with non-studio leadership as needed on firmwide initiatives
  • Listen and communicate effectively and professionally in a wide variety of settings inside and outside the firm
  • Assure consistency and integration of technical resources on project teams from pursuit through completion
  • Set goals, prioritize, and plan work activities for self-management and use time efficiently
  • Direct and prepare work plans and schedules for the completion of technical elements within a project, in coordination with project managers and other Principals
  • Ensure that all HMC procedures, standards, and protocols are followed

Project Management

  • Oversee and manage all aspects of the project management cycle
  • Monitor staffing plans and projected workloads to meet expected project timelines, budgets, and profitability
  • Supervise and manage multiple clients and project groups simultaneously, in all phases of projects
  • Review and assist staff in setting budgets, goals, and preparing work plans that clearly define their expectations, and take appropriate action when as needed
  • Achieve gross profit targets on projects under purview
  • Work with accounting to invoice clients for services and resolve collection of aged accounts and any financial issues with clients
  • Review and edit specifications as needed
  • Adjust staffing when needed to ensure adequate resource deployment
  • Responsible for ensuring that all HMC procedures, standards, and protocols are followed
  • Set goals, prioritize, and plan work activities for self and staff; use time efficiently
  • Provide support and leadership to other offices, studios, and groups
  • Ensure that project managers support design and follow design intent and quality on all projects
  • Ensure that documents are reviewed for quality, coordination, and compliance with the requirements of deliverables and client standards in all phases
  • Review cost estimates and conduct value analysis
  • Resolve plan check and approval issues with the agencies and client
  • Ensure that materials and systems meet HMC and client standards and are within budget
  • Oversee and resolve issues during construction phase of all work under their supervision
  • Sign and approve drawings as required by HMC polices if you are a licensed architect
  • Participate in design charettes, team design critiques and pin-ups

Position Requirements

  • Architectural degree from an accredited university or equivalent demonstrated proficiency
  • Architectural license preferred but not required
  • Minimum of 12 years’ experience in production and coordination of documents in all phases of architectural practice and in management of healthcare architectural projects
  • Minimum of 5 years’ recent experience in healthcare including HCAI/OSHPD
  • Minimum of 2 years’ as a senior leader, leading project teams and engaging in successful business development
  • Must be on-site in an HMC studio to lead staff a minimum of 3 days per week

The salary range for this position is $137,058 to $211,256

title: Director of Engineering, Brokerage Platform
description:
Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world's biggest financial problems. We're looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn't a place for complacency, it's where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We're a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards.

The Brokerage Platform org is the backbone of everything Robinhood trades, clears, and settles. It is the underlying infrastructure that powers every equities trade, every options contract, every event contract, and every crypto transaction that moves through our platform — and it is the foundation on which Robinhood's most important business lines are built. The org spans four deeply interconnected teams: Market Data & Symbology (the real-time and reference data layer that the entire product experience depends on), Trading Platform (core order routing, execution management, and bulk order systems), Clearing (settlement, margin, security lending, cash sweep, and the full back-office operations stack), and Brokerage Infrastructure (the platform layer that enables every product team to move faster through abstractions, reliability investments, and next-generation stack modernization). This org operates 24 hours a day around critical market functions — from market open to trade settlement — and when things go wrong, it matters.

As the Director of Engineering, Brokerage Platform, you will lead one of Robinhood's largest and most consequential engineering organizations. You will own the technical strategy, people leadership, and delivery execution for a broad, high-stakes platform — partnering closely with a dedicated TPM and engaging deeply with trading, crypto, and active trader product teams who depend on your org every day. This is not a role for someone who manages from a distance. You will need the engineering depth to challenge technical bets, the platform mindset to drive the investments that move the business forward, and the leadership presence to build and retain a world-class team in a domain where the stakes are always high.

This role is based in our Menlo Park, CA office, with in-person attendance expected 5 days per week.

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams.

What you’ll do

  • Own the full engineering strategy and delivery for Brokerage Platform — spanning Market Data & Symbology, Trading Platform, Clearing, and Brokerage Infrastructure — setting the technical direction and ensuring the org executes with reliability and conviction
  • Lead and develop a large, distributed engineering organization of senior and staff-level engineers and engineering managers — building the talent, culture, and bench strength the org needs to sustain high performance over time
  • Drive platform investments that have direct business impact — identifying the modernization, reliability, and scalability bets worth making, building the conviction behind them, and seeing them through to measurable outcomes
  • Partner tightly with your TPM counterpart to manage a high volume of incoming asks from trading, crypto, active trader, and event contracts product teams — prioritizing ruthlessly and protecting engineering capacity for the work that matters most
  • Own the reliability and operational health of systems that run continuously around market-critical functions — ensuring the org is prepared for high-severity incidents and has the processes and tooling to resolve them fast
  • Engage deeply with cross-functional leadership across Robinhood — representing Brokerage Platform's roadmap, dependencies, and capabilities to product, ops, and executive stakeholders
  • Champion platform modernization and technical debt reduction — driving initiatives like stack rewrites, sharding, multi-region scaling, and infrastructure abstractions that unlock velocity across the entire engineering org

What you bring

  • 15+ years of software engineering experience, with 6+ years in engineering leadership roles — including demonstrated experience as a Director or Senior Director managing large, multi-team engineering organizations
  • Deep platform engineering background — you've owned and driven the technical direction of foundational backend platforms at scale, not just product features built on top of them
  • (big plus, though not directly required) Experience at the intersection of financial services, trading, brokerage, or adjacent high-criticality domains is a strong plus — you don't need to know all four of our sub-domains, but depth in one or two (market data, clearing, order execution, or brokerage infrastructure) is a meaningful signal
  • A track record of driving platform modernization bets that delivered real business outcomes — you've made the case for a large technical investment, executed it, and pointed to the result
  • Comfort operating in a high-severity, always-on engineering environment — you've led teams through major incidents and built the systems and culture to minimize their recurrence
  • Strong background with distributed systems, backend services at scale, Go or Python, and cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred)
  • Background from high-performance engineering organizations in fintech, trading, crypto, or large-scale consumer platforms — companies similar to Robinhood, Coinbase, SoFi, Google, or similar environments where the platform was the business is a strong plus!

Leadership expectations

Our ambitious roadmap requires a great culture shaped by exceptional leaders. Here’s what we expect from them:

  • Drive high performance by setting clear, focused goals, giving real-time feedback, stretching top talent, and scaling impact through focus, innovation, and tech.
  • Hire and retain top talent by setting a high bar, hiring only those who raise it, investing in onboarding, and addressing talent issues quickly and fairly.
  • Create community by connecting work to purpose, removing friction while prioritizing safety, building trust and inclusion, and leading from the front with integrity.

What we offer

  • Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career.
  • Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching.
  • Top Tier benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents.
  • Access to the Robinhood Employee Fund that gives eligible US employees the opportunity to invest in a private employee fund that provides exposure to Robinhood Ventures funds.
  • Access to the best AI tools on the market and continuous AI skill-building for every employee, technical or not.
  • Lifestyle wallet - a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more.
  • Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits.
  • Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more!
  • Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces.





In addition to the base pay range listed below, this role is also eligible for bonus opportunities + equity + benefits.

title: Senior Technical Program Manager, Application & Platform Security
description:
Space is a warfighting domain. True Anomaly seeks those with the talent and ambition to build the technology that secures it.

OUR MISSION

True Anomaly delivers decisive capabilities for space superiority. We build autonomous spacecraft, advanced payloads, mission software, and space-based interceptors — enabling the U.S. and its Allies to secure the space environment and counter threats from the ultimate high ground.

OUR VALUES

  • Be the offset. We create asymmetric advantages with creativity and ingenuity.
  • What would it take? We challenge assumptions to deliver ambitious results.
  • It’s the people. Our team is our competitive advantage and we are better together.

BENEFITS & PERKS*

  • Best-in-class healthcare: 100% company-paid medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your dependents, with HSA/HRA options
  • Generous time off: Flexible Time Off (FTO) for exempt employees, accrued PTO of up to 25 days for non-exempt employees, plus 12 paid holidays; Parental Leave; Sick Leave
  • Fuel for your day: Daily catered lunch and unlimited snacks for in-office employees
  • And more: 401(k) retirement plan, fitness reimbursement, and Dog Fridays
  • Equity participation: Equity is included as part of our total compensation package, giving you an opportunity to share in the company’s success.

*Do not apply to fixed term and temporary roles

YOUR MISSION

We are looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager to join the Security & Infrastructure PMO, dedicated to our Application Security and Platform Security teams in Long Beach. You will be the embedded program management partner to these two teams, driving execution from intake through delivery, running their operational rhythms, engaging with cross-functional software engineering teams, and keeping leadership's view of commitments and risk current and honest.

Application Security owns the security of the software we build: secure development practices, product and application security programs, vulnerability management, and the controls that keep our codebase and pipelines defensible. Platform Security owns the security of the environments that software runs in: cloud and platform security, identity and access management, infrastructure hardening, and the operational processes that keep those domains healthy. Your job is to make both teams more predictable and more effective—turning technical work into tracked, milestone-oriented programs and surfacing conflicts before they become delivery problems. It is also part engagement manager and part product manager: the company's software engineering teams are App Security and Platform Security's customers, and you help understand their needs and shape how security capabilities are delivered back to them.

This is a dedicated role, but not a static one. Your primary charter is Application Security and Platform Security, and that is where you'll build the deepest context. As portfolio priorities shift, you should expect to flex across other Security & Infrastructure programs when the PMO needs it, bringing the same execution rigor wherever you're pointed.

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Own end-to-end delivery for Application Security and Platform Security initiatives—building and maintaining the program plans, milestone schedules, and dependency maps in Jira, and driving them from intake through close
- Run both teams' operational cadences—sprint/backlog grooming, weekly status, and quarterly planning—and keep backlog health and ticket hygiene good enough that status is trustworthy without a fire drill
- Partner with the team leads on effort estimation, task decomposition, and resource alignment across concurrent workstreams; surface capacity conflicts and schedule risk early, with options
- Serve the software engineering teams as the primary customers of App Security and Platform Security—intake their requests, set expectations on what security can deliver and when, and keep that channel active rather than reactive
- Manage cross-functional dependencies with software engineering, IT, GRC, cloud/platform, and external vendors and assessors
- Produce leadership-ready program visibility—milestone-oriented, risk-flagged, and current—including the roll-ups and tear-sheets the PMO uses for steering
- Partner with the PMO Lead on roadmap planning: prioritization, capacity planning, and keeping the plan of record maintained as priorities shift
- Flex to other Security & Infrastructure programs as portfolio demand requires, bringing the same execution discipline to an unfamiliar domain

QUALIFICATIONS

- 10+ years combining application and platform security with the technical program management of that work—deep in at least one domain (secure SDLC, vulnerability management, CI/CD pipeline security; cloud and infrastructure security, identity and access management), credible in the other, with a track record of owning and running programs end to end
- Demonstrated ability to manage concurrent workstreams with cross-functional dependencies and external stakeholders
- Strong Jira or equivalent proficiency; able to build and maintain structured tracking across multi-team portfolios
- Comfortable operating where scope, priorities, and assignments shift with portfolio demand
- Clear, direct communicator; able to simplify complex status for executive audiences and push back when warranted
- U.S. citizenship required; clearable required

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

- Prior experience as an information security engineer who has since moved into technical program management (preferred over a TPM background without hands-on security experience)
- Familiarity working directly with software engineering and platform/DevOps teams
- Familiarity with NIST RMF, FedRAMP, or federal compliance environments
- Experience in defense technology, aerospace, or DoD contractor environments

COMPENSATION

  • Base Salary: $140,000-$210,000
  • Equity + Benefits including Health, Dental, Vision, HRA/HSA options, PTO and paid holidays, 401K, Parental Leave

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, location, and experience.

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS

  • Work Location—Successful candidates will be located near Long Beach. While we observe a hybrid work environment, some work must be done on site.
  • Work environment—the work environment; temperature, noise level, inside or outside, or other factors that will affect the person's working conditions while performing the job.
  • Physical demands—the physical demands of the job, including bending, sitting, lifting and driving.

This position will be open until it is successfully filled. To submit your application, please follow the directions below. #LI-Onsite

To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) you must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.

True Anomaly is committed to equal employment opportunity on any basis protected by applicable state and federal laws. If you have a disability or additional need that requires accommodation, please do not hesitate to let us know.

title: Mechanical Engineering Intern - Recreational
description:
What we’re building

The marine industry supports recreation, global commerce, and national defense. And yet it runs on technology that hasn't meaningfully changed in fifty years. Until now.

Arc is on a mission to electrify the marine industry. We're rethinking powertrains, software, and vessel designs from first principles. And we're already executing. We started with consumers to develop and harden our core technology. We’re now scaling production of our flagship model with new models and sectors on the horizon. Now we’re extending our platform to commercial applications, starting with tugs, ferries, and defense, with years worth of signed contracts and a pipeline that spans every vessel type on the water.

The technology is proven, the momentum is building, and the opportunity is enormous. The marine industry is going electric and Arc is building the platform that powers it

Who we’re looking for

We’re looking for someone who’s fired up by our mission and ready to build. You’ll thrive here if you adapt quickly, take ownership, and care about the details.

You will join our Mechanical Engineer team as a summer intern from June 14th-August 20th 2027. You will work from our headquarters in Torrance, CA. Given that we’re a startup, you will be working in a fast-moving, dynamic environment that requires adaptability. That said, here are some responsibilities and qualifications we expect to stay relatively constant for this role.

What You'll Do

  • Designing and releasing hardware, with mentorship from a full-time engineer, in areas such as:
    • Composite structures, Interiors & Mechanisms, Marine Systems, Test Fixtures, or Tooling
  • Owning a defined project from requirements through design, prototype, and test over the course of your internship
  • Building and testing prototypes in the shop and on the water, and helping root-cause failures
  • Creating CAD models, drawings, and supporting analysis for parts and assemblies
  • Presenting your work and results to the engineering team

Minimum Qualifications

  • Currently a junior or senior pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related engineering field
  • Hands-on engineering experience through a prior internship, project team, research, or personal projects
  • Proficiency in a 3D CAD tool (NX, CATIA, or SolidWorks)
  • Solid grasp of mechanical engineering fundamentals such as statics, mechanics of materials, and fluids
  • Willingness to get hands-on with fabrication, assembly, and testing
  • Ability to explain and defend your design decisions
  • Clear written and verbal communication
  • Eagerness to learn and adapt in a dynamic setting.

Bonus Qualifications

  • Leadership or major design ownership on a student project team (Formula SAE, Baja, solar car, electric boat, rocketry, or similar)
  • Experience with composites, ideally fiberglass or carbon layups
  • Machining, welding, 3D printing, or other fabrication skills
  • Experience with FEA or other analysis tools
  • Exposure to design for manufacturing or tooling design
  • Experience with NX or a PLM system such as Teamcenter
  • Comfortable pushing a fast but sustainable pace
  • Enthusiasm for boating and the water

At Arc, we encourage diversity and consider all qualified applicants equally for employment, regardless of background, identity, or status. You’re always welcome to reach out even if you don’t meet many of these qualifications. Passion and aptitude make up for a lot.

What we offer

The base pay for this role is $36 per hour.

Additionally, Arc offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

  • Boat days – Yes, we actually go out on the water. A lot.
  • Retirement savings — Traditional and Roth 401(k) access
  • Safety support — Reimbursement for PPE, ergonomic equipment, and anything that ensures we keep our crew safe
  • Relocation Assistance
  • Mentorship Opportunities
  • Office perks — Daily lunches, snacks, and good coffee while onsite

Our values

We move with urgency and build with care. We value these five things above all else:

  • Ownership over both your work and the company’s success
  • Empathy for colleagues and for customers
  • Humility in problem solving and collaboration
  • Pragmatism for navigating ambiguity quickly and sensibly
  • Inclusion of different backgrounds, opinions, cultures, and perspectives.

We want people who share and embody these values. It is vital that our values align - we’d be happy to elaborate on any or all of these during the interview process.

title: Investment Analyst- Campus Recruitment (McGill)/ Analyste en investissement- Recrutement (HEC)
description:
Position based in Montreal

Letko, Brosseau & Associates is one of Canada’s leading independent global investment managers. Founded in 1987, the firm offers a diverse set of investment solutions to a domestic and international customer base. We believe our business-minded, fundamental research approach, strong ethical culture and client-first fiduciary commitment have been key to our long-term growth and success. Through ongoing, active engagement with the companies we invest in, we seek to contribute to positive change, while earning superior returns for our clients.

We are looking for qualified individuals to apply for the role of Investment Analyst.

The role involves developing in-depth knowledge of one or more industries and their publicly traded companies, with the ultimate goal of helping to identify appropriate investments for the company's clients.

The nature of the work is diligent, detail-oriented, and focused on the long term. Analysts establish an array of forecasts and produce valuation models resulting in investment recommendations and ultimately portfolio investments. The scope of the work is global, as it includes the analysis of worldwide industry trends as well as the review of companies operating across geographies.

Successful candidates join Letko Brosseau’s Investment Team, a group of highly-talented and experienced investment professionals with deep industry expertise and relentless curiosity. Investment Analysts have the chance to contribute to the firm’s growth and success not only through their own portfolio recommendations, but also by participating in teamwide investment decisions.

Main responsibilities:

  • Provide investment recommendations of securities within industry coverage;
  • Maintain up-to-date investment thesis and financial models on portfolio companies within industry coverage, and recommend changes to portfolio composition when appropriate;
  • Regularly meet with the management of publicly traded companies, visit their operations andperform any other required due diligence;
  • Develop a pipeline of potential investment opportunities;
  • Assist Client Servicing / Business Development in answering client queries, collecting data, and preparing presentations, promotional material, and framing communications when required;
  • Review proxies and determine how they should be voted in keeping with the firm’s proxy voting policies;
  • Actively participate in investment team meetings.


Required profile:


  • Bachelor’s degree;
  • MBA or M. Sc. in finances or other pertinent area;
  • Excellent academic results;
  • Between 2 and 5 years of professional experience;
  • CFA charterholder (an asset);
  • Professional experience or interest in the information technology, financial services, healthcare, or energy industries (an asset);
    Experience in other industries is also considered;



The ideal candidate is/has:

  • Passion for investing and interest in financial markets.
  • Strong curiosity and a desire to learn about the world around us.
  • Entrepreneurial, self-motivated and independent mindset, capable of working at times with minimal supervision.
  • Excellent research skills and resourcefulness in acquiring information.
  • A high level of judgment, with the ability to critically and independently analyze large amounts of information to make sound investment decisions.
  • Strong work ethic, discipline, and consistency in applying investment principles.
  • The technical knowledge required to analyze companies and investment opportunities.
  • Meticulous attention to detail and excellent analytical skills.
  • A strong ability to excel as part of a team.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills (both oral and written).
  • Multilingualism (French/English and/or other languages) is an asset.
    • Knowledge of English is required to communicate effectively with employees and business partners at our Toronto and Calgary offices. The position also requires the ability to communicate with business leaders from various countries; therefore, knowledge of multiple languages is an asset.

Salary and benefits:


  • Competitive base salary, plus annual bonus;
  • Employer contribution to a deferred profit-sharing plan (DPSP) ;
  • Hybrid model (office work 3 days / week) ;
  • Medical, dental and life insurance as well as short- and long-term disability insurance plans as of day one ;
  • Professional development opportunities, such as support for CFA designation.

Our mission is to provide a supportive and inclusive environment where all individuals can maximize their full potential.

We thank all candidates for applying. However, only those selected for interviews will be contacted.


*****************************************************************


Emploi basé à Montreal

Letko, Brosseau & Associés compte parmi les principaux gestionnaires de placements mondiaux indépendants du Canada. Fondée en 1987, la société offre une gamme diversifiée de solutions de placement à une clientèle canadienne et internationale. Nous croyons que notre vision des affaires jumelée à une approche de recherche fondamentale, une culture reposant sur des bases éthiques solides et un engagement fiduciaire prioritaire envers nos clients expliquent notre croissance et notre réussite à long terme. Par des interventions actives et soutenues auprès des sociétés dans lesquelles nous investissons, nous tâchons de contribuer à des changements positifs tout en procurant un rendement élevé à nos clients.

Letko, Brosseau & Associés est à la recherche de personnes qualifiées pour postuler au poste d’Analyste en Investissement.

La fonction consiste à développer des connaissances approfondies sur une ou plusieurs industries et sur leurs sociétés cotées en bourse, dans le but ultime d’aider à identifier les investissements appropriés pour les clients de l’entreprise.

La nature du travail est minutieuse et axée sur le long terme. Les analystes établissent un ensemble de prévisions et produisent des modèles d'évaluation aboutissant à des recommandations d'investissement et, finalement, à des investissements de portefeuille. La portée du travail est mondiale, car elle comprend l'analyse des tendances mondiales de l'industrie ainsi que l'examen des entreprises opérant dans différentes zones géographiques.

Les candidats retenus se joignent à l’équipe de recherche de Letko Brosseau, un groupe de professionnels de l’investissement hautement talentueux et expérimentés dotés d’une profonde expertise du secteur et d’une grande curiosité. Les analystes en investissement ont la possibilité de contribuer à la croissance et au succès de l’entreprise non seulement grâce à leurs propres recommandations de portefeuille, mais également en participant aux décisions d’investissement à l’échelle de l’équipe.



Principales responsabilités:

  • Fournir des recommandations d'investissement pour les titres dans le secteur couvert;
  • Maintenir des modèles à jour et proposer des modifications à la pondération de leur portefeuille et recommander des modifications à la composition du portefeuille si nécessaire;
  • Rencontrer régulièrement les dirigeants des sociétés cotées en bourse, visiter leurs opérations et faire preuve de diligence raisonnable sur les opportunités d’investissement;
  • Développer une filière d’opportunités d’investissement potentielles.
  • Collaborer avec le département du Service à la clientèle et du Développement des affaires afin de répondre aux questions des clients, à recueillir des données et à préparer des présentations, du matériel promotionnel et des communications;
  • Examiner les procurations et déterminer comment elles devraient être votées conformément aux Directives de vote par procuration du département de la Gestion de portefeuille;
  • Participer activement aux réunions de l'équipe de Gestion d'investissement.


Profil recherché:


  • Baccalauréat ;
  • MBA ou M.Sc. en finances ou autre domaine pertinent ;
  • Entre 2 et 5 ans d’expérience professionnellle ;
  • Titulaire de la charte CFA ᴹᴰ (un atout);
  • Expérience professionnelle ou intérêt dans les industries de la technologie de l’information, des services financiers, secteur de la santé ou secteur de l'énergie (un atout);
  • Expérience dans d’autres secteurs d’activité est également considérée;

Le candidat idéal possède:


  • Une passion pour l’investissement et un intérêt pour les marchés financiers.
  • Une grande curiosité et un désir d’apprendre sur le monde qui nous entoure.
  • Un esprit entrepreneurial et autonome, capable de travailler parfois sous supervision minimale.
  • Une excellente capacité de recherche et de débrouillardise dans l’acquisition d’information.
  • Un haut niveau de jugement, une excellente capacité d’analyser de manière critique et indépendante une grande quantité d’information pour prendre des décisions d’investissement judicieuses.
  • Une excellente éthique de travail, discipline et constance dans l’application des principes d’investissement.
  • Les connaissances techniques nécessaires à l’analyse de compagnies et d’opportunités d’investissement.
  • Une attention méticuleuse aux détails et d’excellentes compétences analytiques.
  • Une bonne capacité à travailler en équipe.
  • D’excellentes compétences en communication et en présentation (orales et écrites).
  • Le multilingue (français / anglais et/ou autres langues) est un atout.
    • La connaissance de l'anglais est requise afin de communiquer efficacement avec les employés et les partenaires d'affaires de nos bureaux de Toronto et de Calgary. Le poste demande également la capacité de communiquer avec des dirigeants d'entreprises provenant de différents pays; la connaissance de plusieurs langues constitue donc un atout.


Salaire et avantages sociaux :


  • Salaire de base compétitif, plus bonus annuel ;
  • Contribution de l'employeur à un régime de participation différée aux bénéfices (RPDB);
  • Modèle hybride (travail au bureau 3 jours par semaine) ;
  • Régimes d'assurance médicale, dentaire et vie ainsi que d'assurance invalidité de courte et longue durée à partir du premier jour ;
  • Opportunités de développement professionnel, telles que le soutien pour l'obtention de la désignation CFA.

Notre mission est de fournir un environnement favorable et inclusif où tous les individus peuvent maximiser leur plein potentiel.

Nous remercions tous les candidats pour leur candidature. Toutefois, seuls les candidats sélectionnés pour les entrevues seront contactés.

title: Senior Regulatory Quality Program Manager
description:
Join the transformative team at City of Hope, where we're changing lives and making a real difference in the fight against cancer, diabetes, and other life-threatening illnesses. City of Hope’s growing national system includes its Los Angeles campus, a network of clinical care locations across Southern California, a new cancer center in Orange County, California, and treatment facilities in Atlanta, Chicago and Phoenix. our dedicated and compassionate employees are driven by a common mission\: To deliver the cures of tomorrow to the people who need them today.

** This is a Fully Remote Opportunity within the United States**

Position Summary\:

The Senior Regulatory Quality Program Manager is responsible for ensuring the organization complies with regulatory requirements through quality performance measurement, data integrity, and EHR-enabled reporting programs. This position will support enterprise regulatory quality programs, including development and implementation of EHR-aligned workflows, data capture processes, and performance measurement frameworks. Responsible for staying up to date with federal and state regulatory requirements and translating requirements into quality measure specifications, reporting logic, and data capture workflows within the EHR and analytics platforms. This position provides the connection between healthcare clinical federal and state regulatory programs, EHR systems, data structures, and regulatory quality performance outcomes.

The Senior Regulatory Quality Program Manager is responsible for leading and coordinating enterprise-level programs that support regulatory compliance, quality performance reporting, regulatory measurement, and EHR-enabled compliance programs across City of Hope. This role operates in close partnership with executive leadership to support enterprise-wide regulatory strategy, program execution, and performance oversight.

As a successful candidate, you will\:

Regulatory Quality Metrics, Data, and Program Execution\:

Serves as a subject matter expert in healthcare regulatory programs, including CMS quality reporting and interoperability requirements, with a primary focus on quality performance measurement and data integrity. Monitors evolving federal and state regulatory requirements and translates these into regulatory measure specifications, reporting logic, and EHR-aligned data capture workflows.

Coordinates the planning, implementation, and execution of regulatory programs (e.g., MIPS, eCQMs, registry-based submissions), ensuring accurate, timely, and compliant reporting. Evaluates the operational and financial impact of regulatory performance and supports optimization of data capture, documentation, and reporting processes.

Partners with Quality Analytics, Clinical Operations, and Information Technology teams to align EHR workflows, data structures, and report outputs with regulatory requirements. Provides guidance and education to stakeholders on measure definitions, documentation standards, and regulatory program expectations. Ensures measurable outcomes through consistent tracking of performance metrics, reporting deliverables, and program milestones.

Quality Performance Measurement, Validation, and Improvement\:

  • Leads ongoing evaluation of regulatory quality measure performance, including data completeness, accuracy, and alignment between clinical workflows and reporting requirements. Validates measure logic, including numerator/denominator integrity, inclusion/exclusion criteria, and data mapping across EHR and reporting systems.

  • Analyzes complex performance data to identify gaps, variation, and opportunities for improvement, and recommends EHR build changes, workflow modifications, and documentation enhancements to improve measure performance and reporting accuracy.

  • Coordinates data collection and abstraction activities across assigned resources to support regulatory submissions, including prioritization of work, issue resolution, and alignment to measure specifications and timelines. Collaborates with clinical, operational, and analytics stakeholders to resolve discrepancies and ensure consistency in reported data.

  • Develops and maintains documentation of regulatory measure logic, data definitions, workflows, and reporting processes to support validation, auditability, and sustainable program execution. Supports clinical leadership in operationalizing regulatory quality programs and performance improvement initiatives aligned with organizational goals.

  • Follows established City of Hope and department policies, procedures, objectives, performance improvement, attendance, safety, environmental, and infection control guidelines, including adherence to the workplace code of Conduct and Compliance Plan.

  • Practices a high level of integrity and honesty in maintaining confidentiality.

  • Performs other related duties as assigned or requested.

title: Operational System Controls Associate
description:
Hyundai Capital America (HCA) helps people move forward. Through Hyundai Motor Finance, Genesis Finance, and Kia Finance, we deliver innovative financing, leasing, and insurance solutions to more than 3 million customers and businesses nationwide.

We’re a company driven by growth, innovation, and people. At HCA, you’ll find opportunities to build new skills, expand your career, and make a real impact—while working in a diverse, inclusive, and values‑driven environment. We’re proud to support our communities through volunteerism, philanthropy, and engaged Employee Resource Groups.

If you’re looking for a fast‑paced, collaborative workplace where your ideas matter, join us as we lead the future of financing freedom of movement. Apply today.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

The Operational System Controls Associate is responsible for supporting the daily execution of the testing and monitoring of key controls to ensure that HCA systems comply with applicable company Policies and Procedures. This role is responsible for supporting activities around root-cause analysis sessions, development of system solutions and implementation of developed solutions.

HOW YOU WILL MAKE AN IMPACT

title: Account Supervisor
description:
ABOUT THE AGENCY:

David&Goliath is an agency that adheres to one simple philosophy: Brave. To be brave, to inspire people and brands to take on their goliaths. To create lasting impact that the world can feel and truly embrace. This is our purpose and for over two decades, we have never wavered from it. We are not made for everyone. We are made for the few who believe that purpose isn't just a business proposition, but a way of life. And for those who believe we can achieve the unthinkable, together. David&Goliath is a collaborative, empathetic, and team-oriented culture that believes in taking on challenges that others might walk away from. Because, the truth is, nobody ever became great without first being brave.

Who we are looking for

We’re seeking a creative, collaborative thinker, and a buttoned up Account Supervisor that doesn’t shy away from a challenge. This person should have a team-oriented attitude, be pro-active and have a strong voice to manage and lead their projects. This person should not wait for projects to be assigned, but should be comfortable digging into the clients’ business to help elicit success and growth. A successful Account Supervisor will work hard, laugh along the way and be proud of the work delivered.

Role

The role of the Account Supervisor is to:

  • Flawlessly manage the day-to-day running of the account in order to ensure the delivery of great, effective work

  • Be responsible for delivering against the direction set by the Account Lead

  • Acquire in-depth knowledge of the client’s business: structure, objectives, obstacles, competitive, industry trends, etc.

  • Build relationships with key clients, internal teams and external partners

  • Ensure that the execution of all creative solutions are met on time and on budget

  • Oversee and mentor junior members of the Account Management team

Responsibilities

Specifically, the responsibilities of the Account Supervisor are as follows:

  • Day-to-day management and administration of the account

  • Manage weekly status report and lead client status meeting

  • Ensure internal teams are clear on daily tasks

  • Manage the client budget and billing

  • Write and distribute contact reports for all meetings

  • Manage development of presentation materials

  • Maintain and ensure all assets are being housed in an organized manner.

  • Develop a meaningful relationship with clients by being knowledgeable of the client’s business, the competition and audience.

  • Make it your business to know everything always happening on your account, at the client and internally

  • Contribute strategically to the account in a meaningful way

  • Ensure the proper information is collected from the client at the beginning of a project. Ask questions if something is missing that will impact a solid creative brief.

  • Partner with Strategic Planning on briefs and comms plans development

  • Contribute to the team’s thinking about the brand and help build strategic arguments

  • Be a competitive center of excellence for the team at all times. Stay current on what the competition is doing from an advertising and marketing perspective.

  • Pave the way for great creative ideas to flourish

  • Work with Production and Project Management to develop project schedules and budgets

  • Develop assignment briefs for projects that do not require a new creative brief

  • Support in the creative development process; be comfortable running projects independently

  • Help creative teams by providing any insight they need to successfully develop work throughout the entire process

  • Manage the Client’s compliance and legal requirements

  • Oversee production of all projects, independently and confidently

  • Develop and manage junior team members; establish goals and ensure they are given the opportunity to grow

  • Mentor junior members of the team on a daily basis, providing them the support they need

  • Manage the annual review process for junior members of the team

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of agency experience, preferably at a creatively driven agency

  • Must have strong broadcast production experience; knowledge of print and digital a plus

  • Strong, entrepreneurial spirit and drive

  • Must have stamina, even under severe time pressure. Possess the ability to always remain cool and calm, setting an example for those around you.

  • Excellent communication skills

  • Proactive, strong problem solving skills, detail oriented

  • Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) preferred

Video Submission Link (1 min. max); show us why you're brave! We're not looking for the highest quality editing, just good content.

The role is based in Los Angeles, CA.

Please note: This role requires someone to be onsite in the D&G office 3 days per week — Tuesdays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays. Some on-set production and occasional travel may also be required.

The base salary is up to $105k plus benefits.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law. We are committed to providing an inclusive and accessible workplace where all employees can thrive.

title: Metal Finishing Technician - 1st Shift (Mon-Thurs, 5am-3:30pm)
description:
Join a team where craftsmanship and attention to detail make a difference every day. As a Metal Finishing Technician, you'll play a vital role in producing high-quality components by performing grinding, polishing, buffing, and surface finishing operations to meet exact specifications. Your work will directly impact the quality, appearance, and performance of industry-leading products.

Run production jobs on multi-axis CNC milling/grinding/lathe, injection molding, induction, multiple grinders, or other various types of semi-automated equipment or manually adjust final product per written or verbal work instructions to produce quality parts while maintaining productivity standards.

Inspect product for quality throughout production run using a variety of measuring tools such as a caliper, micrometer, comparator, laser Keyence, profilometer, a variety of gauges, etc., record inspection findings, and write detailed downtime and other shift communications in a log book.

Read work orders and blueprints to identify appropriate specifications for machine setup and product quality. Review work orders to ensure bill of materials are accurate and all inventory transactions are performed correctly.

Perform offsets to the program and adjustments to the machine feed, speed, and axis points to ensure part specification and quality standards are maintained as necessary. Complex issues beyond basic offsets or equipment adjustments are reported to higher level for problem-solving.

Troubleshoot minor or major machine issues by diagnosing breakdowns, disassembling equipment, and replacing, resetting, and sharpening machine tooling as necessary depending on assigned area.

Perform machine set ups including, but not limited to, changing fixtures, tooling bars, dies, and selecting and loading the program.

Perform general machine maintenance such as cleaning the machine, checking oil and coolant levels, and adding additional oil and coolant as necessary.

Report accurate count of production parts, scrap, and labor hours by completing required paperwork and/or electronic entry.

Comply with established 6S standards and participate in various lean manufacturing activities to improve products, reduce waste, or learn new skills or operations.

Cross-train by rotating to different machines and work areas as required.

Perform all other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

High School Diploma or equivalent preferred.
Three years of experience in grinding and polishing metal.
Knowledge in operating CNC, milling, grinding, or injection molding machines preferred.
Must be able to read, write, speak, and understand basic English.
Ability to demonstrate basic math and computer skills and perform visual quality inspections.
Ability to learn, problem-solve, and make decisions per work instructions and documents.

Physical Demand Requirements
​Occasionally required to stand, walk or sit; use hands to finger, handle or feel objects, tools or controls; reach with hands and arms; climb stairs; balance; stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl; talk or hear; taste or smell. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move objects up to 35 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by the job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.

title: FACILITY MAINTENANCE TECH (Open to Tooele City 1st Class Volunteer  and Senior Status Firefighters Only)
description:
FIRE STATION FACILITY MAINTENANCE TECHNCIAN

(Open to Tooele City 1st Class Volunteer and Senior Status Firefighters Only)

$25.25/hour; Flexible Work Hours; Approximately 3 to 5 Hours Per Week

Tooele City is accepting applications from existing Tooele City 1st Class and Senior Status Volunteer Firefighters for a part-time, variable hour position as a Fire Station Facility Maintenance Technician.

You will support our fire department by performing routine organization, cleaning, and general maintenance and repair of assigned buildings and/or building areas. Some of the more typical duties include:

  • Sweeping, mopping, vacuuming, wiping and sanitizing, dusting, emptying trash, cleaning restrooms, and similar cleaning duties.
  • Purchasing and stocking supplies such as toilet paper, paper towels, soap, cleaning products, salt or snow melts.
  • Performing semi-skilled duties relating to the preventative and corrective maintenance of fire stations including basic plumbing, changing light bulbs, basic carpentry, changing air filters, repairing door and fixture hardware, leaking faucets or hose fixtures, exercise equipment repair and servicing, and similar tasks. Coordinating with the City's facilities maintenance team and/or vendors for work orders or other skilled needs.
  • Moving furniture, tables, equipment, and supplies as needed.
  • Removing water, snow, and/or ice from exterior entrances and walkways, walking surfaces, and stairs as needed to ensure safety.
  • Maintaining service and maintenance records.
  • Communicating issues or problems with the Chief.

You will also be responsible for coordinating deep cleaning needs and may be assigned to be present at department community events for trash removal or other maintenance duties.

Required qualifications:

  • Knowledge of cleaning products, techniques, and equipment.
  • Skill in general maintenance tasks.
  • Self initiative and ability to work independently with limited supervision.
  • Ability to perform physical requirements of the job.
